title: Account Director, Channel Sales
descriptionHtml:
Hi, we're TechnologyAdvice.

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, TechnologyAdvice helps millions of B2B technology buyers make smarter decisions by providing trusted research, practical guidance, and connections to the world's leading technology brands. Our work spans 30+ media brands and 50+ newsletters, supported by a global team across the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, Australia, and the Philippines.

We're a remote-first company that values curiosity, collaboration, and growth. We invest in our people, embrace AI and new technologies to improve how we work, and create opportunities for team members to build meaningful careers. Many of our leaders have grown from within, including our CEO, who started here as an intern.

We believe great work happens when people feel connected. Through company all-hands, team events, Slack communities, learning sessions, and in-person gatherings, we create intentional opportunities for our global team to collaborate, build relationships, and celebrate successes together.

All positions are open to remote work unless otherwise specified in the requirements below. 

The opportunity

Channel Insider, part of TechnologyAdvice, is looking for an experienced Account Director to become the first dedicated EMEA channel sales specialist within our growing EMEA business.

This is a rare opportunity to step into a senior, highly visible, first feet on the ground role with the mandate to help shape, launch, and scale Channel Insider’s EMEA commercial presence. You will join TechnologyAdvice at an exciting stage of growth, with the backing of an established global business, a strong brand portfolio, proven demand generation capabilities, and a leadership team committed to building something meaningful in the EMEA channel market.

This is a senior, quota-carrying role with ownership of the full sales cycle. You will identify and develop high-value client relationships, engage senior marketing and channel decision-makers, uncover commercial challenges, and position tailored solutions across digital brand, content, events, audience engagement, and demand generation.

The successful candidate will be someone who knows the channel ecosystem, understands how vendors and partners go to market, and can bring credibility, confidence, and commercial energy into senior client conversations.

While you will be accountable for your own revenue number, you will not be building in isolation. You will have the support of TechnologyAdvice’s senior leadership, client success, delivery, marketing, StudioA, product, sales enablement, SDRs, and the wider global business. This is a role for someone who wants ownership, visibility, pace, and the opportunity to make a genuine mark on a developing market.

Location: United Kingdom

What you'll do

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive account/territory plan 
  • Grow channel accounts both in terms of their finite number and their annual value 
  • Prospect effectively, organizing your time, and deliver professional and memorable sales pitches to new prospects and existing contacts to achieve quota. 
  • Create and execute key sales and business development strategies to increase pipeline
  • Conduct market research to identify selling possibilities and evaluate customer needs. 
  • Create personalized, compelling value propositions around TechnologyAdvice’s channel offerings and deliver appropriate proposals that accurately describe those products and set proper expectations. 
  • Negotiate and close deals, handle objections and challenges, and manage annual contract negotiations 
  • Remain current on industry trends, market activities, and competitors. 
  • Collaborate with client success to ensure best-in-class service that maximizes repeat business and high regard.

Who you are

  • An outcomes-oriented channel salesperson with 3+ years of experience selling marketing solutions to or with IT channel marketing and executive leadership.
  • Proven track record in winning brand-to-demand, demand generation and digital media campaigns, driving substantial revenue growth through both incumbent and net new accounts.
  • Unrelenting drive and competitive spirit, consistently thriving in high-pressure environments
  • Ability to successfully craft and implement sophisticated account/territory plans with long-term growth objectives
  • Experience with MDF, Co-op, and other vendor reimbursement-funded models.
  • Skilled in diagnosing client needs and designing tailored high-impact business solutions
  • Demonstrated success in negotiating complex contracts, ensuring win-win outcomes
  • Deep expertise in brand-to-demand, demand generation, and digital media
  • Ambitious, fresh-thinking, confident, and inquisitive
  • Agile professional who excels in a fast-paced environment and thrives on continuously pivoting strategies to drive business needs forward

What we offer you

  • Career Growth: Advance with mentorship programs, leadership academies, and opportunities to shape company culture and DEI initiatives.
  • Flex Fridays: Adjust your 40-hour week to enjoy a full or half day off on Fridays.
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from the comfort of your home.
  • Private Health & Dental Insurance: Comprehensive coverage, including discounted gym memberships and additional perks.
  • Paid Time Off: Start with 25 days of holiday per year, with an additional day added for each year of service.
  • Parental Leave: Supportive maternity and paternity leave policies.
  • Salary Sacrifice Nursery Benefit: Save on childcare costs with our tax-efficient program.
  • Life Assurance: Peace of mind with coverage to protect your loved ones.
  • Pension Plan: Invest in your future with our competitive pension scheme.
  • Employee Assistance Program: Access free counseling and other support services.
  • Wellness Perks: Access the Headspace app to support your well-being.
  • Speaker Series Bonus: Present in our monthly speaker series and earn a bonus.

#LI-Remote

Work authorization

Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United Kingdom at hire and must maintain authorization to work in the United Kingdom throughout their employment with our company.

Salary Range
We seek to hire top-tier individuals and intend for our compensation to be at a rate that allows us to recruit and retain individuals who align with our core values, purpose, mission, and vision. Final total compensation is based on a multitude of factors including, but not limited to, skill level, relevant experience to the position, and cost of labor.

title: Account Director
descriptionHtml:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

Role: Account Director (6 Month FTC)

Location: London/ Slough, United Kingdom (2-3 days a week from our Client's Slough Offices)

About the role:

As Account Director, working within our client, & global FMCG business; you are the trusted day-to-day partner for client and the person who keeps complex, multi-platform projects on track. You'll work closely with strategy, creative, production and account colleagues to turn briefs into effective campaigns, with a strong focus on social media and digital content. You'll be accountable for delivery, client satisfaction and project profitability across several projects at once.

What you will be doing:

  • Build a collaborative, trusted relationship with client stakeholders, acting as their first point of contact and protecting the brand across every project.
  • Stay close to the client to understand their needs, anticipate issues and resolve them early.
  • Be accountable for integrated creative projects from brief to fulfilment, maintaining client satisfaction throughout.
  • Work with strategy and account colleagues to shape social strategy and milestones for the client.
  • Agree campaign scope with the client, then produce estimates and timing plans in our internal scheduling system, including for complex, cross-platform social projects.
  • Schedule projects against the right internal resource and help source external resource where needed.
  • Partner with digital, video, photography and print producers to bring the right skills together for integrated campaigns.
  • Keep projects on process, on time and on budget, motivating and coordinating teams through tight deadlines.
  • Be responsible for the financial health of your projects, including profitability, forecasting accuracy and fee discussions. Make sure everyone understands the cost impact of delays, extra amends and re-briefs.
  • Report on project income accurately and on time, and escalate invoicing or estimate queries to senior account and business leadership.
  • Evaluate project results, both qualitative and quantitative, against the original objectives.
  • Guide internal stakeholders through production processes, and spot and act on ad hoc opportunities as they arise.

What you need to be great in this role:

  • Experience managing digital and integrated campaigns in a creative or production agency, with a strong record of delivering across multiple platforms, particularly social media.
  • Ideally FMCG experience
  • Proficient to expert capability in Account Management and Project Management, with confidence running several complex projects at once.
  • Experience working alongside video and photography producers as part of a joined-up approach to campaign delivery.
  • Experience with project scheduling and sourcing resource and production services.
  • Strong client engagement skills, with the ability to organise, influence and build effective working relationships.
  • Clear, courteous communication across strategy, creative, production and client teams.
  • Close attention to detail, sound commercial awareness and a sharp eye for project risk.
  • Comfort integrating with a client-side team while maintaining a top-tier agency service.
  • Nice to have: experience creating content for CMS and e-commerce platforms.
  • Advanced use of Gen AI tools relevant to account management to improve output quality and efficiency
  • Experience designing AI-assisted workflows for yourself and your team
  • Agentic thinking for complex, multi-step challenges
  • Strong understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, with rigorous human oversight

2757 -Account Director, SEO - GCS

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com

We are designed for the new communications economy — built on data & technology, built for people & algorithms, built around diverse schools of thought, built to test & learn at scale, and, crucially, built to evolve. 

Role Summary and Impact

We are looking for a driven and strategic International SEO Account Director to help shape and deliver the SEO and GEO strategy for Honda Motor Group across the EMEA region. This is a great opportunity to support building a new international search programme from the ground up, establishing best-in-class ways of working and evolving it into a high-impact, scalable model for one of the world’s most recognisable automotive brands.

As a senior member you will be responsible for owning operational excellence within the team and for ensuring organisational effectiveness by managing and organising the team's output. This is key role for the international team with client-facing responsibilities and exposure to senior stakeholders both internally and externally.

A great opportunity for someone looking to step up and get exposure into more senior roles.

Skills and Experience

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

Role specific:

  • Minimum 5+ years SEO experience with proven experience in SEO onsite and offsite and technical SEO for leading brands
  • Ability to juggle several tasks at once and consistently to deliver high-quality work to timescale
  • Understanding of Generative Search Optimisation (GSO) and AI-driven discovery, including optimisation for LLMs , AI Overviews, and conversational search interfaces
  • Experience using and interpreting LLM visibility and tracking tools and defining next-generation KPIs beyond rankings .
  • Ability to translate traditional SEO strategies into AI-first search environments, including structured data, entity optimisation, E-E-A-T, and content designed for synthesis by generative engines.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, delivering high-quality outputs to deadline in a fast-paced environment
  • Skilled in identifying growth and innovation opportunities, including those outside scope, and confidently pitching these to internal and client stakeholders
  • Proactive in anticipating challenges in a rapidly changing search landscape, and developing strategic, forward-looking solutions
  • Knowledge in SEO and analytics tools, including GA4, Search Console, crawling tools, ranking platforms, and emerging AI search monitoring tools
  • Understanding of web technologies and architecture (CMS platforms, rendering, indexing, site performance, APIs, structured data)
  • Ability to create compelling strategic narratives, including client proposals, that incorporates AI/search evolution with the support of Business Directors
  • Strong communication, influencing, and negotiation skills, with the ability to simplify complex AI/search concepts for non-technical stakeholders

Essential personal qualities:

  • Highly motivated and able to work and learn independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to take responsibility for own work and to make sure that others deliver in support of you
  • Flexibility - willingness to pick up tasks for others
  • Quick to learn, and keen to develop
  • Attention to detail

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: Account Executive, Affiliate Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Position: Account Specialist, Affiliate Marketing  

The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Please note: This role requires fluency in both German and English.

The Role:  

As an Account Specialist, you will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of multiple affiliate programs. The ideal candidate will have 1-2 years of work experience. Affiliate marketing experience is not required. You will manage affiliate communications, reporting, and general account maintenance, including recruitment, newsletters, fraud checks, and data analysis. You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth. Duties are performed across one or more assigned client accounts, which will vary over time.

Top 5 Responsibilities:  

  • Account & Client Communication  
    Build and maintain client and affiliate communications, including creative newsletters and updates about promotions, program developments, and general client information. Develop relationships with clients and partners to understand their goals and objectives, providing clear and proactive communication across channels.  
  • Reporting & Data Management  
    Utilize Excel (pivot tables, v-lookups, etc.) to produce detailed reports, track performance, and analyze data for insights and trends. Summarize findings and provide actionable recommendations to optimize program performance. Proactively track key metrics and report on campaign performance.  
  • Strategy Execution & Task Ownership  
    Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Prioritize tasks effectively, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Consistently leverage tools and client tracking platforms to support program goals.  
  • Program & Portfolio Management  
    Manage multiple affiliate campaigns, maintaining a balanced focus across each, and organizing tasks by priority. Identify areas for process improvement, and provide proactive support to peers and clients. Manage risks, track fraud, and ensure compliance with program terms and conditions.  
  • Team Collaboration & Growth  
    Collaborate with peers and management to contribute ideas for process improvements and training. Serve as a resource for peers and help drive continuous improvement across the team, sharing best practices and insights.  

What Success Looks Like:  

By 6 Months:  

  • You will be proficient in the day-to-day operations of multiple affiliate programs, including managing reporting, affiliate applications, recruitment, and creative asset deployment.  
  • You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance, ensuring regular fraud checks and compliance.  
  • You will have developed strong relationships with clients and affiliates and will be able to execute tasks with minimal guidance.  

By 1 Year:  

  • You will troubleshoot and resolve account and affiliate issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams.  
  • You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies.  
  • You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development.  

Qualities of the Ideal Candidate  

  • Strong sense of curiosity  
  • Critical thinker  
  • Confident and comfortable being uncomfortable  
  • Flexible, resilient, coachable  
  • Relationship and service oriented  
  • Proactive and outcome oriented  
  • Strong work ethic and personal standards  

Qualifications & Skills:  

  • Fluency in German
  • 1-2 years of experience- background in online marketing, e-commerce, or affiliate marketing beneficial.  
  • Familiarity with affiliate networks and SaaS platforms (e.g., ShareASale, Commission Junction, Impact) is a plus.  
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.  
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel (v-lookups, pivot tables, formatting, etc.).  
  • Knowledge of HTML is a plus.  
  • Ability to travel when necessary for conferences and team meetings.  

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?  

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content and B2B partnership marketing.   

AP Perks & Benefits - What we offer  

  • 100% remote work for everyone  
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off  
  • Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December  
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off  
  • Focus Fridays (no internal meetings)  
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits  
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowance  
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!  
  • Target salary range: £27–37K depending on location and experience  

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.

title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
We're unlocking access to the NHS, because healthcare is not truly free until it's truly accessible 💙

The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. But the largest healthcare provider is fundamentally broken. Patient satisfaction is at an all time low, and the biggest reason cited is lack of access. So we’re on a mission to fix it with technology that actually works.

We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI.

We're developing critical national infrastructure. Today, 26% of GP practices in England use our patient registration software, while one in five GP practices in London use Bookable Search to help new patients find and book appointments seamlessly.

Our latest product, Bookable Navigator, extends this vision by automatically booking appointments for existing patients.

We operate from within a working GP practice in East London 🏥 We're backed by Y Combinator, Innovate UK and the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Programme, and were previously ranked the 8th fastest-growing startup in the UK and 33rd fastest-growing in Europe 🚀

⛩️ Our Principles

Exciting challenges lie ahead. Guided by our principles, we’ll meet these challenges with a thoughtful and caring approach. These principles drive everything we do at Healthtech-1:

  1. 💙 Care deeply

  2. 🏋️‍♀️ Work hard

  3. 🤝 Be your word

  4. 💬 Trust in radical truth and transparency

  5.  🚀 Do your life's best work

  6. 🥳 Find the fun

Read more about our principles and our "why" in the Healthtech-1 Handbook.

🚀 The mission

We have an ambitious mission: to unlock access to healthcare by navigating patients to the right place, first time. We’re going to create a world where every appointment is transparent and bookable, starting in General Practice. We're the team to do this - We were previously ranked 8th fastest growing startup in UK and 33rd fastest in Europe.

We are hiring Account Executives to help us get in front of more practices. Your core focus will be on full cycle sales from lead generation to closing and onboarding practices.

You’ll be joining an ambitious sales team with prior experience at Monzo, Revolut, the Civil Service, the NHS, investment banking, consulting, and other VC-backed startups. Everyone works in pairs to own a geographic patch. We work in pairs because we believe it encourages peer learning and healthy team culture.

Progression works across three dimensions:

  1. Closing bigger deals (larger ACV)

  2. Selling more advanced products

  3. Training/ coaching other members of the team

This is a place to do your life’s best work.

🎯 Goal expectations

Our mission is to unlock access to healthcare. You will contribute by increasing appointment supply. This is achieved through selling more products to more practices.

Objective 1: Convert new practices

  • You will own a geographical patch and do everything it takes to get at least 10 live practices a week.

  • You will hone your craft until you achieve a 70% demo-to-sign rate (demo conversion rate) and a 90% sign-to-live rate (funnelling).

  • You will represent the voice of Healthtech-1 and take pride and care in every interaction with practices.

Objective 2: Generate leads

  • You will create and implement high impact lead gen strategies (e.g. cold calling, email campaigns, events, field sales, referrals, etc.).

  • You will generate high quality leads using storytelling, data, and research.

  • You will fill a personal calendar of demos.

Objective 3: Improve team performance

  • You will improve team processes on a weekly basis.

  • You will bring happy conflict in a loving way, no artificial harmony.

  • You will help the team aim for a stretch target of 15 practices live per person per week.

  • You aim to delight practices in every interaction and leave practices with a great impression of Healthtech-1 regardless of if they buy or not.

⚠️ This role is not for everyone

This is a high-agency, high-expectation role in a fast-moving healthtech environment. You probably won’t enjoy this role if you:

  • Prefer to be told what to do over figuring out what to do

  • Need significant training and supervision to improve

  • Aren't comfortable with honest feedback

  • Don't want to constantly push your work rate

You will enjoy this role if you like owning your target and raising the bar around you.

"You'll be joining a focussed high growth team that have ambitions to help every single practice in the country, and won't stop until they do so. We're humble, low ego and care deeply about doing our life's best work. This will be a ride of a lifetime." -- Pete Huang, Cofounder & Growth Lead.

✅ Must-have traits

  • Bias to action - fearless with getting on the phone, bias to action, takes rejection well

  • Storyteller - High quality and persuasive incredible communicator internally and externally

  • Outcome driven - focus on the big picture and business goals

  • Coach-ability - strong internal communication, be able to take on feedback and adjust plan

  • Tech savvy - understand the stack; Attio etc

  • Team player - low personal ego, brings happy conflict, and improves ways of working

  • Clear communicator - communicates appropriately for the setting (e.g. concise or detailed as needed)

  • Hard working - will go above and beyond to unlock access to healthcare

  • Personable and refreshing - can build a relationship with a spoon, puts people at ease, makes them happy

  • Creative - looks beyond the past and present, looking for new high impact opportunities

👍 Required experience

  • 3+ years of sales experience

  • Worked in a fast paced startup environment

💙 A bit about us

💙 We’re all NHS staff. We’re inside-outsiders. Trusted with one of the biggest datasets in the world.

🏥 Our office is within a GP practice. This is our unfair advantage. Got a question? Pop down the corridor. Want to learn how your work affects real patients? Pop downstairs to reception.

💪🏼 4 days in the office and 1 day WFH (for most roles). We highly prioritise in-person communication and prefer candidates who want to work 4+ days a week in the office. Our anchor days are Mon, Tues, Thurs and Fri. Homemade breakfast and lunch are on the house every day when you're in the office, ensuring you're fuelled for success!

🌀 We work in growth cycles. Every 8 weeks we do the same set of activities. 1 week outside of Business-as-Usual to research, strategise, plan our work. 7 weeks to knuckle down and deliver it.

🤝 We’re highly collaborative. One of the benefits of a high trust team is we often work autonomously, but as a team we’re very collaborative by nature. Two heads are often better than one, and we frequently lean on each other to solve problems together.

🤜🏽 We’re backed by industry leaders. We’re on the DigitalHealth.London Accelerator, backed by the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Program, winners of the London Business School Healthtech Challenge, Innovate UK, and Y Combinator (S23).

🚀 An opportunity for real upside

descriptionHtml:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Ontdek hoe AI het ontwerpen van Werktuigbouwkundige en gebouwinstallaties slimmer, sneller en beter maakt.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • onderzoek waar AI het meeste waarde toevoegt in het ontwerp van gebouwinstallaties;

  • ontdek hoe slimme technologie ontwerp- en modelleerwerk efficiënter maakt;

  • ontwikkel en test een AI-oplossing binnen een praktijkproject;

  • breng kansen, risico's en randvoorwaarden van AI-toepassingen in kaart;

  • adviseer collega’s en management over de toekomst van AI binnen het ontwerpproces.

AI biedt veel kansen voor de installatietechniek, maar vraagt ook om een kritische blik. Tijdens deze afstudeerstage onderzoek je hoe AI ontwerp-, modelleer- en rapportagewerk slimmer en efficiënter maakt. Je verkent toepassingen voor onder meer het verwerken van ontwerpgegevens, het ondersteunen van modellen en het automatiseren van terugkerende werkzaamheden. Daarbij ontwikkel je minimaal één werkend prototype en beoordeel je ook belangrijke thema’s zoals betrouwbaarheid, dataveiligheid en wet- en regelgeving. Samen met adviseurs en modelleurs vertaal je jouw inzichten naar concrete oplossingen voor de praktijk.

Mogelijke onderzoeksrichtingen, waarvan je er in overleg één of twee kiest om uit te diepen:

  • Slim modelleren: AI-ondersteunde of geautomatiseerde modellering van installaties in Revit en Inventor, zoals het genereren van leidingtracés, het plaatsen van componenten of het automatisch controleren van modellen op clashes en ontwerpregels.

  • Automatisch rapporteren: het (deels) genereren van ontwerprapportages, bestekteksten of notities op basis van berekeningen, modeldata en projectdocumenten.

  • AI-agents in het ontwerpproces:een assistent die normen en projectdocumentatie doorzoekt, vragen beantwoordt met bronvermelding of meerdere stappen in een workflow zelfstandig uitvoert.

  • Van data naar ontwerp:het koppelen van berekeningssoftware, BIM-modellen en documentatie, zodat informatie niet meer handmatig hoeft te worden overgenomen.

  • je hebt kennis van of interesse in BIM-software zoals Revit of Inventor;

  • je volgt de ontwikkelingen in AI, hebt zelf al geëxperimenteerd met tools als ChatGPT, Copilot of Claude en kijkt er kritisch naar;

Daarnaast kun je elke tweede dinsdag van de maand aanschuiven bij het Café van de Toekomst: een inspiratiesessie waarbij je samen met je collega’s wordt bijgepraat over onderwerpen en projecten die in onze organisatie spelen. En dat is nog niet alles: je kunt gebruikmaken van onze eigen Academy met ruim 3.000 verschillende leerlijnen, trainingen en e-learningmodules.

Bij Movares werk je mee aan een uitdagende opdracht met volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Er hangt een leuke en gezellige sfeer. Binnen dit team werken werktuigbouwkundig adviseurs en modelleurs samen aan duurzame en toekomstbestendige installaties voor utiliteitsgebouwen, van stations tot kantoren en technische gebouwen. Je komt terecht in een open en betrokken werkomgeving waar kennis delen vanzelfsprekend is. descriptionHtml:

About The Opportunity

We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows.

We are seeking experienced native-speaking software engineers to design, build, and validate these benchmarks. You will create high-signal, high-quality tasks that genuinely test a model's ability to handle multilingual environments without relying on English translation crutches.

  • Task Engineering: Evaluating Coding Agents.

title: AI Engineer (LLM Products) - Remote
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to dexter health!!

At dexter health, we build AI-powered software for care teams. Our mission is to reduce administrative workload in healthcare so caregivers can spend more time with patients.

We are looking for a high-agency AI Engineer to help us build new AI features faster and improve the quality, reliability, and speed of existing AI workflows.

This is a hands-on engineering role. Not research. Not prompt-only. You will turn ambiguous product ideas into working, production-ready AI features.

The role is mostly focused on shipping AI product features, with some AI systems and infrastructure work where needed.

You will work closely with product and engineering, but we expect you to take real ownership. You should be comfortable moving fast, making technical decisions under ambiguity, and using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar every day.

Tasks

As our AI Engineer, you will:

  • Build new AI-powered product features from idea to production

  • Improve existing AI workflows for quality, reliability, latency, and user value

  • Design and implement LLM-based workflows, structured outputs, validation logic, and fallback behavior

  • Build evaluation loops, tests, and quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing product and backend systems

  • Work with commercial and open-source LLMs without being tied to one specific provider

  • Support self-hosted model workflows where they make sense for quality, speed, cost, or control

  • Debug AI feature failures across inputs, outputs, data, backend logic, and user flows

  • Use AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow

  • Ship quickly while keeping production quality high

Requirements

We care less about formal seniority and more about speed, intelligence, ownership, and product impact. We like people who operate with founder-like urgency: they figure things out, make progress under ambiguity, and care about outcomes more than titles.

Must-have

  • Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language

  • Experience building AI-powered product features or LLM-based workflows

  • Ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into working software quickly

  • Strong understanding of how to design, test, validate, and improve AI outputs

  • Experience integrating AI workflows into production systems

  • Strong debugging instincts across application logic, data, model outputs, and user-facing behavior

  • Experience with evaluation, testing, validation, or quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Serious experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as part of your daily workflow

  • High intelligence, fast learning speed, bias to action, and ownership mindset

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, fast decisions, and a high-trust startup environment

  • Clear written and spoken English

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with frontend or fullstack product development

  • Experience with self-hosted LLMs, model serving, inference optimization, or similar systems

  • Experience with open-source LLMs and related deployment workflows

  • Experience improving latency, cost, quality, or reliability of AI systems

  • Experience with healthcare software, healthcare data, or regulated environments

  • Experience working with structured data extraction, documentation automation, voice workflows, or workflow automation

  • German language skills

  • Knowledge of nursing homes or elderly care workflows

This role is probably not for you if

  • You are mainly looking for an ML research role

  • You are a prompt engineer without strong coding skills

  • You need detailed specifications before making progress

  • You prefer slow, highly structured corporate environments

  • You are mainly looking for management, not hands-on building

  • You want to use AI tools only occasionally instead of as part of your daily workflow

  • You optimize for perfect process over fast, reliable execution

Benefits

  • Remote work

  • Fair compensation based on skills, experience, and location

  • Ownership of important backend systems

  • Work on software used in real healthcare workflows

  • Modern AI-native development workflow

  • Room to grow with the company

Why?

Caregivers spend too much time on documentation, coordination, and administrative work. We build technology that reduces this burden.

AI is core to our product. But useful AI features do not come from demos alone. They need strong engineering, fast iteration, evaluation, production thinking, and deep ownership of the user outcome.

If you want to build AI product features that ship, improve real workflows, use AI tools every day, and take ownership in a fast-moving team, we would like to hear from you.

  • Design and build generative AI applications tailored to complex financial and legal workflows, leveraging state-of-the-art models to deliver innovative, practical solutions that streamline decision-making and unlock new efficiencies.

  • Be a proactive sharer of compelling ideas/work to the rest of the team and organisation. We want you to help lead/push the adoption of AI throughout 9fin.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Strong proficiency in Python for production ready delivery.

    • Recommendation systems and ranking: personalisation, learning-to-rank, feed ranking, user modelling, etc.

    • Tabular ML: feature engineering, structured data modelling (GBDTs, etc.)

    • Statistical & Predictive Modelling: supervised ML, anomaly detection, temporal modelling, etc.

    • Deep understanding of the GenAI landscape and agentic frameworks.

  • Experience working in the full model lifecycle (including experimentation, training, testing, monitoring, and deployment). We are data centric and love our evals!

  • You have a strong product focus with a desire to understand the end-to-end impact of your solutions for our end users.

  • Good knowledge of AWS’s AI infrastructure.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance 

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off 

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Hybrid working model, to allow you the flexibility to decide how, where and when you do your best work

Training & Culture

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

title: AI Engineering Intern
descriptionHtml:
At Light, we’re redefining how software is built, how it’s delivered, and how it works.

We’re building organic software. Software that heals itself. Software that adapts to the user and the business. Software that learns and gets better as it’s used.

Our starting point is finance. Companies including Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy already run on Light. We’re building towards a platform that understands how each business operates and evolves with it.

As an AI Engineering Intern, you’ll help make that happen: building systems that identify mistakes, improve their own behaviour, and prove those improvements work. You’ll work on the agents, models, and infrastructure that turn organic software into something customers can rely on.

Who this is for

You must meet both of these requirements:

  • Currently studying at University of Oxford, or University of Cambridge.

  • A silver medal or higher at the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) or International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI), or an equivalent level of achievement in another highly competitive endeavour.

If you’re applying with an equivalent achievement, explain the competition or field, your result, and the standard required to achieve it. If you’re at Oxford/Cambridge and you don’t have an equivalent level of achievement we encourage you to not apply.

Our bar for internships at Light is high. You will need the curiosity to explore unfamiliar areas, the willingness to go the extra mile to get things right, the discipline to test your assumptions, and the persistence to keep going when your first approach does not work.

What you’ll work on

You’ll have access to our repositories, real engineering problems, and an internal coding agent that already opens pull requests against production code. Your work will help make these systems more capable and reliable.

  • Help agents learn from their work. Our agent reviews merged pull requests and corrections to update its repository-specific instructions. You’ll shape that process, catch misleading lessons, and test whether new instructions improve its performance.

  • Train and deploy LLM and ML models. Fine-tune SoA LLM models. Run experiments, compare results against the existing pipeline, and establish whether a model is ready for production. Leverage ML tools to enhance the ability of our Agents via e.g. K-means, t-sne, PCA, random forest trees etc. etc.

  • Build Agents. Take full end to end ownership of an agent. Agent do pre-emptive support for the self-healing pipeline; they fix; they communicate with customers; etc.

  • Build evaluations and review tools. Define what a correct answer looks like, create tests that expose failures, and help catch poor output before it reaches customers.

  • Own projects through delivery. Scope the problem, build the solution, debug regressions, and follow through until the customer can rely on what you’ve shipped.

You’ll work alongside exceptional colleagues.

What else we’re looking for

  • Strong programming ability.

  • Something you’ve built beyond coursework or tutorials: a model, agent, tool, or application that does useful work.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tooling, such as LLM APIs, agent frameworks, model fine-tuning, or automated workflows.

  • A habit of investigating why a system failed and testing whether your fix addresses the cause.

  • Clear thinking and the ability to explain your decisions, including what you tried and why it didn’t work.

Open-source contributions, deployed models, and experience building evaluation pipelines are a plus.

How we’ll measure success

Your work should produce measurable improvements: more correct agent-generated changes, better model accuracy, fewer failures reaching users, or tools the team continues to use. You’ll help define those measures and use them to assess what you build.

What you’ll get

  • Internship compensation above the standard market rate.

  • A role based in our London office, working alongside the product and engineering team.

  • Ownership from your first day, with a path to shipping work into production.

How to apply

Send your CV.

Include a link to something you’ve shipped. Tell us what it does, which parts you built yourself, where it failed, and how you fixed it. Then explain why you want to work on organic software at Light.

We want to understand how you think, what you can build, and what you’re ready to take on next.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

title: AI-Native PHP/Laravel Developer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

title: AI Operations Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Nevoya:


Nevoya is North America's leading next-generation electric trucking carrier, transforming logistics through AI-native operations and relentless customer focus. The company builds and uses proprietary technology to deliver zero-emissions carrier services to Fortune 500 shippers with superior economics and service to legacy diesel operators. The company has operations in California and Texas, and is backed by globally-renowned investors including Lowercarbon Capital.

About the Role:

This is a foundational hire. You will do different aspects of dispatching in trucking — without needing any trucking experience. You’ll keep real freight moving for real customers: assigning loads, communicating with drivers, handling exceptions, and solving the problems of the day.

The reason this works is you. You are AI-native — AI is your default way of researching, troubleshooting, and getting work done — and you have the critical thinking to notice when the playbook is wrong and the initiative to propose the fix. You’ll work directly with engineering and product to automate the repetitive parts of the job, so the role keeps getting smarter.

You’ll get a lot of direction, coaching, and ownership early. Do this well and the role is a launchpad: people who build the operational foundation here will grow into bigger roles across the company.

What You’ll Do:

  • Run daily dispatch execution from our playbook: load assignment, driver communication, check-calls, and exception handling

  • Keep loads covered and customers informed, escalating with judgment when something can’t wait

  • Use AI tools daily to research, troubleshoot, draft, analyze, and automate your own work

  • Improve the playbook as you go — document what works, flag what doesn’t, and ship a better process every week

  • Call out problems early and come with proposed solutions, not just escalations

  • Partner with engineering and product to turn recurring manual work into automated workflows

  • Track the KPIs of your operation — load coverage, on-time performance, driver utilization — and use them to improve

What You’ll Bring:

  • A recent degree or 1–2 years of work experience — high-performing new grads encouraged to apply

  • Sharp critical thinking — you spot what’s broken, ask why, and bring a proposed answer

  • Hungry and coachable: you want direction, feedback, and a steep learning curve

  • Strong written and verbal communication — you’ll be talking to drivers, customers, and engineers in the same hour

  • Organized and calm under pressure; comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities

  • No trucking, logistics, or dispatch experience required

Nice to Have:

  • Internship or early experience in operations, logistics, supply chain, or a fast-moving startup

title: AI Platform engineer
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij de engineer die organisaties naar het volgende niveau tilt met de kracht van Microsoft Power Platform én AI? 

Join the journey!

Wat ga je doen?

Als AI Platform Engineer speel je een sleutelrol binnen het Microsoft Power Platform team van HSO: een snelgroeiende afdeling met een ondernemende mindset waarin jouw expertise noodzakelijk is om verder te kunnen groeien. Jij ontwerpt de fundamenten waarop klanten hun digitale transformatie bouwen — van datamodel tot beveiliging tot ALM — en zorgt dat AI-gedreven oplossingen betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en beheersbaar zijn. 

Jij bent vanaf de salesfase betrokken om samen met het beoogde klantteam de klant op weg te helpen met onze aanpak en propositie. Jij kunt in alle vrijheid platform- en AI-implementatietrajecten uitdenken en begeleiden. In sommige gevallen opereer je alleen, in andere gevallen gesteund door een ervaren en gemotiveerd team — waaronder de AI Platform Consultant, die het business probleem, het functional design en de user journeys aanlevert als basis voor jouw technisch ontwerp. 

Kerntaken: 

  • Je ontwerpt Dataverse-modellen en de bijbehorende security-architectuur (tabellen, relaties, business rules, rollen en rechten), inclusief de datagrondslag (grounding) waarop AI-agents veilig kunnen redeneren. 
  • Je kiest en onderbouwt het juiste patroon per vraagstuk: app, portal, workflow of AI-agent, en ontwerpt de technische architectuur van Copilot Studio-agents (topics, plugins, connectoren, Azure OpenAI-integratie). 
  • Je bepaalt de ALM- en omgevingsstrategie (dev/test/acceptatie/productie, pipelines, release management), inclusief versiebeheer en promotie van AI-agents en hun kennisbronnen. 
  • Je richt governance en beveiliging voor AI in: Data Loss Prevention-policies, tenant- en environment-instellingen voor Copilot Studio, en monitoring/observability van agentgedrag. 
  • Je beoordeelt en valideert AI-gegenereerde oplossingsontwerpen en -code op kwaliteit, security, kosten en schaalbaarheid, en stuurt bij waar nodig. 

Wat breng jij mee?

  • HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau. 
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie bij een IT-dienstverlener, consultancy of aan klantzijde. 
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwerpen van Dataverse-datamodellen en security-architectuur (rollen, teams, business units, field-level security). 
  • Ervaring met het afwegen en kiezen tussen app-, portal-, workflow- en agent-patronen (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Copilot Studio). 
  • Kennis van en ervaring met het definiëren van ALM- en omgevingsstrategieën (pipelines, solution management, environment strategy). 
  • Ervaring met het reviewen en valideren van (AI-gegenereerde) solution designs en code. 
  • Kennis van het technisch ontwerpen van AI-agents in Copilot Studio: topics, plugins, connectoren, grounding op Dataverse en integratie met Azure OpenAI/Azure AI Foundry. 
  • Kennis van AI-governance en beveiliging: Data Loss Prevention-policies, tenant-instellingen, monitoring en responsible AI-principes. 
  • Goede kennis van Power Platform-onderdelen (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Dataverse, Copilot Studio). 
  • Kennis van of ervaring met Microsoft Dynamics 365 (ERP & CRM) en Azure is een pre. 
  • Ervaring met multidisciplinaire teams (Solution Architecten, Project Managers). 
  • Ervaring als Lead Architect of Solution Architect met grote, complexe systemen, bij voorkeur met meerdere (Microsoft) platforms. 
  • Ervaring met Prince II & Agile/Scrum projectmethodieken 

Wat bieden we jou?    

Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  

  • Een competitief salaris en jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties; 
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt  
    voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten;  
  • Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens  
    je Workation;  
  • EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;  
  • Reiskostenvergoeding, 23 cent per kilometer; 
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;  
  • Telefoonabonnement & standaard telefoon of CYOD met bijbetaling of EUR 10,- netto per maand voor eigen telefoon;  
  • 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;  
  • Pensioen van BeFrank;  
  • En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma en daarna heeft onze HSO-Academy een leerreis voor je gedefinieerd;  
  • Je ontvangt ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.  


Over HSO     

HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

You’ll join the Security Engineering team, working alongside our cyber security leadership, architecture team and technical leaders across engineering. Our mission is to equip teams to build and innovate while upholding security best practice and protecting client data in the highly regulated energy sector.

  • Integrate security tooling and use AI to prevent, detect and respond to emerging threats

  • Work with senior technical leadership to shape our technical strategy and solutions architecture, so security, risk and compliance feed into technical decisions

  • Help product teams deliver secure systems quickly by building a strong security culture through mentoring, design reviews and training

  • Give product and engineering teams practical guidance on identifying, prioritising and mitigating systemic risks and vulnerabilities

  • Lead the evolution of our security best practice across application development and the wider SDLC, supporting teams with expert advice and automation

  • Influence technical and non-technical stakeholders across Kaluza and client teams

  • Mentor and coach security and software engineers to balance risk with speed and quality

  • Build relationships with third-party security vendors and industry bodies to keep us at the forefront of emerging practices, tooling and standards


What you’ll bring

  • Extensive experience mentoring engineers and collaborating closely (e.g. pairing, swarming)

  • Deep understanding of software security flaws and web application security best practice (OWASP Top 10, CWE/SANS Top 25)

  • Extensive knowledge of CI/CD and DevOps principles, and their security considerations

  • Experience applying AI in your own work and helping others build it safely into how they develop

  • Scripting skills and first-hand experience of software development at scale

  • Working knowledge of Okta or equivalent, to enable workforce identity and enforce access management policies

  • Awareness of AWS and/or GCP security best practice, and some experience with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform)

  • Experience applying architectural and software design patterns in a complex environment

You’ll also be:

  • Skilled at influencing upwards and outwards, with great communication skills

  • Able to set a clear vision for large-scale technical direction and align multiple teams behind it

  • Committed to a culture of learning and improvement, and willing to challenge engineering leadership to support it

Desirable: Identity and access management (Level 5), software development (Level 6), learning delivery (Level 3), and information assurance stepping up to Level 5


Our values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

title: Art Director
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

As the Art Director you will set the visual standard for the company's materials and produce them: product and capability collateral, presentations, exhibition and event graphics, digital and social assets, and the images that explain the systems themselves.

This is a role for someone who both directs and who is hands on. It spans print, digital, environmental and presentation design rather than specialising in one, and it serves the whole company - sales, government relations, recruitment and the executive team, not marketing alone.

It is also where visual consistency is held. External agencies, photographers, 3D artists and film-makers deliver into the UFORCE brand; the Art Director sets what they work to and judges what comes back. The standard is that everything the company puts in front of a customer reads as though it came from one place.

What you will do

  • Design the materials the company sells and speaks with: capability collateral, specification sheets, presentations, launch assets, digital and social graphics.

  • Help evolve the UFORCE visual system - typography, colour, layout, iconography and the treatment of platform imagery - and keep it documented well enough that others can work to it.

  • Turn technical material - system architectures, concepts of operation, platform diagrams - into images a non-specialist can understand.

  • Design exhibition and event graphics, from stand panels to printed handouts.

  • Art-direct photography, film and 3D work, on location and in review, so that commissioned material comes back usable and on-brand.

  • Active use of AI tools in how work is run and delivered, and an appetite to commission or build workflows that do not yet exist rather than wait for them.

  • Direct localisation of work across the company's markets.

  • Apply the company's security and export-control requirements to visual material, and route imagery of platforms, facilities and personnel for clearance before release.

Required Skills

  • Substantial experience as a Graphic designer or art director, in-house or in an agency, with a portfolio showing both range and finished craft across print, digital and environmental work.

  • Command of typography, hierarchy and composition, and a body of work that holds to a consistent system rather than a collection of one-off styles.

  • The ability to art-direct others - photographers, film-makers, illustrators, 3D artists - from written brief through review to delivery.

  • Deep fluency in Figma, the company's primary design environment: components, variants and shared libraries, not frames alone. Working knowledge of InDesign and Illustrator for print and large-format work.

  • Willingness to master Google Slides. Presentations are a primary sales instrument.

  • Experience making complex or technical subject matter legible, in any field - engineering, science, medicine, infrastructure or defence.

  • Eligibility to gain UK security clearance

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for defence, dual-use or engineering-led products

  • Technical illustration, diagramming or 3D

  • Motion design or video editing

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

title: Autonomy Engineer Intern, Autonomy Infrastructure, Systems and Tools, 2027 (Zurich)
descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role:

The core of our system is the computer vision algorithms that allow drones to understand the world around them. You will architect and implement the algorithms that run on every drone powered by Skydio as part of a world class computer vision and deep learning team with researchers who have pushed the state of the art in academia and industry.

As a Research Intern, you will be paired up with one or more members of our core software development team, assuming direct ownership of a project that meaningfully advances the capabilities of our team and products.

If you have a strong foundation in math, theory, and software development and you are interested in directly contributing to the development of the next generation of autonomy algorithms and pushing them into real products, we would love to hear from you.

 

Areas of Responsibility:

  • Design and build robust replay and analysis systems that enable engineers to inspect and reproduce recorded autonomy behavior, with fine-grained control over system state, perception outputs, and decision-making at every stage of the stack.

  • Develop scalable infrastructure for automated testing and failure triage, expanding our simulation and log-driven test coverage while accelerating root-cause analysis through automated log processing and diagnostics.

  • Operate at the interface between autonomy software and core robotics middleware, defining clear APIs, data contracts, and performance requirements for messaging, state propagation, and coordination across subsystems, while partnering closely with downstream teams to support their implementation and integration.

  • Design and implement high-quality developer infrastructure and tools that prioritize reliability, performance, and usability, enabling rapid iteration, safe experimentation, and sustained velocity across the autonomy organization.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead the design and implementation of scalable tools used across autonomy development and testing workflows.

  • Collaborate with autonomy, QA, and infrastructure teams to gather requirements, align on priorities, and deliver impactful tooling.

  • Build tools that streamline stages of the robotics development process.

  • Take ownership of internal services from concept through deployment and monitoring.

  • Contribute to the long-term vision and roadmap for developer tools that improve debugging efficiency, test coverage, and system understanding.

Qualifications:

  • Proficiency in C++ and Python, with a strong grasp of performance-sensitive and multi-threaded systems.

  • Experience with simulation frameworks, time-synchronized data systems, or state-machine-driven applications.

  • Familiarity with structured data visualization, log processing, or developer tooling design.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where requirements evolve and priorities shift.

Bonus Experience:

  • Experience building performance-sensitive systems (profiling, multithreading, real-time constraints) in robotics, aerospace, automotive, or similar domains.

  • Exposure to robotics / simulation / physics engines.

  • Background in telemetry systems, log ingestion pipelines, or automated test environments.

  • Front-end development skills in modern web frameworks (e.g., React, TypeScript, Three.js, Plotly) with a focus on data interaction and visualization.

  • Familiarity with distributed systems or cloud-hosted services used to support internal tools and customer applications.

Compensation: The hourly rate for this position is $47/hr for Undergrad, $53/hr for Masters, and $70/hr for PhD students*. title: Bauleitung / Objektüberwachung HLS (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über die TeGA-PLAN Heidemann GmbH

Die TeGA-PLAN Heidemann GmbH ist ein unabhängiges Ingenieurbüro für Technische Gebäudeausrüstung mit Sitz in Kiel. Mit rund 30 Kolleginnen und Kollegen planen und begleiten wir spannende und anspruchsvolle Bauprojekte – von der ersten Idee bis zur fertigen Umsetzung.

Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen in der Heizungs-, Lüftungs-, Sanitär- und Elektrotechnik sowie der Gebäudeautomation. Dabei sind unsere Projekte so vielfältig wie unser Team: Ob Forschungs- und Laborgebäude, Gesundheitseinrichtungen, Wohnungsbau, Büro- und Verwaltungsgebäude oder komplexe Industrieanlagen – wir entwickeln technische Lösungen für unterschiedlichste Anforderungen.

Was uns antreibt? Technik sinnvoll einsetzen, statt sie unnötig kompliziert zu machen. Wir legen Wert auf durchdachte, wirtschaftliche und energieeffiziente Lösungen und verfolgen dabei einen klaren Grundsatz: So viel Technik wie nötig, so wenig wie möglich.

Als unabhängiges Ingenieurbüro setzen wir auf fachliche Kompetenz, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein kollegiales Miteinander. Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was wir gemeinsam erreichen, sondern ganz besonders auch, wie wir miteinander arbeiten!

Deine Aufgaben - hier gestaltest du mit:

  • Du bringst unsere Planungen in die Praxis: Als Bauleiter (m/w/d) begleitest du anspruchsvolle Projekte der Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Sanitärtechnik und sorgst dafür, dass aus guten Konzepten funktionierende Anlagen werden.

  • Du hältst auf der Baustelle die Fäden zusammen: Du koordinierst die beteiligten Gewerke, stimmst dich direkt mit Bauherren, Architekten und ausführenden Unternehmen ab und findest gemeinsam mit ihnen Lösungen für die Herausforderungen im Baualltag.

  • Du behältst den Überblick: Qualität, Termine und Kosten hast du im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte fachgerecht und erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du weißt, wovon du sprichst: Ob Ingenieur, Techniker oder Meister – du hast eine passende Qualifikation im Bereich der Technischen Gebäudeausrüstung und kennst dich mit Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Sanitärtechnik aus.

  • Du kennst das Baustellenleben: Du bringst Erfahrung in der Bauleitung oder Objektüberwachung mit, weißt, worauf es bei der Umsetzung ankommt, und findest auch dann Lösungen, wenn es mal nicht nach Plan läuft.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung: Du arbeitest eigenständig, triffst Entscheidungen und vertrittst deine Standpunkte mit fachlicher Kompetenz und einem sicheren Auftreten – ohne dabei das partnerschaftliche Miteinander aus den Augen zu verlieren.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Wir finden, dass gute Arbeit auch ein gutes Arbeitsumfeld verdient. Deshalb setzen wir auf Vertrauen, Flexibilität und ein Miteinander, bei dem sich alle wohlfühlen können.

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu deinem Leben passt: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice geben dir den Freiraum, den du brauchst.

  • Gut ausgestattet und mobil: Firmenwagen, Smartphone und Laptop gehören ebenso dazu wie die Möglichkeit zum Bike-Leasing und Zuschüsse für öffentliche Verkehrsmittel.

  • Gemeinsam wachsen: Wir unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch Fortbildungen, gegenseitigen Wissensaustausch und die Erfahrung deiner Kolleginnen und Kollegen.

  • Wohlfühlen statt Kleiderordnung: Bei uns zählt, was du kannst, nicht was du trägst. Dich erwarten ein barrierefreies Büro, kostenlose Getränke und Snacks. Auch vierbeinige Begleiter sind willkommen.

  • Mehr als nur ein Arbeitsplatz: Mit Fitnessangeboten, Mitarbeitervorteilen und gemeinsamen Teamevents sorgen wir dafür, dass auch abseits der Projekte etwas geboten wird.

  • Ein Team, das zusammenhält: Kurze Wege, offene Türen, ein unkomplizierter Umgang miteinander und Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die sich gegenseitig unterstützen, gehören bei uns einfach dazu.

Deine Erfahrung ist uns etwas wert!

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Jahresgehalt zwischen 60.000 und 85.000 € brutto – abhängig von deiner Qualifikation, deiner Erfahrung und der Verantwortung, die du übernimmst. Was du mitbringst, zählt – und das soll sich auch in deinem Gehalt widerspiegeln.

Dein Start bei uns – gemeinsam von Anfang an!

Wir lassen dich nicht ins kalte Wasser springen. Du lernst unser Team, unsere Arbeitsweise und unsere spannenden Projekte in Kiel und Umgebung kennen. Dabei stehen dir erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen zur Seite, die dich bei deinem Einstieg unterstützen.

Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine eigenen Baustellen und wirst Teil eines Teams, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam Lösungen findet.

Du erfüllst nicht jede Anforderung? Kein Problem! Für uns zählen nicht nur Zeugnisse und Lebensläufe, sondern vor allem deine Erfahrung, deine Persönlichkeit und die Lust, gemeinsam mit uns etwas zu bewegen. Wenn du glaubst, dass du zu uns passt, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

title: Brand Designer
descriptionHtml:
🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

👐 About the team

Part of the Product department, our team of brand designers builds a strong brand that makes every interaction with Alma memorable. In 2027, we’ll make Alma even more visible and chosen, while reinventing how we create with AI.

Want to make a real impact on a fast-growing brand? Join us!

With high operational excellence, you'll manage projects end-to-end, maintain clear stakeholder communication, and consistently deliver on time to meet ambitious deadlines. You will report to Antoine, Creative Director.

As a business partner, you'll craft everything from sales/marketing decks, social media posts to event booths and white papers and brand campaigns.

Through your expertise in design and IA tools management, layout, you'll build scalable systems that empower teams across Alma to communicate our value proposition with impact and consistency, establishing Alma as a visually distinctive leader in European fintech.

To succeed in this job

  • Brand Design expertise: 4+ years as a Brand Designer (ideally in a large, fast-paced organization), with advanced expertise in Figma and Adobe Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and a portfolio showcasing diverse projects and brand system implementation.

  • Growth & business partner mindset: Sets ambitious goals, prototypes rapidly, monitors design trends, and uses client insights to align creative choices with business goals.

And it will be nice if you also

  • Have an experience in B2B/B2C, tech, consumer products, payments, or digital products.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

🧘 What’s in it for you

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

  • Shaping Alma into the brand consumers actively choose and keep coming back to: build a distinctive brand experience that drives consumer preference, loyalty, and long-term engagement.
  • Building Alma’s AI-powered brand guardian: design a Brand AI System that connects Alma’s AI tools to ensure brand consistency across every touchpoint, from content creation to quality control.

descriptionHtml:

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel.

A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success.

  • Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential.

  • Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives.

  • Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK:

ESSENTIAL

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry.

  • Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems.

  • A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives.

  • An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm.

  • Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes.

  • Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs.

  • Comfortable using AI in your daily work, from research and meeting prep to account analysis, and curious about where else it could help you win business.

PREFERABLE

  • Experience building networks of brokers in a Commercial Motor Fleet setting.

  • Have a broker distribution background with an active panel of brokers in the commercial insurance market.

WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary)

title: Business Development Associate
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

Proxima will sell fusion electricity in the late 2030s. Proxima's Business Development team finds and executes business opportunities on the way there: inorganic (acquisitions, minority stakes and joint ventures in businesses synergetic with Proxima) and organic (new product lines built from Proxima assets). You will own opportunities along our Business Development playbook, from market scan to a clear go/no-go from leadership, with an initial focus on inorganic deals. You will work directly with the Business Development Lead and the Head of Business Operations, within the CFO organization, and alongside engineering, finance, legal, and supply chain teams.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the front of the deal funnel: Build market reports, competitive landscapes, and company mappings that shape where Proxima invests.

  • Drive clear decisions: Build decision memos and business cases that lead to a go/no-go from the leadership team and board, pulling in our engineers to ground the analysis in technical reality.

  • Run deal workstreams: Lead expert calls, reference checks and data room screening.

  • Strengthen the function: Contribute roadmap and communication, and systematically deploy AI tools to speed up research, screening, and drafting.

  • Source new opportunities: Attend conferences and industry events, and feed new ideas into the pipeline, including organic ones over time.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Deal execution experience: 2-3 years in tier-1 strategy consulting, private equity, venture capital, or a fast-paced startup, ideally with exposure to industrials, energy, or advanced manufacturing.

  • Technical fluency: STEM degree (engineering, physics, mathematics or similar), or a demonstrated ability to work fluently with technical teams on technical topics.

  • Standalone problem-solving and judgement: You take an ambiguous question, structure it, run the analysis, and come back with a recommendation, without waiting to be told how.

  • Modeling and writing craft: Strong market modeling and memo-writing skills; you can build a valuation, a business plan, and a two-page decision document that leadership actually reads.

  • Clear communication: Fluent in English (written and spoken), comfortable in front of founders, suppliers, and senior stakeholders; German is a plus.

  • Startup mindset: Proactive, detail-oriented, comfortable with pace and ambiguity, and excited by fusion energy and the industrial base behind it.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)
