To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp's Accounting Channel is a key growth driver for the company, and we're looking for a founding Channel Partner Manager to help build our UK accounting-partner motion from the ground up. As an early member of the team in London, you'll have the opportunity to shape how Ramp partners with accounting and advisory firms across the region; building the relationships, go-to-market strategy, and repeatable motions that fuel long-term growth.

This role is for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and takes ownership without being handed a playbook. You'll acquire and grow relationships with accounting and advisory partners, enable their teams, and generate revenue through client referrals. You'll also help us adapt Ramp's partner strategy to the commercial and cultural nuances of the UK markets.

title: Chief Of Staff
descriptionHtml:
Hozah is scaling fast, and the CEO's time has become the bottleneck. We're looking for a Chief of Staff to multiply it: someone who works across every department, uses AI and clear structured thinking to find what is slowing the business down, and fixes it.

Above all, you get things over the line. In a growing business, good initiatives stall between departments, wait on decisions nobody owns and quietly lose momentum. You'll pick them up, clear the blockers, chase the decisions and drive each one to a finished, measured result, with urgency and without waiting to be asked.

This is not an executive assistant role and not a strategy-deck role. You'll own a portfolio of cross-functional initiatives and the leadership operating rhythm, and your influence will come from results and relationships, not borrowed authority.

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of cross-functional initiatives the CEO would otherwise drive personally, from diagnosis through to a finished, measured result.

  • Own the problems that sit between departments: find what is slowing the business down, size it in numbers and get it fixed with the team that owns it.

  • Own the leadership operating rhythm: the board pack, SLT agenda, KPI and OKR tracking, and the decision and action log.

  • Own the follow-through on strategic initiatives, tracking them to completion and raising slippage early with a recovery plan.

  • Own practical AI adoption across the business, building the shared workflows, tools and templates that remove manual work, and helping teams use them well.

  • Own the judgement calls the CEO shouldn't have to make: what you decide, what goes to the CEO and what gets dropped, with board, investor and people-sensitive information handled discreetly.

Who we're looking for

  • You've personally delivered cross-functional improvements end to end in the last two to three years, and can show the before and after in numbers, including at least one in a function you didn't run.

  • You build with AI and data, not just use them. Show us something you made yourself: a Claude or GPT workflow, a script, a SQL query, a model or an automation. Tell us what it replaced and how you checked it.

  • You take an ambiguous problem, break it down, question the data and come back with a recommendation, not a list of observations.

  • You've got senior people to change how their teams work without managing them, and stayed on good terms.

  • You've run or improved an executive cadence (board packs, leadership meetings, KPI or OKR tracking) and you make sure actions actually close.

  • You know what to decide, what to escalate and what to drop, and you handle confidential information carefully.

  • You read a P&L, unit economics and an operational dashboard without help, and you talk in numbers.

  • You'll take on the unglamorous work, challenge with evidence and give the credit to the team that owns the result.

  • You tell it straight, including what didn't work.

What We Offer

  • A newly created role with direct access to the CEO and regular exposure to the Board.

  • Real breadth: you'll work across every department of a fast-scaling tech business.

  • The chance to shape how a whole company uses AI.

  • Hybrid working: three days in our office next to East Croydon Station, two from home (and friendly office dogs).

title: Client Delivery Lead (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Was wir tun: Wir entwickeln die innovativste, zukunftsorientierteste und am stärksten KI-gestützte Plattform für Energiemanagement. Von der Ressourcenoptimierung bis hin zu herausragenden, kosteneffizienten Kundenerlebnissen: Mit modernen Kundeninformationssystemen (CIS), Abrechnung, Messdatenmanagement, CRM und KI-gestützter Kommunikation treibt Kraken die nächste Innovationswelle in der Energiebranche voran.

Warum wir das tun: Die Energieversorgung der Zukunft wird anders aussehen als die, die wir heute kennen. Wir müssen über unsere Zukunft nicht nur nachdenken, sondern sie aktiv gestalten. Jetzt.

Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann.

🏠 Deine Rolle bei uns:

Du wirst Teil des Client-Delivery-Teams bei Kraken und begleitest europäische Kunden auf ihrem Weg durch die technologische Transformation. Dabei unterstützt du langfristige Migrationsprojekte.

Als Client Delivery Lead verantwortest du einen technologischen Fachbereich, beispielsweise Abrechnung, Finanzen oder Kommunikation, innerhalb unserer Kundenprojekte. Dabei geht es entweder um die Migration auf unsere Kraken-Plattform oder um die Betreuung langfristiger technologischer Anforderungen. Du arbeitest eng mit den technischen und operativen Teams von Kraken sowie mit dem Kunden zusammen, um die jeweiligen Projekt- und Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

Als Client Delivery Lead musst du genau verstehen, wie Kraken funktioniert. Du analysierst die vom Kunden gemeldeten Probleme und Anforderungen und konkretisierst passende Lösungen, um bestehende und neue Funktionen optimal zu nutzen. Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden.

🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung:

  • Du betreust die Beziehungen zu deinen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite, häufig Product Owner und fachlich Verantwortliche.

  • Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für technische Weiterentwicklungen sowie für die Eskalation und Lösung von Problemen in deinem jeweiligen Fach- oder Produktbereich.

  • Du bist die zentrale Wissensquelle dafür, wie Kraken funktioniert und wie wir die Kraken-Plattform bereitstellen.

  • Du sichtest und priorisierst eingehende Anfragen und kommunizierst die Prioritäten der Kunden intern.

  • Du fasst Kundenanforderungen, relevante Rahmenbedingungen und Zeitpläne zusammen und vermittelst sie intern, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Kraken-Plattform zu ermöglichen.

  • Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung von Produktfunktionen.

  • Du regst Kunden dazu an, technische Entwicklung neu zu denken, und vertrittst unseren Ansatz der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Bereitstellung mit Überzeugung.

Dies ist eine praxisorientierte Fachrolle ohne Personalverantwortung. Dein Arbeitsstandort liegt in Europa; deine Projekte können in unterschiedlichen Ländern angesiedelt sein. Reisebereitschaft wird vorausgesetzt.

Wir sind eine agile Organisation mit flachen Hierarchien und möchten das auch bleiben. Wir suchen aufgeschlossene Menschen, die mit Unklarheiten und einem sich ständig verändernden Umfeld gut umgehen können. Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du eigeninitiativ handeln und bereit sein, selbst mit anzupacken, um Probleme zu lösen. Dabei gehst du regelmäßig über deinen üblichen Aufgabenbereich hinaus, um unsere Kunden und unsere Organisation voranzubringen.

Du stehst hinter dem Kraken-Ansatz zur Technologieentwicklung, der auf Einfachheit, Kundennutzen und Effizienz beruht, und begleitest die beteiligten Interessengruppen durch den Veränderungsprozess.

Du bist bereit, bestehende Überzeugungen zu hinterfragen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven einzunehmen und bei Bedarf auch über deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich hinauszugehen, um den Kunden zu unterstützen.

Wir entwickeln Kraken für alle: eine universelle Plattform, bei der gemeinsam genutzte Weiterentwicklungen einen größeren Nutzen schaffen und die grüne Energiewende ermöglichen. Als Pioniere auf diesem Gebiet begeistert uns, wie Kraken das Leben unserer Kunden verändern kann. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Kraken die beste Lösung ist – sowohl für mehr Effizienz als auch als Werkzeug im Kampf gegen die Klimakrise. Wenn du diese Überzeugung teilst, bist du bei Kraken Tech genau richtig.

🧠 Das bringst du mit:

  • In dieser Position steht die Erfüllung der Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden für dich im Mittelpunkt. Wir suchen Menschen mit ausgeprägter Problemlösungskompetenz und einer durchweg positiven, lösungsorientierten Einstellung. Wenn du Herausforderungen gerne annimmst und den Ehrgeiz hast, erfolgreich zu sein, passt diese Position zu dir! Deine Haltung: „Jedes Problem hat eine Lösung. Neue Herausforderungen sind spannend, weil wir durch sie jeden Tag besser werden. Und je größer die Herausforderung, desto größer das Erfolgserlebnis.“

title: Client Service Director

Als Client Service Director ben jij de drijvende kracht achter het succes van onze belangrijkste klantrelaties. Je begrijpt de business van de klant, denkt strategisch mee en zorgt dat ambities worden vertaald naar concrete resultaten. Je verbindt mensen, stuurt op kwaliteit en voortgang en houdt grip op zowel de dienstverlening als de financiële prestaties.

Wat jij doet

Als Client Service Director ben je verantwoordelijk voor het totale succes van jouw klantrelaties. Je bent de strategische gesprekspartner voor grote retailklanten en zorgt ervoor dat klantbehoeften, dienstverlening, projecten en commerciële doelstellingen samenkomen. Je overziet het geheel, verbindt de juiste mensen en neemt de regie wanneer dat nodig is. Van strategisch advies en klanttevredenheid tot operationele voortgang en financiële resultaten: jij zorgt voor samenhang, grip en resultaat.

  • Strategisch klantpartnerschap: je bouwt aan duurzame relaties met grote retailklanten en bent hun gesprekspartner op directie- en managementniveau. Je begrijpt hun strategie, uitdagingen en ambities en vertaalt deze naar concrete oplossingen en kansen.

  • Regie op dienstverlening: je bewaakt de kwaliteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening op het gebied van hardware en services. Je zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen en dat de dienstverlening aansluit op de verwachtingen van de klant.

  • Programmamanagement en projectregie: je houdt overzicht over meerdere projecten, programma’s en verbeterinitiatieven. Je bewaakt de samenhang, planning, voortgang, risico’s en resultaten en zorgt dat betrokken teams gezamenlijk naar hetzelfde doel werken.

title: Clinical Trial Manager - Contract 12 months
descriptionHtml:
🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials.

Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your Role

In a few words

You will coordinate the operations of Resilience-sponsored and investigator-initiated studies across several therapeutic areas. Reporting to a Clinical Operations Lead (COPL), you will combine hands-on site oversight with regulatory and contractual coordination and improvements to clinical operations processes.

Your impact

Help sites deliver studies effectively: follow protocols, maintain up-to-date documentation and ensure data quality. You will connect the teams involved so that operational, regulatory and contractual activities progress together.

Your day to day

  • Coordinate day-to-day study operations and logistics, and support the planning and follow-up of site selection, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits.

  • Track site progress, study indicators and data quality, and share issues requiring attention during study meetings and governance committees.

  • Follow up on site agreements, amendments and budget annexes, and contribute to site budget tracking and payment follow-up with Legal and Finance.

  • Maintain regulatory documentation and the eTMF, support audit readiness and ensure compliance with GCP, applicable ICH guidelines, the French Jardé Law and GDPR.

  • Work with Clinical Scientists, Biostatistics and Product teams, and improve clinical operations trackers, standard operating procedures and templates.

✨ Your team

  • Your future colleagues: you will work with Clinical Scientists, Biostatistics and Product teams, as well as Legal and Finance.

  • Your manager: Anne-Julie, the Hiring Manager for this role. She has over 10 years of experience, including in the pharmaceutical industry, and has been Clinical Operations Lead at Resilience for the past year and a half.

  • The little ➕ about your team: We work together to find practical solutions—and make time to celebrate our wins along the way.

👤 Candidate Profile

⚙️ You are the right person if you know how to

  • Organize clinical study activities and track priorities, deadlines and actions across stakeholders.

  • Apply GCP and the relevant requirements of ICH guidelines, the French Jardé Law and GDPR.

  • Maintain structured study documentation and use study indicators to monitor progress.

  • Contribute to regulatory submission follow-up, site contracting and budget tracking.

  • Work in French and English with professional fluency, both written and spoken.

🙂 You are the right person if you have

  • A structured approach to work and close attention to detail.

  • The ability to work independently and prioritize effectively.

  • Clear communication skills across different functions.

  • Curiosity and a resourceful, practical approach to solving problems.

  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to adapt when priorities change.

📃 You are the right person if you have already

  • Earned a degree in life sciences, pharmacy, clinical research or biomedical engineering.

  • Gained at least two years of experience in clinical research, for example as a CRA, site manager or junior project manager.

  • Contributed to the operational follow-up of clinical sites or studies.

💛 Why join us?

  • Contribute to studies that combine clinical research, digital tools and patient-centered monitoring.

  • Build on your operational experience while developing regulatory and contractual coordination skills.

  • Work across several therapeutic areas with colleagues from complementary disciplines.

  • Improve the methods and tools used in day-to-day clinical operations.

  • Work fully remotely within France, with regular travel related to the role.

🤝 Recruitment Process

  1. One-on-one screening with Elena — 20 minutes: discuss your motivation and alignment with the role and Resilience’s culture.

  2. Interview with Anne-Julie, Hiring Manager - 30 minutes: explore your background and the skills relevant to the role.

  3. Case study: a practical exercise related to the role’s responsibilities.

  4. Team interview with the Medical team - 30minutes /ITW: meet team members and discuss day-to-day collaboration.

They will be available only for people involved in the process and erased after 2 years of inactivity.

title: Commercial Lead
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Your Role

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Lead to build and lead a high-performing commercial function that drives strategic customer relationships and secures high-value contracts with both government customers and large enterprises (primarily satellite primes and OEMs).

You'll own the path from shaping opportunities before tenders open, through leading competitive proposals, to securing multi-year contracts and driving sustained account growth. Your ability to navigate complex, high-stakes deals, foster a results-driven culture, and partner with our engineering and business teams will directly influence NewOrbit's market leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Dual-market ownership (Gov & Enterprise): Build and execute account strategies for agencies and large companies; map stakeholders, budgets, and decision paths; shape requirements before tenders open.

  • Tender intelligence & capture: Track pipelines across government portals and enterprise sourcing calendars; run capture plans, win themes, and competitor/price-to-win analyses; lead bid/no-bid decisions.

  • Proposal leadership: Orchestrate compliant submissions; coordinate clarifications, BAFO, and oral presentations.

  • Complex deal negotiation: Close supply, licensing, and co-development agreements; negotiate IP, warranties/liability, service levels, and milestone payments aligned to TRL gates.

  • Partnerships & consortia: Structure teaming with primes, SMEs, universities, and test partners to strengthen bids and delivery confidence.

  • Forecasting & governance: Maintain a transparent pipeline with stage gating, ACV/TCV, probability, and cycle metrics; report risks/mitigations and drive executive decision forums.

  • Voice of customer: Feed market and procurement insights into roadmaps, qualification timelines, pricing, and make/buy decisions.

  • Compliance & controls: Work with Legal/Compliance on export control (UK/EU/US regimes), information security, and public-sector procurement rules.

  • Market presence & pitching: Represent NewOrbit at industry events, tender briefings, space conferences, and executive reviews; deliver compelling pitches and presentations that clearly communicate our vision and value proposition.

  • Team leadership: Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing commercial team, fostering persistence, creativity, and a results-driven culture.

Fundamental Requirements

  • Space industry experience (required): Must have direct experience selling satellites or space hardware - payloads, cameras, antennas, subsystems. Candidates without space industry sales experience will not be considered.

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years in business development or key accounts, with wins across government procurement and large-enterprise buying centres.

  • Customer knowledge: Up to date on where satellite/space hardware customers are coming from today, across government, primes, and OEMs - not relying on outdated relationships.

  • Full sales cycle ownership: Demonstrated experience across all stages - pre-tender shaping, capture planning, proposal/bid leadership, negotiation, and contract close.

  • Tender mastery: Demonstrated success leading competitive bids (capture planning, scoring criteria, compliance, pricing) and handling long, multi-stakeholder cycles.

  • Deal craft: Strong negotiation track record on MSAs/SOWs, licensing, co-development, and milestone-based contracts; fluent in IP and risk allocation.

  • Domain fluency: Able to translate complex engineering (propulsion, LEO satellite platforms, qualification, test/readiness reviews) into customer value and business cases.

  • Leadership & mentoring: Proven ability to recruit, develop, and manage high-performing commercial or sales teams.

  • Process & tools: Disciplined CRM usage, forecasting, and KPI ownership (win rate, cycle time, stage conversion, ACV/TCV).

  • Governance & compliance: Familiarity with public-sector procurement practices and export-control considerations; knows when to engage specialists.

  • Marketing savvy: Skilled in shaping and delivering impactful presentations, narratives, and proposals that resonate with diverse audiences.

  • Soft skills: Executive presence, exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, stakeholder influence, and resilience in long negotiations.

  • Ways of working: High ownership in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment; willing to travel for customer meetings, briefings, and negotiations.

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience at a small satellite company that scaled into a large business - candidates who've operated through that growth curve are especially well suited to this role.

 

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

title: Computer Vision / ML Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.

The role

Every part we make has to be inspected before it ships, and in precision manufacturing inspection is slow, skilled work. Our robotics team is building a computer vision inspection cell for the shop floor, and this role leads that work.

title: Contract manager
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

The Exploration Company builds complex space systems under contracts with government and institutional customers. Programs of this kind evolve: requirements change, design maturity improves, schedules shift, and suppliers and customers request adjustments. Each change must be formally proposed, assessed, negotiated, and recorded in the contract before it can be executed and paid for.

As Contract Manager, you will own the change lifecycle for your assigned contracts. You will drive Contract Change Notices (CCNs) from initial request to signature, protect the company's position on scope, cost, and schedule, and keep the contract baseline accurate for the program team.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the CCN lifecycle from receipt or initiation through impact assessment, negotiation, approval, and formal issue, with clear ownership and deadlines for every open item.

  • Chase and track open CCNs with customer contracting officers, program managers, and internal stakeholders, and escalate delays that threaten schedule or cash flow.

  • Coordinate impact assessments with engineering, quality, supply chain, and finance, covering technical scope, cost, schedule, risk, and compliance effects.

  • Prepare and negotiate change proposals, including pricing justification, supporting documentation, and changes to terms and conditions.

  • Maintain the contract baseline by recording each approved CCN in the contract register and ensuring the scope, price, milestones, and deliverables reflect the current agreed position.

  • Monitor entitlement and notice obligations, including time limits for submitting change requests and claims under the contract and applicable procurement rules.

  • Manage the CCN register and reporting, providing regular status updates on open, pending, and approved changes, value at stake, and aging to program leadership.

  • Support invoicing and revenue recognition by ensuring approved changes are reflected in billing milestones and Odoo or ERP records.

  • Ensure compliance with the contract's terms, applicable public procurement and export-control rules, and internal approval and delegation-of-authority policies.

  • Prepare for audits and reviews by maintaining a complete, traceable record of change decisions and correspondence.

title: CRM & Lifecycle Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

🧚 Our Marketing team

No one is more creative and data-driven than this team; they truly combine the best of both worlds. The Marketing team’s mission is to put our product into the hearts and hands of millions of users around the world.

  • The Growth Team builds and scales innovative growth engines to conquer markets, attract, and retain users.

  • The Brand & Communications Team shapes Joko's long-term vision and builds a lasting emotional connection with users.

  • The Campaign & Merchandising Team drives our B2C campaign calendar and elevates the shopping experience.

  • The B2B Marketing Team positions Joko as the top partner in our space and builds a standout employer brand.

Led by Isa, our CMO, the team is constantly innovating to take the business to new heights.

🎯 What you will do

As CRM & Lifecycle Manager, your mission is to design and run lifecycle programs that turn new signups into engaged, loyal, high-LTV Joko users. You will own the end-to-end CRM strategy across in-app, push, and email from the first onboarding message to the campaign that reactivates dormant users. You will join the Growth team, report to the VP Growth, and partner daily with Product, Data, and Brand teams.

Your main missions will be:

  • Guide new users to their first Joko “wow” moment: The first days shape everything that follows. You’ll design the onboarding journey: messaging, timing, and triggers so every new user feels understood and reaches activation quickly. At our scale, getting those first touches right compounds into millions of engaged users.

  • Turn engaged users into power users, and power users into advocates: You’ll build retention and referral programs that deepen usage among our best users, drive word of mouth, and lift long-term retention.

  • Maximize LTV across the full lifecycle: You’ll design cross-channel journeys that deliver the right benefit to the right user at the right moment. You’ll partner closely with Data to turn behavioral signals into segmentation and triggers, and with Product to keep lifecycle nudges tightly aligned with the in-app experience.

  • Raise the bar on experimentation: You’ll run a continuous A/B testing program (hypotheses, tests, learnings, iterations) to improve existing flows and challenge our current lifecycle map. Every decision should be grounded in evidence, not intuition.

  • Take CRM to the next level with AI: You’ll use AI to automate the operational grind (segmentation, copy iteration, QA, reporting) and unlock what we couldn’t run manually: sharper personalization, faster experimentation cycles, and richer lifecycle logic. You’ll decide where AI genuinely moves the needle (and where it doesn’t), then ship production solutions.

  • Drive growth across the company: You’ll work hand-in-hand with Product, Data, User Acquisition, and Brand so CRM compounds alongside everything else we’re building.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in B2C CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally in a high-growth mobile or consumer app. You’ve owned lifecycle programs end-to-end, not just executed individual components.

  • CRM craft: You’re hands-on with modern CRM platforms (Braze, Iterable, Customer.io, or similar) and you know what “good” looks like across in-app, push, and email. Deliverability, segmentation logic, template design, and orchestration are second nature.

  • Data-driven to the core: You read cohort curves, funnel data, and A/B test results fluently. You use data to form opinions and drive decisions, not just to build reports.

  • Experimentation mindset: You’ve run structured A/B testing programs and know how to design experiments that actually teach you something, not just optimize a subject line.

  • Curious and hands-on with AI: You’re genuinely excited by what AI can do for CRM. You’ve already built solutions from scratch using AI to improve workflows or drive impact, and you have real opinions formed from real attempts on where it works and where it doesn’t.

  • User-centric: You’re relentlessly curious about how users think, what they need, and how they respond. Every message you ship starts from a real user insight, not a template.

  • Ownership and drive: You take initiative, hold yourself accountable to outcomes (not activities), and move fast without dropping the ball.

  • Attention to detail: You know a broken merge tag, a mistimed push, or a poorly segmented email can undo weeks of work. You have a talent for spotting flaws before they ship.

  • Languages: You’re a native-level French speaker and fluent in English, our internal working language.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €43.4K – €69.3K

title: CTO - CDI Paris - Theodo Data & IA
descriptionHtml:
Theodo est une entreprise de conseil et de réalisation en technologie digitale. Ces dernières années, nous avons construit une expertise forte sur deux axes qui convergent : la donnée (plateformes data, gouvernance, qualité) et l'intelligence artificielle (IA générative, agents, ML, vision par ordinateur). Ces deux expertises sont portées par notre entité Theodo Data & AI, qui accompagne les organisations à toutes les étapes de leur trajectoire data et IA.

Le marché est à un point d'inflexion. Les entreprises disposent de volumes considérables de données internes mais peinent à les exploiter, tandis que l'IA générative ouvre des possibilités inédites d'automatisation, d'aide à la décision et de transformation des processus métiers. Nos clients attendent un partenaire capable de couvrir toute la chaîne de valeur, de la stratégie data à l'industrialisation des cas d'usage IA. Nous avons une opportunité unique de devenir un leader reconnu sur ce marché à très forte valeur, en nous appuyant sur notre approche Lean Tech® et nos partenariats stratégiques (Google Cloud Partner of the Year France 2025, AWS, Snowflake).

C'est cette practice que nous vous proposons de piloter.

Votre rôle

En tant que CTO Data & IA, vous êtes le leader qui fait le pont entre le business et la tech sur l'ensemble du périmètre Data & Intelligence Artificielle. Concrètement, vous portez quatre responsabilités.

  • Offre & expertise technique : vous positionnez Theodo à la pointe du marché. Vous benchmarkez les architectures data modernes (data platforms, data mesh, lakehouse) et les architectures IA (RAG, agents, semantic layer, fine-tuning, MLOps). Vous développez des accélérateurs et des enablers internes réutilisables, vous animez la communauté des leaders tech et data scientists, et vous formalisez les apprentissages pour capitaliser sur les retours de mission.
  • Vente & Solution Architecture : vous êtes le référent technique du cycle de vente. Vous intervenez en avant-vente comme solution architect de référence sur nos offres Data & IA, vous co-construisez les propositions techniques avec les équipes commerciales, et vous challengez et crédibilisez les réponses techniques face aux CTO, DSI et CDO de nos clients. Vous travaillez main dans la main avec notre Head of Sales sur le closing des deals stratégiques et sur nos partenariats.
  • Delivery : vous garantissez l'excellence et faites grandir les équipes. Vous communiquez en interne autour de nos offres pour attirer les meilleurs profils, et vous recrutez et formez nos ingénieurs data, data scientists et AI engineers.
  • Marketing technique : vous construisez notre visibilité et notre crédibilité sur le marché. Vous bâtissez et maintenez notre showroom (démos, cas d'usage de référence), vous produisez du contenu à fort impact (articles, livres blancs, tech radars), vous intervenez en conférences et événements (Nuit de la Data, Google Cloud Next, AWS Summit…), et vous alimentez nos partenariats technologiques avec du contenu technique.

Les défis qui vous attendent

  • Vous couvrirez un périmètre large qui va de la data platform à l'IA générative, en passant par la data science classique et le MLOps sans vous disperser.
  • Vous rejoindrez une équipe déjà expérimentée, avec une culture Theodo forte.
  • Vous articulerez une vision unifiée Data & IA là où le marché tend à séparer ces deux mondes, tout en conservant une équipe pluridisciplinaire (data engineers, data scientists, AI engineers, MLOps) pour scaler la delivery.
  • Vous naviguerez dans un écosystème de partenaires technologiques variés (Google Cloud, AWS) en maintenant une posture agnostique crédible.
  • Et surtout, vous transformerez la vague GenAI en offres industrialisables et vendables, avec un ROI démontrable pour nos clients.

Votre environnement

  • Vous travaillerez avec les fondateurs du groupe pour définir la stratégie go-to-market et les priorités de la practice, avec les leaders de la practice et notre Head of Sales pour le closing des ventes et la structuration du pipeline, et avec les leaders tech Data et IA pour renforcer l'expertise collective.
  • Vous vous appuierez sur notre Head of Delivery pour garantir le respect de nos engagements clients, et sur nos partenaires technologiques (Google Cloud, AWS) pour co-construire des offres et maintenir nos certifications.
  • Vous managerez les équipes techniques de la practice Data & IA : data engineers, data scientists, AI engineers et MLOps engineers.

Ce que nous recherchons

Nous cherchons quelqu'un de passionné par la Data et l'IA, animé par un drive fort dans la durée et une curiosité insatiable pour les avancées technologiques (LLM, agents, data platforms, MLOps).

  • Vous êtes très fort en tech sur un spectre large : architectures data modernes (data mesh, lakehouse, governance frameworks) et architectures IA (RAG, agents, fine-tuning, évaluation de modèles, MLOps).
  • Vous avez un sens business affirmé : vous comprenez les job-to-be-done métier des clients, vous savez articuler la valeur délivrée et le ROI, et vous parlez le langage des CTO, DSI et CDO.
  • Vous êtes un très bon leader, capable d'aligner des profils data et IA variés autour d'une vision commune et de fédérer une communauté technique.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise en marketing technique : vous savez valoriser l'expertise créée, vous avez envie d'être visible, et vous êtes autant à votre aise en conférence qu'en rédaction de contenu.
  • Vous avez une grosse capacité d'exécution - focus, intensité, orientation delivery - et vous savez passer de la stratégie à l'opérationnel.
  • Enfin, vous avez la posture d'un solution architect : vous challengez et proposez des architectures techniques en avant-vente face à des interlocuteurs seniors.

Les expériences qui vous permettront de réussir

  • 10+ ans d'expérience dans des rôles de leadership technique, avec une composante data et IA significative.
  • Vous avez conçu ou piloté des plateformes data à l'échelle (data warehouses, data lakes, pipelines temps réel) dans des environnements cloud (AWS, GCP, Snowflake).

  • Vous avez joué un rôle business clé dans un contexte de service ou de conseil, avec un esprit entrepreneurial.
  • Vous avez été speaker en conférence et avez produit du contenu structurant (articles, livres blancs, talks) sur la data ou l'IA appliquée.
  • Idéalement, vous avez évolué dans un environnement à forte croissance et participé au scaling d'une équipe technique.
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 700 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥 Budget matériel pour t’équiper (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib, théâtre avec Kiosk, avantages variés avec Happypal). 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ? Chez Theodo, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité est une richesse et que l’égalité des chances est essentielle pour construire des équipes performantes et épanouies. C’est pourquoi notre processus de recrutement est conçu pour être équitable, bienveillant et fondé sur les compétences. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, d’origine, d’orientation sexuelle, d’âge, de situation de handicap ou de croyances.

title: Customer Marketing Associate
descriptionHtml:
Customer Marketing Manager

Hi, I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).

Product Marketing at hx is a strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market. We're growing the team because customer case studies are critical to our success: insurance is a tight-knit industry that trusts practitioner voices far more than it trusts vendors.

This role is a chance to help shape the narrative we take to market and have a global impact on our success. You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Product Marketing team

Product Marketing sits at the centre of hx's go-to-market engine, translating what we build into stories the market believes. Nothing earns that belief faster than a customer saying it themselves: insurance is an industry where reputation travels through a small number of trusted voices, and our customers include some of the most respected names in specialty and commercial insurance.

As our Customer Marketing Manager, you'll own that voice. Your mission is to increase the frequency, quality, and number of published customer case studies, build relationships with customer accounts so that every testimonial is genuinely mutually beneficial, find new ways to celebrate our customers, and manage award submissions that earn industry recognition for hx and the customers we serve.

This is a role with real ownership from day one. You'll work directly with senior stakeholders at hx and at some of the world's largest insurers, and the content you produce will be used across sales, marketing, and events globally.

What you'll be doing

  • Own case study production end to end - from identifying the story and recruiting the customer through to publication - delivering two published case studies (written, video, or otherwise) per quarter.

  • Publish two additional pieces of customer-contributed content per quarter, from quotes and social content to event appearances, driving hx's key messages to market through customer voices.

  • Build and continually improve our case study recruitment and production process so that participating is low-lift for both our customers and our team, and each cycle runs smoother than the last.

  • Grow engagement across the underwriting community, measured through event attendance, email open rates, and social engagement, particularly on LinkedIn.

  • Identify and manage award submissions throughout the year, coordinating internal and customer stakeholders to produce a targeted number of high-quality entries that increase industry recognition for hx and its customers.

  • Edit and assemble short-form written, video, and social content for promotion and lead generation, keeping every asset aligned with hx's positioning and brand narrative.

What you'll need to have done

  • Taken customer stories or content projects from initial idea through to publication, coordinating multiple senior, time-limited stakeholders inside and outside your organisation.

title: Customer Operations Specialist - Europe
descriptionHtml:
About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

Customer Experience

Plasma is scaling its customer-facing operations across international markets, and we’re growing the Customer Experience Team to match. You’ll join an established team and take ownership of coverage for the CET time zone, making sure our customers get great support when they need it most.

You’ll work across the full customer journey, from first contact through to resolution. Because we’re still building out our playbook, your input will directly shape the processes, standards, and team culture as we grow. You won’t just follow the process; you’ll help refine it.

Some flexibility in working hours & weekend shifts will be needed to support coverage and the occasional busy period. We’re looking for a hard-working self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment and is committed to the mission alongside the rest of the team.

The role

  • Own the customer experience day-to-day: Be the first person our customers reach when something goes wrong or they need help. You will handle inbound queries across chat, email, and support tooling, and take accountability for the quality and speed of every response.

  • Be the right hand of the Ops lead: Work directly alongside the Head of Operations to build out processes, identify gaps, and support decisions as we scale the team internationally. This is not a back-office support role. You will be involved in how we think about operations.

  • Build the foundations: We are early. Many of the processes, templates, and escalation paths do not exist yet. You will create them. From response frameworks to internal guides, you will help lay the groundwork the team will rely on as we grow.

  • Support international team scaling: As we hire Ops team members in new markets, you will help onboard them, share knowledge, and maintain consistency in how we deliver for customers across regions.

  • Spot problems before they become patterns: Track issues across the customer base, flag recurring themes to Product and Engineering, and help prioritise fixes that actually move the needle for customers.

  • Work across teams: Collaborate with Compliance, KYC, and Product to make sure the customer experience is joined up, especially during onboarding and verification flows where things can go wrong quickly.

  • Represent the customer internally: Your proximity to customer feedback is valuable. Use it. Bring customer insight into internal conversations and push for improvements that matter.

  • Be Flexible with Shift Rotation: Most weeks you’ll work the normal Mon-Fri, however team members currently rotate weekend shifts which means that you may be required to work a weekend shift once every 6 weeks. You’ll then be able to take those days worked off the following week.

The Bar

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in customer operations, customer success, or a support role, ideally within fintech, payments, or crypto. We will consider strong candidates from outside these sectors if the fit is right.

  • Someone who takes ownership. You do not wait to be told. When something is broken or missing, you fix it or flag it. You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching.

  • Clear and direct in how you communicate. You can write a helpful, professional response under pressure and explain a complex situation simply. You know the difference between being thorough and overcomplicating things.

  • Competent English Language - our team communicates in english so being competent with the language is a requirement.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. This is an early-stage company. Processes will change, priorities will shift, and some days you will be figuring things out as you go. You see that as interesting rather than frustrating. Preferably, you have worked at a fast-paced tech company.

  • Genuinely curious about crypto. You do not need deep technical knowledge, but you need to understand the basics of how stablecoins and digital assets work and be motivated to learn more. Our customers live in this space.

  • Organised under pressure. You can manage a queue, prioritise effectively, and keep quality high when things are busy.

  • Collaborative by default. You work well with people in different functions, different time zones, and different levels of seniority. Building the team abroad means working with people you may never meet in person, and you are good at that.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up where you had to build or rebuild processes, not just follow them.

  • Exposure to Intercom, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or similar support tooling in a live production environment.

  • Any familiarity with KYC or compliance workflows as they relate to customer onboarding.

  • Experience supporting or managing a small team, even informally, or helping onboard new colleagues.

  • An interest in how stablecoin and DeFi products work and the customer challenges they create.

  • Multilingual skills that could support customer communication across our international markets.

What's in it for you

  • Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation.

  • A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad.

  • Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma.

  • Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage.

  • All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best.

  • Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day.

Data Protection & Privacy
We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Any personal information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable local data protection laws.

Compensation: £35K – £40K • + Tokens

By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The commercial team

We strive to bring the best in technology, user experience and banking to the embedded finance space and be the bank for fintechs and corporates to build on.

As the third hire in the Customer Success team, you'll help customers maximise value from our product and drive growth opportunities.

Who are you

The ideal candidate for this job will have most of the following:

  • 2-3 years experience in B2B customer success, account management or a related role, ideally in financial services, banking or fintech

  • Excellent problem-solving and project management abilities, with experience managing competing priorities while consistently delivering results

  • Demonstrated success in customer retention and driving account expansion

  • Strong relationship-building skills with experience developing trust and rapport across external and internal stakeholders

We’re hybrid-remote, and most of your colleagues will not share an office with you on a day-to-day basis. This means you should also have:

  • A high degree of comfort adopting new software tools for document drafting, collaboration and communication.

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write )

What will you be doing here?

As a Customer Success Manager at Griffin, you will

  • Build strong relationships with your customer portfolio through regular touch-points and QBRs

  • Collaborate with our implementation and technical teams to ensure smooth implementation and faster time-to-value

  • Identify revenue expansion opportunities Uncover upselling and cross-selling potential within existing accounts

  • Contribute and improve existing processes to optimise the customer experience

  • Be an advocate for customers internally, respond to issues and share product feedback

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Salary: £50,000 DOE + commission

  • 25 days off a year + winter break(we close in between Christmas and New Year) + bank holidays

  • Share options - so you own a piece of what we’re building

  • Remote-first flexibility - work from anywhere in the UK

  • Support with home office setup

  • 1:1 coaching and therapy through Oliva

  • Auto-enrolment into company pension scheme with Penfold

  • Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months at full pay

  • Private medical insurance and life insurance (provided by Bupa and AIG respectively)

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

title: Data & AI Strategic Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Functieomschrijving

Organisaties willen meer met data en AI, maar de weg ernaartoe is vaak onduidelijk. Als consultant help jij onze klanten om het volledige potentieel van hun data te benutten, van strategie tot werkende praktijk. Je overbrugt de kloof tussen technische data-oplossingen en zakelijke doelstellingen, zodat klanten betere, datagedreven beslissingen kunnen nemen.

Over ons team

Wij zijn een klein, enthousiast en leergierig team van drie personen. De lijnen zijn kort, iedereen heeft invloed en ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord maar ook uitgeprobeerd.

Onze focus ligt op de consultancykant van data en AI. We begeleiden organisaties bij AI-transformaties en beginnen altijd bij het échte probleem van de klant. Daarna maken we roadmaps en begeleiden we de implementatie. We werken aan data- en AI-governance, data- en AI-strategie, change management en data quality. We vragen onszelf steeds af hoe we dit slimmer en meer AI-driven kunnen doen, en gebruiken AI dus ook zelf in ons dagelijks werk.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. Heb je een andere achtergrond binnen datamanagement? Ook dan willen we je graag leren kennen. Wij leren graag van je mee.

Wat je doet

Consultancy en klantbetrokkenheid

  • Trusted advisor zijn voor klanten: hun zakelijke vraagstuk begrijpen en een passende aanpak voor datamanagement, data- en AI-strategie bieden.

  • Workshops en sessies faciliteren om behoeften op te halen, bevindingen te presenteren en concrete aanbevelingen te doen.

  • Klanten begeleiden bij AI-transformaties, van probleemanalyse en roadmap tot begeleiding van de implementatie.

  • Sterke klantrelaties opbouwen, waaruit nieuwe kansen voor adesso ontstaan.

Expertise in datamanagement

  • Adviseren over data governance, datastrategie en data-architectuur volgens best practices.

  • Bestaande datamanagementprocessen beoordelen, zoals datakwaliteit, en verbeteringen voorstellen.

  • Onderzoeken hoe datamanagement en datakwaliteit meer AI-driven kunnen worden.

  • Op de hoogte blijven van ontwikkelingen in data en AI en die vertalen naar onze dienstverlening.

Projectleiding

  • Datamanagementtrajecten van start tot finish leiden, binnen tijd, budget en kwaliteit.

  • Projectplannen opstellen, voortgang bewaken en samenwerken met data engineers, analisten en andere consultants.

Business development

  • Meedenken over proposities en use cases, en kansen signaleren via je netwerk.

  • Bijdragen aan voorstellen en presentaties voor nieuwe klanten, samen met het salesteam.


Wat jij meebrengt

  • Bachelor of Master in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Computerwetenschappen of een verwant vakgebied.

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ervaring in een dataomgeving, bijvoorbeeld als data-analist of als consultant met focus op datamanagement.

  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in consultancy, bij voorkeur bij een gerenommeerd adviesbureau.

  • Goed begrip van datamanagementconcepten, zoals data governance en datastrategie.

  • Ervaring met het leiden van complexe projecten.

  • Je gebruikt AI zelf in je werk en hebt zin om samen met ons te ontdekken wat er nog meer kan.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden: je betrekt en beïnvloedt stakeholders op alle niveaus.

  • Flexibel en leergierig: je schakelt makkelijk tussen klanten, omgevingen en onderwerpen.

  • Vloeiend Nederlands en Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Nice-to-have: kennis van AI-governance en data-readiness voor AI, en commercieel inzicht.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.


En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

· Een salaris van €5.400 tot €6.600 bruto per maand (40 uur)

· 8% vakantiegeld

· Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week.

· Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris.

· 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen.

· €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen.

· Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden

· Goede pensioenregeling

· Doorgroeimogelijkheden

· Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team.

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

You will guide clients in envisioning and realising AI-driven competitive advantage—beyond tooling and beyond pipelines—while helping organisations adopt AI-enabled ways of working responsibly, balancing innovation with governance, human judgement and measurable business outcomes.

The team

We are the Risk team responsible for managing the credit risk of Liberis’ portfolios, which include designing effective new strategies, managing the credit quality of our products across geographies, and providing specialist credit risk advice to the business.

The Risk team is based in London and covers Risk analytics, Decision Science, Underwriting and Collections. Our mission is to grow Liberis profitably to become the leading embedded business finance provider and we are now looking for a Credit Risk Analyst to join us on this journey.

    The role  

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex problems through data and analysis. This is an ideal role for an analytical thinker who is naturally curious, enjoys investigating trends and identifying opportunities, and is motivated by seeing their work influence real business decisions.

You'll be comfortable taking ownership of projects - framing problems, conducting deep analysis, developing recommendations and working with stakeholders to implement change. While experience in credit risk is beneficial, we're primarily looking for an individual with strong analytical capability, commercial thinking and a track record of turning data into actionable insights.

Reporting to the Risk Manager, you'll help shape Liberis' credit risk strategy by delivering analytical insights, developing portfolio monitoring frameworks and driving strategic initiatives across our global products. You'll work closely with teams across Risk, Data Science, Analytics, Product, Pricing and Commercial to ensure our lending decisions support sustainable growth while remaining within our risk appetite.

What you'll get to do: 

  • Build and improve portfolio monitoring frameworks, turning data into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Monitor losses, delinquencies, inactivity, repayment trends and vintage performance to assess portfolio health and identify emerging risks.
  • Investigate changes in performance, explain their causes and identify opportunities to improve outcomes or support growth.
  • Use your analysis to inform credit risk strategies, including where customer eligibility could be expanded or tightened.
  • Develop forecasting models to better understand future risk and contribute to budgeting and planning.
  • Work with colleagues across risk and the first line to understand problems, communicate findings and recommend action.
  • Deliver analytical projects across the portfolio, showing how your work contributes to business decisions rather than stopping at a report or dashboard.

The interview process:

  • Screening call with Chess (Internal Recruiter) (30 mins)
  • Video interview with the Hiring Manager (1 hour)

What we think you'll need

  • Hands-on data analysis skills, including SQL or BigQuery experience, and the ability to apply those skills to unfamiliar tools. Our current analytics environment includes BigQuery and Looker.
  • The ability to move from data to an explanation: identifying patterns, investigating why they're happening and making practical recommendations.
  • Clear communication, including the ability to explain your own contribution to a project, your analytical approach and what changed as a result.

Next steps If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on  

Our hybrid approach

Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working approach requires colleagues to attend the office at least three days a week, increasing to at least four days a week in Q1 2027

The opportunity

You'll work closely with teams in New York, London, and Belfast across Leveraged Finance, Structured Credit, Private Credit, and Distressed Debt.

What you’ll work on

Associate - News & Market Data Team

title: Data Scientist Internship
descriptionHtml:
Your mission

Our Engineering team

Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product. Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between infrastructure, backend, and frontend.

We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology. Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership, and team spirit.

👉 Curious to see what we’re building? Check out our Tech Blog!

As a Data Scientist Intern, you will help us push the boundaries of what AI can do inside Pigment, focusing on how our AI Modeler builds and maintains planning models. You’ll work closely with our AI engineering and data science teams to design, test, and evaluate LLM-based systems that turn loosely structured inputs into reliable, working Pigment models and formulas.

Project Overview: Making Pigment’s AI Modeler Smarter

Depending on your profile and interests, you will focus on one of these topics:

1. Formula Writing from Specifications

Have the Modeler write a specification of a formula (what it should do, and the tests it must pass), then build a small Formula Writer model that produces a correct formula from it.

2. Building Models from External Documents

Turn amorphous inputs (long PDFs, call transcripts, existing applications, templates) into structured Pigment applications: write the tests first, then iterate on a DSL representation until they pass.

3. Building Models from Databases

Given an existing database, determine which blocks and transformations to create to make sense of the data and integrate it as a Pigment model.

As an intern, you will:

  • Define success criteria, test suites, and evaluation metrics for your topic.
  • Design and iterate on LLM-based approaches (prompting, agentic workflows, intermediate representations).
  • Benchmark quality, reliability, and cost/latency, and document trade-offs.
  • Work with engineers and data scientists to build evaluation pipelines and share findings.

title: Diesel Mechanic
descriptionHtml:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.

Job Overview

We are currently seeking a skilled Diesel Mechanic to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining, repairing, and troubleshooting diesel engines and related systems on our autonomous surface vessels (ASVs) to ensure optimal performance and reliability.

 

Responsibilities

  • Perform routine maintenance tasks on diesel engines, including oil changes, filter replacements, and fluid checks, to ensure proper functioning and longevity.

  • Diagnose and repair diesel engine malfunctions, mechanical issues, and electrical faults using diagnostic tools, technical manuals, and troubleshooting techniques.

  • Inspect and test diesel engine components, systems, and subsystems to identify and address potential problems or areas of concern.

  • Overhaul and rebuild diesel engines and associated systems, including fuel injection systems, turbochargers, and exhaust systems, as needed to restore performance and efficiency.

  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance and repair activities, including parts used, labour hours, and service performed, to track equipment history and ensure compliance with maintenance schedules and regulatory requirements.

  • Follow safety protocols and procedures for working with diesel engines and related equipment, including proper handling and disposal of hazardous materials and fluids.

  • Collaborate with other maintenance technicians, engineers, and operators to troubleshoot complex problems, share technical knowledge, and implement effective solutions.

 

Qualifications

  • Marine Diesel and/or Volvo VODIA experience required

  • GCSEs (or equivalent) are required. A recognised vocational qualification or apprenticeship in diesel mechanics, marine engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.

  • Proven experience as a diesel technician or a diesel mechanic, with demonstrated proficiency in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining diesel engines and related systems.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and technical skills, with the ability to read and interpret technical manuals, diagrams, and schematics.

  • Familiarity with diagnostic tools and equipment used in diesel engine repair, such as scan tools, multimeters, and oscilloscopes.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical and electrical issues.

  • Effective communication skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.

  • Willingness to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with changing priorities and deadlines.

  • Ability to travel as needed to meet business objectives, including throughout the Indo-Pacific region and to our headquarters in Austin, Texas. This role will require spending 30+ days training at Saronic headquarters in Austin, Texas.

 

Physical Demands

  • Ability to perform physically demanding work for extended periods.

  • Frequently and repetitively lift, push, and carry up to 23 kg's.

  • Ability to work outdoors for extended periods in marine and waterside environments.

  • Frequently and repetitively bend, lift, and reach to install and remove components of varying size and weight.

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, including over varied and uneven terrain such as docks, vessel decks, and gravel surfaces.

  • Stoop, lay, bend, reach, squat, kneel, crouch, twist, and crawl for extended periods while working in confined or low-clearance spaces.

  • Climb and maintain balance on ladders, platforms, vessels, and other elevated structures.

  • Exposure to loud noise, vibration, engine exhaust, and hazardous materials with required adherence to safety and disposal procedures.

  • Wear Personal Protective Equipment at all times in work areas, including safety glasses, gloves, hearing protection, steel-toed footwear, and other PPE as required.

 

Benefits

  • Stock Options: Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success

  • Competitive Salary: Industry-standard salaries with opportunities for performance-based bonuses

  • Medical Insurance: Comprehensive private health insurance

  • Time Off: Generous annual leave entitlement, plus public holidays.

  • Parental Leave: Paid maternity and paternity leave to support new parents

This role requires the legal right to work in the United Kingdom. Employment may also be subject to applicable security, export control, and government contracting requirements.

If this role is based in the United States, it requires access to export-controlled information or items that require “U.S. Person” status.
