title: GTM Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY.

The Role

We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion.

This is a hands-on builder role, not a traditional RevOps support function. You'll work like a product engineer for GTM: find the biggest constraint on growth, turn a messy commercial problem into a working system, ship it quickly and improve it using real results. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to be able to build with Salesforce, Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools rather than waiting for someone else to do it.

You'll also be Kernel's own internal customer, using Kernel to build an AI-native revenue engine, pressure-test the product in real workflows and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering.

You'll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations, and work closely with Sales leadership and the wider GTM team.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build a better outbound engine: improve account targeting, signals, enrichment, prioritization, personalization, sequencing and measurement so the team consistently reaches the right companies at the right time

  • Make the GTM team more productive: automate repetitive work across account research, meeting preparation, follow-ups, CRM hygiene and handoffs so BDRs, AEs and Account Managers spend more time with customers

  • Run the revenue operating infrastructure: own the systems behind pipeline management, forecasting, funnel reporting, quota planning, GTM incentive compensation, renewals and expansion

  • Set the rules of engagement: own account assignment and routing, settle ownership disputes, and make sure every meeting booked and held is captured and credited to the right person

  • Improve how revenue work moves through Kernel: build reliable routing, attribution, account assignment and cross-functional handoffs, resolve edge cases and make performance visible

  • Be Kernel's own internal customer: deploy Kernel on our CRM, use it to improve our GTM data and workflows, and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering

What You Bring

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience: you have worked in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM Engineering at a high-growth Series B-E SaaS company and owned meaningful parts of the revenue engine end to end

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: you understand objects, record types, fields, formulas, flows, validation rules, permissions, reports and data migration. You can reason about architecture and debug production behavior

  • Strong GTM building ability: you have built useful systems with Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools, and you know how to move from a rough idea to a reliable workflow that people adopt

  • Commercial judgment: you understand how accounts become meetings, meetings become pipeline, pipeline is qualified and forecast, and won revenue flows into implementation, expansion, renewal and retention

  • Strong data instincts: you can turn fragmented information into trustworthy workflows, measure what is working and create feedback loops that improve performance over time

  • Clear, low-ego communication: you can turn a messy request into a crisp decision, explain trade-offs to non-technical teams, push back constructively and drive adoption through influence rather than authority

It is a plus if you also have:

  • Experience supporting an enterprise sales motion with multi-stakeholder deals and MEDDPICC

  • Experience with renewals, expansion, compensation, quota setting or planning

  • Familiarity with Gong, sales engagement platforms and modern enrichment or intent tooling

  • Experience building operational controls around LLM- or agent-powered workflows

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Prefer strategy and recommendations over configuring systems, cleaning data, investigating edge cases and debugging workflows yourself

  • Need outlined requirements or stable priorities before you can make progress

  • See GTM Engineering primarily as CRM administration or ticket fulfillment rather than a revenue-generating function

❌ This role is definitely not for you if you:

  • Are not comfortable taking broad ownership of a function

  • Prefer a predictable, low-intensity environment

  • Want to protect a 9-to-6 or a mostly remote setup. We are in the office together 4-5 days a week and the pace is high

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

title: Head of Account Management (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

Client Impact at Upvest owns our clients' journey from signature to go-live and beyond, spanning Launch, Migrations, Account Management, Client Experience and Integration Success. Once a client is live, Account Management takes over: we own the relationship end to end, grow it commercially, run it strategically and make sure our clients see Upvest as a partner, not a vendor. Client satisfaction is one of the things that sets us apart from incumbents, and recommendations from our live clients have already been key to new wins.

We are looking for a Head of Account Management to lead this team and Upvest's live client portfolio, which includes some of Europe's best-known fintechs, neobrokers and banks. You will own the commercial development of the portfolio (renewals, upsell, ARR and revenue retention) and the senior relationships behind it, lead a team of senior Account Managers, and build the operating model that lets us scale. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will sit across the table from client C-levels yourself, not only manage the people who do.

You will report directly to Jens Maluck, VP Client Impact, and work closely with Growth, Product, Launch, Client Experience and Finance.

What you’ll do:

  • Commercial growth

    • Own the commercial development of the live client portfolio: renewals, expansions and upsells, against budget and upsell targets

    • Spot commercial opportunities and leveraging knowledge across the portfolio

    • Lead commercial negotiations for live clients, including pricing

    • Build strategic account plans that set out each client's growth path with Upvest, from new use cases and asset classes to new functionality and geographies

    • Advise clients on their end-user investment offering (product, pricing, promotions, conversion), because the better our clients perform, the better Upvest performs

    • Provide case studies and references that help win new business

  • Client ownership

    • Be the senior counterpart for client leadership teams, from handover after go-live through renewals and escalations

    • Lead QBRs, Steering Committees and executive alignment, keeping stakeholders aligned from C-level to technical teams

    • Act as the filter between our clients and the wider Upvest organisation: answer most product, asset class and commercial questions directly, run client meetings independently with your team, and bring in others only where they add real value

    • Be the first point of escalation for live clients, resolving issues quickly and coordinating the wider organisation where needed

    • Represent the voice of the client inside Upvest, channelling structured feedback to Product, Operations and Growth

    • Safeguard the partnership by ensuring contract adherence on both sides

  • Performance and insight

    • Own the portfolio KPIs: ARR, net and gross revenue retention, and client satisfaction (CSAT and Account Health Score)

    • Track client performance (users, conversions, assets under custody, trading activity) against plan, and use anonymised benchmarks to help clients improve

    • Own the client input to the annual budget and the monthly actuals vs budget review with Finance

    • Report to senior management on account health, risks and opportunities, with clear actionable recommendations

  • Team and operating model

    • Lead, hire and develop a team of senior Account Managers, setting a high bar for quality, execution speed and commercial impact

    • Define and continuously improve how Upvest manages its live clients: account tiering, governance cadences, account health scoring, documentation and tooling

    • Drive AI adoption across Account Management, using Claude and system integrations to automate analysis, reporting and preparation work

    • Work very closely with Client Experience who own the day to day operational alignment and ticket resolution

What you bring:

  • Experience: 8+ years in account management, client success or strategic relationship management for B2B enterprise clients, of which 3+ years leading an account management or client team

  • Investment and brokerage expertise: You can discuss asset types in depth (equities, ETFs, funds and MMFs, bonds, securitised derivatives, crypto) and the trading, custody, settlement and fee economics behind them. Ideally, you gained this in B2B investment infrastructure or B2C brokerage (e.g. a neobroker or the investment offering of a digital bank)

  • Commercial track record: You have owned renewals, upsells and negotiations end to end, ideally against NRR / GRR targets or a commission plan, and you can name the deals you generated

  • Relevant background: Regulated fintech or banking with financial institutions as clients, or B2B API, embedded finance or enterprise SaaS

  • Product mindset: You are eager to understand the product in depth and E2E, and have a drive to represent it to the client without the Product team present. You understand the value of standardisation and automation over customisation

  • People leadership: You have led a team of senior individual contributors, and you can show both a strong team culture and raising the bar (coaching, performance management, stepping in when output falls short)

  • Operating model builder: You have built playbooks, improved processes and implemented systems that let a team scale

  • Data-driven: You run accounts on KPIs (client performance, forecast vs actuals, adoption etc.)

  • AI-enabled: You use AI hands-on every day (ideally Claude), are comfortable connecting it to business systems via MCP or similar, and can walk us through workflows you automated

  • Executive presence: You are a trusted counterpart for C-level stakeholders and lead QBRs, SteerCos and difficult commercial conversations without senior back-up

  • Ownership: You are the go-to person for your area: you communicate proactively, flag risks early and take a clear position. You are hands-on and not looking for a pure manage-the-managers role

It’s great if you have:

  • B2C brokerage experience, to guide clients on product design, pricing, promotions, conversion and activity

  • Experience with country expansion (local market specifics, tax and regulatory set-up, market launch)

  • A network and market insight in Upvest's core European markets (e.g. Germany, Netherlands, Spain, UK, France)

  • Experience with migrations or large client transitions

  • German and/or Spanish language skills

  • Location preference: Berlin-based preferred. Alternatively London-based or remote, willingness to travel to Berlin every couple of weeks

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Head of Creative
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

Own creative direction for Allica Bank across brand, design, motion, video, copy and web, leading a multi-disciplinary studio team that serves both brand & marketing work and the high-volume production needs of Growth & Digital Acquisition. Balance hands-on craft leadership with production efficiency at scale, and drive AI adoption across the studio to meet growth's velocity requirements without compromising brand or compliance standards.

Principal Accountabilities

Creative direction & craft

  • Set and maintain creative direction across all brand & growth touchpoints including digital, video, motion, print/OOH, email, sales collateral and internal comms.

  • Provide hands-on creative direction and craft feedback across brand, copy, design, motion and video.

  • Direct and prioritise in-house studio output; own the AI tooling roadmap for extending capacity and make the resourcing case if/when AI-assisted tools no longer cover demand.

Team & production management

  • Lead, develop and manage a team of 7 across copy, design, motion/video and web.

  • Own production process end-to-end: briefing, resourcing, review cycles, delivery timelines, quality control.

  • Manage external agency/freelance relationships where in-house capacity is stretched.

Production capacity & growth support

  • Own the studio's operating model for serving two distinct demand types: considered brand/campaign work, and high-volume, fast-turnaround performance/growth creative (landing pages, ad variants, paid social, CRO test assets).

  • Build a production process (templating, design systems, copy/creative frameworks, AI-assisted variant generation) that can meet Growth & Digital Acquisition's volume and speed requirements without pulling the whole studio into reactive, always-on production.

  • Partner directly with Growth/Digital Acquisition leadership to support in-housing of all Allica’s creative assets, agree SLAs, prioritisation rules, and what can be templated/self-served vs. what needs bespoke creative input.

  • Decide what volume of production can be safely delegated to AI-assisted workflows versus what requires human craft and compliance review.

  • Track studio capacity against demand from both brand and growth, and use that data to make resourcing/tooling cases.

AI adoption

  • Own the studio's broader AI adoption roadmap across design, copy, motion and web production, balancing speed against brand quality and IP/copyright risk.

  • Periodically reassess whether AI tooling is sufficient to cover demand or whether the team has outgrown that setup, and make a resourcing case if so.

Brand

  • Champion brand consistency and evolution as Allica scale.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Proven creative leadership role (Creative Lead/Director level) in a high-growth in-house or prestigious agency environment, managing a multi-discipline team of similar size.

  • Genuine hands on craft experience across brand, copy, design and motion/video, not delegated oversight.

  • Practical, current experience embedding AI tools into creative production workflows (design, copy, motion, and ideally web/no-code tooling).

  • Experience running a creative studio that serves both brand and performance/growth marketing demand, understands the difference in process, pace and quality bar between the two.

  • Experience building templated/systemised creative production (design systems, modular copy frameworks, creative testing pipelines) to support high-volume output.

  • • Comfortable partnering with Growth, Digital Acquisition and Product stakeholders, not just Brand and Marketing.

  • Strong commercial acumen and able to work with senior commercial, product and growth leads and advocate for the importance of quality creative execution.

  • Financial promotions or regulated marketing experience: a plus, not a requirement. Comfortable learning and operating within a regulated approval process even without prior direct experience.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Head of Operations
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is that we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region, including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

The Head of Operations Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale.

This is not a P&L role, and it's not a "manage from a distance" role either. You'll partner closely with the CEO to turn business objectives into strong execution on the ground, building systems, leading teams, and stepping in directly when execution breaks.

 

What You'll Own

  • Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market.

  • Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless.

  • Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability.

  • Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed.

  • Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases.

  • Oversee company administration and internal operations, including office management, documentation, vendor coordination, and adherence to internal policies.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong background in operations, execution, or internal business operations in tech, fintech, or fast-scaling environments.

  • Proven experience leading operations and admin teams in high-expectation environments.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to solve problems directly, not just delegate them.

  • Strong organisational, execution, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to fast-moving situations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and drive execution without formal authority.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who want to direct operations from a distance instead of stepping in when things break.

  • Candidates who need fully-built systems and processes handed to them.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid escalations, messy cases, or hard conversations with vendors and staff.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

  • This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1-2 weeks from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Head of Regulatory Affairs, Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

Checkout.com holds licences in many countries, and the way we work with our supervisors matters more every year. We are creating a new Regulatory Affairs function to lead that work, and we are looking for the person to build it.

As Head of Regulatory Affairs, you will manage our supervisory relationships day to day and run the formal work that comes with them: information requests, thematic reviews, inspections and examinations. You will also shape how the new function works and where it grows, working closely with the Director of External Affairs.You will bring together the right people across Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Product and Tech, and make sure everything we send is accurate, consistent and on time.

You will start hands-on, building the foundations yourself, leveraging advanced AI tools, then build a team of regulatory affairs specialists across our major markets over time.

What you'll do

Build the function

  • Shape our approach to supervisory engagement across our regulated entities.

  • Design how Regulatory Affairs works day to day, including how it works with Compliance, Legal, Risk and the business.

  • Help plan where the team grows, including which countries need local specialists and in what order.

  • Build a clear view of supervisory risk across the group and use it to set priorities.

  • Advise executives on what our supervisors expect and how upcoming supervisory activity will affect the business.

Manage our supervisory relationships

  • Run the regular cycle of supervisory meetings: preparation, briefing senior colleagues, attending and following up.

  • Keep a clear record of what we have told each regulator and what we have committed to.

  • Own the protocol for how we engage with supervisors, so colleagues know who speaks to whom and when.

  • Spot emerging issues early and raise them with senior leadership.

Run regulatory requests

  • Own regulator information requests and thematic reviews from receipt to submission: scope, owners, deadlines, evidence, version control and quality checks.

  • Act as a single front door for the business, so teams get one clear request instead of several.

  • Challenge draft responses for gaps and inconsistencies before they go out.

Lead inspections and examinations

  • Run inspections, examinations and skilled-person reviews as programmes, from the opening notice to the closing meeting.

  • Set the plan and the narrative, coordinate evidence, and prepare and rehearse subject-matter experts and senior leaders.

  • Run a lessons-learned review after each engagement and improve the process for next time.

Build the team and the infrastructure

  • Hire, develop and lead a team of regulatory affairs specialists across our major markets.

  • Build the playbooks, templates, trackers and governance the function will run on.

  • Build a library of past submissions so we can reuse good work.

  • Set up regular reporting to senior leadership and entity boards on open requests, inspections and commitments.

What we are looking for

  • A builder. You have set up a function, team or process from scratch, and you enjoy turning an open brief into something that works.

  • Significant experience as a regulatory affairs manager / lead at a regulated payments, e-money or fintech firm.

  • Hands-on experience running regulatory information requests and inspections end to end, ideally across more than one country.

  • Time in a supervisory team at a major financial regulator, such as the FCA, ACPR, MAS or CBUAE, is a strong advantage.

  • Strategic judgement. You can set a clear direction, explain it to executives and turn it into a plan.

  • Excellent project management. You can run several deadlines with many contributors at once and keep every one of them on track.

  • A track record of keeping calm under pressure.

  • Sound judgement on when to bring in Legal or Compliance.

  • Credibility with regulators and the trust of senior executives.

  • Impeccable written communication.

  • People management experience, or clear readiness to build and lead a team

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Healthcare Product Manager Junior - CDI Paris - Theodo HealthTech
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.

Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Chez Theodo HealthTech, l'entité experte en santé, nous accompagnons tous les acteurs de la santé dans le développement des dispositifs médicaux digitaux sur-mesure. Grâce à notre expérience du Lean et de la tech, combinées à notre connaissance de la santé, nous concevons et développons des dispositifs médicaux numériques qui s'intègrent dans le parcours de soins des patients (thérapies digitales - DTx, essais cliniques virtualisés, parcours de soins digitalisés). Notre but est de réaliser des produits qui changent la vie de leurs utilisateurs, qu'ils soient soignants ou patients.
Tes futures missions : En tant que Product Manager, ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client. Tu seras pour cela encadré par un Lead Product Manager. - Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée, en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client. - Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…). - Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème. - Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints. - Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions. - Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique, en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks. - Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives). Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : - Hub Santé : lancé par l’Agence du Numérique en Santé en 2024, vise à connecter en temps réel les 83 SAMU, SMUR, SDIS et autres acteurs de l’urgence, dans un écosystème historiquement fragmenté. Accompagnée par une équipe de 3 experts Theodo, l’ANS a déployé une plateforme nationale d’interopérabilité permettant une coordination critique plus fluide et sécurisée. Résultats : +10 SAMU connectés dès la phase pilote, interopérabilité effective sur plusieurs périmètres et conformité HDS maintenue. - Vidal : référence centenaire de l’information médicale, a développé avec Theodo un assistant médical basé sur l’IA générative pour fournir aux professionnels de santé des réponses fiables en un temps record et sécuriser la prescription. En 8 semaines, une équipe de 4 experts Theodo a conçu un POC de chatbot RAG connecté à la base Vidal, capable de réduire le temps de recherche tout en garantissant traçabilité et fiabilité des sources. Objectif : renforcer la confiance des praticiens et faire entrer Vidal dans l’ère du service médical “fonctionnel”. Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur, avec jusqu’à 2 ans d’expérience professionnelle, idéalement en conseil ou dans un contexte avec forte exposition client. - Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business, avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet. - Excellente aisance relationnelle : à l’aise face aux clients, capable d’adopter la bonne posture et de créer une relation de confiance. - Posture client first : disponible, réactif, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours et d’anticiper les besoins. - Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser, capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé.Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo HealthTech ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

Über DP World


Handel ist das Lebensblut der Weltwirtschaft, er schafft Chancen und verbessert die Lebensqualität der Menschen auf der ganzen Welt. DP World existiert, um den weltweiten Handelsfluss zu verbessern und die Möglichkeiten für die Kunden und Gemeinschaften, die wir weltweit bedienen, zu verändern.


Mit einem engagierten, vielfältigen und professionellen Team von mehr als 115.000 Mitarbeitern aus 159 Nationalitäten in 77 Ländern auf sechs Kontinenten treibt DP World den Handel weiter und schneller voran, hin zu einer nahtlosen Lieferkette, die für die Zukunft gerüstet ist.

Darüber hinaus gestalten wir die Zukunft neu, indem wir in Innovationen investieren. Von intelligenten Liefersystemen bis hin zur automatisierten Lagerbeladung sind wir auf dem neuesten Stand der disruptiven Technologie und treiben den Sektor zu besseren Handelsmethoden an, um Störungen von der Fabrikhalle bis zur Haustür des Kunden zu minimieren.


DP World hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, Grenzen zu überschreiten und die Kluft zwischen allen Nationen und Kulturen zu überbrücken – nicht nur in dem, was wir tun, sondern auch in unserem Verhalten.


Wir sind bestrebt, eine Kultur zu schaffen, in der sich jeder respektiert, unterstützt und befähigt fühlt, sein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Wir glauben, dass die Akzeptanz von Inklusion und Vielfalt Innovation und Wachstum vorantreibt und uns hilft, Menschen, Unternehmen und Gesellschaften zu verbinden. Freie Geister und unterschiedliche Perspektiven verändern unsere Welt, und gemeinsam können wir verändern, was möglich ist.


Die DP World-Familie besteht aus Syncreon, Imperial und P&O.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role
You'll own the people agenda for our teams in France, where the large majority of Vibe's engineering and product talent sit. You'll report to our HRBP Director in New York and partner closely with our Chief People Officer, based in Paris. This role exists because our European headcount is scaling fast and the technical org needs a dedicated partner on the ground. You'll get real ownership of a strategic region, direct exposure to senior technical leaders, and the chance to shape how we grow talent across three continents.


What You'll Do

  • Partner with leaders on the full talent lifecycle, from onboarding to retention.

  • Advise on organizational design as the technical org scales.

What You Need

Nice to Haves

  • A track record of connecting people decisions to business outcomes.

Our Values
At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.
You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.
This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.
If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.


What We Offer

The pay range for this role is €60,000–€90,000.
At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

Our Interview Process
We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting.

  • Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

title: Implementation Manager
descriptionHtml:
Location: Dublin or London, hybrid, minimum 2 days per week in office

Full-time, permanent


About Kota

Kota is making insurance and retirement benefits as accessible as modern software. We do this across two products: Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance and retirement product for other platforms.

Today we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at companies including Carwow, Tines, Zoe and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from investors including EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone and Frontline, along with founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio and OpenAI.

The Role

Kota Embed powers the benefits layer inside other platforms, mostly employers of record and HR platforms with employees across multiple countries. Partner launches and growth require best-in-class delivery: integration build, benefits set up market by market, data migration, seamless end-customer product experience, and support readiness.

We're hiring an Implementation Manager to own those launches end to end, plus the renewals that follow. You'll run around five at once working alongside Embed Sales and Account Management teams.

This is a delivery role with real teeth. Partners tell their own clients when benefits are going live based on what we tell them, so the dates matter and the person who owns them has to be able to hold a line and change it early when it needs changing.


What You'll Do

  • Own new partner launches from signature to live: scope, plan, cadence, dependencies, blockers, the lot

  • Run roughly five concurrent projects, and know which one needs you this week

  • Align product, engineering, benefits and commercial around the same plan and the same dates

  • Define what go-live actually means for each launch, and get everyone using the same definition

  • Chase blockers rather than report them, including with people who don't work for you

  • Join partner calls alongside the Account Executive or Account Manager, and lead the delivery half of them

  • Keep internal tracking in Asana and the partner-facing view in sync

  • Spot a slipping date early and say so, to us and to the partner

What We're Looking For

  • Experience running multiple customer-facing implementations at once rather than one large programme

  • Either technical depth, comfortable with APIs and integration conversations, or a strong data and analytics background. We're open on which

  • A track record of getting things delivered through people who don't report to you

  • Calm and process-driven, with the judgement to know when the process is in the way

  • Comfortable in front of customers, including when the news isn't good

  • Able to hold a date, defend it, and change it early rather than late

  • Highly organised and proactive - enough to run five things properly rather than five things approximately

  • Comfortable with pace and with processes that are still being built


Benefits, HR tech, payments, fintech, cross-border or migration experience is a plus. You don't need to know anything about insurance or pensions before you start.


Our Values

  • Have Integrity. We care deeply about our why and it won't jeopardise our how.

  • Care Deeply. Our products are our story, we look at the details, go the extra mile to delight customers.

  • Own Your Ship. Ask why, do the work, get the data, solve the problem, be an owner.

  • Raise the Bar. We continuously look to push past good enough. Expect more, move faster, and never stop raising your and the team's standards.

  • Play to Win. We exist because we decided to say no to the norm, now we do this everyday.


Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 mins. Cover the basics and make sure we're aligned

  2. Competency interview, 45 mins. With our Strategy & Operations Associate

  3. Task, 60 mins. A real implementation scenario. We'll send it in advance and work through it together on the call with GM + 1

  4. Final, 45 mins. With our CEO and COO


Benefits

  • Health insurance via Kota

  • Workplace pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota (location dependent)

  • Group life assurance via Kota (location dependent)

  • WFH stipend for your home office setup

  • Annual company-wide offsite

title: Influencer & Branded Content  Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are PMG

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.

Who You'll Be Working With

At PMG, our Influencer & Branded Content team is at the intersection of culture, storytelling, and strategy, helping brands connect with audiences in authentic, meaningful ways. We craft high-impact influencer campaigns that go beyond traditional advertising, driving engagement, building brand affinity, and delivering measurable results across social, digital, and experiential platforms.

As the Influencer & Branded Content Senior Manager, you’ll play a key leadership role in shaping and delivering influencer and creator strategies across PMG’s clients. You’ll collaborate with creators, talent agencies, media strategists, content teams, client leaders, and brand partners to develop programs that connect cultural relevance with business impact. You’ll help strengthen PMG’s influencer and creator marketing capabilities by establishing scalable best practices, developing strong talent and platform relationships, and ensuring a high standard of strategy, execution, measurement, and client service.

You’ll help advance the future of branded content at PMG by identifying emerging creator trends, exploring new content formats and platforms, and translating innovation into actionable opportunities for clients. You’ll also lead and develop team members, helping them strengthen their strategic thinking, channel expertise, and ability to deliver exceptional work.

If you’re passionate about shaping culture through creator-driven storytelling, using data to guide meaningful decisions, and building innovative influencer programs that deliver measurable impact, this is the place to make your mark.

What You Will Do

  • Lead full-scale influencer and branded content campaigns from brief to delivery—including strategy development, talent identification, negotiations, publisher partnerships, content approvals, and reporting—translating business objectives, audience insights, and cultural trends into impactful creator programs.
  • Oversee campaign strategy and execution in partnership with internal team members, ensuring every detail is delivered with excellence, on time, aligned with brand standards and client business objectives, and optimized for measurable success.
  • Manage and mentor a team of professionals, supporting workload planning, day-to-day execution, coaching, feedback, performance management, and long-term professional development while building a culture of collaboration, creativity, and accountability.
  • Partner with the Director of Influencer & Branded Content to help evolve PMG’s offerings, develop scalable frameworks, best practices, processes, and measurement approaches, and train team members to grow their expertise and impact.
  • Serve as a senior subject matter expert in influencer marketing and branded content, bringing a strong point of view to client conversations, strategic recommendations, new business opportunities, and emerging creator trends.
  • Serve as a senior point of contact for clients, clearly communicating strategic plans, campaign updates, recommendations, and results through regular calls, emails, and in-person meetings.
  • Develop innovative influencer and branded content programs for existing clients and new business opportunities, partnering closely with account, strategy, media, and creative teams to connect creator ideas to broader marketing objectives.
  • Play an active role in new business efforts, contributing to RFPs, pitch development, influencer research, and presentation storytelling.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, talent agencies, publishers, and platform partners to expand access to talent, industry insights, platform innovation, and strategic opportunities.
  • Bring platform fluency across both established and emerging social channels, shaping creator strategies that are native to each platform.
  • Track and distill influencer marketing trends into practical strategies that keep our work relevant, fresh, and forward-thinking.
  • Apply and evolve measurement frameworks to evaluate creator performance, campaign effectiveness, audience engagement, and business impact, translating results into actionable recommendations for clients.
  • Provide strategic guidance and quality oversight across campaign planning, creator selection, contracting, content approvals, reporting, compliance, and partnership deliverables.
  • Partner with senior leaders to identify opportunities to improve team processes, resource planning, capabilities, and approaches that support continued client and business growth.
  • Use AI, automation, and technology to elevate the quality and efficiency of work, streamline processes, and enable faster, more informed decision-making.
  • The primary focus of this role is the Influencer & Branded Content channel, ensuring excellence in strategy, execution, and performance. However, responsibilities may extend across other media channels as needed to support broader campaign objectives and business priorities.

What You Will Bring

  • 6+ years of experience in Influencer & Branded Content, including 3+ years of leadership experience, with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • You bring advanced expertise in content creation and influencer marketing strategy, developing creator-led programs that connect cultural insight, platform behavior, audience needs, and client business goals.
  • You have strong experience in contract review and proposal development, navigating creator and partnership negotiations with clarity, consistency, and a focus on delivering value for clients and partners.
  • You bring exceptional attention to detail, maintaining high standards across campaign execution, reporting, content approvals, compliance, and partnership deliverables.
  • You have strong proficiency in project implementation, leading complex influencer and branded content programs from strategic planning through launch, optimization, and post-campaign learning.
  • You are skilled in presentation and communication, delivering clear strategic narratives, senior-level recommendations, and performance insights to clients, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • You have a deep understanding of advertising standards, client service, and relationship management, helping brands and creators build trusted partnerships that meet business, legal, and platform expectations.
  • You are proficient with influencer management dashboards, social media platforms, and the broader social media ecosystem, using data to evaluate creators, guide recommendations, and improve campaign performance.
  • You have experience building relationships across the influencer marketing ecosystem, including creators, talent agencies, publishers, and platform partners, and leveraging those relationships to strengthen client programs.
  • You bring strategic thinking, business and financial acumen, and thoughtful resource management to guide account priorities, team planning, and scalable approaches to client growth.
  • You have demonstrated experience managing and developing team members, balancing day-to-day leadership with coaching, feedback, performance management, and long-term professional development.
  • A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a Customer-Focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value.
  • A dedication to People-Focused leadership, fostering collaboration, innovation, and professional growth by Leading by Example and nurturing strong relationships that empower others to excel.

What We Offer

Performance-Based Rewards: Your impact should be part of your reward. This role is eligible for PMG’s annual bonus program—a standout part of our total compensation offering and an opportunity to share in our success. Bonus awards are informed by individual impact and performance, as well as team and company results, and are subject to applicable program terms.

Professional Development: Keep growing through learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and support for career advancement.

Generous Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge, connect with loved ones, and enjoy life outside work.

AI Tools and Training: Access enterprise AI tools and ongoing training that helps PMGers use AI effectively, creatively, and responsibly.

Our benefits and compensation programs may vary by location and eligibility and are subject to applicable plan terms. We’ll share full details during the hiring process.

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. Contexte de la mission

Dans le cadre d'un projet majeur du secteur nucléaire, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Fabrication / Adjoint Responsable Fabrication spécialisé en chaudronnerie nucléaire pour accompagner la structuration, la mise en place et le pilotage d'activités de fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés, notamment en acier inoxydable.

La mission s'articule autour de deux sites de fabrication présentant des niveaux de maturité différents : le premier dispose déjà d'une expertise et d'une expérience confirmées en fabrication INOX, tandis que le second n'a encore jamais réalisé ce type de production.

L'objectif est d'accompagner le déploiement de cette nouvelle activité sur le second site, en s'appuyant sur les savoir-faire existants, tout en assurant la coordination, la transmission des compétences et l'harmonisation des méthodes de fabrication entre les équipes.

Cette mission nécessite une forte présence terrain, une solide expertise technique en chaudronnerie nucléaire et d'excellentes capacités de communication et de pédagogie pour fédérer les équipes et accompagner le changement.

Missions

  • Participer à la mise en place et à l'organisation des ateliers de fabrication.

  • Accompagner le déploiement d'une nouvelle activité de fabrication INOX sur un site industriel n'ayant jamais réalisé ce type de production.

  • S'appuyer sur l'expertise du site maîtrisant déjà la fabrication INOX pour faciliter le transfert de savoir-faire et de bonnes pratiques vers le second site.

  • Assurer la coordination technique et opérationnelle entre les deux sites de fabrication.

  • Définir et mettre en œuvre les premières lignes directrices et les méthodes de fabrication.

  • Concevoir, définir et mettre en place les gabarits et outillages nécessaires à la fabrication.

  • Assurer le pilotage opérationnel et l'accompagnement technique des équipes de fabrication.

  • Participer activement à la formation des équipes et à leur montée en compétences sur les procédés de fabrication INOX.

  • Favoriser la communication, le partage des connaissances et l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les équipes des différents sites.

  • Élaborer et mettre à jour les documents nécessaires au suivi et à l'organisation de la production.

  • Apporter un appui technique et méthodologique aux équipes afin de garantir le bon démarrage des activités de fabrication.

  • Accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouvelles méthodes et pratiques industrielles.

  • Expérience dans la mise en place, l'organisation ou le développement d'ateliers de fabrication.

  • Capacité à définir des méthodes de fabrication, des gammes opératoires et des gabarits de production.

  • Maîtrise de la documentation technique et des méthodes de fabrication industrielles.

  • Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques, notamment du Pack Office, pour la rédaction, la structuration et le suivi documentaire.

  • Expérience en encadrement fonctionnel, pilotage et accompagnement d'équipes de production.

  • Capacité à transmettre ses connaissances, à former les équipes et à accompagner leur montée en compétences.

  • Excellent communicant, capable de créer du lien entre les équipes, de faciliter les échanges entre les sites et de faire adhérer les collaborateurs aux nouvelles méthodes de travail.

  • Qualités pédagogiques, sens de l'écoute et capacité à fédérer des équipes présentant différents niveaux d'expertise.

title: Ingénieur.e de recherche (H/F) - CDD 18 mois
descriptionHtml:
Méthodes numériques et d’intelligence artificielle combinée à une approche expérimentale pour concevoir des matériaux et dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie à partir de composites biocarbone à base de graphite.

ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des SOlides Divisés, de l'Energie et de l'Environnement), unité mixte de recherche CNRS dédiée aux procédés, matériaux et énergies durables.

Le Postdoc sera dirigé par le professeur Ange Nzihou et codirigé par un chercheur de l'université de Princeton (États-Unis).

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

Ce travail s’inscrit dans un projet ERC (European Research Council) Advanced Grant. L’ERC est une organisation européenne de financement qui soutient des projets de recherche de rupture à travers des appels à projets très compétitifs, dans le cadre du programme Horizon Europe de l’Union européenne.

Le projet ERC vise à évaluer la capacité de stockage de composites innovants en biocarbones. Il s’agit d’une famille de matériaux carbonés avancés et durables issus de la biomasse, permettant de stocker l’énergie dans différents environnements, contrairement à la plupart des solutions actuelles reposant sur des matériaux d’origine fossile ou non durables. Cela devrait se traduire par une réduction notable des émissions de CO₂ et des économies d’énergie. Les travaux seront menés dans un environnement international, avec des visites régulières dans les laboratoires de partenaires en France, en Inde et aux États-Unis.

Nous recherchons un chercheur ou une chercheuse très motivé(e) pour contribuer à la conception et au développement de matériaux et de dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie avancés et performants, en combinant des méthodes de calcul, l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et des approches expérimentales.

L’objectif est de développer et d’appliquer des modèles numériques, des méthodes fondées sur les données et des outils utilisant l’IA afin de prédire les propriétés des matériaux, d’optimiser leur composition et leur structure, et d’améliorer la capacité et les performances de stockage de l’énergie. Les travaux combineront des études théoriques et numériques avec la synthèse expérimentale, la caractérisation, la validation et l’optimisation de solutions innovantes de stockage de l’énergie.

Un axe important du projet portera sur l’étude des propriétés thermophysiques, thermomécaniques et de stabilité thermique de composites à base de biocarbone graphitique. Le/La candidat(e) étudiera les relations entre la structure des matériaux, leurs propriétés fonctionnelles, leur comportement et les performances globales du dispositif en conditions d’utilisation, afin de contribuer au développement de technologies de stockage de l’énergie sûres, efficaces et durables.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

• Solides compétences en sciences computationnelles, en méthodes apprentissage automatique (machine learning) et en méthodes fondées sur l’intelligence artificielle
• Solides compétences en caractérisation des matériaux, en recherche expérimentale et dans les technologies de stockage de l’énergie
• Bonnes compétences en programmation

Capacités et aptitudes :

• Rigueur scientifique, capacité d’analyse et de synthèse
• Autonomie et esprit d’initiative
• Capacité à travailler dans un environnement de recherche international et interdisciplinaire
• Bonne communication écrite et orale en anglais

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

Diplôme de doctorat (PhD) en génie des procédés, science des matériaux, génie énergétique, physique, sciences computationnelles ou dans un domaine connexe.

What we're all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. The opportunity.

The Quantexa Academy helps our customers, partners and colleagues become self-sufficient with the Quantexa Platform. We do that through online learning, instructor-led sessions and bespoke digital resources that let every user harness the power of our award-winning Decision Intelligence Platform.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an Instructional Designer to join our Design & Publish Team within Education Services. You'll turn complex technical topics – data, analytics, software and FinTech – into clear, engaging and accessible learning experiences, taking projects from first conversation with a subject matter expert through to a polished, published solution.

This is a role for an independent problem solver. You'll own your design projects end to end, decide how best to approach each one, and organize your own time across several priorities at once, spotting risks early and keeping stakeholders informed without needing to be chased. You'll work alongside Product, R&D and Delivery experts, and have the room to bring your own ideas on tools, approaches and how we use AI to design better learning.

If you love making hard things easy to learn, and do your best work with autonomy and trust, we'd like to hear from you.

This is a hybrid role, with the expectation of attending the company office in central London twice a week.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing needs.

  • A collaborative, proactive and solution-focused approach, and the ability to build positive relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

Desirable

  • Experience coordinating projects that involve several stakeholders.

  • Experience mentoring or sharing knowledge with colleagues, or an interest in doing so.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

As the Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer, you will own the development of high-speed control and protection systems for the Alpha fusion demonstrator, focusing on FPGA-based solutions for plasma heating hardware protection.

You will work across the full development lifecycle, from writing and verifying HDL code to developing software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing, integrating embedded software and electronics, and establishing robust development and deployment pipelines.

You will also help establish Proxima’s FPGA development capability beyond plasma heating, defining reusable architectures, development workflows, testing methodologies, and HDL best practices that can be adopted across other systems.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Design, implement, and maintain HDL-based control and protection systems, starting with plasma heating system protection.

  • Establish end-to-end FPGA development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and SIL/HIL test environments integrated with plant design frameworks.

  • Develop embedded software, firmware, and low-level drivers to interface FPGAs with sensors, actuators, and other control systems.

  • Collaborate across RF, controls, electronics, and systems teams to define system interfaces, ICDs, and verification plans.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Degree in Electronics, Embedded Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong proficiency in HDL (VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog) and software scripting (Python, C/C++).

  • Proven experience integrating FPGAs with hardware peripherals, board-level electronics, and communication interfaces.

  • Familiarity with modern software development practices (Git, CI, code review, automated testing).

  • Systems-thinking approach with strong debugging skills spanning HDL, embedded firmware, and physical hardware.

Nice to have:

  • High-speed digital interfaces (multi-gigabit serial links, LVDS, SerDes, RF/instrumentation links) and PCB-level signal integrity.

  • FPGA+processor platforms and MPSoCs (e.g., AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+).

  • Precision timing and synchronization (IEEE 1588 PTP, White Rabbit)

  • Network protocols (Ethernet).

  • Real-time signal processing, fast protection systems, and high-speed data acquisition in fusion or industrial environments.

  • HDL design methodologies and techniques for reliable radiation-hardened systems.

  • Schematic comprehension and custom PCB development.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at "L2" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: International Expansion
descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the French market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in French markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak French and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the French market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

  • Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

  • Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and eventually on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

  • Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

  • Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

  • Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to deliver first-of-a-kind projects in one of Europe’s most important flexibility markets, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Ideally, you would be able to start by February 2027.

Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in the France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

title: Investor in Residence
descriptionHtml:
About the role

You've built a company, run a team or invested for a few years, and you're between chapters. Maybe you've exited, left a role, or wound something down. You want time to work out what comes next without stepping out of the venture world while you do.

We're offering a seat in our Berlin office for six to nine months. You'll work as part of the investment team on real deals and real portfolio problems, and you'll have room to explore your own next move, whether that's founding again, joining a startup or going deeper into investing.

About PT1

PT1 is an independent early-stage VC with offices in Berlin and London. We invest in companies that electrify energy and buildings, automate construction and industry, and make infrastructure more resilient.

Our portfolio includes Voltfang, ecoworks, PlanRadar, Wunderflats, Terra One, Gendo, Beagle, Climate X and AUAR. We've invested alongside Visionaries, ForwardOne, Daphni, Insight Partners, Google Ventures, Zacua Ventures and Aenu.

How we work

We're a small team, and PT1 feels more like a well-funded startup than a classic fund. Everyone here has shaped the firm, from how we run diligence to which theses we chase to the tools we've built. We run on our own stack for sourcing, diligence and portfolio work, and people who've seen it call it the most advanced VC stack they know.

What you'll do

  • Work on live deals from the first call to IC, and bring an operator's or investor's judgement to them

  • Shape investment theses in the markets you know best

  • Work with portfolio founders on the problems you've already solved: hiring, product, go-to-market, their next round

  • Help build the platform. If you think in systems or write code, there's a lot to push further.

  • Use the time and the network to work out your own next step. If that turns out to be a company we'd back, even better.

About you

  • Ex-founder, operator or investor with real years behind you (VC, PE, M&A, or building and running a company)

  • Technical background or technical depth: engineering, CS, maths, natural sciences, or years of building technical products

  • Strong opinions on at least one of energy, infrastructure, construction or automation

  • Comfortable with financial models and term sheets

  • Fluent in English. German helps.

  • Available full-time for six to nine months, based in Berlin

  • Right to work in Germany

What we offer

  • A defined window to explore your next chapter while staying close to the founders, investors and deals in the ecosystem

  • A real seat on the investment team, not an advisory title

  • Access to our dealflow, portfolio and co-investor network across Europe's energy, infrastructure and automation scene

  • Our Berlin office with links to the London team

  • A network that stays with you after you leave
