title: Junior Account Executive, Enterprise - German speaker
descriptionHtml:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.


Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.


Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.

About the Team

Our enterprise team serves internationally operating companies that want to simplify mobile connectivity across borders. Instead of many contracts with different network operators, they get one provider, one platform and consistent processes from 1GLOBAL, including eSIM, IoT connectivity and API integration. We work directly with customers and indirectly through resellers and distributors, in the DACH region and across our other markets.

We are growing with our existing customers, through our partners and from new inbound requests. Many of these opportunities don't need a long enterprise sales cycle; they need fast and reliable closing. That is where you come in: you own this business independently, with your own targets and short paths into the team. You will be the first person in this role and shape it from day one.

About the Role

You win revenue with our existing customers, partners and new inbound requests: from identifying needs through quoting and negotiation to signature and activation. With your own sales targets, you own a clearly defined segment and work closely with our enterprise and partner teams in the DACH region and internationally.

Grow existing customers

  • You manage a portfolio of existing customers, spot additional needs (more countries, users, plans or IoT use cases) and turn them into upsell and cross-sell deals.
  • You own contract renewals and expansions, from timely outreach through to signature.
  • You are your customers' first point of contact in sales and resolve requests quickly, together with Customer Success or Support where needed.

Qualify and close new opportunities

  • You handle inbound requests, qualify them in a first call and close small and mid-sized deals yourself.
  • You hand larger opportunities over to our enterprise sales team, well prepared, and support them through to closing.
  • You use campaigns, events and referrals to start new conversations with companies in our focus segments.

Activate partner revenue

  • You support our resellers and distributors day to day: with quotes for their end customers, pricing questions and orders.
  • You make sure new partners are up and running quickly and close their first deals.
  • You identify which partners have more potential and agree next steps with Partner Management.

From quote to activation

  • You prepare quotes, negotiate terms within our pricing guidelines and take deals through to signature.
  • You manage the path from order to activation, because revenue only starts once connections go live.
  • You keep your pipeline and forecast up to date in our CRM so we always know where we stand.

Requirements

About You

Must Have

  • Fluent German and English, spoken and written: you negotiate and write in both languages every day
  • Completed commercial apprenticeship or a degree, plus 1 to 4 years of B2B sales experience, for example in inside sales, account management, as an SDR/BDR or in sales support with direct customer contact
  • Drive to close: you enjoy working towards targets and follow up until the deal is signed
  • Fluent German and English, spoken and written: you negotiate and write in both languages every day
  • Structure and reliability: you keep many deals and orders moving in parallel and see each one through
  • Confident on the phone, by email and on video calls, with a friendly and solution-oriented tone
  • Experience with CRM systems and confident with MS Office, especially Excel


Nice to Have

  • Experience in telecommunications or IT, for example with a network operator, service provider, system integrator or distributor
  • Experience in indirect sales with resellers and distributors
  • Experience with quoting and contract processes in an enterprise environment
  • Additional languages, for example Dutch, Spanish, French, Polish or Portuguese

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Junior Accountmanager Software
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij jouw commerciële carrière een vliegende start geven en energie halen uit het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten? Bij ITIS Products in Barendrecht krijg je alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen tot succesvol softwareaccountmanager. Je richt je voornamelijk op new business, leert alles over onze innovatieve softwareoplossingen en bouwt stap voor stap aan jouw eigen klantenportefeuille. Ervaring met softwareverkoop is mooi meegenomen, maar jouw commerciële drive en enthousiasme zijn voor ons veel belangrijker.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Junior Accountmanager Software ligt jouw focus op het creëren van nieuwe commerciële kansen. Je gaat actief op zoek naar potentiële klanten, legt de eerste contacten en laat organisaties kennismaken met de softwareoplossingen van ITIS Products. Je krijgt hierbij de begeleiding van ervaren collega's, zodat je jezelf kunt ontwikkelen tot een zelfstandig accountmanager.

Je adviseert organisaties over SOFOS 360, onze software voor het registreren en beheren van gevaarlijke stoffen. Daarnaast werk je met Chemwatch, een internationaal toonaangevende softwareoplossing waarvoor ITIS Products exclusief partner is binnen de Benelux.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Actief benaderen van nieuwe klanten en genereren van new business.

  • Opbouwen van jouw eigen klantenportefeuille.

  • Plannen van commerciële afspraken bij potentiële klanten.

  • Inventariseren van klantbehoeften en commerciële kansen.

  • Verzorgen van softwaredemonstraties, zelfstandig of samen met een productspecialist.

  • Opstellen, uitwerken en opvolgen van offertes.

  • Begeleiden van het verkoopproces van eerste kennismaking tot opdracht.

  • Onderhouden en verder uitbouwen van klantrelaties.

  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en nieuwe commerciële kansen.

  • Intensief samenwerken met consultants, productspecialisten en softwareontwikkelaars.

  • Stap voor stap doorgroeien naar een zelfstandig Accountmanager Software.

Wat wij je bieden

  • Je ontvangt een passend salaris, afhankelijk van jouw kennis, werkervaring en opleiding.

  • Een aantrekkelijke bonusregeling op basis van behaalde resultaten.

  • Een leaseauto, laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

  • 26 vakantiedagen (op basis van een fulltime dienstverband), met de mogelijkheid om vakantiedagen te kopen of te verkopen.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling.

  • Een opleidingsbudget en volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en coaching door ervaren collega's.

  • Mogelijkheden om, in overleg, deels vanuit huis te werken.

  • Een informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

  • Kennissessies, vrijdagmiddagborrels, teamuitjes en familiedagen.

  • Daarnaast profiteer je van diverse extra voordelen, zoals personeelskortingen, leuke evenementen en andere aantrekkelijke extra's.

Wat neem je mee?

Je hoeft geen ervaren softwareverkoper te zijn om succesvol te worden in deze functie. Misschien werk je nu als commercieel medewerker binnendienst, accountmanager, sales consultant of in een andere commerciële B2B-omgeving en ben je toe aan de volgende stap. Ook wanneer je net aan het begin van jouw commerciële carrière staat en graag wilt leren, nodigen wij je van harte uit om te reageren.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau.

  • Enige commerciële werkervaring of een sterke commerciële drive.

  • Affiniteit met new business en acquisitie.

  • Interesse in software, IT of digitale oplossingen.

  • Een ondernemende, leergierige en resultaatgerichte instelling.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden.

  • Een klantgerichte en enthousiaste uitstraling.

  • Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. Engels is een pré.

  • Een rijbewijs B.

ITIS Products en de VDK Groep

ITIS Products is een innovatieve softwareontwikkelaar uit Barendrecht. Met SOFOS 360 helpen wij organisaties om gevaarlijke stoffen veilig te registreren, beheren en te voldoen aan wet- en regelgeving. Daarnaast zijn wij exclusief partner van Chemwatch binnen de Benelux en ondersteunen wij organisaties met internationale softwareoplossingen en actuele chemische informatie.

Wat ITIS Products onderscheidt:

  • Ontwikkelaar van de gespecialiseerde softwareoplossing SOFOS 360.

  • Exclusief partner van Chemwatch binnen de Benelux.

  • Een innovatieve organisatie waar ondernemerschap, ontwikkeling en samenwerking centraal staan.

  • Veel ruimte om jezelf commercieel én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen.

VDK Groep, de razendsnel groeiende Topwerkgever van Nederland!

ITIS Products is onderdeel van de VDK Groep: een familie van meer dan 115 zelfstandige bedrijven binnen de installatietechniek. Daardoor profiteer je van de slagkracht, ontwikkelmogelijkheden en zekerheid van een grote organisatie, terwijl je werkt binnen de ondernemende cultuur van een compact en innovatief softwarebedrijf. Zo krijg je volop kansen om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en mee te groeien met een organisatie die blijft investeren in mensen, technologie en innovatie.

title: Junior Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About EDITED

EDITED is the world’s leading AI-driven retail intelligence platform. We empower the world’s most successful brands and retailers with real-time decision making power. 

By connecting internal business and external market data, EDITED infuses intelligence into every retail decision. We help retailers increase margins, generate more sales, and drive better business outcomes through AI-powered market and enterprise intelligence that fuels automation. 

At EDITED, we foster a dynamic and inclusive culture where creativity thrives and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Our environment is dynamic and supportive, encouraging team members to take initiative, innovate, and continuously grow. We value diversity, transparency, and a shared commitment to excellence, creating a workplace where everyone's voice is heard and contributions are recognised. 

We believe that achieving a positive work-life balance is key to driving innovation and success. Our flexible working options—including hybrid working, flexible hours and a work from anywhere policy—empower our team to perform at their best. 

The Opportunity

We're seeking a motivated and curious Junior Data Scientist to join our team. In this role, you'll work alongside experienced data scientists and engineers to deliver actionable insights and build data-driven solutions across EDITED. You'll learn key methodologies, contribute to impactful projects, and develop your technical and analytical skills in a supportive environment.

What You'll Do As A Junior Data Scientist:

  • Deliver Data Science Projects: Assist in designing, building, and maintaining data science models and pipelines to solve core business problems.

  • Data Analysis & Exploration: Analyze complex datasets to extract meaningful insights, trends, and patterns supporting retail intelligence.

  • Collaborate & Learn: Work closely with senior team members, receiving mentorship and feedback to continuously refine your technical skills.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product and engineering teams to integrate data products into production systems.

  • Maintain Data Quality: Validate and clean data sources to ensure high reliability and consistency across models and reporting.

  • Communicate Findings: Present project outcomes and analytical findings clearly to team members and key stakeholders.

What You'll Bring:

  • A strong STEM degree (including Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics/Statistics, etc), or equivalent experience.

  • Solid understanding of foundational data science concepts and statistical methods.

  • Proficiency with Python and standard data science libraries (e.g. Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn).

  • Strong problem-solving ability and enthusiasm for learning new technologies.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Curiosity to learn in an ever changing, fast paced environment.

What We’re Looking For In A Junior Data Scientist

It’s important for us to look for candidates that strive for excellence with a positive attitude, a strong sense of ownership and work ethic, and a passion to consistently develop and improve their knowledge and skillset. If you’re excited about the role of Junior Data Scientist and the opportunity to work at EDITED, we encourage you to apply even if you only match some, rather than all, of the requirements.

Essential:

  • 1+ years of experience (or strong academic/project background) in data analysis or machine learning.

  • Good working knowledge of Python.

  • Understanding of core machine learning concepts and statistical analyses.

What We Offer You As A Junior Data Scientist

We value our team and to attract exceptional people, we offer an excellent package! This year, we were recognised as one of the top companies to work for in the UK.

  • You can utilise our flexible working policy to ensure you can work around your schedule - this means starting & finishing when it suits you best!

  • At EDITED we are set up to work remotely

  • Enhanced parental leave policy

  • 25 days annual leave + public holidays (and an extra day for every year at EDITED)

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

  • Access to an Employee Assistance Programme

  • Gifts for work anniversaries and big life events

  • Dog friendly office

We do not use AI to source, screen, evaluate, or make decisions about candidates - every hiring decision is made by our team. We use Ashby, our applicant tracking system, which includes AI-assisted interview notetaking and automation for scheduling interviews and sending routine emails. These tools support our hiring process but do not make hiring decisions. We aim to be an equal opportunities employer and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

title: Junior Forward Deployed Engineer: Software Development & Applied AI (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem verwandten Fach abgeschlossen und willst Software nicht nur bauen, sondern direkt beim Kunden Wirkung erzeugen? Du verstehst Geschäftsprozesse genauso gut wie Code und hast Lust, KI-Lösungen von der ersten Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz zu begleiten?

Als Junior Forward Deployed Engineer arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Softwareentwicklung, Applied AI und Beratung: Du bist nah am Kunden, verstehst seine Prozesse und Daten, entwickelst passende Lösungen und bringst sie in den produktiven Betrieb. Ein Teil deiner Zeit fließt außerdem in die Entwicklung unserer eigenen KI-Tools und Produkte.

Über DataClue

DataClue ist eine Unternehmensberatungs-Boutique mit Fokus auf Applied AI & Data Analytics und Execution & Transformation. Wir entwickeln maßgeschneiderte Lösungen mit messbarem Mehrwert. Unser interdisziplinäres Team vereint Business- und Entwicklungs-Know-how und begleitet Kunden: von Konzeption und Strategie über Projektmanagement bis zur Umsetzung.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung von Backend-Services, Datenpipelines und KI-Agenten in Python

  • Umsetzung von Frontends und internen Tools mit TypeScript und React

  • Arbeit mit relationalen Datenbanken: Datenmodelle, SQL und Datenaufbereitung

  • Forward Engineering beim Kunden: Anforderungen direkt mit den Fachbereichen aufnehmen, Prototypen schnell bauen und iterativ in produktive Lösungen überführen

  • Integration von LLM-APIs und KI-Agenten in bestehende Systemlandschaften (z. B. ERP, CRM, Power BI, Microsoft 365)

  • Übersetzung von Geschäftsprozessen in technische Konzepte und Datenmodelle

  • Beratungsanteil: Workshops beim Kunden mitgestalten, Ergebnisse präsentieren und mit Stakeholdern abstimmen

  • Verantwortung für eigene Arbeitspakete inkl. Tests, Dokumentation und Code-Reviews

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Fach

  • Erste praktische Erfahrung in Softwareentwicklung, Data oder IT-Beratung (z. B. als Werkstudent:in, im Praktikum oder in einer ersten Festanstellung)

  • Gute Kenntnisse in Python sowie Erfahrung mit TypeScript und React

title: Junior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We're looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join our engineering team in London. This is a hybrid role, with a minimum of three days a week in our London office. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to grow quickly, work on real production systems, and learn how a high-growth fintech operates from the inside.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers who will support you through code reviews, pairing and mentorship. We maintain a culture of ownership, and we value engineers who are curious about the business and keen to work with stakeholders to improve processes and the customer experience.

There are opportunities across platform engineering, B2B customer integration, conversion optimisation and business process automation. You'll work on a best-in class Open Banking decision-making platform and learn how to build systems that operate with low latency, at scale.

Our technology stack:

Python (including FastAPI, OpenTelemetry, procrastinate, SQLAlchemy, Uvicorn), Java,

React, Postgres, MySQL, Liquibase, Retool, Docker, AWS

What you’ll be doing

  • Build and maintain features in our backend services, which can span any part of the lending lifecycle – from finding and onboarding new customers, to helping underwriters assess affordability, through to paying out and collecting loans

  • Take part in the full software development lifecycle: contributing to designs, writing tests, reviewing code and helping with deployments

  • Write clean, well-tested code in Python and Java, with guidance and feedback from senior engineers

  • Work with colleagues in Product and Design, as well as internal users, to understand requirements and turn them into working software

  • Help troubleshoot and resolve system issues that affect our customers, as part of a supported team rota during business hours

  • Write and improve SQL queries against our Postgres databases

  • Gradually take ownership of parts of the platform as your experience grows

  • Build and improve frontend features in React, and grow your skills across the full stack

Who you are

  • 0–2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience from a degree, bootcamp, internships or personal projects

  • Working knowledge of Java and Python – you don't need to be an expert, but you're comfortable writing and debugging code in both

  • Hands-on experience building frontend interfaces with React

  • An understanding of core programming concepts such as data structures, object-oriented design and writing unit tests

  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases

  • Comfortable using Git for version control

  • A genuine interest in fintech and how financial products work

  • A sharp eye for detail – in lending, small mistakes can have a real impact on customers

  • You learn fast, pick up new tools and concepts quickly, and enjoy doing so

  • You thrive in a fast-moving environment, are comfortable finding your way around a large, evolving codebase, and take initiative to work things out

  • Good problem-solving skills and a methodical approach to debugging

  • Clear communicator who asks questions, takes on feedback and works well in a team

  • Keen to work across the full stack, from backend services and databases through to the frontend

  • Able to work from our London office at least three days a week

Ideally you'll also have

  • Experience with async Python or frameworks such as FastAPI

  • Basic familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure) or Docker

  • Knowledge of lending products or Open Banking

How we work at Abound

To be successful here, our culture needs to energise you. Here is how we operate:

  • High Bar & Real Ownership: We are a high-performing team, and we hire people who raise the bar and take pride in great work. We own outcomes, not tasks.

  • We Work Hard: We care about impact, not face time. At key moments, we go the extra mile to deliver for customers and the business.

  • MVP & Iteration Culture: We ship fast, learn from real customers, and continuously improve our products and processes.

  • One Team Collaboration: We collaborate deeply across engineering, product, operations, and the wider business.

  • Thrive in Change: Priorities evolve as we learn what works. We value people who use good judgment, adapt quickly, and stay focused on outcomes.

What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

  • Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership through WellHub

  • Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d) – Remote
descriptionHtml:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als Lead AI Engineer führst du unser Engineering-Team, entwickelst rund drei Viertel deiner Zeit selbst mit und arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen.

Deine Schwerpunkte:

  • Selbst entwickeln. Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Features und Architekturthemen in unseren Agenten-, RAG- und Workflow-Systemen und schreibst Pläne, an denen sich andere orientieren.

  • Technische Richtung. Du triffst wichtige Designentscheidungen mit, priorisierst gemeinsam mit dem CTO die technische Roadmap und treibst die technische Vision von MAIA voran.

  • Das Team anführen. Du koordinierst die Arbeit im Team und bist Sparringspartner für alle Engineers, in Designdiskussionen, Reviews und Feedback. Du führst technische Interviews und entscheidest mit, wen wir einstellen.

  • Besser werden, gemeinsam. Mit dem Team verbesserst du laufend, wie wir entwickeln, gerade im agentischen Arbeiten: von Plänen und Reviews über Evals bis zu Releases.

  • Am Puls der Technik. Du verfolgst neue Entwicklungen bei LLMs, Retrieval, Agenten und darüber hinaus, bewertest sie nüchtern und bringst ins Produkt, was trägt.

Was wir suchen

  • Ein herausragender AI Engineer. Du hast LLM-Systeme gebaut und in Produktion betrieben. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche, Tool Calling und Agenten kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Techniken probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype.

  • Starke Architektur. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Du triffst Designentscheidungen, die auch in einem Jahr noch tragen, und erkennst schwache Architektur auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.

  • Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.

  • Technische Führung. Du hast ein Team als Tech Lead, Lead Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle fachlich geführt. Wie die Rolle hieß, ist zweitrangig. Du gibst Verantwortung ab und freust dich, wenn das Team ohne dich gute Entscheidungen trifft. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du gern selbst weiter, denn diese Rolle ist keine reine Managementrolle.

  • Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du hast eine klare Meinung dazu, wie ein Team mit ihnen schnell bleibt, ohne an Qualität zu verlieren.

  • Remote führen. Du führst auch aus der Ferne wirksam. Du kommunizierst proaktiv, machst Entscheidungen schriftlich nachvollziehbar und bist für das Team gut erreichbar.

  • Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Du sprichst Probleme früh an, argumentierst mit Belegen und erklärst technische Entscheidungen verständlich, im Team ebenso wie gegenüber Produktmanagement, Customer Success und Vertrieb. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Ein großer Teil des Teams arbeitet gemeinsam in unserem Büro in Leipzig, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kocht fast jeden Tag zusammen. Du arbeitest remote von überall in Deutschland, dein Wohnsitz muss in Deutschland liegen. Zweimal im Jahr treffen wir uns zu Team-Events, und ab und zu gibt es Teamtage in Leipzig. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, auch zu Führungsthemen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 90.000 bis 100.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem Interview zu Technik und Führung. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges Interview zu Technik und Führung und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Lead Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why loveholidays?

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.

 

The difference you’ll make

You’ll lead the Applied AI team within the wider AI Centre of Excellence, setting technical direction and managing the engineers who build, administer and improve the AI-enabled systems and SaaS platforms that support our customers and colleagues. You’ll work closely with business verticals, engineering, security and senior stakeholders to turn business priorities into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes.

You’ll combine people management with hands-on technical leadership across applied and agentic AI workflows, SaaS services, integrations and data pipelines. You’ll guide architecture and delivery, develop the team’s capabilities and own relationships with third-party SaaS suppliers, ensuring our platforms are reliable, secure and deliver value for money.

The team sits within Business IT & AI Operations. You’ll provide the direction, governance and operational ownership that help loveholidays scale intelligent automation and well-run business systems safely and effectively, balancing new opportunities with service quality, cost and long-term maintainability.

Your day-to-day:

  • Lead and line-manage Applied AI engineers, setting clear goals, providing regular feedback and coaching, supporting career development and managing performance. Help recruit and onboard new team members as the team grows.

  • Set the team’s technical direction and delivery roadmap with business and technology stakeholders, prioritising work, allocating capacity and managing dependencies to deliver measurable business outcomes.

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership for applied and agentic AI workflows, integrations and automation pipelines, guiding architecture, reviewing designs and code, and contributing to complex or high-impact engineering work.

  • Set standards for building, testing and evaluating tool-using agents with Google ADK or similar frameworks, including safe tool access, human oversight and production readiness.

  • Own operational performance across AI-enabled services and SaaS platforms, including service health, access, releases, usage and cost. Lead incident escalation and continuous improvement, with clear evaluation criteria and service measures.

  • Own account management for third-party SaaS suppliers, acting as the primary relationship owner and running regular service and roadmap reviews. Hold suppliers accountable for agreed service levels, resolve escalations and coordinate their delivery with internal priorities.

  • Manage the supplier and contract lifecycle with procurement, finance, legal and security, covering selection, onboarding, licensing, commercial negotiations, contractual obligations, renewals, notice dates and exit planning. Own spend management for the team’s SaaS and AI services, working with finance to forecast and manage costs against agreed budgets, explain variances and optimise licences and consumption. Track adoption, spend and value, and inform build-versus-buy decisions.

  • Establish engineering and operational standards for secure change management, documentation, runbooks and governance. Communicate progress, risks and trade-offs clearly, and ensure services have clear ownership and support arrangements.

Your skillset:

  • People & Delivery Leadership: Experience line-managing engineers, coaching and developing people, managing performance and leading delivery. Able to set direction, prioritise competing demands and build a collaborative, accountable team.

  • SaaS Supplier & Account Management: Experience owning third-party supplier relationships, service reviews, escalations, licensing and renewals. Commercial judgement and the ability to work with procurement, finance, legal and security to improve service quality and value for money.

  • SaaS Platform Ownership: Experience leading the administration and lifecycle management of cloud-based business systems, including configuration, user access, environments, integrations and releases.

  • Applied AI & Technical Direction: Strong experience delivering applied and agentic AI workflows that combine models, tools and business data, including orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation and evaluation. Able to make architecture and build-versus-buy decisions, establish engineering standards and guide others. Familiarity with Google ADK or similar frameworks is desirable.

  • Engineering & Integration: Strong hands-on engineering skills and experience designing and reviewing REST API, webhook and event-driven or scheduled integrations between SaaS platforms, AI services and backend systems.

  • Operational & Stakeholder Leadership: Experience operating production services in cloud environments, preferably Google Cloud Platform, using CI/CD, observability, incident management and secure operational practices. Able to explain technical and commercial trade-offs, influence stakeholders and connect delivery to business outcomes.

The interview journey

  • Intro with a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 30 mins

  • 1st stage video interview with the hiring manager - 1 hour

  • Applied AI technical leadership, team management and SaaS supplier management task

  • Final stage with Director of Applied AI and senior stakeholders - 1 hour

Perks of joining us:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Ability to buy and sell annual leave

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

 

Our commitment to inclusion

At loveholidays, we focus on creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed. We value the different perspectives, experiences and ideas each person brings, because they help us work better together, challenge our thinking and make stronger decisions.

As we continue to grow and evolve, we want everyone to feel supported and able to do their best work. We’re also committed to making our hiring process accessible, so please let our Talent Acquisition team know if you need any adjustments at any stage.

descriptionHtml:

309 - Lead Architect, Data & AI Platforms – Choreograph Consulting

About WPP Media

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com

About Choreograph: A Leading WPP Media Brand

Choreograph is WPP’s global data products and technology company. We’re on a mission to transform marketing by building the fastest, most connected data platform that bridges marketing strategy to scaled activation.

We work with agencies and clients to transform the value of data by bringing together technology, data and analytics capabilities. We deliver this through the Open Media Studio, an AI-enabled media and data platform for the next era of advertising.

We’re endlessly curious. Our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 1,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.

Role Summary and Impact

We are hiring a Lead Architect to own the technical design of Azure-first data and AI platforms. You will define the reusable patterns, reference architectures and end-to-end solution concepts that our delivery teams build from, and prove them in code rather than in slideware.

This is an engineering-first, developer-architect role: roughly 70–80% designing solutions, building and packaging reusable patterns, and prototyping new concepts in code, and 20–30% client-facing advisory.

As a senior technical authority, you will bridge client strategy with hands-on code, setting the reference architecture and proving it yourself, then partnering with the Data Engineering, Platform/DevOps, Security and Client Delivery teams who industrialise it into resilient, self-service, cost-effective and compliant delivery at scale. Replacing traditional IT operations and manual governance with modern software automation, you will mentor engineers, review code/IaC, and own key technical decisions and trade-offs.

What this role is not: This is not an IT infrastructure, cloud operations or estate-management position. There is no BAU support rota, ticket queue, or manual portal configuration. Candidates whose recent experience is running and supporting cloud infrastructure, rather than designing and building data and AI platforms in code, will not be a fit. Equally, this is not a hands-off design role: you will prototype and prove your own patterns before a delivery team scales them.

Area of expertise:

  • Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) & Automation: Production fluency with Terraform; treating IaC like software code using modular designs, policy-as-code, reusable baselines, and automated testing via CI/CD (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps).
  • Solution Architecture Pattern Design & Packaging: Defining end-to-end solution concepts and reference architectures, then packaging them as deployable, versioned assets that other teams can pick up and run, rather than as documents.
  • Azure-First Data Platforms: Deep architecture and build experience on Microsoft Azure (Data Lake/Lakehouse patterns, ADLS Gen2, Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Delta Lake), with enough hands-on AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience to design portable patterns for mixed client estates.
  • Orchestration & Data Pipelines: Batch and streaming ingestion using Azure Data Factory (pipelines, wrangling flows, integration runtimes), Event Hubs, Kafka, and performance optimization (Spark/Synapse SQL).
  • AI Solution Design & Build: Designing and building AI solutions on the data platform: Agentic AI workflows, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns, vector search and LLM orchestration, alongside standard analytical workloads.
  • Security as Code: Networking, private endpoints, managed identities, Key Vault, RBAC, Purview governance and data masking, all defined in Terraform and versioned like application code.
  • Observability, FinOps & Operations: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, cost/performance telemetry, SLAs/SLOs for pipelines, and FinOps-aware cloud design.
  • API & Service Integration: Designing data services using Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and API Management.

Skills and Experience:

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.
  • Developer-Architect Mindset: A hands-on builder who sets reference architectures and patterns, leading by example through direct code contributions and rigorous code/IaC reviews.
  • 70/30 Design-to-Advise Split: Spends 70–80% of the time architecting solutions, writing code, packaging repeatable patterns and prototyping new concepts, drawing on end-to-end understanding of the data platform in use, and 20–30% in front of clients, translating commercial objectives into technical roadmaps and explaining trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders in their own language.
  • Coding & Automation Obsession: Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, SQL, Terraform); automates everything possible via IaC and CI/CD, favoring repeatability over legacy IT ticket processes.
  • Azure-Deep, Cross-Cloud Aware: Expert on Azure and comfortable across AWS and GCP, designing for operability, security, and cost while preparing platforms for emerging AI architectures.
  • Clear Communicator & Mentor: Able to facilitate client workshops, write concise design docs/runbooks, align cross-functional teams, and mentor engineers to create shared ownership of outcomes.
  • Outcome-Focused: Measures success with deployment frequency, lead time for changes, data pipeline SLAs, cost efficiency, and platform reliability metrics.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead Azure-First Platform Architecture: Architect and implement Azure data platforms for clients, including landing zones, networking, identity, and data platform services (Azure Data Lake Storage, Synapse, Databricks), extending patterns to AWS or GCP where a client estate requires it.
  • Design & Build Data Pipelines: Design, Implement key data ingress patterns across data platforms. Key focus would be Azure Data Factory pipelines and data flows for ingestion, transformation, and orchestration; establish patterns for parameterization, retries, and error handling to meet pipeline SLAs, then work with the Data Engineering team to scale those patterns into production delivery.
  • Implement Modern IaC & CI/CD: Design, implement key IaC patterns. Deliver infrastructure-as-code using Terraform; create reusable modules and policy-as-code guardrails. Establish repo strategies, branching, pull requests, multi-stage pipelines, approvals, and automated promotion gates.
  • Package Reusable Solutions: Turn proven designs into packaged, deployable assets (Terraform modules, pipeline templates, reference implementations and accelerators) with the documentation and worked examples delivery teams need to reuse them across clients.
  • Architect for AI & DataOps: Introduce DataOps practices (automated unit/integration testing, data quality checks) and build the AI layer on top of it: vector search, RAG workflows and agentic capabilities.
  • Prototype & Showcase New Concepts: Build working prototypes of new data and AI concepts (RAG, agentic workflows, streaming and real-time patterns) and demonstrate them to clients to shape demand, test feasibility and de-risk delivery before a full team is committed.
  • Client Advisory & Technical Leadership: Own the technical relationship with client and agency stakeholders. Run discovery and design workshops, present at design authorities, and translate commercial objectives into phased roadmaps, costs and trade-offs that a non-technical audience can act on.
  • Ship Secure-by-Default Controls: Codify private endpoints, managed identities, Key Vault-backed secrets, RBAC, network isolation, data encryption and Purview cataloging/lineage as reusable modules, so security ships with the platform rather than being applied afterwards.
  • Optimize Performance & Cost (FinOps): Optimize compute and storage across Spark clusters, autoscaling, partitioning, and serverless options; track, report, and drive cloud cost savings.
  • Observability & Reliability: Build monitoring into pipelines and platforms using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics, and define the SLOs and alerting the owning engineering team runs against.
  • Guide Event-Driven Architectures: Lead streaming and micro-batch patterns (Event Hubs, Kafka on Azure, Structured Streaming) where required by client use cases.
  • Enable the Data Engineering Team: Mentor engineers, review pull requests/IaC, and hand over patterns and accelerators in a state the Data Engineering team can run with, so larger builds are delivered by the team rather than bottlenecked on you.

Requirements:

  • Hands-on Developer-Architect experience: Proven track record in cloud platform and data engineering, with deep expertise in Microsoft Azure and hands-on exposure to AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Production IaC Fluency: Strong proficiency in Terraform applied with a software engineering mindset (reusable modules, testing, modular code structures).
  • Data Platform Core: Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, and Azure Databricks (Spark).
  • CI/CD Mastery: Strong CI/CD experience using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps for both IaC and data workloads.
  • Software Engineering Fundamentals: Solid coding capability in Python and SQL; performance tuning for Spark/Databricks; data modelling for analytical and AI workloads.
  • Evidence of Shipped Work: Able to walk through data platform code, Terraform modules or pipelines you have personally authored. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to talk through their own code and design decisions at interview.
  • Patterns Adopted by Others: Examples of reference architectures, reusable modules or accelerators you have designed, packaged and had adopted by teams other than your own.
  • Client-Facing Advisory Skills: Demonstrated ability to consult directly with senior client and agency stakeholders, including non-technical business audiences, present pragmatic technical solutions, and lead architectural workshops unaided. You will be the technical voice in the room, not supported by a separate engagement lead.
  • Security as Code: Ability to implement VNets, private endpoints, managed identities, Key Vault, RBAC and governance patterns as Terraform, rather than through portal configuration or change-request processes.

Nice to have:

  • Production experience shipping RAG or agentic AI workloads to live users (vector databases, LLM orchestration frameworks).
  • Event-driven architectures with Event Hubs, Kafka, Stream Analytics, or Functions; CDC patterns.
  • Lakehouse/Delta patterns on Databricks; MLflow and feature store awareness.
  • Data quality tooling and frameworks (Great Expectations, Deequ) and dbt for transformation governance.
  • Data Governance: Experience tracking data lineage, defining data quality policies and procedures, and enforcing them at runtime.
  • API Management, Logic Apps, or Azure Functions integration experience.
  • Experience with Azure Enterprise-Scale Landing Zones and Azure Policy.
  • Relevant certifications: Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Data Engineer Associate, or AWS / GCP equivalents. Certifications are welcome but are weighted below demonstrable evidence of shipped code.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

title: Lead Consultant Microsoft 365 (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Everything as a Service. Egal ob es um Microsoft 365 geht oder Security-Lösungen wie Sophos und Hornetsecurity – dostani IT bietet seinen Kunden Lösungen für effizientes und sicheres Arbeiten. Durch die Expertise unserer Kolleginnen und Kollegen können sich unsere Kunden auf ihr Kerngeschäft konzentrieren. Hast du Lust, mit uns gemeinsam richtig gute IT Services zu liefern?

Für unser weiteres Wachstum suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als

Lead Consultant Microsoft 365 (m/w/d)

am Standort Dortmund

in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit

Deine Rolle:

In deiner Rolle berätst du unsere Kunden strategisch und operativ rund um Microsoft 365 und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen passende Lösungen – von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, etwa bei Rollouts, Migrationen oder Cloud-Projekten. Zusätzlich übernimmst du die Service-Management-Verantwortung für deine Kunden: Du sorgst für die stabile, SLA-konforme Erbringung der laufenden Services und treibst deren kontinuierliche Verbesserung voran.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Fachliche und strategische Beratung unserer Kunden rund um Microsoft 365 sowie Konzeption und Umsetzung passender Lösungsansätze für Kundenprojekte, inkl. Anforderungsanalyse und Entscheidungsvorlagen

  • Leitung und Umsetzung von Microsoft-365-Projekten wie Rollouts, Migrationen und Cloud-Projekten

  • Verantwortung für die vereinbarungsgemäße Erbringung der IT-Services (SLA/OLA), inkl. Monitoring, Reporting und Eskalationsmanagement

  • Durchführung regelmäßiger Service-Reviews und Steering-Termine, Ableitung und Nachverfolgung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen

  • Koordination des internen Teams sowie externer Dienstleister

  • Pflege und Weiterentwicklung des Service-Katalogs sowie Mitwirkung an Vertrags- und Leistungsscheingestaltung

  • Fachliche Anleitung von und Wissenstransfer an Kolleginnen und Kollegen

Deine Qualifikationen

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (Fachinformatik) oder Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik

  • Fundiertes technisches Verständnis in Microsoft 365, Azure, Netzwerken und Security

  • Mehrjährige (Leitungs-)Erfahrung in der Beratung und Umsetzung von Microsoft-365-Lösungen, z. B. bei Rollouts, Migrationen oder Cloud-Projekten

  • Erfahrung in der Projektleitung bzw. -koordination von IT-Projekten

  • Kenntnisse im IT-Service-Management bzw. mit ITIL-Prozessen von Vorteil, z. B. im MSP- oder IT-Dienstleistungsumfeld; eine Zertifizierung ist ein Plus

  • verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch

Deine Benefits

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung – kurze Wege, echte Mitgestaltung

  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsfreiheit von Tag 1 für Strukturen, Prozesse und neue Serviceangebote

  • Individuelle Weiterentwicklung: z.B. ITIL, Microsoft-Zertifizierungen, Trainings

  • Attraktive Vergütung mit erfolgsabhängiger Komponente

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten

  • Langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden MSP mit modernem Toolstack

Kein langes Anschreiben nötig – schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und 2–3 Sätze, warum du und dostani IT zusammenpassen.

Wir melden uns schnell zurück. Versprochen.

title: Lead Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 

About the team

 

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

  

About the role

 

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will lead high-impact AI projects and shape the technical direction of bespoke solutions. This role requires hands-on technical excellence combined with crucial team leadership.


You will define data science approaches, design robust software architectures, mentor junior colleagues, and ensure delivery rigour across projects all while building deep client relationships and solidifying our reputation as a leader in practical, measurable AI.

#LI-PRIO

  

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Leading project teams that deliver bespoke algorithms and high-stakes AI solutions to clients across the sector.

  • Conceiving the core data science approach and designing the associated robust software architecture for new engagements.

  • Mentoring a small number of data scientists and supporting the professional growth of technical team members on projects.

  • Partnering with commercial teams to build client relationships and shape project scope for technical feasibility.

  • Contributing to Faculty’s thought leadership and reputation through delivering courses, public speaking, or open-source projects.

  • Ensuring best practices are followed throughout the project lifecycle to guarantee high-quality, impactful delivery.

     

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You possess senior experience in a professional data science position or a quantitative academic field.

  • You demonstrate strong programming skills, with the ability to be a fluent Python programmer, using core libraries (NumPy, Pandas) and a deep-learning framework (e.g., PyTorch).

  • You have a deep expertise in core data science paradigms (supervised/unsupervised, NLP, validation), demonstrating a proficiency across the standard data science toolkit, including the ability to develop new, innovative algorithms.

  • You bring a leadership mindset, focused on growing the technical capabilities of the team and nurturing a collaborative culture.

  • You exhibit commercial awareness, with experience in client-facing work and the ability to translate business problems into a rigorous mathematical framework.

  • You are skilled in project planning, assessing technical feasibility, estimating delivery timelines, and leading a team to deliver high-quality work on a strict schedule.

 

Our Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Take Home Technical Assessment

  3. Technical Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Lead Database Administrator
locations: Newcastle upon Tyne, England, United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team!

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Lead Fullstack Developer - Secteur Public - CDI Paris - Theodo GovTech
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Chez Theodo GovTech, nous accompagnons nos clients - ministères, collectivités territoriales et grands opérateurs publics - dans la conception, le développement et la maintenance de produits numériques accessibles, durables et utiles pour la société. Rejoindre notre aventure, c'est partager une ambition commune : utiliser le numérique pour augmenter l’efficacité de l'action publique et améliorer le quotidien des agents et des usagers.
Pourquoi on recrute ? Nous recrutons un(e) Lead developer chez Theodo GovTech afin d’assurer la satisfaction des acteurs publics en créant des produits qui répondent aux besoins d’amélioration de la qualité du service public rendu aux citoyens, associations, entreprises. Tes missions seront divisées en 3 parties : - S’assurer du delivery du projet et de sa qualité Travailler sur les conceptions et les features les plus complexes, s’assurer que les conceptions soient implémentables par les équipes de dev Etre garant(e) de la qualité de l’architecture et du code produit grâce à nos méthodologies Theodo (3S) et routines (code review) - Etre le point de contact de ton client S’assurer de la satisfaction permanente de ton client en participant aux points de routines avec ce dernier (backlog refinment, daily et cérémonie) - Etre responsable de la réussite des Software Engineer sur le projet Former ton équipe via des routines comme les code review et le pair programming Encadrer ton équipe sur le terrain avec des 1:1 avec chaque membre de ton équipe Tes perspectives d’évolution 3 axes d’évolutions s’offrent à toi: - Architecte senior : développer une expertise technique - Thought Leader : création de communauté Tech, être en open source dans un but de faire connaître Solona et le groupe Theodo à de potentiels futurs clients. - Intrapreneur : devenir porteur d’offre dans le groupe Profil recherché Hard skills - 5 à 8 ans d’expérience en Tech et 1 expérience a minima en Tech Lead d’1 an - Tu maîtrises des concept web complexes (front, back, BDD, Infra, Déploy, CI, Logs) et DevOps (Docker, Container - Kubernetes) - Tu disposes d’un intérêt pour un code de qualité - Tu sais créer une architecture simple en infrastructure - Tu as déjà accompagner et coacher des membres junior de ton équipe - Bonus : tu as une expertise sur les enjeux des projets publiques et enjeux d’accessibilité et/ou tu as une expérience dans le secteur public Soft skills - Tu as une bonne capacité d’analyse; tu sais modéliser un problème et une solution pour être capable de résoudre des problèmes complexes - Tu sais créer du lien avec tes clients interne ou externe et les membres de ton équipe - Tu fais preuve de pédagogie; tu sais expliquer des concepts de manière accessible et compréhensible. Déroulement des entretiens L’entretien se déroule en 5 étapes sous une dizaine de jours : - Un call de qualification (30 min), avec Clémence, notre Head of Talent Acquisition - Un cultural fit (1h) avec Clémence - Un entretien de refacto (1 heure), avec Matthieu, notre CTO - Un entretien de modélisation (1 heure) avec Matthieu, notre CTO - Un final (30 min) avec Maxime, notre CEOPourquoi rejoindre Theodo GovTech ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

descriptionHtml:

Travailler à ses côtés, c’est intégrer une équipe d’experts passionnés, être challengé sur le plan technique et méthodologique, et contribuer à des projets à fort impact pour les clients.   • Vous développerez des pipelines d’extraction de données et mettrez en place des solutions d’évaluation et d’observabilité des agents IA.

title: Lead Product Manager - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
Tes futures missions : En tant que Lead Product Manager, tu pilotes des projets produits complexes en portant la vision produit, en orchestrant le delivery et en garantissant la création de valeur pour le client comme pour les équipes. - Définir et porter la stratégie produit avec le client : modélisation de la valeur, architecture produit, EPICs, arbitrage des trade-offs et alignement technico-fonctionnel. - Assurer un delivery réussi en coordonnant plusieurs squads pour livrer des projets complexes dans les temps, le budget et le niveau de qualité attendu. - Créer les conditions de réussite des équipes en définissant le bon set-up (équipes Theodo ou partenaires), en négociant les moyens nécessaires et en adaptant l’organisation aux contraintes du projet. - Apporter de la visibilité et de la clarté via des dispositifs de gouvernance adaptés, pour aligner l’ensemble des parties prenantes. -Selon la composition de l'équipe, tu pourras être responsable de faire monter en compétence les Products Managers, en créant un environnement propice à leur réussite, leur montée en compétences et leur projection chez le client et/ou chez Theodo. - Garantir la satisfaction client sur le long terme, en construisant une relation de confiance, en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités et en collaborant avec les équipes Sales, Staffing et People. Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : - iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning. - Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires. Deux équipes produit ont piloté la reconstruction des plateformes de bout en bout, rejointes en fin de projet par une équipe data pour structurer et valoriser les données. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle, impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.
