title: Lead Product Manager, DeFi
descriptionHtml:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are looking for a Lead Product Manager, DeFi to build Bitpanda’s DeFi ecosystem from the ground up, creating the world’s premier Euro-denominated DeFi ecosystem while making it safe, accessible, and intuitive for our customers. 

The first use case is crypto-backed borrowing and lending in the Bitpanda app, with an eye to then build more sophisticated products and use cases leveraging tokenized commodities, securities, funds, and structured products. You’ll decide which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, and work collaboratively to bring DeFi to Bitpanda customers in a way that feels as simple as the app they already trust. You'll work in a small, senior team with our smart contract engineers and Bitpanda's Legal, Compliance and Risk teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product.

What you’ll do 

  • Design and run the lending markets: set loan-to-value and liquidation thresholds, interest rate curves, caps, and oracles, while also owning monitoring and incident playbooks.
  • Bring liquidity and users to permissioned markets and assets: set supply targets, bring in euro liquidity from stablecoin issuers, institutional lenders, curated vaults and market makers, and work out how verified customers reach these markets, without paying for volume.
  • Make sure the right DeFi infrastructure is in place, particularly for permissioned tokenized assets: DEX liquidity deep enough for swaps and liquidations, liquidators, oracles and the other building blocks the markets depend on.
  • Shape what customers see, sign, and own in the Bitpanda app, including how liquidation and risk are explained, and measure real use: borrowers who come back, bad debt and revenue, not total value locked alone.
  • Recommend which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, backed by a business case, and work with Legal, Compliance and Risk from day one on EU consumer credit rules and MiCA.

Who you are 

  • 6+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on building and scaling DeFi or crypto products.
  • You know lending markets in depth: collateral and liquidation mechanics, interest rate models, oracles and how they fail, curation and bad debt. You're at home with the EVM and can read Solidity smart contract code well enough to question engineers about it.
  • Demonstrated experience bringing DeFi applications into regulated consumer products and successfully bridging the gap between decentralized and centralized finance.
  • Ability to lead through influence, build clear business cases, and write excellent documentation in English. This includes a strong working knowledge of EU crypto regulations (e.g., MiCA) to effectively partner with Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams.
  • Nice to haves: 
    • hands-on experience scaling onchain ecosystem liquidity from scratch
    • knowledge of and/or work experience in traditional financial markets

** This position is available in all of our Hubs.


What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

title: Lead Talent Partner - Product and Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

Orbital is entering a major scaling chapter, and Product Engineering + Design Engineering are at the heart of it. We’re looking for an exceptional Lead Talent Partner to own how we find, attract, engage, assess and close the very best Product Engineers and Design Engineers in a fiercely competitive market.

This is a low-volume, high-calibre role. Success looks like building a market-leading attraction engine and a repeatable hiring system that consistently delivers bar-raising hires, primarily in the UK (with occasional US roles).

The role, in a nutshell

You’ll be the CTO’s partner for Product & Design Engineering hiring — owning the strategy, the operating rhythm, and the market-facing plan that enables Orbital to repeatedly win top talent.

At Orbital, these roles are typically:

  • Product Engineers: product-minded full‑stack engineers who ship end-to-end customer value.

  • Design Engineers: frontend/UI engineers operating at the intersection of design and engineering, with high craft.

You’ll work closely with the CTO, senior Product/Engineering/Design leaders, and a marketing specialist to build the narrative, content and materials that help Orbital stand out — and convert the best people over time.

What you’ll do

1) Own the Product & Design Engineering hiring strategy (CTO partnership)

  • Build and own a forward hiring plan with the CTO/COO: forecasting, sequencing, and prioritisation.

  • Own the hiring plan and reporting in the ATS (e.g. Ashby): req pipeline, stage design, interviewer pools, and metrics.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on:

    • market intelligence and compensation benchmarks

    • org design and team build sequencing

    • interview plan quality and signal

    • funnel health and quality indicators

2) Build a market-leading attraction engine (content + community + creative search)

  • Design and run a high-touch, always-on engagement and nurture engine for top Product & Design Engineering talent (not tied only to live reqs).

  • Partner with leadership and marketing to create standout content and outreach materials (positioning, sequences, technical narratives, proof points, community activity).

  • Establish targets (set with the CTO) and report on pipeline health and learning loops:

    • warm pipeline size by discipline/level

    • engagement rates (reply / meeting booked)

    • nurture → active candidate → offer → accept conversion

    • competitive intel and drop-off reasons

3) Deliver hiring outcomes (low volume, very high calibre)

  • Personally own the most senior and business-critical Product Engineering hires (e.g., Staff/Principal/Lead level and key leadership roles).

  • Protect the quality bar for assessment, references, and offer calibration; step in on escalations and closing.

  • Set the operating rhythm: pipeline reviews, prioritisation, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement.

What we’re looking for (must-haves)

  • Scale-up experience: proven track record hiring in a high-growth tech scaleup with high standards and ambiguity.

  • Deep Product & Design Engineering market immersion: credible, active network in the UK. Ideally you have run meetups and build communities. You know who the standout people are and what motivates them.

  • Exec-search level craft: evidence of closing low-volume, very high-calibre engineers via creative, non-standard routes (not just inbound + job boards or Linkedin).

  • Attraction + nurture strategy: you’ve built always-on engagement motions that convert exceptional people over time (content, community, referrals, targeted events, high-touch outreach).

  • CTO partnership: you’ve partnered closely with technical leadership to define quality, design assessment, and calibrate the bar.

  • Strong written narrative and messaging: you can translate a technical story into compelling outreach/materials (and collaborate well with marketing).

  • Data-informed judgement: you use metrics as feedback loops for quality and funnel health — and can clearly explain what you track and why.

What this role is not (important)

  • Not high-volume recruiting — this is low volume, bar-raising hiring.

  • Not a “maintain the process” job — you’ll build and continuously improve the attraction engine and operating model.

  • Not fully remote — hiring is UK-first and roles are hybrid.

Working model & location

  • Location: London, UK 2-3 days a week.

  • Working model: Hybrid (all roles)

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements.

Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.

title: Legal Counsel, Product & Privacy
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

⚖️ Our Legal team

The Legal team is at the heart of Joko’s growth and protection. We navigate the complexities of contracts, regulations, and risk management to ensure the company operates smoothly and seizes opportunities with confidence.

We handle all legal matters: Contracts, Corporate, Labor, Data protection, IP etc… enabling other teams to innovate with confidence.

Leveraging our expertise and external partners, we collaborate with all functions to protect Joko’s interests efficiently and proactively.

🚀 What you will do

As Legal Counsel, Product & Privacy, you will work hand in hand with our Product, Tech and business teams to make sure our product, including Juno, complies with privacy, AI, consumer and platform rules, from the PRD to the launch. You will report directly to the Head of Legal (Maya).

🔐 Privacy and AI

  • Run our GDPR programme on a centralised, cross-European basis, working closely with our DPO: records of processing, DPIAs, privacy notices, data subject requests, processor agreements and transfers.

  • Ensure compliance with non EU privacy laws as the teams grow our international activity.

  • Champion privacy by design within the product teams: show up early, ask the right questions, and help find solutions that work for users and the business.

  • Act as product counsel on Juno alongside the Product team: AI Act compliance, transparency obligations, and model and vendor terms.

🛍️ Consumer and platform rules

  • Maintain our terms of use and terms of sale with the teams who design our offers, including the cashback and gift card terms, withdrawal rights, the referral programme, and the rules of our prize draws and contests.

  • Keep Joko compliant with the expectations of the DGCCRF and its equivalents in each new country, including country-specific terms where local law requires them.

  • Own our compliance with app store and browser store rules (Apple, Google, Chrome Web Store, Firefox), together with the Security and Product teams.

  • Ensure our compliance with the terms of our affiliate networks, with the teams who manage these partnerships.

💳 Banking and payments regulation

  • Map the regulatory perimeter of each business line and each new market (payment and e-money regimes, gift cards) with the teams building them and our external specialist counsel.

  • Monitor whether each business line stays within its current status as the product evolves.

💡 How the scope is covered. We don't expect you to be an expert in all of these areas. Privacy and AI are the core of the role; consumer law and platform rules can be learned on the job if they're new to you, and we rely on external counsel in needed.

🙌 Who you are

  • You have 4 to 6 years of experience in data protection, including time in a top-tier law firm or as in-house product or privacy counsel.

  • You have worked with product and tech teams, and you can read a PRD or a data flow and identify the issues it raises.

  • You follow AI regulation closely and you have already advised on AI products.

  • Experience in consumer law is a plus; a CIPP/E or equivalent certification is a plus.

  • You hold a Master's degree in IP/IT law, data protection law or business law from a leading French law school. Admission to the Paris Bar is a plus.

  • You are fluent in French and English.

  • You give clear and actionable answers to non-lawyers, and you know when a risk is acceptable.

  • You are curious about AI and want to learn how to build the tools that change legal work.

What we tell you upfront. Until the three poles are staffed, every Legal Counsel works across the full legal scope with the Head of Legal. Functional ownership is formalised as soon as the Commercial & IP and Product & Privacy seats are both filled.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

title: Leiter Operations (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unternehmen

Die Hoffmann+Voss GmbH ist Teil der PolymerCycle Gruppe und spezialisiert auf die Regranulierung und das Recompounding technischer Kunststoffe. Die Hoffmann+Voss GmbH liefert ihre Produkte an höchst anspruchsvolle Kundenindustrien – wie die Automobilbranche, Elektro-/Elektronik oder Haushaltsgeräte – zuverlässig und nach strengen Qualitätsanforderungen. Dafür greift die Hoffmann+Voss GmbH auf langjährige Erfahrung in der Aufbereitung und Compoundierung von technischen Kunststoffen zurück. Mit einem vollumfänglichen, modern ausgestatteten Labor bietet Hoffmann+Voss umfassende Analytik-, Prüf- und Entwicklungsleistungen.

In der Gruppe bündeln die Unternehmen der PolymerCycle Gruppe ihren Zugang zu unterschiedlichen Rohstoffströmen, ihre Expertise in komplexen Kundenindustrien, umfangreiche Produktionskapazitäten sowie tiefes technologisches und materialwissenschaftliches Know-how. Durch die Kombination von Sortier-, Trenn-, Regranulierungs- und Compounding-Know-how entstehen hochwertige Recyclinglösungen, die sowohl technische Anforderungen erfüllen als auch die wachsende europäische Nachfrage nach qualitätsgesicherten Rezyklaten bedienen.

Für das Werk der Hoffmann+Voss GmbH in Viersen suchen wir einen Leiter Operations (m/w/d).

Aufgaben & Verantwortung

  • Gesamtverantwortung für den operativen Betrieb des Werks – einschließlich Produktion, Instandhaltung, Lagermanagement und Logistik sowie Arbeitssicherheit und nachhaltiger Ressourcennutzung
  • Führung, Entwicklung und Organisation des Produktionsteams sowie Sicherstellung einer effizienten Personaleinsatz- und Schichtplanung
  • Steuerung und kontinuierliche Optimierung der Produktionsprozesse für Regranulierung und Recompounding – von vom Wareneingang über die Zerkleinerung und Aufbereitung bis hin zur Extrusion
  • Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung von Produkten, Prozessen und Technologien
  • Verantwortung für Kennzahlen, Maßnahmen zur Produktivitätssteigerung sowie Initiierung und Umsetzung von Verbesserungsprojekten nach Lean- und KVP-Prinzipien
  • Budget- und Kostenverantwortung einschließlich Investitionsplanung, Wirtschaftlichkeitsbetrachtungen und laufendem Kostencontrolling
  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Umwelt- und Arbeitsschutzanforderungen

Qualifikationen

  • Technische Ausbildung oder Studium – beispielsweise in Kunststofftechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Maschinenbau oder Produktionstechnik
  • Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung in einem produzierenden Unternehmen, idealerweise in der Kunststoffverarbeitung oder im Recycling
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Produktionsmanagement, Prozessoptimierung, Lean-Methoden und Qualitätsmanagement
  • Solides betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis – Kostenrechnung, Budget- und Investitionsplanung
  • Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Hands-on-Mentalität, sicherem Auftreten sowie der Fähigkeit, Mitarbeitende zu motivieren und Veränderungen wirksam umzusetzen
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und ERP-Systemen

Wir bieten

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselposition in einem wachsenden, zukunftsorientierten Markt mit direktem Einfluss auf die weitere Entwicklung des Standorts
  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum – Prozesse weiterentwickeln, Strukturen schaffen und Verbesserungen im Werk unmittelbar umsetzen
  • Zusammenarbeit in einem dynamischen, interdisziplinären Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und engem Austausch innerhalb der PolymerCycle Gruppe
  • Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Entwicklungsperspektiven innerhalb der Gruppe
  • Ein sicherer, langfristig angelegter Arbeitsplatz mit leistungsgerechter Vergütung, attraktiven Benefits und einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld mit hochwertiger technischer Ausstattung

title: Leitung Kommunikation / Öffentlichkeitsarbeit (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Das Unternehmen:

Strategie gestalten. Menschen erreichen. Kommunikation weiterentwickeln.

Unser Auftraggeber ist ein etabliertes, regional stark verwurzeltes mittelständisches Finanzinstitut mit hoher gesellschaftlicher Verantwortung und einer engen Verbindung zu den Menschen und Unternehmen in der Oberpfalz. Als bedeutender Finanzdienstleister engagiert sich das Unternehmen nicht nur für seine Kundinnen und Kunden, sondern auch für das gesellschaftliche, kulturelle und sportliche Leben vor Ort.

Im Zuge einer strategischen Weiterentwicklung soll insbesondere die Kommunikation moderner, digitaler und zielgruppenorientierter aufgestellt werden. Dafür suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, die klassische Öffentlichkeitsarbeit mit zeitgemäßer Kommunikation verbindet und neue Impulse setzt.

Die Stelle:

In dieser verantwortungsvollen Position übernimmst Du die Leitung des Bereichs Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Deinem Team die interne und externe Kommunikation strategisch weiter.

Strategische Kommunikation: Du entwickelst die Kommunikationsstrategie kontinuierlich weiter und sorgst dafür, dass die Maßnahmen auf die übergeordneten Unternehmens- und Geschäftsziele einzahlen.

Vorstandskommunikation: Du berätst den Vorstand bei kommunikativen Fragestellungen, bewertest Themen und Botschaften und entwickelst passende Kommunikationsansätze. Dabei hast Du auch die interne Kommunikation und die Stimmung innerhalb der Organisation im Blick.

PR & Öffentlichkeitsarbeit: Du verantwortest die externe Kommunikation, pflegst die Beziehungen zu regionalen Medien und steuerst auch anspruchsvolle Kommunikationssituationen – beispielsweise bei Veränderungsprozessen, Krisen oder öffentlich sensiblen Themen.

Führung & Teamentwicklung: Du führst ein sechsköpfiges Team mit unterschiedlichen fachlichen Hintergründen, förderst die Zusammenarbeit und entwickelst Kompetenzen und Strukturen weiter.

Digitale Kommunikation: Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung der digitalen Kommunikation voran. Insbesondere Social Media und die Ansprache jüngerer Zielgruppen sollen künftig einen noch höheren Stellenwert erhalten. Dabei liegt Dein Fokus auf der strategischen Ausrichtung und Steuerung.

Gesellschaftliches Engagement: Du begleitest die strategische Ausrichtung des regionalen Spenden- und Sponsoringengagements und wirkst bei der Verteilung eines Budgets von rund 1,5 Millionen Euro mit.

Vertriebsunterstützung: Du entwickelst Kommunikationsmaßnahmen und Kampagnen, die insbesondere die Gewinnung junger Kundinnen und Kunden unterstützen und darüber hinaus das Firmenkundengeschäft sowie das Private Banking stärken.

Besondere Kommunikationsthemen: Du steuerst das Beschwerdemanagement bei eskalierten oder öffentlich sensiblen Fällen und begleitest die regionale Kunstsammlung gemeinsam mit der zuständigen Kuratorin.

Du arbeitest überwiegend strategisch und steuernd. Für die operative Umsetzung steht Dir ein erfahrenes Team zur Seite. Gleichzeitig hast Du die Möglichkeit, die zukünftige Ausrichtung und Organisation der Kommunikation aktiv mitzugestalten.

Qualifikation:

Du bist eine kommunikationsstarke Führungspersönlichkeit, die strategisch denkt, Menschen begeistert und klassische PR ebenso versteht wie moderne digitale Kommunikationsformate. Du hast Freude daran, unterschiedliche Themen zusammenzuführen und Kommunikation als wichtigen Erfolgsfaktor eines Unternehmens zu etablieren.

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Berufserfahrung in PR, Öffentlichkeitsarbeit, Unternehmenskommunikation und/oder Marketing
  • Erste oder mehrjährige Führungserfahrung – idealerweise sowohl fachlich als auch disziplinarisch
  • Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Social Media, digitale Kommunikationskanäle und insbesondere die Ansprache jüngerer Zielgruppen
  • Strategisches Denkvermögen und die Fähigkeit, Kommunikationskonzepte zu entwickeln und zukunftsorientiert weiterzuentwickeln
  • Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Textkompetenz sowie ein sicheres Gespür für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und anspruchsvolle Kommunikationssituationen
  • Erfahrung in der Beratung von Führungskräften und idealerweise im Umgang mit Vorständen oder Geschäftsführungen
  • Eine breite kommunikative Aufstellung: Du verbindest klassische Presse- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit mit moderner Unternehmens- und digitaler Kommunikation
  • Eine offene, verbindliche und souveräne Persönlichkeit, die unterschiedliche Menschen und Kompetenzen zusammenbringt
  • Was uns besonders wichtig ist: Wir suchen keinen klassischen Pressesprecher und auch keinen reinen Social-Media-Spezialisten, sondern einen vielseitigen Kommunikationsprofi mit Führungskompetenz, strategischem Blick und einem guten Gespür für gesellschaftliche und digitale Entwicklungen
  • Erfahrung in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind Deine fachliche Kompetenz, Deine Persönlichkeit und Deine Bereitschaft, neue Perspektiven einzubringen

Das erwartet Dich:

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Führungsposition mit direkter Nähe zum Vorstand und kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Ein engagiertes, fachlich vielseitiges Team mit sechs Mitarbeitenden und unterschiedlichen Kompetenzprofilen
  • Die Chance, die Kommunikationsstrategie eines etablierten Unternehmens maßgeblich zu prägen und moderne Kommunikationsformate weiter auszubauen
  • Ein Vorstand, der die Weiterentwicklung der Kommunikation aktiv unterstützt und insbesondere in den Bereichen Social Media und digitale Kommunikation investieren möchte
  • Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket mit leistungs- und erfolgsorientierten variablen Bestandteilen sowie einer zusätzlichen Sonderzahlung
  • Eine arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • 32 Tage Urlaub, ab 2027 sogar 33 Tage, sowie zusätzliche freie Tage an Heiligabend und Silvester
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten bei einer 39-Stunden-Woche mit transparenter Arbeitszeiterfassung
  • Vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Ein Mitarbeiterrestaurant und verschiedene Betriebssportangebote

Dein Arbeitsmodell:

Für diese Führungsposition ist eine regelmäßige Präsenz vor Ort gewünscht – grundsätzlich an vier Tagen pro Woche. Gerade in den ersten sechs Monaten steht die persönliche Vernetzung und ein umfassendes Onboarding im Mittelpunkt. Flexible Arbeitszeiten zwischen 7 und 20 Uhr sowie eine transparente Erfassung und Steuerung von Überstunden gehören selbstverständlich dazu.

Interesse geweckt?

Du möchtest Kommunikation nicht nur verantworten, sondern aktiv verändern und weiterentwickeln? Du hast Freude daran, strategische Themen mit einem starken Team umzusetzen und neue kommunikative Wege zu gehen?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

Bewirb Dich jetzt und lass uns gemeinsam über Deine nächsten Karriereschritte sprechen.

title: Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role
The laser amplification chain scales the beam energy needed by our fusion system. Developing it involves complex technical decisions, interdependent teams and requirements that evolve as the programme advances.

We are looking for a Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d) to give this function clear direction and accountability. Your mission is to lead the amplification team, critically evaluate technical information and turn stakeholder input into decisions, priorities and a credible development roadmap. You will guide the function towards delivery of a subsystem that meets agreed requirements and can integrate with the wider laser system.

You do not need to be an expert in every amplifier technology. You do need strong engineering judgement, extensive technical leadership experience and enough laser understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and work effectively with domain specialists.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop the function. Provide line management for technical teams, set clear expectations, give feedback and develop their capabilities. Build a view of the skills and capacity needed as the programme evolves, and contribute to hiring and team development.

  • Provide technical decisions and steering. Listen to different stakeholders, critically review their input and challenge assumptions. Work with specialists to assess options and make reasoned decisions, identifying where further evidence or expertise is needed.

  • Own the development roadmap. Translate system requirements and programme priorities into a function-level plan that goes beyond individual task lists. Establish milestones, identify dependencies and capability gaps, and adapt the plan as requirements and evidence change.

  • Guide complex project delivery. Lead larger technical projects through uncertainty. Keep priorities, resources, risks and trade-offs visible, coordinate with programme management and lab operations, and escalate issues early.

  • Connect amplification to the wider system. Take accountability for the amplification architecture, requirements and interfaces, drawing on the team's specialist expertise. Coordinate with adjacent laser functions and system integration so technical decisions support agreed performance and integration needs.

Who You Are

  • You have some laser exposure and a general understanding of amplification. You have enough relevant background to understand the function, engage with specialists and assess how its decisions affect the wider system. Direct hands-on amplifier development is an advantage, not a prerequisite.

  • Extensive technical leadership experience. You have led technical teams and larger, complex engineering projects, with responsibility for people, priorities and delivery. You can develop specialists and provide direction across disciplines.

  • Strong engineering judgement. You can evaluate technical arguments, distinguish assumptions from evidence, identify risks and challenge recommendations constructively. You do not need to know every answer yourself, but you know how to reach a sound decision with the right experts.

  • Experience leading through uncertainty. You have worked on development programmes with incomplete information, evolving requirements or changing technical priorities. You can maintain direction while adapting plans as new evidence emerges.

  • People and stakeholder leadership. You listen carefully, reconcile different perspectives, communicate decisions clearly and remain close to the team. Your leadership experience includes line management and developing technical colleagues, not only coordinating schedules.

  • Your background may be in laser systems, photonics, optical systems or a broader complex-engineering programme that includes relevant laser work. Your current title is less important than the scope of technical and people leadership you have exercised.

    Nice to have

  • Direct experience developing laser amplifiers or high-energy/high-power laser systems.

  • Familiarity with solid-state, fibre or diode-pumped amplification, CPA/OPCPA, or relevant pulsed and ultrafast systems.

  • Systems engineering, requirements traceability, technology-maturity planning and subsystem integration.

  • Industrialisation, supplier coordination, budget and resource planning, or design for cost and manufacture.

  • Experience in fusion, a high-power laser facility or a defence laser programme.

  • A PhD or equivalent depth of experience in physics, photonics or a related engineering discipline.


Why work with Us?

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers, and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges, and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Flexibility: Work should fit around your life, not the other way around. We offer the ability to work from our office, but some flexibility to work from home as well.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide on a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

title: Low-touch Customer Success Manager (Remote - EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

As our portfolio is expanding, we're looking for an additional Customer Success Manager for our Guided segment. You will serve as the primary post-sales partner for a portfolio of approximately 30 enterprise accounts across the EMEA region, guiding customers from onboarding through scaled adoption and long-term expansion.

You’ll run a strong operating cadence across customer engagements — including kickoffs, success planning, executive business reviews, adoption reviews, and renewals — helping customers translate product usage into measurable business outcomes and clear ROI.

You will proactively manage customer health, identify risks before they become blockers, and drive resolution across technical and business stakeholders. In addition, you’ll help design scalable playbooks and programs that improve customer outcomes across the broader customer base.

Working closely with Support, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Sales, you’ll turn technical success into durable revenue growth by driving adoption, renewals, and expansion opportunities that contribute to strong enterprise net revenue retention.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own a portfolio of n8n enterprise customers, acting as the primary post-sales partner across onboarding, adoption, and renewal

  • Lead customer kickoffs and success planning, aligning stakeholders on goals, timelines, responsibilities, and measurable outcomes

  • Drive onboarding and enablement across technical and business audiences, accelerating time-to-value and unblocking implementation challenges

  • Establish a strong operating cadence (health checks, executive syncs, QBRs), using customer data and adoption insights to guide priorities and decisions

  • Monitor customer health and product usage signals to proactively identify risks, manage escalations, and maintain stakeholder alignment

  • Quantify and communicate business value throughout the customer lifecycle, building ROI narratives tied to adoption, efficiency gains, and business impact

  • Identify and progress expansion opportunities (upsell/cross-sell), partnering with Account Executives on account strategies that drive customer growth

  • Partner closely with Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product teams to resolve blockers quickly and deliver a seamless customer experience

  • Provide structured, actionable feedback to Product and Engineering, representing customer needs and helping shape roadmap priorities

Requirements

🤝 Enterprise Customer Success experience: You’ve managed a portfolio of enterprise SaaS customers and can confidently run kickoffs, onboardings, stakeholder alignment, and QBRs end-to-end.

💻 Technical fluency: You can engage credibly with IT and engineering stakeholders across topics like APIs, integrations, authentication, environments, and automation architecture, and know when to escalate.

💼 Commercial acumen: You’ve supported renewals and expansion opportunities (upsell/cross-sell), with a track record of driving retention and growth outcomes.

📊 Value & outcomes mindset: You’re comfortable translating product usage into measurable business outcomes, ROI, and executive-ready narratives.

🧭 Operational rigor: You run a structured operating cadence, manage competing priorities effectively, and keep stakeholders aligned with strong follow-through.

🗣 Clear, high-trust communication: You communicate clearly with both technical builders and executive stakeholders, and you’re known for building durable customer relationships.

🤝 Cross-functional collaboration: You partner effectively with Sales, Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product to unblock customers and improve the customer journey.

🌱 Builder mindset in ambiguity: You thrive in fast-moving environments, take ownership, and enjoy building processes as the company scales.

🤖 Automation + AI curiosity: You’ve used automation, AI tools, or workflow platforms before and can bring ideas that improve customer value realization.

Nice-to-haves

🚀 Startup/scale-up experience: You’ve operated in high-growth environments and enjoy “building the plane while flying it.”

🎓 Technical or STEM education: Degree or equivalent experience in a technical field such as Computer Science, Engineering, or similar.

🧩 Familiarity with n8n or similar platforms: Experience with workflow automation, integration, or iPaaS platforms will help you ramp quickly.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Memory
descriptionHtml:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

As foundation models move from answering questions to acting over long horizons, memory becomes a central requirement. Systems must decide what is worth keeping and improve from experience. Large context windows and retrieval systems are not enough. You will work with researchers on projects across the company that require memory in different modalities to define general solutions that enable models to represent experience, decide what they keep and what they discard, and to efficiently store, retrieve and exploit memory.

In this role, you will

  • Design new memory architectures that work across problems, modalities and products
  • Define new ways to measure and evaluate memory performance
  • Help create and deliver production-ready, scalable and high-quality learning models and associated algorithms
  • Critically assess the effectiveness of such models and make recommendations for the ongoing roadmap

What we're looking for

  • PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics or related field, or 3+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Experience creating machine learning algorithms for vision and/or language problems and deploying them as production-level systems
  • Expert, hands-on knowledge of:
    • Foundational models and vision and/or language, incl. local deployment and model post-training of open weights models
    • Memory, state, or long-horizon behaviour in foundation models: your experience may come from language agents and long-context methods, reinforcement learning under partial observability, world models, or sequence modelling
    • Python and associated ML tools/frameworks (numpy, scipy, sklearn, pytorch)
  • Experience with working collaboratively with other developers, following a flexible and agile approach

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits except for PMI (for dependents). Our current benefits package includes pension, private medical insurance, health care cash plan, dental insurance, disability and life insurance, critical illness, cycle to work scheme, flu shots, health checks, and meals. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents.                         

ABOUT US

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here.

We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here.

title: Manager, Architecture
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Technology practice are looking for an experienced Architecture Manager to join the team. 

In Technology, we help clients define, drive and deliver technology-led change. We have deep experience in the strategy, design, delivery and assurance of large-scale transformation across financial services, energy, commodities, utilities, telecoms and government. Our people become trusted advisors, independent of any technology provider, and deliver real value for our clients.

AI is changing how organisations work, compete and invest, and it’s changing architecture with it. Our clients need architects who can cut through the hype, turn ambition into practical action and create value without losing control of cost, risk or complexity.

In our Architecture practice we bring the right balance of innovation, pace and control to technology-enabled change. We work on our clients’ most complex and highest-return challenges. Commodity or ivory-tower architecture isn’t where we play.

As a Manager, you’ll lead architecture work, use AI to raise the pace and quality of what we deliver, and play an active part in growing our business. You’ll spot opportunities, shape compelling work and build relationships that last well beyond a single engagement.

What you will be doing

Lead architecture that delivers real value

You’ll lead architecture work that turns strategy into practical change. That means owning architecture engagements and workstreams, shaping target architectures and roadmaps, and helping clients make better decisions about where to invest, what to simplify and how to manage risk.

  • Lead engagements with clear ownership of scope, quality, outcomes and client relationships
  • Help organisations improve their architecture functions, operating models and governance
  • Communicate complex ideas clearly, from delivery teams through to CTOs and CIOs

Help clients navigate AI-enabled change

You’ll help clients move from interest in AI to safe, valuable adoption. We’ll look to you to cut through the noise, design for change and make sure AI-enabled solutions have the foundations they need: data, integration, security, identity, governance and clear ownership.

  • Shape AI-ready architectures that balance innovation, pace and control
  • Help clients move beyond disconnected pilots to reusable services, governed delivery and measurable value
  • Use AI tools to speed up research, analysis, option development and architecture artefacts, with strong quality assurance throughout

Create and convert commercial opportunities

You’ll play an active part in growing our business. That means spotting where we can help, shaping work that clients value and building the confidence to convert good conversations into deliverable opportunities.

  • Qualify opportunities through delivery, market insight and trusted relationships
  • Shape proposals, statements of work, team shapes and commercial models with discipline
  • Build architecture propositions that match our growth priorities and the challenges our clients face

Lead people and build our capability

You’ll help build the kind of team people want to work in and clients want to work with. You’ll coach others, share what works and help us turn individual expertise into reusable capability across the practice.

  • Lead mixed Baringa and client teams with clear expectations and a strong coaching mindset
  • Coach colleagues on effective and responsible use of AI
  • Help grow the practice through training, thought leadership, reusable assets and recruitment

 
Your skills and experience  

  • Experience leading architecture work within complex technology-enabled change, with a strong delivery focus
  • Experience in both enterprise and solution architecture, translating strategy into deliverable target architectures and roadmaps, and designing and assuring solutions to achieve it
  • Broad experience across architecture domains (business, application, integration, data, infrastructure and security), with deep expertise in at least one
  • Cloud experience across XaaS offerings, with knowledge of cloud-native services and how to use them in cloud and hybrid solutions
  • A practical understanding of AI and the architecture considerations needed to adopt it safely and at scale. Hands-on AI design experience is a bonus, not a must
  • Experience contributing to proposals, bids or account growth, and the commercial awareness to shape work that is valuable and deliverable
  • The ability to take ownership of projects and teams, sell work and deliver results
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain the complex in simple terms, concisely and with clarity
  • Experience managing stakeholders from C-suite through to engineering, and a desire to build lasting relationships
  • A collaborative style, real curiosity and a genuine interest in helping others grow 

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. title: Manager / Associate Director, Corporate Tax Advisory
descriptionHtml:
The Role

Join the UK’s market leading Financial Advisory Restructuring Tax team and make a real difference on a range of high profile and dynamic transactions. Our Financial Advisory Restructuring Tax team specialises in providing tax advice on the restructuring of financially distressed businesses. They have built a fantastic track record in recent years, leading on some of Europe’s largest and most complex restructuring processes. These include debt restructuring transactions, debt-for-equity swaps, business reconstructions via Restructuring Plans, Schemes of Arrangement and CVAs, and insolvency appointments. The variety of work really stands out, as does the friendly and supportive nature of the team. The team has a great mix of UK and international transactions work and is looking to recruit a corporation tax specialist at Associate Director level to build on the existing business capability and target a number of exciting developments in the restructuring market. This role is primarily advisory focused but will have some compliance responsibility. This is a unique opportunity to get involved. The role is technically interesting and personally rewarding.

Key Responsibilities

Your key areas of focus will include:

  • Working directly with our financial advisory colleagues and external stakeholders including lenders, borrowers and legal advisors to understand the often complex commercial and legal requirements of each restructuring transaction;
  • Developing a strategy for achieving the commercial aims in a tax efficient manner.
  • Reviewing and preparing reports setting out the steps necessary to meet the aims of the transaction;
  • Advising insolvency practitioners involved in the restructuring on the tax consequences of their intended actions;
  • Advising on the submission of appropriate tax returns or other documentation to tax authorities and liaising with them, as required;
  • Supporting the business development activities of the team (you will have a broad scope to build relationships both internally and with key clients); and
  • Contributing to the technical and personal development training of the broader team.

Key Skills & Experience

To qualify for the role you must have:

  • ACA/CTA or equivalent qualification or experience;
  • Strong UK tax technical skills;
  • Strong communication, team playing and project management skills;  and
  • The ability to perform strongly under pressure.

Prior experience of transactions or insolvency processes is preferred.

What can we offer you?

New joiners are supported by a week-long induction programme, and continuous improvement is achieved through a structured and tailored programme that suits your career development.

As well as this we offer a whole host of benefits and reward including:

  • Competitive Salary
  • 28 days holiday
  • Discretionary Bonus Scheme
  • Cash benefits allowance
  • Company pension scheme
  • Extensive investment in personal development & learning
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave (depending on length of service) and shared parental leave
  • Group Income protection
  • Life assurance
  • Cycle to work schemes
  • Regular social, cultural and charitable activities

About Teneo

Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.

Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions, and organizations.

Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organizational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance, ESG and DE&I.

The firm has more than 1,800 employees located in 40+ offices around the world.

title: Manager CTO Office
descriptionHtml:
Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Manager CTO Office rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO en geef je leiding aan circa 16 IT-professionals. Het CTO Office is het centrale regie- en ondersteuningsorgaan binnen het CTO-domein.

Vanuit het team zorg je ervoor dat het Technology - domein aantoonbaar in control is, met geïntegreerde sturing op onder andere governance, risk, performance, change portfolio en Third Parties.

Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. Je bouwt aan een professionele, resultaatgerichte werkomgeving waarin continu leren, talentontwikkeling, vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan.

Als Manager CTO Office heb je een sleutelrol binnen het MT Technology en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO. Je verbindt leiderschap en strategisch inzicht met een pragmatische aanpak. Zo zorg je voor samenhangende sturing en beheersing van het Technology-domein, waarbij governance en control bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en een effectieve IT-organisatie.

Sturing en beheersing
Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integrale visie op governance en control, waarmee Athora effectief voldoet aan interne en externe verplichtingen en tegelijkertijd ruimte creëert voor innovatie en groei. Je geeft richting aan governance, quality & risk management, procesmanagement, compliance, performance management, service management en demand & delivery management. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten.

Verandering en verbetering
Je ontwikkelt en bestuurt het change portfolio voor het CTO-domein. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je leidt het CTO Office, ontwikkelt talent en versterkt vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en een professionele, resultaatgerichte cultuur;

  • Je stuurt het Technology changeportfolio aan en zoekt daarbij actief de verbinding met de betrokken Change & Agility managers en de centrale portfoliofunctie;

  • Je ontwikkelt en verbetert de IT-governance: je verduidelijkt verantwoordelijkheden, versterkt de besluitvorming en geeft richting en waarborgt aansluiting tussen Technology Governance en Data & AI Governance belegd bij het Data & AI Office;

  • Je borgt samen met de relevante stakeholders kwaliteit, risicobeheersing en compliance binnen Technology;

  • Je bereidt namens Technology de overleggen voor met toezichthouders zoals DNB, de externe accountant, Internal Audit en tweedelijns controlefuncties;

  • Je voert de regie over Third Party Risk Management en waarborgt dat risico's, prestaties en compliance van strategische IT-sourcingpartners effectief worden beheerst;

  • Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de sourcingstrategie en het outsourcingbeleid. Ook organiseer en bewaak je de governance en monitoring van kritieke uitbestede activiteiten;

  • Je levert heldere operationele, tactische en strategische stuurinformatie en versterkt daarmee transparante besluitvorming en een sterke performancecultuur.

  • Je bewaakt budgetten, beheerst kosten en maakt de financiën binnen Technology en de onderliggende dienstverlening inzichtelijk;

  • Je coacht en geeft functioneel leiding aan Product Owners, Release Train Engineers en Scrum Masters binnen Technology.


Wat vragen we van jou?

Voor deze rol zoeken we een ervaren manager die overzicht weet te houden in een complex Technology-landschap en tegelijkertijd dicht genoeg op de uitvoering zit om daadwerkelijk verandering te realiseren.

Dit breng je minimaal mee:

  • WO-werk- en -denkniveau en een relevante opleiding, bij voorkeur in informatiemanagement, IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Minimaal 10 jaar relevante ervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening, met een sterk trackrecord op het gebied van strategisch advies, Governance, IT-governance, IT-procesmanagement, quality & risk control en performance-, service- en demand & delivery management;

  • Ruime ervaring met het aansturen, ontwikkelen en inspireren van teams van vergelijkbare omvang, waarbij je medewerkers in staat stelt het beste uit zichzelf te halen;

  • Diepgaande kennis van IT4IT, COBIT en andere toonaangevende IT-standaarden en frameworks, en het vermogen deze effectief toe te passen in een complexe organisatieomgeving;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met SAFe-principes en Agile werken, inclusief incrementplanning, sprintcadans, backlogmanagement en het succesvol managen van afhankelijkheden tussen teams;

  • Sterke verandermanagementvaardigheden, waarbij je strategische ambities vertaalt naar concrete initiatieven en blijvende resultaten realiseert;

  • Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken met senior management, Legal & Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit en externe accountants;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega’s die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.

Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

Salaris per maand:
Op basis van cao schaal 19 HAY is de range € 7.872,85 tot € 10.497,13 op basis van 36 uur.

Enthousiast?
