title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is building the team to help the world's most ambitious organizations adopt Claude in ways that are transformative, safe, and lasting. Our Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with strategic customers to ship production AI applications that solve real business problems. As this practice grows, we need a founding leader to build and scale it.

As the first FDE Manager in DACH, you'll own the team that sits at the frontier of enterprise AI deployment. You'll hire and develop a high-performing team of FDEs, set the technical and operational bar for customer engagements, and build the playbooks that turn one-off successes into repeatable patterns. You'll work hand-in-hand with Engagement Managers who own delivery logistics and stakeholder management, while you ensure your team is shipping quality code, growing technically, and representing Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments.

This is a player-coach role with a strong bias toward leadership. You'll stay close enough to the technical work to review architectures, debug production issues, and pair with your team when it matters — but your primary impact will come from the people you hire, the standards you set, and the culture you create. You'll partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering to shape how Anthropic serves its most strategic customers, and your team's field insights will directly influence product direction.

This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity and is energized by building from zero to one. You'll be defining what good looks like for FDE management at Anthropic — there is no existing playbook to follow.

Responsibilities

  • Hire, develop, and retain a world-class team of Forward Deployed Engineers. Set a high bar for technical talent and customer instincts.

  • Conduct regular 1:1s, provide technical mentorship, and invest in the career growth of each team member. Create an environment where FDEs do the best work of their careers.

  • Staff and oversee customer engagements across your team's portfolio, making resource allocation decisions that balance customer needs, team development, and business priorities.

  • Collaborate with account teams and Engagement Managers during the pre-sales process to qualify engagements, scope work, and inform statements of work.

  • Review technical architectures and code produced by your FDEs, ensuring the team ships high-quality, production-ready solutions that solve real customer problems.

  • Stay hands-on enough to lead technical discovery sessions, prototype solutions, and debug complex issues alongside your team when needed.

  • Build repeatable playbooks, starter repositories, integration templates, and an internal knowledge base that captures what your team learns in the field.

  • Define team OKRs that tie to customer success outcomes and product adoption goals. Create operational cadences — standups, retros, engagement reviews — that keep the team aligned.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to translate field insights into product improvements. Serve as the voice of the customer in internal planning.

  • Travel to customer sites as needed (25-50%), particularly during engagement kickoffs and for your team's highest-priority accounts.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or a technical customer-facing role such as forward deployed engineering or consulting.

  • 2+ years of people management experience within a services/post-sales/FDE organization with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.

  • Experience building organizations from 0->1, not just inheriting an existing one.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers on technical implementations, including comfort navigating complex organizational dynamics.

  • Executive presence with the ability to move fluidly between strategic conversations with senior stakeholders and hands-on debugging sessions with engineers.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can translate technical complexity into clear narratives for diverse audiences.

  • Genuine excitement about building something new and defining what great looks like for a team that doesn't yet exist.

Why this role matters

You'll be a founding leader of a team that defines how enterprises adopt and scale AI. Your work will directly influence Anthropic's product direction, create reusable patterns for the broader customer base, and establish Anthropic as the trusted partner for AI transformation — all while advancing the responsible development of frontier AI systems.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Vestlane

Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Wir sind zertifiziert und für die regulatorische Realität spannender Akronyme gebaut – von GwG, BaFin, AMLR, RTS, CSSF bis hin zu DORA, RAIF, AIFMD, MiFID uvm.

Du hast schon ein paar Jahre B2B-Marketing gemacht und willst jetzt Kanäle wirklich verantworten statt nur zuzuarbeiten? Du willst die Welt von Venture Capital und Private Equity von innen kennenlernen, ohne selbst in einem Fonds zu sitzen? Du kannst schreiben, denkst in Zielgruppen statt in Posts und findest es reizvoll, aus GwG und CSSF-Rundschreiben Inhalte zu machen, die Compliance-Verantwortliche tatsächlich lesen? Du betreibst Marketing mit KI-Tools und Daten statt mit der Gießkanne? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich!

Als Marketing Manager arbeitest du direkt mit unserem COO zusammen, der Go-to-Market verantwortet, und in enger Abstimmung mit unserem CEO. Du übernimmst die Marketing-Themen, die heute auf seinem Tisch liegen – von Content und SEO über LinkedIn und Newsletter bis Website und Events – und bist nah dran an jeder Entscheidung, die unsere Positionierung bewegt. Kolleg:innen aus Regulatory, Design und Customer Success liefern dir Fachwissen, Grafiken und Kundenstimmen. Echte Verantwortung für eigene Kanäle ab Tag eins, kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung, keine Agenturschleifen. Dein Arbeitsplatz ist unser Office in Bonn, mit flexiblen Home-Office-Regelungen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Content, der gelesen wird: Du planst und schreibst Blogartikel, Landingpages und Fachbeiträge zu KYC/AML, AMLR, Fondsregulierung und unseren Produktfeatures – auf Deutsch und Englisch, fachlich sauber, verständlich und mit Haltung.

  • SEO und GEO verantworten: Du baust auf unseren bestehenden Rankings auf, entwickelst die Keyword-Strategie weiter und sorgst dafür, dass Vestlane auch dort gefunden wird, wo heute gesucht wird.

  • LinkedIn und Newsletter fahren: Du bespielst die Company Page, bereitest Posts für die Geschäftsführung vor und verantwortest unseren Regulatory- und Product-Newsletter von der Themenplanung bis zum Versand.

  • Website weiterentwickeln: Du pflegst und erweiterst vestlane.com in unserem CMS (Storyblok), briefst Design, testest neue Seiten und misst, was funktioniert.

  • Success Stories und Events: Du sammelst Kundenstimmen gemeinsam mit Customer Success, machst daraus Case Studies und verantwortest das Pre- und Post-Marketing von Events, Webinaren und Partner-Announcements.

  • Die Marketing-Maschine bauen: Du strukturierst Contentplanung, Tracking und Reporting, baust KI-Workflows für Recherche, Entwürfe und Distribution und zeigst mit Zahlen, welche Maßnahmen Pipeline bringen.

Dein Profil

  • 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing, idealerweise SaaS, Finanz- oder Legal-/RegTech-Umfeld. Du hast schon mindestens einen Kanal eigenständig verantwortet (Content, SEO, LinkedIn oder Newsletter) und kannst zeigen, was dabei herausgekommen ist.

  • Du schreibst sehr gut auf Deutsch und Englisch: klar, präzise, ohne Buzzword-Nebel. Du kannst einen komplexen Sachverhalt in drei Sätzen erklären und in einem Post zuspitzen.

  • Solide SEO-Kenntnisse (Keyword-Recherche, On-Page, Content-Struktur, Tracking) und echtes Interesse an Generative Engine Optimization. Erfahrung mit einem CMS, LinkedIn Company Pages und einem Newsletter-Tool.

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools im Alltag selbstverständlich für Recherche, Entwürfe und Analysen und weißt, wo du selbst nachschärfen musst.

  • Du magst Zahlen: Du willst wissen, ob dein Artikel rankt, ob der Newsletter geöffnet wird und was davon im CRM ankommt.

  • Interesse an Finanzregulierung und Compliance. Du musst kein GwG-Profi sein, aber du musst Lust haben, dich einzuarbeiten – Fachwissen bekommst du von Kolleg:innen, die täglich damit arbeiten.

  • Du siehst dich als Unternehmer:in innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als Content-Lieferant:in. Du willst heute Verantwortung und morgen Führung, und du willst dir beides erarbeiten, indem du etwas aufbaust.

Deine Benefits

  • Eigene Kanäle und Themen ab Tag eins, mit klarem Entwicklungspfad hin zu mehr Verantwortung im Marketing

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit COO und CEO, kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Agenturschleifen

  • Vollzeit, unbefristet, Start ab sofort möglich

  • Kompetitives Gehaltspaket

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Bezahlte Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen

  • Arbeitsplatz in unserem Bonner Office, flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office-Regelungen

  • Moderne Tools und KI im täglichen Einsatz

  • Ein Team, das Compliance ernst nimmt, weil Compliance das Produkt ist, kein Kostenfaktor

Abschluss

Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und zwei bis drei Arbeitsproben (Artikel, Posts, Landingpages, Newsletter – was zeigt, wie du arbeitest). Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht; ein paar Sätze dazu, warum Marketing für ein RegTech dich reizt, reichen. Wir prüfen deine Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Wochen.

Der Prozess ist bewusst kurz und hat drei Schritte: ein 30-minütiges Kennenlerngespräch, in dem es um dich, deinen Weg und die Frage geht, ob wir zueinander passen. Dann ein 45-minütiger Termin mit einer praktischen Aufgabe aus dem echten Alltag – zum Beispiel ein LinkedIn-Post zu einem regulatorischen Thema –, damit du siehst, was dich erwartet, und wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Zum Abschluss ein 30-minütiges Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Insgesamt weniger als zwei Stunden deiner Zeit, und du bekommst nach jedem Schritt zeitnah Rückmeldung.

Fragen vor der Bewerbung? Melde dich bei uns!

title: Master Data Management Supplier Engagement Lead, Global Business Services
descriptionHtml:
Master Data Management Supplier Engagement Lead, Global Business Services

At IVC Evidensia, we are a leading veterinary services provider in Europe and North America with more than 2,500 clinics and hospitals across 19 countries and around 42,000 employees. We aim to have an extraordinary impact on animal lives, supporting in the region of 25,000 animals every single day across our international network. IVC Evidensia exists to champion the long-term health and welfare of animals and deliver our purpose of Healthy Animals, Happy Owners.

The GBS Master Data Management Supplier Engagement Lead is a new role and is responsible for establishing and leading a proactive, business-facing supplier engagement and governance function within Global Business Solutions (GBS).

The role will act as the primary point of coordination between suppliers, clinics, Country Finance, Procurement and GBS, ensuring that new suppliers are onboarded efficiently, accurately and in accordance with established master data governance standards, financial controls and procurement policies.

Leading a team of GBS Regional Supplier Engagement SMEs, the role will drive a consistent, standardised approach to supplier onboarding, validation, engagement and ongoing supplier data quality across all operating countries.

A key focus will be to embed preventative controls at the point of supplier creation, ensuring supplier records, payment methods, payment terms, banking information and supporting documentation are accurate, complete and appropriately authorised before being established in Oracle.

The role will also support and be consulted on the targeted supplier data improvement and remediation initiatives, including Direct Debit and Payment Terms Rationalisation, working collaboratively with Procurement, PTP and Country Finance to reduce payment exceptions, strengthen compliance and improve end-to-end Procure-to-Pay performance.

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities:

Supplier Onboarding & Front-Line Governance

* Own and standardise the end-to-end supplier onboarding process across GBS-supported countries * Establish minimum mandatory supplier information, documentation and validation requirements before supplier creation * Ensure appropriate validation of supplier legal identity, tax information, banking details, payment methods and payment terms * Implement preventative controls to minimise duplicate suppliers, incomplete records, incorrect payment arrangements and unauthorised supplier creation * Ensure exceptions to supplier onboarding standards are documented, approved and escalated in line with established governance * Establish clear ownership and approval requirements between Clinics, Country Finance, Procurement and GBS

Supplier Engagement & Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary escalation and coordination point for supplier onboarding issues * Lead proactive supplier outreach to obtain missing information, clarify onboarding requirements and resolve data discrepancies * Develop standardised supplier communication templates, engagement scripts and supporting guidance, including local-language requirements * Build effective working relationships with Country Finance, Procurement, PTP, Clinics and other relevant stakeholders * Coordinate resolution of complex supplier onboarding cases and ensure clear accountability for outstanding actions * Drive supplier and clinic education to improve the quality of submissions and reduce avoidable queries

Supplier Master Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

* Partner with the Customer & Supplier Master Data Lead to define supplier data quality standards and validation requirements * Develop supplier data quality reporting and root-cause analysis to identify recurring onboarding issues * Lead supplier-facing remediation activities, coordinating the collection and validation of information required to correct existing records * Identify opportunities to simplify and automate supplier onboarding, documentation collection and validation workflows * Support integration of newly acquired clinics and their supplier populations into the standard GBS supplier governance framework

Supplier Engagement Operational Performance & Governance

* Establish service standards, KPIs and reporting for supplier onboarding, engagement, data completeness and governance compliance * Monitor onboarding backlogs, supplier response times, outstanding documentation and ageing exceptions * Work closely with Genpact to ensure validated supplier requests are processed accurately and within agreed service levels * Monitor recurring BPO processing issues, escalate service failures and coordinate corrective actions with the MDM Lead * Maintain clear audit trails for supplier validation, approvals, exceptions and remediation activities * Provide regular performance updates, risks and improvement recommendations to GBS leadership

Regional Team Leadership & Capability Development

title: Medical Director
descriptionHtml:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the operating system for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives.

The role

Lucis analyses 110+ biomarkers, builds personalised clinical protocols, and delivers them through an AI-powered preventive health product. We are live in France and opening the UK, Portugal and Spain.

This role exists to turn clinical judgement into the medical standards the company can run on.

We are hiring a Medical Director to own Lucis's clinical direction and medical safety system.

You will:

  • Decide what we test and why, and to what clinical standard the service runs

  • Set the risk posture and the governance model: who signs what, how incidents are handled, what Lucis can claim

  • Own the certification call and path: medical device classification, CE, ISO, or stay out of scope, and the argument behind it

  • Hire and lead the clinical operations and safety team.

  • Represent Lucis clinically with labs, insurers, institutional partners and regulators, alongside the CMO

About you

You're passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast-moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve.

You'll fit in well if

title: Meewerkstage Berenschot-COT Instituut voor Veiligheids- en Crisismanagement
descriptionHtml:
0,8-1 fte | Utrecht | Hybride | Veiligheids- en crisismanagement | € 600,– | Wo

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Ben jij een wo-student die gefascineerd is door veiligheid, crisismanagement en complexe maatschappelijke vraagstukken? Vind je de theorie boeiend, maar kun je niet wachten om de praktijk te ervaren? Wil je meedraaien in een team dat adviseert bij ingrijpende incidenten en organisaties voorbereidt op het onvoorspelbare? Dan is een stage bij Berenschot-COT iets voor jou!

Tijdens deze meewerkstage draai je als volwaardige collega mee in het hart van het veiligheidsdomein. Je werkt aan opdrachten voor ministeries, veiligheidsregio’s en private organisaties. Van het analyseren van cyberaanvallen tot het ondersteunen bij grootschalige crisisoefeningen: jij maakt écht het verschil.

Dit ga je doen

Als stagiair bij Berenschot-COT werk je onder begeleiding van een ervaren projectleider samen met collega’s aan diverse projecten binnen het veiligheids- en crisisdomein. Je bent actief betrokken bij zowel trainingen en oefeningen als onderzoeks- en adviesopdrachten.

Je draagt onder andere bij aan:

  • het ontwikkelen en voorbereiden van trainingen en crisisoefeningen, waaronder het opstellen van oefenscenario’s en trainingsmateriaal

  • het ondersteunen bij de uitvoering van trainingen en oefeningen, inclusief observatie en evaluatie

  • het uitvoeren van onderzoeks- en adviesopdrachten voor uiteenlopende inhoudelijke thema’s binnen crisismanagement

  • het verzamelen en analyseren van informatie

  • het bijwonen van bijeenkomsten en verzorgen van verslaglegging

  • het meewerken aan (calamiteiten)onderzoeken

Daarnaast neem je deel aan interne overleggen, kennissessies en teamactiviteiten. Zo leer je niet alleen het vakgebied goed kennen, maar ook de dynamiek van werken in een professioneel adviesbureau.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid vanaf dag één krijg je de kans om te ontdekken waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Berenschot-COT is gespecialiseerd in advisering, onderzoek, trainingen en oefeningen op het gebied van veiligheids- en crisismanagement. Wij adviseren organisaties vóór, tijdens en na crisissituaties en helpen hen hun crisis- en veiligheidsmanagement structureel te verbeteren.

Berenschot-COT heeft brede ervaring binnen zowel de publieke als private sector, in binnen- en buitenland. Opdrachten die landelijke bekendheid kregen zijn onder meer het onderzoek naar het schietdrama in Alphen aan den Rijn, de tramaanslag in Utrecht, de ongeregeldheden rond Ajax-Maccabi Tel Aviv en de cyberaanval bij de TU Eindhoven. Voor meer informatie en recente opdrachten zie: www.cot.nl.


Dit neem je mee

We zoeken een gemotiveerde wo-student (laatste jaar bachelor of master) met affiniteit voor crisis- en veiligheidsvraagstukken. Denk qua studieachtergrond bijvoorbeeld aan communicatie, media, politicologie, bestuurskunde, security studies of criminologie. Andere relevante opleidingen zijn uiteraard ook welkom, mits je motivatie aansluit bij ons werkveld.

Daarnaast:

  • je kunt zelfstandig werken en functioneert goed binnen een team

  • je bent communicatief vaardig en presenteert je professioneel, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

  • je hebt een sterk analytisch vermogen

  • je bent beschikbaar voor een stageperiode van vijf of zes maanden voor vier of vijf dagen per week (maximaal 38,75 uur)

  • startmomenten zijn maart (t/m juli) of september (t/m februari).

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot-COT werk je in een professionele en maatschappelijk betrokken adviesomgeving met veel ruimte voor initiatief en ontwikkeling. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • een uitdagende meewerkstage van vijf of zes maanden

  • een stagevergoeding van € 600,– per maand (op fulltimebasis)

  • een laptop

  • flexibele werkmogelijkheden, ook thuis

  • regelmatige feedback- en check-in momenten met je stagebegeleider

  • een platte organisatie waarin je écht iets kunt betekenen

  • een gezellig team dat werk en plezier goed weet te combineren.

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma. Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Solliciteer meteen

Wil jij ook een trotse Berenschotter worden? Je kunt tot 1 juli reageren. Solliciteer direct! Vragen? Neem contact op met Vicky Schats, via WhatsApp (06-25 72 26 12) of per e-mail (). Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen een werkweek een reactie. Bij een positieve eerste indruk nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Als dat goed aansluit, ontvang je een concreet aanbod.

title: Member of Marketing Staff - Events Marketing Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup based in London, founded by Guy Podjarny, who previously founded Snyk. We’ve raised more than $100 million from world-class investors, including Index Ventures, Accel, GV and Boldstart. In 2025, Tessl ranked #2 in Sifted’s B2B SaaS Rising 100 and #20 in its AI 100.

We’re building the context layer for AI coding agents and a platform for AI-native software development. As an early member of the team, you’ll help shape how we build and scale a company operating at the forefront of AI and software development.

About the Role

Events are one of the main ways Tessl builds real relationships with developers, customers, and partners. We're looking for a mid-level Events Marketing Specialist in New York to run our growing US events program on the ground: community meetups, developer chapters, conferences, partner and customer events, and larger Tessl-owned moments.

This is a hands-on execution role, with the opportunity to influence our events strategy as we grow our presence in the US. You'll take an agreed plan and make it real, and you'll be the person in the room making sure it runs. Most of the team sits outside the US, so you'll own your events with real autonomy, while sharing learnings and the impact of events on our growth goals with the wider team.

What You'll Do

Run US events end to end

  • Own operational delivery once strategy, objectives, and format are agreed: timelines, run-of-show, budgets, vendors, venues, catering, AV, signage, swag, and shipping

  • Be the primary owner on the ground, and troubleshoot calmly when something breaks an hour before doors open

  • Make Tessl events feel considered and consistent, not just staffed

Support the developer community program

  • Help chapter leaders across the US navigate venues, formats, logistics, swag, and promotion

  • Show up for priority community events and represent Tessl in the room

  • Build repeatable resources so local chapters get more self-sufficient over time

Coordinate conferences, partner and field events

  • Manage Tessl's presence at third-party conferences and developer events, and support commercial B2B activations with Sales and Partnerships: booths, sponsorships, side events, dinners, and co-hosted events

  • Keep both sides clear on responsibilities and deadlines on co-hosted events, and support larger programs like US roadshows alongside senior team members

Help fill the room

  • Work with Marketing, Community, and Sales so every event has a promotion plan and the assets to back it

  • Flag early when registrations track below target, and help identify the local communities and companies worth reaching (audience acquisition matters here, but this isn't primarily a demand generation role)

Keep everyone aligned

  • Maintain a single source of truth for each event so people know what's happening and what they own

  • Surface risks and blockers early with a proposed fix, and work smoothly across time zones with the UK-based Marketing and Community teams

What Good Looks Like

  • US events run smoothly without senior team members managing every operational detail

  • Plans are current and trusted, and everyone knows what's expected of them and when

  • Problems surface early, with solutions rather than surprises

  • Events feel polished and intentional on the ground

  • Our community program expands, with regular, well-attended meetups in key US cities

  • Chapter organisers feel well supported and grow more self-sufficient over time

  • Events contribute measurable value to our growth goals, generating sales opportunities and growing our community

  • Awareness of Tessl and AI Native Dev grows among developers and technical leaders in the US

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a strong operator and doer. You don't need to bring a new events strategy; you need to be very good at turning plans into reality.

Must have:

  • A few years running events, field marketing, or community events, from planning through to live delivery

  • Excellent organisation and project management, with real attention to detail across several events at once

  • A proactive communicator who keeps people informed rather than waiting to be asked

  • Good judgment and the confidence to make sensible calls independently

  • Experience managing external vendors, venues, and event partners

  • Happy to get hands-on: as comfortable talking through a plan with a senior stakeholder as tracking down a missing shipment before doors open

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving company and working with a distributed international team

Nice to have:

  • Experience with developer, technology, or startup community events

  • Experience supporting community chapters, ambassador programs, or meetup organisers

  • Both community-focused and commercial B2B/field event experience

  • Familiarity with the New York technology and developer scene

  • Some experience promoting events through community channels, email, social, or local outreach

Location and Travel

This role is based in New York, with regular travel across the US. You'll be Tessl's primary events operator on the ground, so you should be happy to travel when your presence will make an event materially better. We don't expect you at every Tessl event. You'll also work with the global Marketing and Events team at larger moments and team gatherings.

Salary and Benefits

Salary: We offer a competitive salary based on experience and skills, benchmarked against industry standards.

Application Process

  1. Introductory call

  2. Hiring manager deep dive

  3. Practical exercise

  4. Final conversation with leadership


We care deeply about the warm, inclusive environment we’re building at Tessl and we value diversity – we welcome applications from those typically underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this role but are not totally sure whether you’re the right person, do apply anyway!

title: Mixed-signal Verification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer you will own the methodology, planning, and execution of mixed-signal verification for digital-to-analog interfaces on Arago's Systems-on-Chip, working across analog, RTL, architecture, and firmware teams to ensure correct integration and drive verification to sign-off.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience in ASIC or SoC verification.

  • Experience verifying mixed-signal blocks or digital-to-analog and analog-to-digital interfaces.

  • Experience with AMS (analog-mixed-signal) co-simulation flow, and setting up mixed-signal testbenches.

  • Strong SystemVerilog skills and practical experience with UVM or an equivalent verification methodology.

  • Experience building verification environments and developing tests, assertions, scoreboards, and functional coverage.

  • Good understanding of both digital design fundamentals and basic analog/mixed-signal concepts.

  • Strong debugging skills, including the ability to investigate issues spanning RTL, models, clocks, resets, configuration, and analog behavior.

  • Experience with scripting and automation, preferably Python, Tcl, shell, or similar.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Own the mixed-signal verification methodology and verification plan for digital-to-analog interfaces on Arago SoCs.

  • Build and maintain verification environments at block, subsystem, and SoC level.

  • Develop tests, assertions, checkers, scoreboards, and functional coverage.

  • Verify digital control and configuration of analog/mixed-signal circuitry across normal operation, corner cases, and error conditions.

  • Run regressions, analyze coverage, debug failures, and drive verification to sign-off.

  • Develop or integrate behavioral and real-number models needed for efficient mixed-signal simulation.

  • Work closely with analog, RTL, architecture, firmware, and SoC verification teams to identify and resolve interface issues.

Nice to have

  • Verification experience with complex high-speed interface IP such as PCIe, DDR/LPDDR, UCIe, SerDes, USB, CXL, or similar PHY-based interfaces.

  • Experience verifying interface initialization, link training, calibration, adaptation, clocking, power-state transitions, or other digital/analog control loops.

  • Experience with real-number modeling, SystemVerilog RNM, wreal, Verilog-AMS, or equivalent mixed-signal verification techniques.

  • Experience developing or integrating behavioral models of analog/PHY components into digital verification environments.

  • Experience with SoC-level integration and verification of complex interface IP.

  • Experience with low-power verification, power-state management, or UPF.

  • Experience driving a complex IP or SoC verification effort through coverage closure and tape-out.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

title: New Business Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

Hiring and how we work

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next New Business Account Executive UK/I/Northern Europe..

About the job

This position is needed to sell into high value Enterprise prospects and existing customers with ARR under $50k. You will play a key role in further growing Twilio’s Communication business across UK/I/Northern Europe. You will be responsible for sourcing new, high value customers as well as driving the sales process from internal leads to qualifying new prospects and handling deals to closure.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Be responsible for net new customer acquisition and driving ACV for a specific set of accounts while maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Work closely with your SDR and SE teams to own, drive and build intelligent outreach campaigns into new prospects
  • Source new leads and drive sustainable pipeline growth each quarter
  • Master creating pricing proposals, negotiating terms and managing the contract process. Ideally, you also have experience selling communications solutions to a technical and business audience, building trust and mutual respect with technical customers and peers.
  • Are passionate about what you do and you are able to think outside of the box and have extraordinary interpersonal and communication skills to make complex contractual, technical, and financial details sound simple.
  • Able to balance challenging priorities and handle multiple projects/deals at the same time.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 6+ years of Enterprise Sales experience and a track record of personally selling and closing complex solutions to enterprise and software companies. 
  • Strong experience identifying, mapping and prospecting enterprise accounts
  • Proven success in selling complex, technical solutions such as cloud communications platforms, APIs, Conversational AI and/or enterprise software
  • Experience in account management, developing large enterprise clients, and a history of meeting or exceeding sales targets
  • Experience working with Fortune 500 or similarly large enterprises
  • Background in working within a quota-driven environment with proven ability to close high-value deals (e.g., six to seven figures)
  • Expertise in solution-based selling or consultative selling 
  • Strong negotiation and contract management skills, including handling complex deals with long sales cycles.
  • Prospecting and lead generation skills—ability to develop a pipeline through multiple channels, including direct sales, partnerships, and networking.
  • Ability to build and nurture relationships with C-level executives, decision-makers, cross-functional partners and key stakeholders in large enterprises
  • Strong presentation and negotiation skills
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic / environment. 
  • Familiar working with MEDDPICC sales qualification methodology and other Sales methodologies 

Desired:

  • Ideally, you also have experience selling both to a business and technical audience
  • Understanding of the CPaaS & Customer Engagement ecosystem and familiarity with:
    • Cloud communications (voice, SMS, chat, video, etc.).
    • Contact centre agent productivity and Conversational AI
    • APIs and integrations for communication services.
    • Telecommunications industry dynamics.
    • Knowledge of enterprise technology architecture and the technical needs of large organizations, including how CPaaS solutions integrate with existing systems.

Location

This role will be remote and based in the UK or Ireland.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way. 

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

title: Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is that we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region, including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

The Operations Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale.

This is not a P&L role, and it's not a "manage from a distance" role either. You'll partner closely with the CEO to turn business objectives into strong execution on the ground, building systems, leading teams, and stepping in directly when execution breaks.

 

What You'll Own

  • Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market.

  • Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless.

  • Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability.

  • Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed.

  • Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases.

  • Oversee company administration and internal operations, including office management, documentation, vendor coordination, and adherence to internal policies.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong background in operations, execution, or internal business operations in tech, fintech, or fast-scaling environments.

  • Proven experience leading operations and admin teams in high-expectation environments.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to solve problems directly, not just delegate them.

  • Strong organisational, execution, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to fast-moving situations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and drive execution without formal authority.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who want to direct operations from a distance instead of stepping in when things break.

  • Candidates who need fully-built systems and processes handed to them.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid escalations, messy cases, or hard conversations with vendors and staff.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

  • This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1-2 weeks from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

descriptionHtml:

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

People Experience Administrator (German-speaking) - People Operations

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom.

We’re looking for a People Experience Administrator

Keep the employee journey running smoothly for iwocans across the UK and Germany. You'll support payroll in both countries, run onboarding and offboarding, and be the first port of call for questions.

The team
The People Operations team's mission is to attract, develop and retain high performers who genuinely love being part of iwoca. The People Experience team handles the nuts and bolts of the entire employee journey, from onboarding and offboarding to background checks and visa paperwork. It looks after HR systems like BambooHR and Peakon, keeps policies up to date, and manages benefits and payroll. The team is the first point of contact for most People Operations questions.

The role

As our People Experience Administrator, you'll be the first point of contact for iwocans and the person who keeps the employee journey running smoothly, from someone's first day to their last.

Supporting payroll across our UK and German teams is a key part of the role, so you'll play a direct part in making sure every iwocan gets paid correctly and on time.

It's a broad, hands-on role at the heart of our People Operations team, with the flexibility to shape your days and hours around your life, so it suits anyone balancing work with other commitments. You'll own your work and be someone the team relies on.

In this role, you'll:

  • Support the payroll process across our UK and German entities, working with Finance and our People Partners so every iwocan gets paid correctly and on time.

  • Own the day-to-day running of our UK and German benefits, and be the person iwocans come to when they have a question about them.

  • Maintain our HR database (BambooHR) through careful data entry and regular audits, keeping people data accurate across both countries.

  • Coordinate onboarding for every new iwocan, from background checks to new-starter set-up, so their first days run seamlessly.

  • Run the offboarding process, booking and tracking exit interviews.

  • Answer iwocans' day-to-day questions, directly or through our ticketing system.

  • Work across People processes in both the UK and Germany.

The requirements

  • Ideally 1-3 years' experience in a People Operations or HR administration role.

  • Fluent in German and English, so you can confidently support our German team and the payroll and benefit administration.

  • Confident with HR systems (we use BambooHR and Ashby), accurate with data and reporting, and careful with confidential information.

  • Comfortable working independently and juggling competing priorities.

  • Comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to work faster and improve the quality of your work, with good judgement about when to use them.

  • Genuinely excited by the operational side of the People Ops: you love improving processes, driving change, and being at the centre of how things get done.

The salary
We expect to pay from £32,000 - £36,000 for this role in London but, we’re open-minded and want to find the right person for this role, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

  • Flexible working hours.

title: Physical Verification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

Salience Labs is building an industry-defining approach to optical circuit switching for AI infrastructure, engineered for real latency reduction and cost savings. We're moving towards real-world deployment, and joining at this stage means genuine ownership over that next chapter, working alongside a highly technical team on one of the most consequential problems in AI infrastructure today.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Physical Verification Engineer to drive DRC/LVS signoff for our integrated circuit and photonic integrated circuit (PIC) designs. You’ll work at the intersection of electronic and photonic design, running and debugging verification flows against foundry PDKs and helping keep our tapeouts clean.

What You’ll Do

  • Run and debug physical verification (DRC, LVS, extraction) on IC and photonic IC layouts

  • Debug LVS/DRC discrepancies, including port mismatches, hierarchy mismatches, and device recognition issues

  • Read, manipulate, and QA GDS/OASIS layout data

  • Maintain and extend verification runsets and rule decks

  • Build Python/Tcl/shell tooling to automate verification flows and triage error reports

  • Maintain verification libraries and runsets under version control, with controlled release processes

  • Handle third-party and foundry IP with care, following licensing terms

  • Work with design, layout, and CAD teams to close out verification issues ahead of tapeout

  • Document known issues, workarounds, and runset changes

What You Bring

Required

  • 3+ years of hands-on physical verification experience in IC design

  • Practical experience with Siemens Calibre and/or Synopsys ICV for DRC/LVS signoff

  • Experience with custom/analog layout tools such as Cadence Virtuoso or Synopsys CustomCompiler

  • Strong working knowledge of GDS/OASIS formats and LVS concepts

  • Proficiency with Linux and scripting in Python, Tcl, or shell

  • Experience managing rule decks, runsets, or libraries under version control (e.g., Git)

  • Ability to independently debug complex hierarchical netlist and layout issues

  • Strong written communication for documenting root causes and fixes

Nice to have

  • Photonic IC verification experience

  • Experience with Verilog/SystemVerilog netlists

  • Exposure to foundry PDK qualification

  • Experience building internal automation to scale verification

title: Principal, CEO Office
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The CEO Office

The CEO Office works with senior leaders across Checkout.com on high-priority strategic and operational problems. The team turns important questions into clear decisions, coordinated execution and measurable business outcomes.

The role

This is a manager-level individual-contributor role for a hands-on operator. You will own defined, high-priority, cross-functional initiatives end to end—from framing problems and aligning stakeholders to implementing solutions and delivering measurable outcomes.

Working closely with the Head of the CEO Office, you will combine structured problem-solving with hands-on execution. You will translate priorities into coordinated action, strengthen how teams operate and drive initiatives through to impact.

This is neither a traditional PMO nor a presentation-led strategy role, and it is not an executive-level position. Success requires sound judgement, analytical rigour, clear communication, operational follow-through and the ability to influence effectively without formal authority.

How You'll Make an Impact (Role overview)

  • Support the CEO and Head of the CEO Office on critical cross-functional initiatives by helping coordinate day-to-day delivery, stakeholder collaboration and progress towards measurable outcomes.

  • Help investigate complex, ambiguous problems by clarifying the problem, developing practical solutions and supporting the implementation of durable processes or systems.

  • Support departments in scaling by contributing to organisation design, objectives and KPI setting, and the development of robust operating processes.

  • Assist leadership in navigating ambiguity by surfacing insights, decisions and risks, coordinating follow-through and supporting alignment across teams, particularly where there is no natural owner.

  • Projects may include organisational model design, international expansion strategy, scaling new business lines, strategic planning and goal setting, go-to-market execution, regulatory, data and financial infrastructure initiatives, and supporting board and shareholder reporting.

What We're Looking For (Background and core competencies)

  • Relevant background and impact: Experience in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.Relevant backgrounds include consulting, high-growth technology, investing, investment banking, strategic finance or entrepreneurial operations. Payments or fintech exposure and international experience are advantages.

  • Problem-solving and analytical rigour: Use first-principles thinking, data and judgement to structure ambiguous problems, identify key measures and move between strategic questions and operational detail. Advanced SQL or hands-on data analysis is a plus.

  • Building and execution: Turn analysis into practical plans, KPIs, processes, tools or systems that create durable value. Experience building low-code/no-code or AI automations that others continue to use is a plus.

  • Ownership and impact: Personally own cross-functional work and deliver measurable outcomes.

  • Influence and collaboration: Build trust, navigate trade-offs and make progress across functions without formal authority, with a low-ego and collaborative approach.

  • Learning agility and entrepreneurial mindset: Learn quickly, respond well to feedback, adapt to changing priorities and show evidence of creating, launching or materially improving something from scratch. Founding or entrepreneurial experience is valued but not required.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Principal Engagement Manager, AI
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

The Role in a Nutshell

While our Sales Directors focus on the initial "Land"- introducing our agentic AI offering to our clients and securing the first use case - you are the architect of the "Expand."

Your mission is to take a client who has seen the initial spark of value and guide them toward full-scale AI transformation. You aren't just managing a relationship; you are building the business cases that prove why we should handle their most complex customer journeys, from home moves and complaints to high-volume storm responses.

Why This Role is Unique

You aren't starting from zero. You are taking over accounts that already love the product and have seen it work. Your job is to take that 20% success story and turn it into a 100% partnership. You are the bridge between a successful start and a transformative future.

🚀 What you’ll own:

1. Strategic Account Expansion

  • Partner with the Sales Director during the hand-off to deeply understand the client’s initial pain points and long-term vision.

  • Identify white space within the account - finding new conversation types and new channels where Agent Studio can drive ROI.

  • Move the needle from a "pilot" or "niche" implementation to a core, enterprise-wide solution.

2. Business Case & ROI Development

  • Act as a value consultant. Clients will want proof before they commit more budget; you will gather data from their initial deployment to build compelling, CFO-ready business cases.

  • Translate technical performance (e.g., containment rates, sentiment analysis) into business outcomes (e.g., cost savings, CX improvements, reduced churn).

3. Relationship & Strategy Mapping

  • Build deep, multi-threaded relationships across the client’s organisation - from the operational leads to the C-Suite.

  • Understand the client’s 12-to-24-month roadmap to ensure Agent Studio is positioned as the primary tool to solve their upcoming challenges.

4. Solution Advocacy

  • Conduct innovation workshops with clients to showcase how new Agent Studio features can solve specific business problems they haven't yet addressed.

  • Act as the internal voice of the customer, feeding back requirements to the Product team to ensure our roadmap aligns with enterprise growth.

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:

  • You have a background in account management, customer success, or strategic consulting where your success was measured by revenue growth.

  • You are comfortable diving into spreadsheets and analytics to find the proof that justifies a client’s further investment.

  • You can take a complex AI product and explain its value in terms of business outcomes rather than just features.

  • You have extensive experience working with autonomous AI products and understand the technical complexity behind the customer outcomes.

  • You can juggle deep diving into multiple customers accounts and strategies in parallel without becoming unorganised.

descriptionHtml:

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Speed is something we fight for every day at Fin, and we believe Berlin is built for people who share that instinct. We are drawn to Berlin by its rare blend of deep technical talent and rich creative culture – all within a vibrant, globally connected city that’s close to our R&D hubs in Dublin and London. It’s a place where the best of the best technical talent thrive, and where people from around the world are eager to relocate and build ambitious products.

Our ambition is to hire 100 people in Berlin over the year ahead across engineering, AI, data science, product, and design. We believe this is the most exciting time to join, be the founding R&D talent in the region and make a lasting impact as we build the world's number one customer agent!

What's the opportunity? 

Principal Engineers at Fin have the opportunity to lead the definition and execution of key strategic initiatives.You will work autonomously and be accountable for strategic execution in part of the engineering organization. You will build both back-end and front-end systems, and work closely with designers, product managers, researchers, and data analysts. You will coach and mentor other engineers and partner closely with the Group Engineering Managers on technical strategy and leadership.

Learn more about our engineering culture at intercom.engineering

What will I be doing? 

As an experienced engineer you will:

  • Have a mastery of domain knowledge and work as a leader within the R&D org to drive key strategic projects.
  • Provide assessments of project progress, risks and challenges to engineering leadership to help guide resource allocation and prioritisation.
  • Contribute to our technical architecture as we grow. We scale to service requests from all our customers’ customers. We’re growing and so are they.
  • Care about agility as much you care for scalability and availability. Continuous deployment keeps us focused on incremental releases. Even our biggest technical achievements roll out piece by piece, feature flagged out of sight.
  • Contribute to all phases of software development including ideation, prototyping, design and implementation. This role has a mix of both hands-on development as well as lead/architecture work.
  • Build using the best tools in the industry. We invest heavily in AI-powered developer tools that remove friction and help you focus on solving meaningful problems.
  • Play an active role in hiring, mentoring and career development of other engineers
  • Raise the bar for technical standards, performance, reliability, and operational excellence

What skills do I need? 

  • Ideally, you’ve built an exciting SaaS product in your previous roles and loved the satisfaction that comes with knowing that people around the world are using something you’ve created
  • Significant, demonstrated impact that your work has had on the product and/or the teams
  • Deep knowledge of a high-level programming language (for example, Ruby, Python, Perl etc.) but it doesn’t need to be a language that we use here! Great people are effective and learn what we use quickly (or introduce us to better ways of working)
  • You will have experience with Distributed systems
  • 2+ years of experience as the primary technical leader for a team
  • Experience collaborating directly with technical leaders, product teams and designers, and a proven track record of delivering value to customers or users. Engineers at Fin are pragmatists who work closely with others on cross-disciplinary teams and have a strong sense of product strategy.

#LI-Hybrid

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Principal Hardware Engineer I
descriptionHtml:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.
We are looking to add a Principal Hardware Engineer I to our team. If you are great at what you do, enjoy working in a startup environment, and are passionate about developing leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. At the Principal level, you will be tasked with full-stack hardware development for complex modules and hardware systems. You will have the opportunity to start at concept development and progress through detailed design, analysis, layout, build, test, and delivery, doing hands-on work at each phase. The Principal level also includes technical leadership opportunities, gaining responsibility for critical designs and teams of engineers developing new products and systems. At a small company and a startup, your work will make direct contributions to the success of the business. The work is challenging and impactful, requiring both breadth and depth of technical knowledge. Our products are made for high-reliability space and airborne applications, so designs require high levels of technical rigor while maintaining the agility of a startup environment. The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Own end-to-end design of complex electronics modules and systems, from concept and architecture through schematic, layout, test, and production. Products may include high-speed digital, power electronics, and/or RF.
  • Lead teams of hardware engineers to develop new products with multiple electronics modules.
  • Provide subject matter expertise in support of hardware development across the company.
  • Develop hardware architecture and write hardware requirements for systems of high complexity.
  • Perform detailed and complete schematic design for complex boards, ranging from key components to supporting passives.
  • Perform detailed PCB layout in Altium Designer for complex boards, often working with a PCB Drafter.
  • Complete analysis such as worst-case circuit analysis, signal integrity analysis, and power integrity analysis. Guide analysis methodology.
  • Develop bring-up plans and design verification plans for new hardware and complex systems.
  • Perform bring-up and key verification testing of modules and complex integrated systems, often working with a team to complete validation.
  • Release modules and assemblies to production, working with the Manufacturing and Test Engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior and senior engineers to build technical understanding and professional development.
  • Use strong working knowledge of adjacent fields, such as software and mechanical, to streamline development of complex hardware systems.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor of Science (BS) degree or higher in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
  • Minimum of 9 years of industry or university research experience in board-level electronics design, analysis, and test.
  • Direct experience designing high-reliability electronics and small systems for space or defense applications, including part derating, worst-case analysis, and thermal constraints.
  • Experience owning the design phase of complex board-level electronics and small hardware systems, including architecture design, trade studies, key part selection, and detailed design.
  • Multiple experiences delivering hardware products through production and deployment.
  • Expertise in PCB layout and manufacturing, including high-density interconnect (HDI) stackup design, IPC standards, and industry best practices.
  • Expertise derisking designs with board-level signal integrity and/or power integrity simulation tools such as Ansys SIwave, ADS SIPro, or Mentor Hyperlynx.
  • Strong understanding of adjacent fields, such as software and mechanical, that contributes to judicious design of hardware system architectures.
  • Expert-level proficiency in electronics design tools such as Altium.
  • Extensive lab experience for bring-up and verification of new hardware, based on in-depth understanding of specialized lab equipment.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills.

    • PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Experience leading teams of hardware engineers to develop multi-module assemblies, including hardware architecture, requirements, and interconnects.
  • Design for space radiation environments.

title: Principal Payments Architect
descriptionHtml:
Principal Payments Architect

Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Lead innovative payments transformation across financial services.

About Capco

Capco is a global leader in technology and business consulting, dedicated to driving digital innovation and transformation in financial services. We’ve partnered with over 100 clients worldwide - from pioneering FinTech's to established global institutions - helping them adapt, compete, and scale in a rapidly evolving industry. With more than 30 offices globally, we combine deep expertise in banking, payments, capital markets, insurance, wealth and asset management, and energy with an agile, inclusive, and entrepreneurial culture.

Role Overview

You will play a central role in shaping and delivering some of our clients' most critical payments transformation programmes, applying your expertise in enterprise and solution architecture alongside your deep knowledge of payments. You will help modernise core payment platforms and enable new digital payment capabilities while guiding clients through complex regulatory, operational, and technology change. Your work will influence how banks and financial institutions build, operate, and innovate across domestic and international payment ecosystems.

Working closely with engineers, you will design scalable and resilient payment solutions while helping senior stakeholders shape long-term payments strategies and investment decisions. You will also lead high-performing teams, mentor junior technologists, and contribute to the growth of our Technology & Engineering Practice through thought leadership, community engagement, and supporting new client opportunities. You'll be encouraged to adopt approved AI-enabled tools and automation to enhance architecture design, accelerate analysis, improve documentation quality and support more informed decision-making, while applying appropriate human judgement, governance and responsible AI principles.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the architecture and modernisation of complex payment platforms across domestic, international, real-time, on-us and card payment ecosystems, delivering scalable, resilient and secure solutions.
  • Define payments technology strategies, target architectures and transformation roadmaps while working closely with business, engineering and delivery teams to guide implementation and investment decisions.
  • Apply modern architecture practices including microservices, event-driven design, cloud-native technologies and DevOps, leveraging approved AI-enabled workflows where appropriate to improve productivity, design quality and delivery outcomes while maintaining human oversight.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, mentor technical teams and contribute to Capco's Technology & Engineering community through thought leadership and business development.
  • Ensure architectural decisions align with regulatory requirements, security, resilience, governance and responsible AI principles where AI-enabled capabilities form part of the solution landscape.

Required Experience

  • Proven experience designing or modernising payment platforms across Faster Payments, Bacs, CHAPS, SWIFT, SEPA, Open Banking, ISO 20022 and related payment ecosystems.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise and solution architecture, distributed systems, cloud technologies, modern engineering practices and recognised frameworks such as TOGAF and Domain-Driven Design.
  • Strong consulting, stakeholder management and leadership experience with the ability to influence senior technology and business decision-makers.
  • Experience delivering large-scale payments transformation programmes using agile delivery methodologies and modern engineering practices.
  • A curiosity for AI-enabled ways of working and an understanding of how approved AI tools, automation and responsible AI governance can improve architectural delivery while maintaining appropriate review, auditability and human judgement.

Bonus Points For

  • Senior consulting experience delivering large-scale payments transformation programmes.
  • Experience leading pre-sales engagements, proposals and commercial estimates.
  • Awareness of emerging technologies including digital wallets, tokenisation, embedded finance and AI (including Generative AI and Agentic AI), AI-driven fraud detection and intelligent automation within payment ecosystems.
  • Knowledge of financial crime, AML controls, payment fraud prevention and security architecture.
  • Exposure to international payment ecosystems and relevant architecture or cloud certifications such as TOGAF or AWS.

Why Join Capco?

At Capco, you’ll be part of a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture working with Tier 1 financial services enterprises on impactful and enriching projects. We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package to support your growth as both a technologist and a consultant.

Our benefits include:

  • Core benefits: discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health and dental insurance, life insurance, and critical illness cover.
  • Mental health: access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, and in-house first aiders.
  • Family-friendly: maternity, adoption, shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause, and bereavement.

  • Holiday flexibility: 5 weeks of annual leave with the option to buy or sell days.
  • Continuous learning: minimum 40 hours of annual training, including workshops, certifications, e-learning, and ongoing business coaching.
  • Extra perks: Gympass (Wellhub), travel insurance, Tastecard, season ticket loans, and Cycle to Work scheme.

Inclusion at Capco

Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration—a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.
