title: Principal Software Architect
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Role Overview

Role:

We are looking for a Principal Software Architect to join our Compute Software organisation at IonQ. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the architecture of the software that enables a quantum computer, from low level hardware control up to developer programming interfaces, contributing to the team’s mission of delivering a complete software product for a quantum computer.

You’ll play an important part in shaping the software and tools that support our work in building the world’s most advanced quantum systems. Our architecture now needs to evolve to support the next generation of our systems, and you will lead that work.

Responsibilities:

In this position, you will develop the software architecture covering real-time and non-real-time hardware management, low level orchestration and user interfaces for the current product and the future roadmap of products. You will also work with the technical leads from the development teams to support the effective development and delivery of a scalable solution that supports internal experimental scientists and external customers.

You’ll have the opportunity to develop an evolving software architecture to support a family of products, contributing directly to the success of the system software team in delivering a world leading quantum computer. You will coach and train technical leads in good architectural principles, and work closely with the infrastructure, firmware and compiler teams across the UK and the US.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Development and documentation of the system software architecture
  • Managing the evolving architecture across a family of products
  • Coordination with other architects across the whole of software and the wider system
  • Research and analysis to support future requirements elucidation
  • Coordination with technical leads to ensure that the design and implementation meets the intention of the architecture

Requirements:

To be successful, you will need prior experience of developing a large and scalable software architecture covering real-time requirements and distributed processing. We’re looking for someone who can think strategically at the architecture level, solve challenging technical issues, track the latest industry good practice and tools, and communicate those ideas and technologies to the wider software team.

You will work at the level of the whole system, describing each component, what it does and its constraints, and then handing the detailed design and implementation to the development teams rather than designing through code. A grounding in formal architecture methods and principles such as cohesion, coupling and encapsulation will help you succeed, as will experience of evolving an architecture that has to grow with the product. Our immediate focus is system software and lower level control; experience further up the software stack is an advantage.

You’d be a great fit with:

  • More than 10 years of software development experience, with more than 5 as a software architect
  • A clear understanding of software architecture principles
  • A background in real-time software development
  • Experience working on software projects written in Rust

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. 

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.

Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

About the Role

title: Product Engineer (Frontend) (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Hi, we are Particula, the prime rating provider for digital assets! Our mission? To make the market for digital assets more accessible, secure and transparent for institutional investors. We support issuers, trading facilities, banks and asset managers to create trust, minimize risks and allocate capital effectively. Join our team and shape the future of the financial world with us!

👋 About the Role

We are looking for a product engineer to own our user-facing applications end to end. We operate without dedicated designers or product managers. You will work directly with internal and external stakeholders as well as backend & AI engineers to turn high-level goals into shipped, well-measured features.

This is not a ticket-closing role. You spot user friction, propose a fix, build it, measure the outcome and iterate quickly.

You will also help shape how we build software with AI agents, translating requirements into working code and establishing the guardrails, automated tests and review habits that keep quality high when code is AI-assisted. You remain responsible for every line you ship, whether you or an agent wrote it.

What you will do

  • Ship features end to end: Take concepts from conversation to production, covering UX design, frontend implementation, API integration and deployment.

  • Act as a product builder: Spot friction points yourself, pitch improvements and make sure every feature solves a real user need.

  • Make decisions with data: Implement analytics, track feature adoption and iterate on the numbers.

  • Work directly with users: Talk to internal teams as well as external stakeholders, and turn unstructured feedback into clear technical plans.

  • Own AI-assisted delivery: Use and orchestrate coding agents daily. Write the specs and plans, choose the patterns and approach, and review generated code before you push it.

  • Review your peers' work: Be one of the main reviewers of frontend pull requests, and keep a balance between delivering working functionality and keeping the review workload manageable.

  • Own the design system: Maintain and extend the shared component library and UI guidelines so the product stays consistent. An external design agency will help set the visual language.

  • Own quality and testing: Propose and set up the QA and testing strategy for your area, using automated E2E and component tests to ensure reliability, performance and security.

How we work

These are fixed parts of the job, and we ask candidates to read them as requirements.

  • Delivery process: Work follows a defined delivery process. Inside it, you own the open decisions in your area, including solution design and implementation approach.

  • Decision rights: Architecture, API contracts and design system direction are set centrally because they are shared across teams. You change them through a written proposal. Once a decision is made, everyone follows it. Backend engineers own the security and performance of services.

  • Team rhythm: A daily stand-up and a biweekly Friday demo. Attendance is expected.

  • Speed: We ship small and often and iterate on the interface quickly. Quality comes from tests and reviews, not from polishing before release.

Requirements

Must have

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering, with evidence of owned product work: features you took from problem to production and measured. Experience in a fast-paced startup is a plus.

  • Strong frontend expertise: Deep proficiency in TypeScript and a modern component framework (Vue 3 / Nuxt preferred).

  • Product and UX sense: A track record of designing clean, functional interfaces and delivering features without dedicated PMs or designers.

  • Data-driven mindset: Hands-on experience setting up and using analytics tools (PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar).

  • Daily use of AI coding agents: Active experience with agentic tools (Claude Code, Copilot), a clear method for guiding them, and a clear method for checking what they produce.

  • Testing and review habits: Experience with automated E2E and UI testing (Playwright, Cypress, Vitest), the ability to define a testing strategy, and the discipline to review code, yours and others', before it merges.

  • Clear communication: Fluent written and spoken English, comfortable presenting ideas to non-technical stakeholders and working through written proposals.

Strong plus

  • Domain background: Prior experience in fintech, Web3 / digital assets or data-driven products.

  • Design systems: Experience building or maintaining a component library.

  • Backend / BFF capability: Experience building APIs and BFF layers, ideally with PHP / Laravel.

  • Cloud and DevOps: Practical experience with AWS environments, deployments and observability.

  • AI tooling workflow: Experience creating agent skills or CI guardrails for AI-assisted development.

Our stack

TypeScript · Vue 3 · Nuxt · PHP · Laravel · AWS · AI-assisted development workflows

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours in a company that relies on remote work

  • Exciting product in a very dynamic market environment as well as founding-level ownership of a key growth function.

  • Values-based start-up culture

  • Flat hierarchy

Let’s build the next layer of trust for digital assets - together!

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

 

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

     

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

     

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

     

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

title: Product Integration Engineer, Defence
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Product Integration Engineer to develop and prove out our products with military customers, starting with the Field Operator HUD (FOH): a head-mounted, always-on visual intelligence system built from Distance hardware, a HUD operating system and AI-assisted data processing that pulls sensor, feeds and command-and-control into the operator's field of view. Your job is to make it work on a specific customer's platform, in the field, not just on a bench, as part of our core R&D team. If you're a hands-on generalist who knows VR or XR and would rather be where the tech meets the user than stuck at a desk, this one's for you.

WHY DISTANCE?

At Distance Technologies, the problem we're solving is simple to state and hard to solve: the amount of data in the world is endless, but human capacity is not. We are building a fundamentally new perception layer between humans and machines, transforming transparent surfaces into interfaces unlike the world has ever seen. Think of the windscreen of a car, the visor of a helmet, or a sight device, each becoming a new front-end for AI. The way we turn bits and atoms into expanded human perception is protected by over 50 granted international patent families. We build it for two demanding worlds: defence and automotive. And we build it from a single foundation fusing software, hardware and computational optics.

There are 60 of us today, with decades-long experience building world's best products, optics, and open-source operating systems. We partner and build with globally leading companies like KIA, Supacat, and Galvion, and we were Google Ventures' first investment in Finland.

THE ROLE

The FOH is already in field trials with military users. Your first project is getting it working with British Army equipment and defence primes, building the integration around what the customer actually needs. As our product line grows you'll take on a widening set of customer integrations across our defence work, each one a different platform, stack and set of interfaces.

Your core responsibilities include:

  • Owning customer integrations end to end. Make the FOH work inside a customer's platform: adapt the software, wire it into their sensors, displays, video and connectivity, and get it demo- and trial-ready. Prototype fast in dedicated environments to prove value with a client before it hits the shared codebase.

  • Being Distance in the field. Join demos, trials and exercises with defence clients, support on-site deployments when needed, and bring back what you see and hear on real kit.

  • Bridging the field and the core. Turn what customers need into concrete integration work with the R&D and commercial teams, spot what should become shared product capability, and feed it into the roadmap and, eventually, the shared codebase.

You won't be a satellite. You'll join the software standups and reviews and be a real part of R&D.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Your work ships and gets used. What you integrate goes into real kit already in trials with military users, and what you learn from demos, trials and exercises with them feeds straight back into the product.

  • You own the whole thread. From first prototype to working integration in the field, it's yours, not passed between five teams.

  • New display tech. Glasses-free computational optics and a see-through HUD, the kind of problem you won't find at most XR jobs.

  • A small team backed to move fast. Around 60 of us, Google Ventures' first investment in Finland, and flat enough that your calls count.

OUR EXPECTATIONS

What we're looking for:

  • A builder, not a passenger: a hands-on self-starter who takes ownership, works things out when docs are missing, and would rather be with a customer or in the field than at a desk.

  • At least a couple of years of software engineering experience with VR or XR, plus generalist instincts.

  • Comfort across a mixed software stack. You've worked with some of C++, Unity and embedded, and you pick up the rest quickly.

  • Some exposure to electrical integration or software-to-hardware interfaces. We're not expecting deep hardware experience on top of strong software.

  • You're at home in prototype and integration work: incomplete docs, customer-specific stacks, messy interfaces.

  • Good with clients, and happy to be the person representing Distance at a demo or trial.

  • Willing to travel within the UK when needed, and to Finland now and then.

It's a bonus, though not required, if you've worked with HMDs, wearable displays or spatial computing, know C++ for integration and application development, can stand up a UI or application stack for quick situational-awareness or demo prototypes, are comfortable with embedded or Linux at integration level, or have seen sensor, display and video interfaces at system level.

You'll be based within commuting distance of the Bath office and in the office two to three days a week. Our working language is English.

DID WE GET YOU INTERESTED?

descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Buying and selling a car should feel like one seamless motion for a dealer, not two separate systems. Right now it's the opposite: a dealer buys through us, then has to manage collection, payment and resale largely on their own, stitching together workflows across multiple platforms and channels, much of it manual.

For a dealer, speed is money. Every extra day a car sits before it's collected, priced, and paid for is a day of depreciation, tied-up capital, and a missed chance to buy the next one.If we can get a dealer from 'I've bought this car' to 'it's ready and paid for' faster through transport and collections, quicker final pricing, and Wallet, we make them more profitable. A dealer who's more profitable because of Carwow has little reason to go elsewhere: they'll lean on us more, and churn less.

This role owns that last-mile agenda: getting cars collected quickly, resolving final price without friction, and making Wallet work the way dealers expect it to. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Dealers are already asking for smarter scheduling, less manual chasing, and tools that reduce the overhead of running a business. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. If you want to own an operational product area end to end, work with some of the most sophisticated buyers in UK retail, and build things that have a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it.

Small changes at this scale can change how customers perceive us, how often they order, and the economics of the entire marketplace. We bring together consumer psychology, experimentation, data science, economics, and product craft to answer one deceptively difficult question: How do we make every order feel like great value while driving sustainable growth?

  • Define the metrics and decision frameworks used to evaluate customer value, growth, and marketplace economics.
  • Communicate strategy, results, and tradeoffs to senior leaders across DoorDash.

You might be a great fit if you:

  • Are comfortable working closely with Data Science and ML Engineering on algorithmic or optimization problems.
  • Can turn ambiguous commercial questions into clear and executable product hypotheses and roadmaps.

Why Join Us?

Our Global Structure

title: Product Manager Supply Chain & Transport - F/H
descriptionHtml:
Le Product Management, c’est notre ADN.

Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes sur les produits digitaux qui tiennent leur chaîne d’approvisionnement debout. Référencement transporteurs, flux maritimes, routiers et ferroviaires, données critiques, maîtrise des coûts réels. Des sujets denses, peu spectaculaires vus de loin, et parmi les plus structurants qu’un Product Manager puisse porter.

Ce que tu fais concrètement :

  • Tu pars du terrain avant de concevoir. Cartographie des flux de données, entretiens avec les coordinateurs transport parfois répartis sur plusieurs pays, identification des vrais irritants. Tu traduis ce qui remonte en parcours cibles, pas en liste de demandes.

  • Tu portes une vision à deux ou trois ans. Tu construis la roadmap d’une plateforme de référencement et de pilotage : automatisation des appels d’offres, gestion des quotas, prévision des délais d’acheminement. Tu décides ce qu’on construit, et ce qu’on laisse tomber.

  • Tu prends la donnée en main. Modèles interconnectés, qualité de la donnée, écarts entre coûts réels transporteurs et refacturation interne. Tu interprètes toi-même les indicateurs, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher.

  • Tu pilotes le cadrage et la delivery. Briefs produit et scénarios d’usage pour ta squad technique, animation des rituels, validation de la conformité à chaque jalon, mise en service et formation des utilisateurs. Un outil historique ne disparaît que si le nouveau tient vraiment la route.

  • Tu mesures l’impact. Réduction de la charge manuelle des équipes transport, fiabilisation des délais, tenue des coûts. Tu définis les KPI et les OKR qui comptent et tu les défends.

  • Tu participes à la vie d’Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d’expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

  • Tu as déjà vu ce que l’automatisation des flux ou un algorithme de prévision change sur un produit supply chain ? On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l’IA partout.


👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

  • Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l’IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien, on la fait avec les meilleurs clients.

  • Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Si tu es PO aujourd'hui et que tu veux devenir PM, on te donne les moyens : mentorship, cas complexes, retours structurés. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

  • Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs qui se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.)

  • Des valeurs fortes : depuis 8 ans Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l’ambition, l’expertise et l’apprentissage.

Le package : 42.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu’à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.



👉 Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu justifies d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager sur des produits digitaux avec un passage par la supply chain, la logistique, le transport international ou les référentiels de données critiques.

  • Tu es à l’aise dans des architectures fonctionnelles denses et des modèles de données interconnectés, avec une exigence forte sur la qualité de la donnée. Le pilotage de roadmap et de backlog fait partie de ton quotidien, et ton orientation valeur est ton moteur.

  • Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une autonomie opérationnelle réelle, une communication capable d’embarquer des interlocuteurs internationaux et dispersés, et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve.

  • Anglais professionnel attendu.

  • Environnement technique que tu croiseras : Jira, Confluence, Figma, data lakes, API REST, écosystèmes ERP et TMS.

Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ?

Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l’adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle

Etape 2 : Validation de tes hard skills avec cas pratique avec un manager

Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP

Etape 4 : Echange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d’embauche

Quelle que soit l’issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum !

Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog.

title: Product Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
About DeepJudge:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

 

About the role:
DeepJudge is a fast-growing venture-backed startup at the forefront of applying Artificial Intelligence in the legal domain. Founded by ex-Googlers and ETH PhDs, our mission is to help legal teams harness their collective knowledge so they can focus on the strategic aspects of their work. DeepJudge’s state-of-the-art knowledge retrieval system directs legal professionals to the internal insights that matter most, providing a strong foundation for AI-powered workflows. We’re headquartered in Zurich, with a team in the United States and Canada, and cater to clients all around the world.

We are looking for a thoughtful and strategic Product Marketing Manager to help shape how we communicate the value of AI-powered legal solutions to the market. As a subject matter expert on our products, you will craft compelling messaging, develop go-to-market strategies, and collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure our positioning resonates with customers.

This is an exciting opportunity for a marketer who is passionate about making complex technology approachable and valuable for legal professionals. You are a great fit for this role if you have a proven track record in B2B SaaS product marketing, a talent for crafting compelling messaging, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally to drive product launches, customer adoption, and market success.

What you’ll be doing

  • Craft compelling messaging and positioning that articulates the value of DeepJudge to our core audiences, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.

  • Lead the launch of new features and products, collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful adoption and engagement.

  • Act as a proactive advocate for DeepJudge’s product by sharing product features, use cases, and insights across the company.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders in Product, Marketing, and Commercial teams to create effective enablement materials and ensure alignment with strategic goals.

  • Gather and synthesize customer and market insights to provide actionable feedback that informs product development and enhances product-market fit.

  • Translate data and findings into actionable insights that drive decisions and fuel impactful product and feature updates.

  • Collaborate with the Marketing team to support marketing campaigns for new product features and updates.

  • Create, monitor, and analyze product marketing performance metrics to guide strategic actions.

  • Use tools such as Hubspot, Figma, Webflow, Linear, and G Suite to manage projects, analyze data, and create content, with a focus on data-driven decision-making

What we are looking for

  • 3+ years of product marketing experience, in the B2B SaaS or technology space (legal tech strongly preferred but will consider experience within complex data/AI enterprise software space)

  • Overall 5-8 years of experience as product marketer, marketing solutions, product management or product strategy

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. Writing experience is important (share your portfolio or submit a writing sample with your application)

  • Comfortable with user data and have experience in industry and customer research

  • Translate data into actionable insights, ensuring decisions are grounded in evidence, not assumptions

  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment, managing multiple priorities with attention to detail

  • Analytical data-driven mindset, but orientation towards getting things done quickly and efficiently

  • Ideally, experience collaborating with Marketing on account-based and content strategies

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field

What you can look forward to

  • You will be able to take on full ownership of your projects and tasks from day 1

  • You will have a stake in shaping the future of a high-impact, high-growth deep-tech startup

  • Competitive compensation, flexible working arrangements

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

title: Product Owner / Business Analyst / AMOA (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
E-Finances développe et commercialise des logiciels de gestion financière utilisées par des entreprises en France et à l'international depuis 25 ans. Nos outils couvrent la gestion de trésorerie, les rapprochements bancaires et comptables, ainsi que la validation et la transmission sécurisée des paiements vers les banques (EBICS, SWIFT).

Nous cherchons un(e) Product Owner, Business Analyst ou AMOA pour prendre en charge le backlog fonctionnel de nos produits. Vous travaillerez avec une équipe R&D de quatre développeurs et vous êtes rattaché(e) au responsable R&D.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Organiser le backlog produit, proposer les priorités et le tenir à jour.
  • Qualifier les demandes et les anomalies remontées par le support et les clients, et proposer la suite à donner.
  • Rédiger des tickets clairs et complets (user stories, critères d'acceptation), prêts à être développés.
  • Écrire et tenir à jour les spécifications fonctionnelles et les règles métier.
  • Suivre l'évolution des normes bancaires et leur impact sur nos produits.
  • Animer les rituels agiles : daily, refinement, sprint planning, revue de sprint et rétrospective.
  • Préparer et réaliser les recettes fonctionnelles (tests manuels), puis coordonner les mises en production avec la R&D.
  • Documenter le paramétrage, en lien avec le support, et contribuer aux notes de version.
  • Contribuer à la feuille de route fonctionnelle des produits, avec le responsable R&D.

Vous êtes seul(e) sur ce rôle, mais pas isolé(e) : vous démarrez sur le produit principal, avec l'appui du responsable R&D et de collègues qui connaissent très bien les produits et les clients, puis vous élargissez progressivement votre périmètre.

Votre profil

Idéalement vous disposez d’expérience en gestion financière, incluant par exemple la gestion de trésorerie ou la comptabilité.

Vous avez aussi :

  • un bon esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, à l'écrit comme à l'oral
  • l'envie de questionner les demandes et de proposer des solutions utiles aux clients
  • de la rigueur : vous vérifiez avant d'affirmer
  • de la curiosité pour le fonctionnement d'un logiciel : droits, données, paramétrage
  • une expérience en recette ou en test
  • la pratique de Jira et Confluence
  • l'habitude d'utiliser des outils d'IA au quotidien
  • l'anglais écrit, nos produits et leur documentation existent aussi en anglais

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Des produits concrets, utilisés chaque jour par nos clients, dans un domaine exigeant (réglementation, sécurité).
  • Un rôle où vous avez la main sur l'organisation du backlog et de la documentation produit.
  • Une autonomie croissante dans les décisions fonctionnelles et la priorisation, à mesure que vous maîtrisez les produits.
  • Une équipe à taille humaine, avec des échanges directs avec la direction, la R&D, le consulting et le support.

Le processus de recrutement

Quatre étapes :

  1. Un premier échange d'environ 30 minutes avec le responsable R&D & IT et le responsable consulting.
  1. Une étude de cas sur place, d'environ 1h30.
  1. Une rencontre avec l'équipe.
  1. Un dernier échange avec la direction.

Infos pratiques

  • Contrat : CDI, statut cadre.
  • Lieu : Carquefou, en périphérie de Nantes. Une proximité géographique (moins d'une heure de trajet) est nécessaire pour venir régulièrement sur site.

descriptionHtml:

Vos missions

Ta mission est de maximiser la valeur du produit livré tout en assurant l'excellence opérationnelle chère à notre culture.

1. Stratégie et Vision Produit

  • Définir et porter la vision du produit à court et moyen terme en accord avec les objectifs de croissance de l'entreprise.
  • Identifier et analyser les besoins des utilisateurs internes pour proposer des fonctionnalités pertinentes.

2. Gestion du Product Backlog

  • Rédiger les User Stories détaillées, claires et sans ambiguïté pour l'équipe technique, facilement interprétable par l’IA.

  • Recueillir régulièrement les feedbacks des parties prenantes pour adapter le produit de manière itérative.

Vos compétences

Ce que nous te demandons :

Expérience :

  • Minimum 2 ans d’expérience comme Product Owner ou Product Manager dans une startup ou une entreprise technologique en forte croissance.
  • Expérience concrète dans un environnement Agile (Scrum ou Kanban).

Compétences techniques :

  • Excellentes capacités de priorisation.
  • Bonne compréhension des problématiques techniques pour dialoguer efficacement avec les développeurs.
  • Une connaissance SQL est un vrai plus.

Professional SAP Basis Administrator (m/w/d) in Frauenfeld, Zürich, Bern oder Basel

  • überwachst du gemeinsam mit deinem Team die SAP Systeme und sorgst für Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität

Das gelingt dir durch…

  • mindestens vier Jahre Berufserfahrung im SAP Basis Umfeld, mit Fokus auf SAP Betrieb

  • fundierte Kenntnisse von mindestens zwei relevanten SAP Datenbankplattformen

  • Eigenverantwortung und Begeisterung für herausfordernde Tätigkeiten

  • eine strukturierte und zielführende Arbeitsweise, sowie Freude an der Arbeit im Team

  • Flexibilität sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

Kostenloser Kaffee und Firmenparkplätze - kennst du vermutlich schon, oder?

Wir möchten dir da schon etwas mehr bieten:

Flexibles Jahresarbeitszeitmodell: Bye, 9-to-5! Deine Arbeitszeit kannst du dir bei uns frei einteilen.

Weiterbildung: Bleibe immer up to date – mit bis zu zwei Wochen bezahlter Weiterbildung kein Problem

Zukunftsorientierung: Als globale Tech-Company leben wir am Puls der Zeit und blicken stets in die Zukunft.

Tools: Digitale Werkzeuge – die Essentials deiner Karriere. Bei uns kannst du Laptop und Smartphone aber auch privat nutzen.

Teamspirit: Teambuildings oder Grillabende – wir finden immer einen Grund zusammenzukommen.

Come as you are!: Bei uns geht es um das, was du draufhast – nicht um das, was du anhast. Lieber Casual, Business oder etwas dazwischen - come as you are!

Mehr Ferientage: Die gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen Ferientage sind dir nicht genug? Uns auch nicht, denn mit leeren Batterien arbeitet es sich nicht sehr gut!

Workation & Entsendungen: Eigentlich am Schreibtisch aber mental schon wieder an deinem Lieblingsurlaubsort? Durch Workations und Entsendungen hat das Träumen ein Ende.

Work-Life-Balance: Schon viel davon gehört aber nie erlebt? Bei uns bestimmst du deine Balance.

Wellbeing: Es ist völlig okay, wenn nicht immer alles okay ist. Ob Stress, schlechter Schlaf oder schwierige Entscheidungen – unsere externe Online-Plattform bietet dir kostenlose, vertrauliche und anonyme Unterstützung durch erfahrene Expertinnen und Experten.

Was macht es besonders, für uns zu arbeiten?

Bei uns gleicht kein Tag dem anderen – Langeweile gibt es nicht.

Du und deine Kolleg*innen werdet mit Blick auf eure Stärken individuell gefördert. Wir legen Wert auf Weiterbildungen und fördern den teamübergreifenden Wissenstransfer durch unsere Expertenteams. Zudem sind nahbare Führungskräfte und gezieltes Performance Management wichtige Bestandteile unserer Kultur.

Teamwork makes the dream work – ist ja klar, oder?

Individualität macht uns aus: Teamwork ist uns wichtig, trotzdem verschwindet hier niemand in der Masse.

Arbeiten mit Wohlfühl-Faktor

Den itesys-Spirit haben wir ja schon erwähnt. Teamausflüge, gemeinsame Grillabende oder Office Brunch – wir finden immer einen Anlass zusammenzukommen. Bei uns muss niemand zum Lachen in den Keller gehen: in den Pausen herrscht eine lockere ausgelassene Atmosphäre bei dem alle willkommen sind. Beim Arbeiten kannst du jederzeit auf die Hilfsbereitschaft deiner Kolleg*innen zählen und musst dich nicht davor scheuen, Fragen zu stellen.

Wir freuen uns darauf dich kennenzulernen!

title: Program Director - Hardware Systems (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

YOUR MISSION

As a Program Manager at STARK, you will lead one of our core hardware programs taking it from early R&D all the way to production readiness. You’ll be responsible for translating ambitious technical concepts into operational products and building the team that makes it happen.

You’ll work hand-in-hand with a dedicated Chief Engineer, combining program leadership with technical direction. Together, you’ll shape the vision, align priorities, and drive execution across engineering, production, and business functions.

A key part of your mission will be to build and scale a world-class engineering team, recruiting top talent, defining structure, and fostering a high-performance culture that moves fast, collaborates openly, and delivers. You’ll also coordinate with shared engineering functions (simulation, testing, systems, etc.) to allocate resources effectively and ensure critical work gets the attention it needs.

This role is about ownership and leadership: Building both a product and the organization that delivers it.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • End-to-End Program Leadership: Own the delivery of a major hardware program from R&D, to go-to-market verification to production readiness.
  • Team Building: Build, structure, and grow a high-performing multidisciplinary team. Recruit top engineering talent and create an environment where they can deliver their best work.
  • Partnership with Chief Engineer: Co-lead the program, pairing strong technical direction with decisive program leadership.
  • Strategic Planning: Translate strategic goals into clear milestones, deliverables, and resource plans.
  • Execution & Prioritization: Drive focus on what matters most. Keep teams aligned, proactive, and moving fast.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Connect the dots across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and business functions to maintain alignment and momentum.
  • Program–Portfolio Alignment: Work closely with the VP Programs to ensure key programs get the focus and resources needed to deliver cutting-edge technology to customers at record speed.
  • Leadership & Culture: Set high standards, communicate clearly, and keep teams motivated and accountable even in demanding phases.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Deliver concise, transparent updates on progress, risks, and key decisions to leadership.
  • Process & Structure: Implement pragmatic governance and scalable processes that enable speed without bureaucracy.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Experience: 4–10 years in program or project management, ideally in hardware, aerospace, robotics, or defense. Proven experience leading complex technical programs and growing teams.
  • Background: Technical or technically literate background: e.g. engineering, industrial engineering, or technical management. You don’t need to design systems yourself, but you must understand how engineers think and work.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams. You attract talent, set structure, and keep people aligned through clarity and purpose.
  • Mindset: Mission-driven, decisive, and pragmatic. You thrive in ambiguity and bring structure to complexity. You seek feedback, learn fast, and raise your own bar continuously.
  • Communication: Clear, direct communicator with strong written and verbal skills in English and German.
  • Execution: Strong bias for action: >ou get things done, stay close to the details, and drive accountability.
  • Tools: Comfortable with modern program tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence, Excel, and PMO systems).

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

DATA PRIVACY STATEMENT

This data privacy statement, which refers exclusively to data collected as part of the online application process, is to inform you about how your personal data that is collected as part of the online application process is handled at our end.

Rights of data subjects

If we as the controller process personal data, you as the data subject have certain rights under Chapter III of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), depending on the legal basis and the purpose of the processing, in particular the right of access (article 15 of the GDPR) and the rights to rectification (article 16 of the GDPR), erasure (article 17 of the GDPR), restriction of processing (article 18 of the GDPR), and data portability (article 20 of the GDPR), as well as the right to object (article 21 of the GDPR). If the personal data is processed with your consent, you have the right to withdraw this consent under article 7 III of the GDPR.

To assert your rights as a data subject in relation to the data processed during this online application process, please refer to our Data Protection Officer (see item 2).

Concluding provisions

title: Programme/Delivery Manager
descriptionHtml:
Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 7 countries, and growing.

About usDepotnet is a provider of work management software for the utilities, and infrastructure space. We are a team of 50+ people based in Henley-in-Arden, Warwickshire.

Our team is made up of people with software & technology backgrounds, and others with deep expertise in the end-markets we serve. We all share a common goal, which is to be the number one SaaS solution in the utilities and infrastructure space.

We are a passionate team who genuinely enjoy working together, and it shows in how we operate. We set a high bar because we're proud of what we do, and we know how important it is to our customers and the critical work which they deliver, building and maintaining the UK's infrastructure.

Depotnet joined Everfield in 2023

About the Role

The Program / Delivery Manager owns the sprint cycle end to end for Depotnet - taking signed-off change requests and roadmap items and turning them into a sprint plan the development team can deliver against, on time and to the expected quality.

What you will do:

  • Own the sprint cycle end to end, from planning through to release

  • Take signed-off change requests (CRs) and roadmap items prioritised by our Product and Client teams and turn them into an actionable sprint plan

  • Run sprint planning, allocating work across developers and contractors against known capacity

  • Protect the sprint from mid-flight scope changes, working alongside the Tech Director and Heads of Tech to keep delivery on track

  • Plan QA windows and UAT alongside the delivery schedule

  • Own the release schedule and resource availability planning

We Are Looking For:

  • Strong capacity planning skills - able to allocate work across developers and contractors against known constraints

  • Comfortable saying no politely and protecting the team from mid-flight scope creep

  • Enough technical literacy to challenge an estimate and hold your own in a conversation with developers

  • Fluency with Azure DevOps

  • A dynamic, energetic approach - genuinely up for a challenge, with the resilience to manage a huge range of competing priorities

  • Confidence holding your own with senior stakeholders, balanced with the rapport-building of a natural team player

Interview Process:

Here's what to expect and who you'll meet during the recruitment process:

  • First interview with Talent Acquisition Manager Holly (0.5h)

  • Second interview with Operations Director Michelle Morgan (45mins)

  • Final interview with Technical Director Ben Squibb (1h)

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision is made based on skills, qualifications and experiences.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Project Controller (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Project Controller (m/w/d)

Einsatzort: Linden (Hessen) oder Berlin

Arbeitszeit: 40 hours/week

Bitte beachten Sie: Diese Rolle ist ausschließlich vor Ort in Berlin auszuüben

Über uns

ITM Power ist ein führendes Unternehmen in der Branche für grünen Wasserstoff und entwickelt und fertigt hochmoderne PEM-Elektrolyseure, die eine Schlüsselrolle bei der weltweiten Dekarbonisierung spielen. Mit über zwei Jahrzehnten wissenschaftlicher Expertise haben wir uns als Branchenführer im Bereich der sauberen Energietechnologie etabliert.

Unsere Standorte in Deutschland dienen als zentrale Drehscheibe innerhalb der EU und beherbergen Teams aus den Bereichen Geschäftsentwicklung, Engineering, Beschaffung und Kundendienst, um unseren Kunden schnelle und effiziente Lösungen zu bieten.

ITM Power befindet sich in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase und konzentriert sich auf die effiziente Umsetzung von Projekten. Wir suchen motivierte Talente, die unsere Leidenschaft für saubere Energie teilen und aktiv zur globalen Energiewende beitragen möchten.

Der Projektcontroller ist für die Verwaltung des Gesamtprojektzeitplans und die Kontrolle der Projektkosten verantwortlich und stellt sicher, dass die Ausgaben im Rahmen des Projektbudgets bleiben. Zu den Aufgaben dieser Position gehören die Erstellung von Kostenberichten, die Analyse der finanziellen Leistung im Zusammenhang mit dem Projektplan sowie die Beratung von Projektmanagern und Stakeholdern hinsichtlich Strategien zum Kostenmanagement. Der Projektcontroller arbeitet eng mit den Finanz- und Projektmanagement-Teams zusammen, um eine genaue Kostenverfolgung und Berichterstattung sicherzustellen.

Sie unterstützen Projekte, indem Sie an internen und externen Kosten- und Terminüberprüfungen teilnehmen sowie die Kostenverfolgung und -abstimmung durchführen. Darüber hinaus führt diese Position regelmäßige Überprüfungen und Aktualisierungen des Projektrisikoregisters durch. Sie koordinieren die gesamten Projektsteuerungsaktivitäten unabhängig von Umfang und Komplexität, einschließlich Turnkey- und Pauschalprojekten, unter vollständiger Einhaltung der vertraglichen Anforderungen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie arbeiten gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam an der Entwicklung von Projektsteuerungsstrategien und -plänen, die mit den Projektzielen und vertraglichen Anforderungen übereinstimmen

  • In dieser Position überwachen, analysieren und berichten Sie über den Projektfortschritt, die Kostenentwicklung und bestehende Projektrisiken, gemeinsam mit dem Projektmanager entwickeln Sie Maßnahmen, um kritische Bereiche anzugehen und die Projektziele zu erreichen

  • Sie stellen die Genauigkeit, Vollständigkeit und Konsistenz der Projektsteuerungsdaten und -informationen sicher und implementieren Qualitätssicherungsprozesse, um zuverlässige und einheitliche Projektergebnisse zu gewährleisten

  • Sie entwickeln und pflegen Projektzeitpläne und arbeiten mit den Projektteammitgliedern zusammen, um wichtige Projektmeilensteine zu identifizieren und kritische Pfade zu analysieren

  • Darüber hinaus überwachen Sie die Projektkosten im Vergleich zum Budget und zur Prognose, erstellen gemeinsam mit den Projektmanagern Kostenschätzungen, identifizieren Kostenabweichungen und entwickeln entsprechende Korrekturmaßnahmen

  • Sie steuern die Prozesse zum Änderungsmanagement (Change Orders), um sicherzustellen, dass Änderungen ordnungsgemäß dokumentiert und in die Projektpläne sowie Kostenschätzungen integriert werden

  • Sie überwachen und überprüfen den Verbrauch von Arbeitsstunden im Verhältnis zu den erbrachten Leistungen und identifizieren Änderungen, die sich auf das erforderliche Budget auswirken

  • Sie identifizieren terminliche Herausforderungen und Probleme, die sich aus Einschränkungen oder Schnittstellen zwischen verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Funktionen ergeben

  • Sie überwachen und berichten über den kritischen Pfad sowie die Terminplanentwicklung des Gesamtprojekts

  • Sie empfehlen dem Projektteam alternative Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung des Terminplans und bringen diese zur Diskussion bzw. Entscheidungsfindung ein

Das bringen Sie mit

Fachliche Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Kosteningenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Kostencontrolling oder in der Projektsteuerung innerhalb der Engineering- und Bauindustrie

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Projektsteuerung im EPC-Umfeld (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) ist von Vorteil, ebenso wie eine Zertifizierung als PMP (Project Management Professional) und/oder AACE (Certified Cost Engineer)

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Softwareanwendungen zur Kostensteuerung, beispielsweise Primavera P6, MSP und SAP

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Budgetplanung, Forecasting und Abweichungsanalysen

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Projektmanagement-Software, beispielsweise Power BI, SAP oder Oracle

  • Vertrautheit mit Methoden der Kostensteuerung, insbesondere Earned Value Management (EVM)

Persönliche Kompetenzen

  • Sie treten als engagierter Repräsentant des Unternehmens auf, überzeugen durch ein professionelles Auftreten und gehen mit gutem Beispiel voran

  • Sie verfügen über ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Sozialkompetenzen sowie die Fähigkeit, den Projektfortschritt präzise und verständlich zu berichten

  • Sie sind teamorientiert und arbeiten effektiv mit anderen zusammen, um gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen

  • Sie verfügen über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und Problemlösungskompetenz

  • Sie arbeiten äußerst strukturiert, organisiert und eigeninitiativ

  • Sie zeichnen sich durch Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft aus

  • Sie verfügen über sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was wir Ihnen bieten

  • Sie arbeiten an einer der wichtigsten Zukunftstechnologien im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien in einem wachsenden Markt mit langfristigen Perspektiven

  • Sie erhalten eine attraktive Vergütung

  • Sie profitieren von 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr

  • Sie erwartet ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld

  • Sie werden Teil eines dynamischen und erfahrenen Teams

  • Sie erhalten eine umfassende Einarbeitung sowie gezielte Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Bitte senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf sowie ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben (in englischer Sprache)

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und gestalten Sie die Zukunft des grünen Wasserstoffs mit!

title: Projectontwikkelaar vastgoed
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij bouwen aan de woningbouwopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.

Dit wordt jouw baan

Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling.

Wat ga je doen

Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie.

· Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning tot aan de start van de realisatie;

· Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's;

· Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders;

· Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken;

· Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering;

· Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming;

· Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces;

· Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie;

· Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren projectontwikkelaars en krijgt de ruimte om op termijn een meer aansturende rol te vervullen.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.


Hier zit je op jouw plek

Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling.

Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen.

Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.


Dit breng jij mee

· Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als projectontwikkelaar, ontwikkelmanager of vergelijkbare functie;

· Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding;

· Ervaring met woningbouwontwikkelingen;

· Aantoonbare ervaring met projecten van substantiële omvang (200+ woningen is een pre).;

· Ruime ervaring met ontwikkeltrajecten in de SO-, VO- en DO-fases, het verkrijgen van omgevingsvergunningen en verkooptrajecten;

· Inzicht in bouwtechnische uitgangspunten om adviseurs aan te sturen en het plan verder uit te werken;

· Ervaring binnen een ontwikkelaar, ontwikkelende bouwer of vastgoedorganisatie.

Je bent een ontwikkelaar die vooral energie krijgt van de projecten na tendergunning verder te brengen richting realisatie. Je begrijpt de dynamiek van de bouw en weet hoe je samen met alle betrokken partijen woningbouwprojecten succesvol kunt ontwikkelen én realiseren.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Het salaris voor deze functie ligt bij een medior profiel tussen € 5.639,- en € 7.049,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur) en bij een senior profiel tussen € 6.512,- en € 9.512,- (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring.
