descriptionHtml:
Cara Care, a digital health company backed by Bayer AG, is on a mission to improve people’s digestive health through technology. As we expand our product portfolio and modernize our platform, we’re looking for a versatile, pragmatic, and forward-thinking (Senior) React Native Engineer (m/f/x) to help shape the future of digital therapeutics.

Your Role

You’ll join a cross-functional product team with high ownership, lean processes, and a clear focus: deliver real impact to patients. We’re looking for someone who thrives on solving real-world problems with code, is technology-open, and knows when to build fast and when to build right. You’ll also help us use AI tools and coding agents thoughtfully in day-to-day engineering, turning emerging capabilities into reliable workflows that improve how we design, build, test, and operate patient-facing products.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and ship high-quality React Native apps for iOS and Android with TypeScript.
  • Use AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and generate tests. Define clear tasks and constraints, provide relevant context, and validate the resulting changes through code review, automated tests, and checks on real devices.
  • Own the full mobile lifecycle: architecture, implementation, automated testing, release management, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Integrate native capabilities (push notifications, deep links, biometric auth, camera/sensors); write and maintain native modules when needed (Swift/Kotlin).
  • Drive mobile performance and reliability (startup time, bundle size, memory, battery) and meet accessibility best practices.
  • Set up and evolve mobile CI/CD (e.g., Fastlane, GitHub Actions/Bitrise), internal testing (TestFlight/Play Console), and release pipelines.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Medical to explore, define, and deliver patient-centric features, and to improve our current platform.
  • Connect AI-assisted development workflows to design and engineering tools via MCP, for example to access Figma specifications and components, check implementations against designs, and automate repetitive coding and validation tasks. Keep patient data, credentials, and other sensitive information out of unapproved tools and workflows.
  • Uphold technical excellence in architecture, code quality, and security, especially in a regulated healthcare environment, including applicable requirements under IEC 62304, BSI TR-03161, and the MDR.
  • Contribute to a platform that powers multiple regulated digital health products across indications like IBS, GERD, and upcoming expansions.
  • Mentor other developers and help raise the technical bar across the team.

Requirements

Your Profile

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on React Native and shipping production apps.
  • Expert with React Native and TypeScript, React Navigation, state management, and testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library; Detox a plus).
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and write automated tests, including connecting agents to engineering tools via MCP. You can explain how you scoped the work, verified the results, and handled tool permissions and sensitive data.
  • Proven track record delivering to App Store and Google Play, including handling certificates/provisioning, in-app updates, and staged rollouts.
  • Solid understanding of mobile security and privacy: secure storage, keychain/keystore, certificate pinning, data minimization, and PII handling.
  • Experience with mobile CI/CD and release automation (Fastlane, GitHub Actions or Bitrise), and tools like Sentry.
  • Product mindset: you’ve worked in product-centric teams, collaborated closely with non-technical stakeholders, and care deeply about UX and accessibility.
  • Bonus: experience in regulated industries, healthcare, or other security-conscious environments; native iOS/Android development (Swift/Kotlin)


💡Please note: Cara Care is a remote-first company with a fully distributed team. All team members are based in Germany so candidates must reside in Germany to join us.

Benefits

💸 Fair compensation: We offer fair pay, regular salary reviews, and the equipment you need to do your best work.

🫶 Great team spirit: Join a vibrant, interdisciplinary team and enjoy a friendly, supportive working atmosphere, with regular in-person team events.

👨‍💻 Remote-first working: Prefer working from home? No problem. Want to join us at our Berlin office? That works too. Our remote-first approach gives you the flexibility to work where it suits you best.

🏝️ 30 days off per year: Rest matters. You’ll get 26 vacation days plus 4 additional company-wide mental health days each year to take a breather and recharge.

🦉 Flexible working hours: Whether you’re an early bird or prefer a later start, you can shape your working day around what works for you.

🏋️ Urban Sports Club (USC): Enjoy access to a wide range of sports, fitness, and wellness activities at discounted rates.

🧠 OpenUp: Access a variety of resources and services to support your mental health and personal wellbeing.

🛍️ Corporate Benefits: Get attractive discounts and exclusive offers from a wide range of well-known brands and providers.

🚀 Make a real impact: Be involved, contribute your ideas, and help shape what comes next. Your voice matters, and you can make a real difference.

About Cara Care

Cara Care is a digital health company on a mission to improve the lives of people with digestive health conditions through holistic, science-based digital therapies.

Our established IBS therapy, Cara Care für Reizdarm, provides personalised content, practical exercises, and symptom tracking to help people better understand and manage their condition. It is listed in the German Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices’ (BfArM) directory of digital health applications (DiGA) and is covered by statutory health insurance in Germany.

We are expanding our product portfolio and evolving our technology platform to bring digital therapies to more people across a broader range of conditions.

Backed by Bayer

We’re proud to share that Cara Care has recently joined the Bayer Group, a move that strengthens our mission and enables us to scale our impact even further. With Bayer’s global healthcare expertise and our innovative digital approach, we’re poised to redefine care for digestive health.

What It’s Like to Work With Us

At Cara Care, you’ll be part of an interdisciplinary team of doctors, designers, engineers, and creatives who are deeply passionate about improving lives. We’re inspired by our patients and driven by real-world impact. We move fast, collaborate closely, and never lose sight of the importance of well-being—both for our users and ourselves.

Diversity Matters to Us

We believe that diverse teams build better products. That’s why we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone—regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability.

We know that applying for a new job is a big step, and we genuinely appreciate your time and effort. We’re excited to get to know you!

title: Senior SAP AMS Support Consultant (SAP SD, SAP MM, SAP PP)
descriptionHtml:
Job title: Senior SAP AMS Support Consultant (SAP SD, SAP MM, SAP PP)

Employment: Permanent

Location: UK based

Salary: Excellent basic salary

Benefits: 24 days holiday, paid birthday day off, paid volunteer day, holiday buy & sell, Bupa private healthcare, 5% employer matched pension contribution, life insurance 4x annual salary, electric car lease scheme, funded social events, investment in personal development, you chose the charity we make the financial contribution, CSR initiatives, and much more!

The Company

At The Config Team, we’re not a typical corporate consultancy, and we’re not a generic SAP/IT Consultancy. We are experts in SAP supply chain, and we do it exceptionally well. With 30+ years of experience and our own suite of products (like PreBilt™ for EWM), we help global brands create smarter, faster, more resilient supply chains.

Each project we deliver is different from the next. We can offer an environment that brings a variety of projects at the forefront of modern supply chain solutions.

What You’ll Do

To delight our customers by exceeding their expectations in all aspects of support and service. The Config Team is an experienced and trusted SAP AMS partner.

The Senior AMS Consultant is critical for managing and delivering day to day client requirements including Service Requests, Incident Resolution, Problem Management and Minor Changes aligned to ITIL Methodology and Service Level Agreements. This role involves resolving complex issues and providing strategic advice to improve SAP-related processes.

You will be expected to own SAP AMS related activities across different SAP modules. Support of other technologies including the range of The Config Team products and mobile technology. The role will see you develop a strong understanding of client and industry business processes to provide advice to clients.

To ensure the above is fully achievable for our clients you will need to have a strong knowledge and understanding of SAP SD, SAP MM, and SAP PP.


Required Skills

  • Functional experience within SAP SD, SAP MM, and SAP PP.

  • Good knowledge on processes and best practice principles within specialist area of SAP.

  • To be able to demonstrate problem solving abilities in SAP.

  • Ability to deal with internal and external stakeholders in a support environment.

  • A full valid UK driving license.

  • Right to work in the UK.

Desired Skills

  • Functional and/or configuration experience within any other SAP module.

  • Experience of using or implementing mobile solutions either in SAP ITS or using a Third Party Product with SAP.

  • Able to investigate ABAP issues and bugs.

The Config Team

A leading SAP Supply Chain Software Consultancy, with a people-centric and collaborative culture focused on employee well-being, learning and development and creating an excellent place to work for our people. We aim to delight customers with the exceptional delivery of SAP projects.

Why apply for this position with The Config Team?

  • Work with globally recognised brands.

  • Join a software business with an exceptional 98% customer retention rate.

  • Work Where Works approach.

  • Opportunity to build and shape our partner strategy.

  • Work with innovative SAP software products and solutions.

  • Excellent career progression and learning & development opportunities.

  • Be part of a collaborative, supportive and people-focused culture.

Find out more about Life At The Config Team on Glassdoor where we our proud to say employees rate us 4.9 / 5 stars! https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-The-Config-Team-EI_IE1831019.11,26.htm

At The Config Team, our people are our greatest asset. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment built on trust, respect, and integrity, where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. We strive to create a workplace where all individuals feel welcome, safe, valued, and supported.

We are committed to preventing discrimination of any kind and actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including those from underrepresented groups. To ensure you can perform at your best during the hiring process, we are happy to accommodate any reasonable adjustments you may need.

To find out more information, a full job description or if you have any questions, please submit your CV.

﻿We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - SAP Connectors
descriptionHtml:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran and dbt Labs are building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

Fivetran's SAP connectors move enterprise data out of SAP and into modern data platforms. We're looking for an all-round SAP specialist who combines strong ABAP skills with deep knowledge of SAP outbound interfacing. You'll work on the interfaces and data extraction mechanisms that let Fivetran reliably pull data from SAP ECC and S/4HANA systems, and you'll help customers and internal teams get the most out of them.

You will be the SAP specialist within a team of Java developers. Your knowledge and input is crucial to the success of this team. 

Technologies You’ll Use

  • ABAP programming using traditional SAPGUI as well as Eclipse (or other IDE).
  • Databases (HANA/Oracle/etc)
  • Cloud environments (AWS/GCP/MS)
  • AI tools Claude/Codex/

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance ABAP components (function modules, classes, CDS views, and enhancements) to drive scalable outbound data extraction from SAP systems.
  • Own and modernize internal SAP test environments to accelerate feature development for current connectors and upcoming public cloud / BTP integrations.
  • Architect robust outbound interfaces leveraging OData, standard and generic DataSources, ODP/ODQ delta frameworks, and RFC connections.
  • Optimize data throughput and reliability across ECC and S/4HANA landscapes by diagnosing and resolving extraction performance bottlenecks and delta synchronization issues.
  • Analyze underlying SAP database structures (HANA and traditional DBs) to unlock efficiency gains and streamline data pipeline performance.
  • Partner closely with engineering, support, and customers to translate complex business requirements into elegant technical architectures.
  • Deliver end-to-end support for enterprise clients by troubleshooting complex connectivity, authorization, and configuration challenges in customer SAP environments.
  • Establish technical design standards, interface specifications, and best practice documentation for internal and external knowledge sharing.
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging SAP technologies—including SAP Datasphere and BTP—to keep Fivetran’s connectors at the forefront of modern data integration.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of hands-on SAP development experience, with strong ABAP skills (classic and modern ABAP, ABAP OO, ABAP for HANA)
  • Deep knowledge of SAP outbound interfacing:
    • OData (v2 and v4): service design, SEGW, performance, and security
    • SAP extractors: standard and generic DataSources, delta handling, ODP/ODQ, CDS-based extraction
    • RFC: function modules, BAPIs, destinations, and tRFC/qRFC
  • Solid working knowledge of both SAP ECC and S/4HANA, including the differences in data models and extraction options between them
  • Good knowledge of databases: SQL, query performance and tuning, SAP HANA, and relational database concepts
  • Understanding of SAP data models and key modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD)
  • Experience with SAP authorizations and technical user/role setup for interfaces
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Good communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders
  • Fluent in English
  • Experience in code reviews, design, troubleshooting and testing
  • Ability to use conversational AI systems (like Claude, ChatGPT, and internal chatbots) to support researching, authoring, reviewing, and synthesizing various SDLC artifacts such as TDDs, PRDs, Postmortems, Test Plans, and Proposals

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including connecting SAP to cloud data platforms
  • Java development experience
  • Familiarity with data integration/ELT tools and data warehousing concepts
  • Knowledge of SLT, SAP Datasphere, BW and SAP BTP.

The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process.

Pay Range€131.912—€164.890 EUR

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.     

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video.

To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here.

We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. title: SME Onboarding Specialist - Germany (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Deine Mission

Du bist die Stimme unserer deutschen Kunden und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass sie mit Pennylane erfolgreich sind. Du hilfst kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen (KMU), ihre Finanzprozesse zu vereinfachen und das volle Potenzial unserer Finanzmanagement-Plattform auszuschöpfen. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns den Aufbau von Pennylane in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Onboarding mit Wirkung: Du begleitest neue KMU-Kunden und ihre Steuerkanzleien durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Einstieg reibungslos gelingt und Unternehmen schnell von den Möglichkeiten unserer Plattform profitieren.

  • Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere bestehenden KMU-Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, erkennst Potenziale für zusätzliche Funktionen und eine erweiterte Nutzung und hilfst deinen Kunden, ihre unternehmerischen und finanziellen Ziele mit Pennylane zu erreichen.

  • Proaktiv beraten: In regelmäßigen Gesprächen prüfst du, wie erfolgreich deine Kunden mit Pennylane arbeiten und wo sie Unterstützung brauchen. Du steigerst ihre Zufriedenheit, optimierst die Nutzung der Plattform und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn eine Abwanderung droht.

  • Gemeinsam den deutschen Markt gestalten: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem deutschen Sales-Team und dem lokalen Leadership-Team zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Abläufe weiter, bündelt Produktfeedback und treibt das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland voran.

  • Expertise aufbauen und teilen: Du entwickelst dich zur gefragten Ansprechperson für unsere Plattform und die deutsche Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft. Dein Wissen und bewährte Vorgehensweisen gibst du direkt an unsere KMU-Kunden weiter.

Das bringst du mit

  • Relevante Erfahrung: Du hast 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, im Finanzmanagement, in Corporate Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren unternehmensinternen Rolle. Idealerweise hast du selbst mit Finanzprozessen, Rechnungsstellung oder Buchhaltungsabläufen gearbeitet. Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, bei einem Fintech oder in einer Steuerkanzlei ist ein Plus.

  • Fachliche Grundlage: Du hast ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Rechnungswesen mit.

  • Verständnis für den deutschen Markt: Du kennst die Anforderungen von KMU an ihr Finanzmanagement und verstehst die zentralen Abläufe rund um Rechnungswesen, Rechnungsstellung und das finanzielle Tagesgeschäft in Deutschland.

  • Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, versetzt dich in deine Kunden hinein und erklärst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Themen einfach und verständlich.

  • Lust, selbst anzupacken: Du möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, das in Deutschland noch am Anfang steht und wächst. Du ergreifst die Initiative, denkst in Lösungen und hast Freude daran, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du freust dich darauf, unser Team beim Onboarding im Pariser Headquarter kennenzulernen, und bist bereit, gelegentlich Kunden in Deutschland zu besuchen – etwa einmal im Monat.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren internationalen Teams.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

title: Sr. Customer Success Advisor
descriptionHtml:
Onwards Together!

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

Location: Germany (Remote)

Our Team’s Vision:

Customer Success Advisors exist to help customers sustain value.

We serve as our customers’ strategic business partners, building trusted relationships that ensure they continuously realize the outcomes that drove their investment in Illumio. Through executive engagement, success planning, lifecycle management, and cross-functional leadership, we help customers measure success, overcome business obstacles, and identify opportunities to deepen the value Illumio delivers over time.

Customer Success Advisors orchestrate the expertise of the broader Illumio organization. Working alongside Technical Account Managers, Professional Services, Support, Sales, Product Engineering, and our partner ecosystem, they bring together the right people at the right time to help customers achieve their business objectives. By aligning customer priorities with Illumio’s capabilities, CSAs ensure every engagement contributes to long-term customer success.

Joining the Customer Success Advisor team means becoming part of an organization dedicated to customer advocacy, trusted partnerships, and measurable business outcomes. If you’re passionate about building executive relationships, leading through influence, coordinating across teams, and helping customers achieve lasting success, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on both our customers and Illumio’s continued growth.

Your Impact: 

As a Customer Success Advisor (CSA), you are a critical part of the Customer Success Organization reporting to the Director of Customer Success. Your role will be directly tied to value generation for our customers, by helping them develop the right strategy to onboard, adopt, and successfully utilize Illumio's products to achieve their desired outcomes. The results of your efforts should lead to healthy, adopted, referenceable customers that achieved value-based outcomes and are eager to expand their use of Illumio across their organization.

  • Develop cross-functional knowledge that spans IT Security, IT Operations, Infrastructure, and Application Portfolio Management practices. Your ability to partner with all teams within Illumio (like Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product Management, Engineering, Office of the CTO) to drive a strategic roadmap for your customers will be vital to your success.

title: Staff Engineer | Voyagu
descriptionHtml:
Role: Staff Engineer (Integrations / Supply, air travel)

Company: Voyagu

Location: Fully remote, Europe preferred. European time zone; about two hours of difference is fine. About eight hours online, and some overlap with US time zones helps because many users are there.

Job Type: Full-time. Contract model is flexible: contractor, payroll provider or direct employment.

About Voyagu

Voyagu builds one platform that runs several travel businesses. Today the focus is air travel. The platform covers client management (CRM), ERP modules for finance and accounting, travel operations, and integrations with travel supply systems.

The model is offline travel: agencies that sell through people. Voyagu does not sell the software and does not plan to, but agencies work with it in different models. It is a bootstrap scaleup, so teams are lean and money is counted.

Development leans heavily on AI. Teams of AI agents run big features under a business operator and a technical operator. Sometimes this turns two half-years of work into two weeks. It does not always work. When code is cheap, product vision and architecture become the bottleneck, and that is where you come in.

This role owns the integrations and supply direction. Air travel alone is deep: every airline has its own distribution channels and APIs. You would lead one of five platform development streams and report to the CTO. There is no product manager in between, and you work directly with the founder and other business stakeholders. The team has no one with your profile today, so you would be the first.

What you are expected to do

Technical ownership

  • Lead the integrations and supply direction as its technical owner.

  • Build integrations with GDS systems. Voyagu works with one today and needs more.

  • Connect airline direct APIs and non-GDS protocols across multiple sources.

  • Handle servicing after sale: changes, cancellations, refunds, and group bookings split into parts.

  • Work with live, real-time availability. Seat availability does not depend on price.

  • Prevent costly errors. One missed booking can mean tens of thousands of dollars. Design for reliability, for example with idempotency, so nothing is paid or bought twice.

  • Keep the solution sized to Voyagu’s scale and avoid over-design. This is not internet-scale work.

  • Keep the system stable. Speed and error rate are the measures.

Vision and delivery

  • Shape the technical vision with stakeholders and defend it. They will challenge it.

  • Expect no ready-made tasks. Business stakeholders give you a direction, not a finished task.

  • Turn the agreed platform capabilities into features and give estimates. Several dozen capabilities are written down, such as search and booking.

  • Success means Voyagu accepts your estimates and you deliver them, or come close. Part of the plan will be agreed together with you.

AI-driven development

  • Build and direct teams of AI coding agents instead of writing code by hand.

  • Explain and defend how to use AI effectively.

  • Bring AI practices that are as good as Voyagu’s, or better.

Team

  • Lead the two people already working in this direction, once you have onboarded.

  • Hire as little as possible. Hiring is a last resort. Long term the direction may grow to one to three people.

What you need to succeed

  • You have worked in the travel domain, especially on integrations with supply systems. About two or more years is likely enough.

  • You understand booking versus ticket, and the statuses and states of each.

  • You have owned a large piece of a product, not a small slice.

  • You work at staff or senior level, as architect and technical lead.

  • You understand what Voyagu does and why, and you talk well with stakeholders.

  • You use AI well beyond the beginner level and have a clear view on how to use it effectively.

  • You believe small teams work. You do not think in big organisations.

  • You work in a European time zone; ideally you are based in Europe.

  • You speak Russian: engineering works mostly in Russian. Business teams speak English, and English B2 is enough.

  • Nice to have: you have seen both corporate and lean startup worlds, or a bootstrap scaleup. You may be an ex-founder or a small-company CTO who stayed hands-on.

  • Nice to have: you have run teams of agents, not only asked an agent to write a feature.

  • Nice to have: vendor-side experience building for end users. Python is the current main stack, but language skill is not important.

  • Not required: high-load experience, writing agent skills, or deep C#/legacy aviation knowledge.

What you get

  • You own a whole direction, with responsibility handed over fully.

  • You are the technical lead for integrations and supply, with no product-manager layer in between.

  • You work with AI agent teams. Voyagu will invest heavily in tokens and compute where it pays off.

  • You can bring AI practices better than Voyagu’s own, and the team will share theirs.

  • A large, technically hard platform: real-time inventory, many sources, money at stake.

  • A lean environment with few meetings and flexible hours.

  • Fully remote in Europe, with flexible contract models.

  • Equity is not standard, but it is negotiable for an exceptional candidate.

How to apply

Apply through hirehire, the agency running this search for Voyagu. The process has three stages: an engineering interview with the CTO, a travel-domain interview with the founder, and a practical case with a defence.

title: Website Growth Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Germany
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Dein Team und Umfeld

Pennylane wächst international: Nach Frankreich bauen wir unsere Websites und Conversion-Funnels für Spanien, Deutschland und die USA aus. Deutschland ist dabei ein strategischer Fokusmarkt. Dafür suchen wir dich: Du entwickelst die deutsche Website als eigenständiges Produkt weiter – mit einem klaren Blick auf den Markt, unsere Zielgruppen und ihre Bedürfnisse.

Du wirst Teil unseres Website-Teams im Bereich Growth und berichtest direkt an den Head of Growth. Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineers und Designern arbeitest du in einer festen Squad. Dabei bist du täglich mittendrin, packst selbst mit an und bringst Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit deinem Team live.

Deine Mission

Du verantwortest und optimierst die Conversion-Rate unserer Websites für den deutschen Markt: pennylane.com/de und start.pennylane.com. Für jede Zielgruppe schaffst du ein passendes Nutzererlebnis: Selbstständige, kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, größere Mittelständler und Steuerkanzleien.

Von der ersten Analyse bis zur umgesetzten Verbesserung liegt der gesamte Prozess bei dir. Du erkennst Hürden, entwickelst die Strategie, testest neue Ansätze und machst ihren Erfolg messbar.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Conversion optimieren und kontinuierlich experimentieren

  • Du entwickelst die Conversion-Strategie für den deutschen Funnel – von der Startseite über Preis- und Produktseiten bis zur Demo-Buchung und eigenständigen Registrierung.

  • Du treibst einen kontinuierlichen A/B-Testprozess voran: Ideen entwickeln, Tests planen, live bringen, auswerten und weiterentwickeln. Laufende Experimente gehören für dich zum Alltag.

  • Mit Analytics, Heatmaps und Verhaltensanalysen identifizierst du Hürden und Potenziale entlang der Nutzerreise, unter anderem mit Amplitude und Tracking-Daten.

  • Du führst ein umfassendes CRO-Audit der deutschen Website durch und vergleichst Funnel, Preisseite und Startseite mit führenden B2B-Websites.

2. Die deutsche Website als Produkt weiterentwickeln

  • Du verantwortest die Roadmap der deutschen Website und priorisierst nach Wirkung und Umsetzbarkeit.

  • Du entwickelst das Portal für Steuerkanzleien, die Marketplace-Integration und den Demo-Buchungsprozess für den deutschen Markt weiter.

  • Du verantwortest unser CMS Contentful: von einer klaren Struktur über wiederverwendbare Komponenten bis zum Aufbau neuer Seiten.

  • Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineering verantwortest du den gesamten Self-Service-Registrierungsprozess für Deutschland: das deutsche Formular, die automatische Ergänzung von Unternehmensdaten und eindeutige Unternehmenszuordnung über Northdata, die Datenübertragung an Salesforce und die Kontoerstellung über die Produkt-API.

3. Die Umsetzung im Team vorantreiben

  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit von UX, Engineering und Data – mit einem priorisierten Backlog, klaren Spezifikationen, konsequenter Nachverfolgung und Qualitätssicherung.

  • Du moderierst Weeklys, Dailys und Retros und sorgst dafür, dass Tickets zügig von der Planung bis zur Veröffentlichung vorankommen.

  • Du koordinierst Content, Product Marketing und Lokalisierung: von der KI-gestützten Übersetzung über die Prüfung durch Muttersprachler bis zur Integration ins CMS.

  • Du nutzt KI, um Prozesse und Reporting zu automatisieren.

4. Teams und Stakeholder zusammenbringen

  • Du arbeitest eng mit SEO, SEA, Content, Product Marketing, Product, Legal und dem deutschen Marktteam zusammen – unter anderem an Landingpages zu RFE, Compte Pro und E-Rechnung.

  • Du bringst unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf einen gemeinsamen Kurs und gewinnst ihre Unterstützung, auch ohne disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung.

  • Du kommunizierst Prioritäten, Zeitpläne und wichtige Neuerungen klar und teamübergreifend.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung mit messbarer Wirkung: Du hast 3–4 Jahre Erfahrung im Product Management oder in der Conversion-Rate-Optimierung, idealerweise im B2B-SaaS- oder B2C-Umfeld. Du hast Features von der Idee bis zum Launch verantwortet und kannst anhand konkreter Kennzahlen zeigen, was sich dadurch verbessert hat.

  • Eigenständiger Umgang mit Daten und CRO-Tools: Du arbeitest sicher mit Tools wie Amplitude, GA4, Contentsquare oder Hotjar. Du ziehst deine Daten selbst, erkennst Muster und leitest Hypothesen ab, ohne auf eine Analyse durch andere angewiesen zu sein.

  • Fundierte A/B-Testing-Kenntnisse: Du weißt, wie du die nötige Stichprobengröße bestimmst, eine klare Erfolgskennzahl definierst und typische Fehler vermeidest – etwa Tests aufgrund vorläufiger Ergebnisse zu früh zu beenden oder mit zu kleinen Stichproben zu arbeiten.

  • Klare Kommunikation: Du schreibst präzise Briefings für Designer, erklärst Priorisierungsentscheidungen auch gegenüber skeptischen Stakeholdern und präsentierst Ergebnisse verständlich für ein nichttechnisches Publikum.

  • Sprachkenntnisse und Marktverständnis: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder vergleichbarem Niveau und kennst den deutschen Markt. Für die internationale Zusammenarbeit bringst du verhandlungssicheres Englisch mit. Französisch ist ein Plus.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

title: Research Engineer, Index Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked.

We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves.

Desired Experience

  • You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means

  • Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale

  • You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better

  • You like working across teams. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build

  • You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

Example Projects

  • Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

  • Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

  • Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

  • Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

descriptionHtml:
Vous souhaitez piloter des projets à forte valeur ajoutée dans un environnement technique exigeant ?

Vous recherchez un poste combinant management de projets, relation client, expertise technique et développement d'activité ?

Rejoignez-nous !

JACIR - société du groupe COFINAIR qui regroupe 4 sites production en France, en Allemagne et en Italie, 290 personnes pour 70M€ CA – se positionne aujourd’hui comme le partenaire incontournable Européen en proposant des technologies innovantes de refroidissement évaporatif respectueuses de l’environnement : design, fabrication, commercialisation, Services dédiés aux tours de refroidissement et refroidisseurs adiabatiques pour l’industrie et le tertiaire.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités nucléaires, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable Qualité Nucléaire. Véritable référent(e) qualité, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la structuration, le déploiement et l'amélioration continue de notre système de management de la qualité, en lien avec les exigences de la filière nucléaire.

Ce poste est basé à notre site de Martin-Eglise (76).

Rattaché/e au Responsable Activité Nucléaire & Complexes, vous pilotez les démarches qualité et accompagnez les équipes dans l'atteinte des objectifs de performance, de conformité et de sûreté :

Vos missions

Piloter et développer le système de qualité nucléaire

  • Conduire le projet de certification ISO 19443 et en assurer le déploiement au sein de l'organisation.
  • Réaliser les analyses d'écarts et définir la feuille de route associée.
  • Structurer, déployer et faire évoluer le système documentaire et les processus liés au Système de Management de la Qualité (SMQ).
  • Définir, suivre et analyser les indicateurs qualité de l'activité nucléaire.
  • Développer et promouvoir la culture qualité et la culture de sûreté à tous les niveaux de l'entreprise.

Accompagner les projets nucléaires

  • Garantir la traçabilité documentaire et la conformité qualité des projets en production.
  • Définir et valider avec les clients et les chefs de projet les étapes libératoires des commandes.
  • Participer à la qualification, l'évaluation et au suivi des fournisseurs.
  • Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans l'application des exigences qualité et réglementaires.

Assurer la conformité et l’amélioration continue

  • Préparer et coordonner les audits internes, fournisseurs et de certification.
  • Piloter les non-conformités, analyses de causes et actions correctives.
  • Veiller au respect des exigences clients, normatives et réglementaires applicables au secteur nucléaire.
  • Proposer et mettre en œuvre des actions d'amélioration continue.

Vos compétences

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur et votre capacité à piloter plusieurs sujets simultanément ainsi que pour votre leadership.

Vous disposez d’excellentes qualités relationnelles et aptitude à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés (clients, organismes de certification, fournisseurs, équipes internes).

Issu(e) d’une formation Bac +5 ou Ingénieur en génie industriel, mécanique, énergétique ou domaine équivalent, vous justifiez d’au moins 7 années d’expérience, idéalement dans le secteur du nucléaire ou dans un environnement fortement réglementé.

Vous maîtrisez le Pack Office et disposez d'un niveau d'anglais B2 minimum.

La maitrise des référentiels ISO 19001 & 19443, des exigences des procédés de fabrication et techniques de soudage constitue un véritable atout.

Des déplacements ponctuels sont à prévoir.

Avantages

Chez JACIR, vous rejoignez une entreprise à taille humaine, reconnue pour son expertise technique et engagée dans une démarche d'amélioration continue.

Dès votre arrivée, vous bénéficierez d'un parcours d'intégration complet comprenant une formation à nos produits, nos services et nos procédures QHSE.

Vous bénéficierez également des avantages suivants :

  • Mutuelle santé et prévoyance prises en charge à 70 % par l’employeur
  • CSE : chèques cadeaux, chèques vacances, évènements collectifs
  • Intéressement aux résultats collectifs
  • RTT et jours offerts
  • Télétravail selon charte en vigueur

Vous intégrerez une entreprise attachée à une culture QHSE forte, où chaque collaborateur est acteur de la sécurité, de la qualité et du respect de l’environnement.

JACIR s'engage à garantir l'égalité des chances pour tous nos candidats en valorisant la diversité et l'inclusion. Nous nous efforçons de recruter des talents variés qui enrichissent notre équipe et favorisent un environnement de travail respectueux et collaboratif.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organization. You'll set and execute the strategy for how we build revenue analytics across Salesforce and Looker, run insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business, partner closely with revenue leadership on the full range of topics they face, and, as you ramp up, take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

This is a generalist role by design: analytics is the foundation, especially in your first two quarters, and the role broadens from there to include business partnering and forecasting. What matters most is the versatility to move across all three, not depth in any single one.


What You'll Do

  • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

  • First 180 days: Build a highly automated revenue insights engine using AI, while establishing yourself as the business partner revenue leadership.

  • First 12 months: Broaden into leading and supporting the forecasting cadence.


What Will You Be Doing?

Revenue Analytics & Insights

  • Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order.

  • Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan.

  • Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider revenue leadership team rely on.

  • Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it.

  • Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep.

Business Partnership to Revenue leadership

  • Become the go-to Revenue Operations partner for revenue leadership, covering reporting, insights, and the broader range of topics that come up in running a sales organization.

  • Translate revenue leadership's open questions into structured analysis and clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Represent revenue's priorities into the Revenue Operations roadmap, and vice versa.

  • Support revenue leaders in business reviews, planning moments, and ad hoc requests with credible, fast turnaround.

Forecasting

  • Run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders alongside the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking.

  • Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion.

  • Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement.


What Will You Need to Succeed?

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue or Sales Operations, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

  • Exposure to Account Executive (AE) or similarly quota-carrying organization.

  • Strong Salesforce reporting skills and working fluency in a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), with a practical, business-first approach to data.

  • A genuine generalist mindset — as comfortable building a dashboard or an insights report, as running a forecasting call.

  • A track record of setting direction and quality bar for analytical work.

  • Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to work with and influence sales leadership and revenue executives.

  • Comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end: framing the question, choosing the method, landing the recommendation.

  • Excellent written communication — the insights digest is a core, ongoing deliverable of this role.

  • Experience partnering with global or multi-region teams is a plus.


What we Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Robotics Engineering Intern
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Robotics Engineering Intern to get robots to build control cabinets they have never seen before. You will work with our robotics engineers and see your code run on real robots in our production.

Our robots run on our own factory operating system and adapt to each new cabinet using digital twins and 3D perception. Current projects include DIN rail assembly and wiring.

Duration: 6 months; Start: flexible

Tasks

  • Build robot applications that take over real production steps, such as DIN rail assembly and wiring.

  • Develop robot skills to pick, place and mount components and handle flexible wires.

  • Implement 3D perception, so robots find components, terminals and wires on their own.

  • Generate robot jobs from our digital twin for every new cabinet automatically.

  • Test and improve our robot applications on our cobots, together with our robotics engineers and electricians.

Requirements

  • You are studying robotics, mechatronics, computer science or something similar at a top university with strong grades.

  • First hands-on experience with robot arms, ideally with cobots and ROS.

  • Interest in manipulation, motion planning and 3D perception.

  • Get things done mentality: prioritising results over process.

  • Humble, low ego, not afraid to get your hands dirty.

  • You build fast and test on real hardware, iterating constantly.

  • Fluent in English, German is a plus.

Benefits

  • Scaling from 0 to 1: you shape our robotics technology, from first prototypes to solutions running in our production.

  • Work as a full team member of an interdisciplinary team of top performers that will both support and challenge your growth.

  • Lunch allowance, a subsidized sports membership and modern tech.

  • A new office in Garching, right on top of our own production floor.

Vetaion is building a fully automated production facility for control cabinets in Munich. We use digital twins and robotics to automate the manufacturing process, orchestrated by VetaionOS, our own operating system for the factory.

Our mission is to strengthen Germany as a leading industrial hub. Join our team and our mission, let's reinvent the future of production together!

title: Sales Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
Über uns
Lupa entwickelt ein Produkt, das eine völlig neue Kategorie schafft und das es in der Branche so noch nicht gegeben hat.

Wir sind das KI-native Betriebssystem für Tierarztpraxen und Tierhalter. Unsere intelligente All-in-one-Plattform ersetzt die fragmentierten, umständlichen Systeme, mit denen Tierarztpraxen seit Jahren arbeiten müssen. Sie vereint Terminplanung, Kundenkommunikation, klinische Dokumentation und KI-gestützte Behandlungsempfehlungen. Praxen arbeiten dadurch effizienter, Tierärzte können sich wieder auf das konzentrieren, was sie lieben, und Tierhalter sind enger mit der Gesundheit ihrer Tiere verbunden als je zuvor.

Unsere Erfolge sprechen für sich: 2023 gegründet, sind wir heute Marktführer in Großbritannien, gehören zu den 100 führenden KI-Start-ups Europas und sind in zwölf Monaten um das Zehnfache gewachsen. Unser Team zählt inzwischen 70 Mitarbeitende und wächst schnell weiter. Jetzt expandieren wir mit voller Kraft in die USA und nach Europa. Wir haben 25 Millionen US-Dollar an Finanzierung erhalten, betreuen mehr als 2,5 Millionen Haustiere auf unserer Plattform und haben ein lebendiges Büro in München. Außergewöhnliche Talente von Unternehmen wie Palantir, Google, DeepMind, BCG, Meta und AWS sind bereits Teil unseres Teams, und wir stehen erst am Anfang.

Dies ist die seltene Gelegenheit, genau zum richtigen Zeitpunkt Teil eines rasant wachsenden Unternehmens zu werden. Deshalb suchen wir außergewöhnliche Menschen, die dieses Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten möchten.

In dieser Rolle wirst du:

  • Die Outbound-Akquise für Tierarztpraxen und Tierkliniken verantworten. Diese Pipeline baust du selbst auf

  • Hochwertige Leads identifizieren, recherchieren und per Kaltakquise über Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn ansprechen

  • Interessenten qualifizieren und Termine für unsere Account Executives vereinbaren, inklusive einer Übergabe mit allem relevanten Kontext

  • Ein tiefes Verständnis für das Produkt, die Kunden und den Markt von Lupa aufbauen, damit deine Ansprache beratend ist und nicht nach Skript klingt

  • Eng mit Marketing und Produkt zusammenarbeiten, um Messaging und Positionierung auf Basis deiner Erfahrungen aus der Praxis zu schärfen

  • Die Pipelinedaten im CRM korrekt und aktuell halten, denn unser Team arbeitet mit sauberen Daten

  • Erkenntnisse aus deinen Gesprächen mit Interessenten an das Team weitergeben und so unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie und Produktentwicklung mitgestalten

Dein Hintergrund könnte wie folgt aussehen:

  • Fundierte Vertriebserfahrung als SDR, BDR oder in einer anderen Outbound-Rolle. Erfahrung in B2B SaaS oder Tech ist von Vorteil, aber auch andere Branchen sind willkommen!

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Muss

  • Bereitschaft, vor Ort in unserem Büro in München zu arbeiten

  • Du bist sicher in der Akquise per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn und gehst dabei beratend vor

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst den Mehrwert eines Produkts klar vermitteln, sowohl gegenüber medizinischem Fachpersonal als auch gegenüber nicht technischen Ansprechpartnern

  • Sehr gute Organisation und hohe Eigenmotivation: Du behältst mehrere Interessenten und Pipelines gleichzeitig im Blick, ohne an Schwung zu verlieren

  • Erfahrung mit einem CRM und ein datengetriebener Ansatz zur Verbesserung deiner Outreach-Ergebnisse sind von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Vertical SaaS oder im Umfeld professioneller Dienstleistungen ist von Vorteil

Als Person:

  • Interessierst du dich ehrlich für die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden und willst sie lösen, anstatt nur eine Anrufquote zu erfüllen

  • Bist du hungrig auf Wachstum und bereit, alles für deinen Erfolg zu geben

  • Bist du belastbar: Absagen bringen dich nicht aus der Ruhe, sie machen dich besser

  • Möchtest du dich in eine Closing-Rolle entwickeln und siehst die SDR-Position als Sprungbrett, nicht als Endstation

  • Freust du dich darauf, vor Ort in unserem Büro in München zu arbeiten, mit gelegentlichen Reisen zu unserem Hauptsitz in London

  • Arbeitest du gerne mit Menschen, die freundlich, ambitioniert und pragmatisch sind

  • Liebst du Tiere? Das ist ein Bonus, denn du verkaufst an Menschen, die ihr Berufsleben den Tieren gewidmet haben

Wie sieht Erfolg nach sechs Monaten aus?

  • Du vereinbarst kontinuierlich qualifizierte Termine, und deine Pipeline ist eine, mit der unsere Account Executives wirklich gerne arbeiten

  • Du kennst Produkt, Markt und Kunden so gut, dass du Discovery Calls eigenständig führen kannst

  • Du prägst bereits, wie das Team über Outbound denkt. Deine Erkenntnisse aus der Praxis verändern, wie wir in den Markt gehen

title: Sales Director, Insurance  - UK
descriptionHtml:
What We’re All About

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future.

At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures, allowing you to build a career that matches your ambitions. Over 41% of our colleagues come from diverse ethnic or religious minority backgrounds, and we speak over 20 languages across 50 nationalities, creating a true sense of belonging for all. We are heading in one direction—the future. We’d love you to join us.

The Opportunity

Do you strive to make a profound difference in the insurance industry? Are you passionate about supporting innovation and change that drives business growth, trusted risk management, and customer-centricity?

At Quantexa, we do. This drive to challenge ourselves and the industry is what inspires us every day. Our culture is underpinned not only by our ability to build market-leading, AI-driven Decision Intelligence technology, but by our dedication to creating real, operational change across the insurance vertical. It is what has allowed us to support the industry across 4 continents and 20+ countries, and it is what will continue to make our future. #UNSTOPPABLE.

As the Insurance Sales Director for the UK, you will join a collaborative, high-performing team within the Quantexa Sales division. This position is central to building out our core UK insurance nucleus. You will be a focal point in providing thought leadership, industry subject-matter expertise, and the entrepreneurial drive needed to acquire net-new logos, scale our pipeline, and enhance our go-to-market strategy.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Define and Execute Strategy: Report directly to the Senior Director, Insurance EMEA Insurance Sector Lead, working alongside solution owners, Solution Engineers, and industry leads to define and execute a winning sales strategy for the UK Insurance sector.

  • Drive New Logo Acquisition: Act as a high-impact hunter focused predominantly on securing net-new "Logo" accounts (Tier 1 & Tier 2 insurers) across the UK general insurance, London market, and life insurance sectors.

  • Leverage the Partner Ecosystem: Partner closely with key cloud hyperscalers (e.g., Microsoft, Databricks) and global consulting firms to maximize joint pipeline-generation initiatives and warm lead activation.

  • Own the Enterprise Lifecycle: Manage long, complex, and high-value enterprise software sales cycles from initiation to close, consistently delivering against annual recurring revenue (ARR) targets.

  • Foster Internal Collaboration: Build trust and work cohesively with Solution Engineering, Field Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Solution Success teams to ensure our technology matches client expectations.

  • Maintain Process Hygiene: Take ownership of sales pipeline accuracy, reporting, and operational hygiene within our CRM and ATS (Ashby) environments.

  • Industry Representation: Act as a brand ambassador, networking and presenting at key UK Insurance and Insurtech industry events.

What You’ll Bring

Must Haves (Essential Experience):

  • Technology Sales Pedigree: Proven experience selling complex enterprise software, platform-as-a-service (PaaS), or SaaS solutions (rather than data or consulting services alone).

  • Insurance Sector Expertise: A track record of selling directly into P&C, Specialty (London Market), or Life Insurers.

  • Enterprise Deal Execution: Proven success managing, navigating, and closing multi-month, multi-stakeholder enterprise software cycles (£100k+ ARR / multi-year deals).

  • C-Suite Presence: The communication style and executive presence required to confidently "educate and solutionise" with, and sell directly to, C-suite and VP-level stakeholders within major insurance carriers.

  • Collaborative & Inclusive Mindset: The ability to operate as an independent decision-maker who is also equally collaborative when evaluating technical options with Solution Engineering and Product teams.

  • Resilience & Ambition: An optimistic, high-energy outlook with the determination and perseverance to succeed in complex, challenging, and evolving environments.

Nice to Haves (Preferred, but not required):

  • Domain Alignment: Experience selling technology solutions focused on Fraud (our primary right-to-win use case), Data Management, or Customer Intelligence.

  • Hyperscaler Familiarity: Direct experience co-selling or partnering with cloud hyperscalers (specifically Microsoft and Databricks).

  • Tier 1 General Insurance Contacts: Pre-existing relationships and established credibility with major tier-1 insurers

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Commission

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - Mainland Europe
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in Mainland Europe (DACH & France). You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara’s platform with our largest customers.

Notre entreprise propose des solutions de télésurveillance en oncologie, gastro-entérologie et psychiatrie, basées sur la collecte d’ePRO associées à des techniques d’IA. Elles s’appuient sur une plateforme de suivi pour les professionnels de santé, permettant une détection précoce des effets secondaires pour une prise en charge continue et anticipée, et une application mobile pour les patients, permettant de mesurer et gérer leurs symptômes grâce à des ressources adaptées.

Nos solutions permettent d’optimiser les prises en charge, d’enrichir la compréhension des patients en continu pendant leur parcours de soin et d’accélérer la recherche clinique grâce à la collecte, la structuration et l’analyse fine des données de vie réelle.
