title: Security Assurance Analyst
descriptionHtml:
At a glance

Location: Cambridge

In-office expectation: One day per week on average

Employment type: Permanent

Salary: £45-£55,000

Why this role exists

As Redgate grows, so does the scrutiny our customers place on how we handle their data, and our need to have the same confidence in our suppliers.

This role exists to drive the assurance process, giving customers confidence in Redgate, and ensuring our supply chain lives up to our expectations of security.

About Redgate

Redgate brings together people who want to do their best work in an environment built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

We build solutions that help data professionals securely manage the data and databases that their organizations depend on, a space that's only becoming more critical as systems scale, data regulations increase, and AI adoption accelerates.

AI at Redgate

By 2028, Redgate will operate as an expert-plus-agent company, domain experts amplified by AI, delivering customer value at a pace our peers can't match.

AI handles the heavy lifting. Our people control the judgement. Everyone at Redgate works with Claude, giving you access to the best AI tools from day one.

Why join our Security team?

● You'll join a team that values thoroughness, collaboration, and building genuine trust with our partners both within the company and externally.

● There's a clear pathway to grow your technical security skills, with structured mentoring from our Security and Technical Operations teams.

● We value sustainable ways of working, giving you the time to build strong processes rather than just clearing the backlog.

About the role

This role places you at the centre of Redgate's customer and vendor security assurance, from completing detailed security questionnaires to leading due diligence on potential suppliers. You'll build the evidence base and relationships that let customers trust how we handle their data, while developing your technical expertise in both our products and infrastructure over time.

● You'll cover the full lifecycle of customer security questionnaires and vendor due diligence, working directly with Sales, Product, Procurement and Legal.

● There's scope to shape how assurance work gets done, including building a central repository of responses and evidence that speeds up future reviews.

● You'll work closely with the Security Manager and Cyber Security Engineer, with a structured route towards more technical security responsibilities such as integration and API reviews.

Join WRITER's security team as a staff detection and response engineer and help protect the AI infrastructure that's transforming how the world works. You'll build sophisticated detection systems that identify attacks targeting our AI platform, training data, and model deployments while creating automated response capabilities that scale with our explosive growth. This isn't just traditional security work – you're defending cutting-edge AI/AGI systems against adversaries who are evolving their tactics as fast as AI itself advances.

This role combines hands-on security engineering with strategic thinking to stay ahead of novel threats that don't exist in textbooks yet. You'll be the operational arm of our security function, translating threat intelligence into real-time detections, coordinating incident response across multiple teams, and hunting for sophisticated attacks across GPU clusters and distributed training environments. If you're excited by the challenge of securing systems that are fundamentally different from anything you've protected before, this is your opportunity to define what AI security engineering looks like at scale.

You'll work closely with our AI Security research team, Cloud Infrastructure, Software Security Engineering, and AI researchers to build a defense-in-depth strategy that protects one of the most valuable AI platforms in the industry. This role can be based inSan reporting to our head of security operations.

  • Design and implement detection strategies that identify AI-specific threats including prompt injection, model extraction, data poisoning, adversarial examples, and unauthorized access to training datasets or model weights across our distributed infrastructure

  • Hunt proactively for sophisticated threats across GPU clusters and training infrastructure by analyzing model outputs for signs of compromise, reproducing AI-specific vulnerabilities from security research, and identifying visibility gaps in distributed training environments before adversaries exploit them

  • Build detection-as-code frameworks with version control and automated deployment, onboard telemetry from AI training infrastructure and inference endpoints, and create dashboards that track model security metrics, GPU utilization patterns, and access to sensitive research data

⭐️ What you need

  • 3-5+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or incident response with a proven track record of identifying and stopping sophisticated attacks in production environments, plus 3+ years specifically securing AI/ML infrastructure, high-performance computing environments, or other distributed systems at scale

  • Strong programming skills in Python, KQL, SPL, or similar languages that allow you to build custom detection logic, automate response workflows, and create tools that operationalize security at scale across cloud-native and distributed computing environments

descriptionHtml:

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Security is a hands-on, delivery-focused team that helps Allica Bank move quickly while maintaining strong, proportionate, and effective security controls.

The team combines day-to-day operational support with continuous improvement, automation, control assurance, and stakeholder partnership across the bank.

We work closely with Technology, Engineering, Product and business teams to make security practical and effective, while ensuring our controls support the requirements of a regulated banking environment.

Role Description

  • The purpose of this role is to strengthen Allica Bank's identity and access controls by making access easier to request, safer to approve and simpler to evidence. The role will combine day-to-day IAM operations with engineering, automation, and continuous improvement to reduce manual effort and improve the security and governance of identity services.

  • The role sits within Security and focuses on Identity and Access Management, primarily across Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Entra Identity Governance, Azure identity, access management and security controls, with support for Google Cloud Platform IAM governance, engineering and automation as that capability develops.

  • The successful candidate will contribute to the day-to-day running of IAM services, including access requests, joiner/mover/leaver activity, access reviews, privileged access, RBAC, application SSO, and application onboarding. Alongside BAU responsibilities, they will identify and deliver improvements to processes, controls, and automation.

  • This is not a purely operational IAM role. The successful candidate will be expected to run IAM services, engineer improvements, automate repeatable work, strengthen controls and help mature identity services across the bank.

  • Experience using automation and AI tools to improve processes, reduce manual effort and strengthen security controls is desirable.

  • Success in this role will be measured through the quality and timeliness of IAM operations, stronger identity governance and evidence, improved automation, and reduced manual effort.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Operate and maintain IAM services, including user lifecycle management, access requests, provisioning, deprovisioning and access changes across Microsoft Entra ID and integrated applications.

  • Manage identity governance and access controls, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), least-privilege access, Conditional Access and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).

  • Manage access reviews and certifications, including reviewer engagement, evidence collection, exception handling, remediation tracking and reporting.

  • Onboard and integrate applications into the IAM/IGA platform, including SSO, SAML/OIDC, SCIM provisioning and secure authentication using Microsoft Entra ID.

  • Support identity-related issues and investigations, working with application owners, Technology, Security and other stakeholders to resolve access issues and manage associated risks.

  • Maintain IAM documentation and operational standards, including process guides, access models, onboarding standards, control evidence, and runbooks.

  • Support wider identity and cloud access services where needed, including Azure identity, access management and security controls, credential lifecycle management, and Google Cloud IAM governance, engineering and automation.

  • Provide clear reporting to Security leadership, highlighting IAM risks, control status, work in progress, blockers, and remediation actions.

  • Support related control and regulatory activities, including Risk Smart Indicators and Data Subject Access Requests, where IAM input or evidence is needed.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Experience in Identity and Access Management, Security Operations, Cloud Security or technical operations, ideally within a regulated or control-focused environment.

  • Good hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Azure identity, access management and security controls, including users, groups, Enterprise Applications, SSO, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management and access management controls.

  • Understanding of IAM principles and controls, including least privilege, RBAC, privileged access, joiner/mover/leaver processes and segregation of duties.

  • Experience supporting access reviews, remediation, audit evidence and operational controls, with strong attention to detail and follow-through.

  • Comfortably balancing BAU operational work with hands-on engineering, including improving processes, writing or adapting scripts, documenting workflows and automating repeatable tasks.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain identity risks, controls and needed actions in plain English.

  • Strong ownership and accountability, particularly where access approvals, evidence, remediation and control outcomes are involved.

  • Understands the importance of effective, auditable controls in an FCA/PRA-regulated environment.

  • Able to consider the end-user experience when designing and improving access processes, balancing security, usability, and operational efficiency.

  • Microsoft identity and governance: Microsoft Entra Identity Governance, Conditional Access, PIM, access reviews and Enterprise Applications

  • Automation and scripting: Microsoft Graph, PowerShell, Logic Apps, Azure Functions or similar automation tooling

  • Azure identity, access management and security controls

title: Senior AI Transformation Lead
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward transformation leads to be part of our early team at Resonance in Berlin. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent, and we're building our Berlin hub to serve clients across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As a Senior AI Transformation Lead in Berlin, you’ll run our most ambitious client engagements across DACH. You’ll own relationships with C-suite leaders, PE sponsors and management teams, and lead a team of transformation leads and AI engineers. You’ll map how a business runs its key processes, find where AI fundamentally changes the economics, and redesign them agentic-first rather than bolting AI onto today’s process. You’ll prototype the new workflows yourself with Claude Code or similar, build the business case, and lead the change through to the people who have to adopt it. Every engagement starts with a value case and ends with the metric that moved in the client’s P&L. As one of our first 100 and one of our first leads in Berlin, you’ll also coach your team, turn each engagement into playbooks the next team starts from, and help shape how Resonance hires, operates and grows in DACH.

What we’re looking for: You’re a senior operator, typically with 5+ years of experience in equivalent roles, including running AI client engagements or transformation programmes end to end. You might be a senior consultant, engagement manager or associate partner at a top-tier strategy firm, a VP or Director on a PE value creation team, an AI director, or an operator who has led a transformation from inside a business. You’re a builder with a deep understanding of technology. You don’t need to write production code, but you use AI every day, prototype with new models and tools the day they land, and know where to challenge your engineering counterparts. Just as important, senior executives trust you with their most important outcomes, you frame hard trade-offs clearly, and you bring resistant organisations through change. We want both in one person. You have extreme agency, operate with urgency, and have consistently been among the very top performers of your peers. PE portfolio or value creation experience, operating experience in software or services, and German for client work in DACH are a plus. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Frontier AI work with real stakes, driving tangible outcomes for consequential companies. A team built to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe, and the autonomy to shape how the firm delivers and grows in Berlin as an early leader. A chance to help close Europe’s AI gap, moving European businesses to the right side of the productivity chasm.

Logistics: Berlin, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in DACH and Europe. English is our working language; German is a plus. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates, start dates are flexible, and we're open to people relocating to Berlin.

Apply

Send your CV and a short note on the transformation you're proudest of leading and the impact it delivered.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

title: Senior AML/CFT Compliance Officer
descriptionHtml:
RULEMATCH has built a digital assets trading and clearing venue with world-class partners to meet the specific needs of regulated financial institutions. By offering significantly more capital-efficient and lower latency trading, RULEMATCH is helping increase institutional adoption and enable the next evolution of the crypto and digital asset market.

To strengthen our compliance function, RULEMATCH AG, based in Zürich, Switzerland, is looking for a Senior AML/CFT Compliance Officer.

In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the effectiveness and ongoing development of RULEMATCH’s AML/CFT framework. You will combine hands-on compliance expertise with sound regulatory judgement, taking ownership of key compliance processes and contributing to a robust control environment in a dynamic and evolving regulatory landscape.

Tasks

  • Take ownership of the ongoing monitoring, maintenance and enhancement of the AML/CFT framework to ensure compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

  • Develop, draft, review and maintain internal AML/CFT policies, procedures and controls.

  • Oversee and perform AML/CFT compliance operations, including participant onboarding, KYC and due diligence.

  • Ensure appropriate documentation and lifecycle management of participant relationships.

  • Review and investigate transaction monitoring and screening alerts, assess potentially suspicious activities and ensure appropriate escalation and documentation.

  • Assess the effectiveness of existing AML/CFT controls and drive continuous improvement of processes, systems and risk mitigation measures.

  • Support regulatory matters, including the preparation of documentation, responses and information required by supervisory authorities.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to embed a strong compliance culture and deliver AML/CFT training across the organisation.

Requirements

  • Several years of relevant professional experience in AML/CFT compliance, ideally within financial services, banking, digital assets or fintech.

  • Strong knowledge of AML/CFT regulatory requirements and their practical application within a regulated financial institution.

  • Experience in developing and maintaining compliance frameworks, assessing regulatory risks and implementing effective controls.

  • Experience in engaging with supervisory authorities or supporting regulatory examinations and enquiries is a strong advantage.

  • Experience with digital assets, digital securities and related technologies is a plus.

  • Excellent written and spoken German and English are mandatory.

  • Strong professional judgement, integrity and the ability to take ownership of complex compliance matters and make sound, risk-based decisions.

  • A pragmatic, business-oriented and detail-conscious approach, combined with an entrepreneurial mindset.

  • The ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities and work flexibly when required.

  • An open-minded, solution-oriented attitude, strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

  • A genuine interest in technology and in optimising compliance systems, processes and technical implementations.

Benefits

  • Annual salary of CHF 150’000 and additional stock appreciation rights to participate in the increase in value of the company.

  • Be part of a venture in a fast-growing market with the ambition to compete with the world's best.

  • Inspiring environment with a focus on excellence, teamwork, and transparency.

  • Competitive pension plan benefits.

Please note that only direct applications will be considered for this position.

title: Senior Application Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Build the Software Foundation for Next-Generation Mobility

At Apex.AI, we develop safety-certified software for mobility systems and intelligent machines. Our products power applications in automotive, trucking, robotics, aerospace, agriculture, and industrial automation. We are looking for a Senior Applications Engineer who combines strong C++ engineering skills with a passion for solving complex customer challenges.

In this role, you will work directly with global customers and internal product teams to design, build, deploy, and support advanced software solutions based on Apex.OS. You will help customers bring real-world systems to production while contributing improvements and features back into our core platform.

This is a highly technical, hands-on role ideal for someone who enjoys deep systems engineering, customer collaboration, and writing production-quality C++ software.

If you thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy solving difficult distributed and embedded systems problems, and want to help shape the future of software-defined mobility, we’d love to talk with you.

This role is located in our Munich office. Authorization to work in the Germany is required.


What You’ll Do
  • Roll out Apex.AI software to customers and provide technical support solutions using Apex.AI products
  • Collaborate closely with customers to understand technical requirements and deliver high-quality implementations
  • Deploy, integrate, and support Apex.AI software in customer environments
  • Troubleshoot complex software, networking, middleware, and embedded systems issues
  • Partner with internal engineering teams to improve product capabilities, usability, and performance
  • Contribute features, fixes, and enhancements directly to Apex.OS
  • Deliver technical presentations, workshops, and customer training sessions
  • Help accelerate customer adoption and success across automotive and intelligent machine platforms

    • What You Bring
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in modern C++
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across complex software systems
  • Experience developing software for embedded or distributed systems
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to work directly with customers and cross-functional teams
  • Experience using modern development workflows and tools such as Git, GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, and issue tracking systems
  • Self-driven and comfortable operating independently in dynamic technical environments

    • Nice To Have
  • Experience in automotive, robotics, aerospace, industrial automation, or other safety-critical domains
  • Familiarity with operating systems, networking, and communication protocols (UDP, multicast, TCP/IP, DDS, ROS/ROS 2)
  • Understanding of real-time systems and automotive software architectures such as AUTOSAR
  • Experience in technical consulting, field engineering, developer support, or professional services
  • Customer enablement or technical training experience
  • Familiarity with build systems such as Bazel or CMake
  • Experience working with Linux-based development environments

    • Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

    The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

    • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
    • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

    Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

    • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
    • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

    Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

title: Senior Associate (European Competition practice)
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analyses that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation.  We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings:  firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid.  We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation effects of damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.  

For more information on the Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in Europe visit our website.

Position Overview

Candidates will be expected to rapidly take on genuine responsibility, assisting Vice Presidents and other senior staff by providing conceptual and practical input to competition case work as required. The role brings with it the possibility of working on some of the largest and most significant competition cases in Europe, playing a key role in the shaping of the cases.

Desired Qualifications

  • First degree in economics and a PhD/DPhil in economics from a well-regarded institution with a strong foundation in microeconomics, preferably with a specialism with large data sets (empirical PhDs) or Industrial Organisation and/or statistics/econometrics), plus up to 3 years of relevant work experience.
    • Non-PhD applicants should have strong academic achievement in a Master's program, plus 5-7 years' relevant work experience;
  • Professional work experience in consulting, business, or with a competition authority strongly preferred;
  • Demonstrated understanding of economic concepts, competition/regulatory authorities, competition policy and quantitative and qualitative analysis methods;
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills;
  • Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership;
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities;
  • Excellent time management and task prioritisation skills.

To Apply

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. To be considered for this position, submit through this job posting:

  • Curriculum Vitae – please include current address, email and telephone number;
  • Covering letter – please describe your interest in a role with CRA's Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in London and how this role matches your goals;
  • Writing Sample (optional) – we prefer a sole-authored submission from an existing work (work product, published article or job market paper) that includes your commentary on a quantitative analysis and/or relevant to the field of economics;
  • Transcripts (optional) - from the most recent academic training (may be unofficial copies).

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Diversity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (Equality Act 2010). As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

The statements included in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

title: Senior AWS Consultant
descriptionHtml:
CloudNation helpt organisaties om het maximale uit de cloud te halen. We combineren diepgaande technische expertise met een pragmatische aanpak en bouwen samen met onze klanten aan schaalbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige oplossingen.

We geloven in doen wat werkt: geen dikke rapporten, maar concrete oplossingen met zichtbare impact. Onze consultants staan midden in de uitvoering, werken nauw samen met klanten en zoeken continu naar manieren om te verbeteren en te innoveren met cloud en AI.

Wat ga je doen?

Als AWS Cloud Consultant sta je midden in de uitvoering:

  • Je ontwikkelt cloudstrategieën en vertaalt businessdoelen naar concrete AWS-oplossingen, op basis van een grondige analyse van de bestaande IT-omgeving en het AWS Well-Architected Framework.

  • Je onderzoekt samen met klanten waar AI echt waarde toevoegt, van slimme automatisering tot generatieve AI met Amazon Bedrock.

  • Je neemt de rol van meewerkend voorman: je stuurt engineers aan en werkt zelf actief mee aan de implementatie van cloudoplossingen.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de delivery binnen scope, stelt een Work Breakdown Structure op en bewaakt samen met de projectmanager de voortgang, kwaliteit en planning.

  • Je coacht en ontwikkelt je team volgens het ‘To do, To participate, To do it yourself’-principe.

  • Je zorgt dat oplossingen schaalbaar, veilig en toekomstbestendig zijn en blijft na oplevering betrokken bij optimalisatie en doorontwikkeling.

Over deze rol

Dit is een senior rol met een duidelijke Customer Lead-overlay. Naast een sterke basis als AWS Cloud Consultant ben jij het vaste aanspreekpunt voor de klant en verantwoordelijk voor de waarde die we samen realiseren, over de hele lifecycle.

Je combineert technische kennis met leiderschap, neemt teams en partners mee en vertaalt cloudmogelijkheden naar concrete impact. Tegelijk bouw je aan sterke, langdurige klantrelaties en help je zowel de klant als het team steeds een stap verder.

Als Customer Lead:

  • Ben je het vaste aanspreekpunt en escalatiepunt voor de klant.

  • Neem je eigenaarschap over de klantroadmap en stuur je op bedrijfswaarde.

  • Ben je verantwoordelijk voor de uitkomsten van de delivery en stuur je bij wanneer resultaten afwijken van de verwachtingen.

  • Vorm je tijdens Continuous Delivery samen met de People & Process Officer het governance-model richting de klant.

  • Vertegenwoordig je intern het perspectief van de klant en breng je collega’s en partners op één lijn.

  • Signaleer je kansen om de samenwerking verder uit te bouwen.

Onze gedachte

We werken volgens ons 6D Delivery Model. Als Customer Lead houd je de rode draad vast over alle fasen. Het zwaartepunt van jouw deliverywerk ligt hier:

DISCOVER, DEFINE & DESIGN

Je analyseert IT-omgevingen, voert Well-Architected Reviews uit en vertaalt businessdoelen naar concrete AWS-strategieën, migratieplannen, roadmaps en toekomstbestendige oplossingen.

DEVELOP & DEPLOY

Als meewerkend voorman stuur je engineers aan en werk je zelf mee aan de implementatie en uitrol. Je bewaakt scope, voortgang en kwaliteit, stelt de Work Breakdown Structure op en neemt eigenaarschap over de delivery, in nauwe afstemming met de klant en projectmanager.

CONTINUOUS DELIVERY

Je zorgt voor een succesvolle oplevering en blijft betrokken bij optimalisatie, innovatie en doorontwikkeling. In deze fase komt de Customer Lead-rol het sterkst naar voren: je bewaakt de klantwaarde en geeft samen met de People & Process Officer richting aan de governance.


Wat neem je mee?

  • Ruime ervaring, doorgaans 5+ jaar, met AWS-services, architectuur en cloudoplossingen.

  • Ervaring met AWS-frameworks zoals Well-Architected, AWS CAF en landing zones, inclusief migraties en optimalisatie.

  • Sterke hands-on ervaring met Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD en het realiseren van AWS-oplossingen.

  • Ervaring met het aansturen van technische teams en het nemen van eigenaarschap over complexe klantprojecten.

  • Je combineert technische expertise met sterk stakeholdermanagement en stuurt op bedrijfswaarde en resultaat.

  • Ervaring met AI-assisted development en AI in je dagelijkse werk, bij voorkeur met een agentic way of working.

  • Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels. Relevante AWS-certificeringen zijn een pré.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een marktconform salaris van 66k-115k per jaar.

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget, laptop, telefoon, pensioenregeling en 26 vakantiedagen.

  • Een persoonlijk opleidings- en certificeringsbudget voor jouw ontwikkeling in AWS en AI.

  • Ondersteuning bij het behalen van certificeringen, waarbij behaalde certificeringen terugkomen in je salaris.

  • Een rol met veel eigenaarschap, waarin je een eigen klantportfolio draagt en stuurt op waarde en groei.

  • Volop ruimte voor innovatie, eigen initiatief en het werken met de nieuwste cloud- en AI-technologie.

  • Hybride werken, met Bunnik als thuisbasis en vrijdag als gezamenlijke kantoordag.

  • Een open en ondernemende cultuur waarin we samenwerken, van elkaar leren en successen vieren.

Over CloudNation

CloudNation, an IG&H company, helpt organisaties versnellen met cloud en AI. Als AWS Premier Tier Services Partner combineren we diepgaande technische expertise met strategisch inzicht om organisaties niet alleen te moderniseren, maar ook toekomstbestendig te maken.

We geloven dat echte impact ontstaat wanneer strategie en uitvoering samenkomen. Daarom adviseren onze consultants niet alleen, maar bouwen en realiseren ze ook: van de eerste strategie tot implementatie, optimalisatie en doorontwikkeling.

AI? Wij maken het werkend.

We geloven in AI voorbij de hype. We bouwen het, passen het toe bij klanten én gebruiken het iedere dag zelf.

  • Claude op AWS: we bouwen veilige AI-gateways in het AWS-account van de klant, met EU-inference via Amazon Bedrock en een AI Center of Excellence eromheen.

  • Een AI-agentframework: we ontwikkelen agentic AI die onze delivery versnelt, bijvoorbeeld met autonome agents die audit-ready Infrastructure-as-Code opleveren.

  • Productie-AI voor klanten: samen met TOPdesk ontwikkelden we TicketBuddy, een GenAI-servicedeskassistent.

  • AI in ons DNA: van AI Readiness Scans bij klanten tot interne hackathons en AI-literacy, we passen zelf toe wat we adviseren.

Interesse?

Wil jij AWS-expertise combineren met technisch leiderschap en verantwoordelijkheid voor langdurige klantwaarde? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Run & Grow
descriptionHtml:
About the Run & Grow:

Run & Grow is where SumUp builds the platforms and capabilities that help merchants discover, join, use, and continue growing with our products. The tribe brings together engineering, product, design, and revenue operations teams around two connected goals: helping SumUp serve and retain merchants, and accelerating acquisition, activation, and engagement.

Our work sits at the heart of SumUp's growth engine. We turn complex challenges across merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, commercial systems, operations, risk, and compliance into reliable products and services that other teams can build on. The systems we create help SumUp move faster, make better decisions, and deliver a simpler experience to millions of small businesses.

Joining Run & Grow means working on high-impact engineering problems with a broad view of the business. You'll collaborate across disciplines and teams, shape the foundations behind important merchant journeys, and help create a more connected, scalable way for SumUp to run and grow.

What you'll do:

  • Design, build, and operate production-grade backend services, APIs, and integrations, primarily using Go.
  • Build event-driven workflows and distributed systems using technologies such as Kafka and asynchronous processing.
  • Define clear service boundaries, data models, schemas, and API contracts that other teams can use confidently.
  • Build capabilities supporting merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, operations, risk, and compliance.
  • Own technical work end to end, from discovery and system design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production follow-up.
  • Modernise existing services and improve reliability through observability, security, failure handling, and incident response.
  • Collaborate with Product, Data, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Sales, Marketing, and other engineering teams to turn complex requirements into practical solutions.
  • Review code and designs, make pragmatic technical trade-offs, share knowledge, and mentor engineers around you

You'll be great for this role if you:

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
  • Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
  • Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
  • Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable fintech, payments, or similar domains
  • Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts
  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
  • Communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and explain technical concepts and trade-offs to different audiences.
  • Value pragmatic engineering, continuous improvement, mentoring, and reliable production operations.

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks.

descriptionHtml:
About the Run & Grow:

Run & Grow is where SumUp builds the platforms and capabilities that help merchants discover, join, use, and continue growing with our products. The tribe brings together engineering, product, design, and revenue operations teams around two connected goals: helping SumUp serve and retain merchants, and accelerating acquisition, activation, and engagement.

Our work sits at the heart of SumUp’s growth engine. We turn complex challenges across merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, commercial systems, operations, risk, and compliance into reliable products and services that other teams can build on. The systems we create help SumUp move faster, make better decisions, and deliver a simpler experience to millions of small businesses.

Joining Run & Grow means working on high-impact engineering problems with a broad view of the business. You’ll collaborate across disciplines and teams, shape the foundations behind important merchant journeys, and help create a more connected, scalable way for SumUp to run and grow.

What you’ll do:

  • Design, build, and operate production-grade backend services, APIs, and integrations, primarily using Go.
  • Build event-driven workflows and distributed systems using technologies such as Kafka and asynchronous processing.
  • Define clear service boundaries, data models, schemas, and API contracts that other teams can use confidently.

  • Collaborate with Product, Data, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Sales, Marketing, and other engineering teams to turn complex requirements into practical solutions.
  • Review code and designs, make pragmatic technical trade-offs, share knowledge, and mentor engineers around you

You’ll be great for this role if you:

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
  • Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
  • Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
  • Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable fintech, payments, or similar domains

title: Senior BI Analytics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer / BI Analyst to bridge the gap between data engineering and business insight. You’ll take ownership of transforming raw data into trusted, well modelled datasets and deliver impactful reporting that drives decision making across the business. This role combines strong technical data modelling skills with stakeholder-facing analytics and BI development.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data models using dbt on Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery)

  • Create and maintain dashboards and explores in Looker, enabling self-serve analytics

  • Translate business requirements into clear data models, metrics, and visualisations

  • Define and maintain core business metrics and data definitions in partnership with stakeholders and the wider analytics team

  • Implement data quality checks, testing, and documentation within dbt

  • Partner with stakeholders across all parts of the business including commercial, product, marketing, finance, and operations

  • Optimise query performance and manage cost efficiency in BigQuery

  • Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics engineering across the wider analytics team

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Previous experience in analytics engineering, BI or data analytics roles

  • Strong SQL skills (expert level, performance tuning experience preferred)

  • Experience working with modern cloud data platforms and distributed data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake)

  • Proven experience with dbt (modelling, testing, documentation)

  • Experience building dashboards in Looker (LookML is a strong plus)

  • Solid understanding of data modelling concepts (star schema, dimensional modelling)

  • Experience working with large-scale datasets

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work with non-technical stakeholders

NICE TO HAVE

  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, especially BigQuery

  • Experience with orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow)

  • Knowledge of data governance and data quality frameworks

  • Exposure to reverse ETL tools (e.g. Hightouch)

  • Familiarity with AI coding assistants and a habit of integrating them into day-to-day analytics workflows

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE LOOKS LIKE

  • Clean, well-documented, and trusted data models used across the company

  • High adoption of Looker dashboards and self-serve analytics

  • Reduced time-to-insight for stakeholders with the use of AI tooling to accelerate delivery

  • Clear, consistent definitions of key business metrics

  • Improved data reliability and fewer reporting discrepancies

    WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • The transformation layer (dbt) and semantic layer (Looker)

  • Core business metrics and reporting definitions

  • Data quality and testing frameworks

  • BI best practices and documentation standards

    WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

    • 28 days annual leave

    • 1 day for your wedding

    • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

    • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

descriptionHtml:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.
From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.
As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.
Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.
We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

Within Brevo, the Finance Department ensures that the company has, at all times, the financial resources required for its development. It guarantees that the company growth remains sustainable and profitable.

The Sales Administration plays a key role in addressing three major challenges for their assigned customer portfolio:

  1. Build and maintain trust-based relationships with clients regarding all billing matters.
  2. Ensure that billing processes are aligned with accounting rules and contribute to their continuous improvement & ensure the Cash collection
  3. Support the sales team throughout the customer relationship lifecycle.

Your impact at Brevo :

1. Client Relationship Management (Billing Focus)

  • Give clients clarity on Brevo's billing model and respond to inquiries on contractual terms, pricing, and invoices.
  • Support sales in resolving billing disputes; proactively flag billing errors, unpaid invoices, or budget overruns to clients and sales teams.
  • Manage administrative follow-up of Order Forms, contracts, and POs.

    • 2. Billing Process Management

    • Register and manage Enterprise subscriptions; issue manual invoices per contract terms, delivered services, and pricing grids.
    • Support monthly closing by preparing the list of invoices/credit notes to issue (1st of each month), ensuring recognized revenue matches delivered services.
    • Monitor outstanding payments using accounting team data.

      • 3. Cash Collection

      • Execute cash collection: monitor, prioritize, and follow up on overdue accounts via email, phone, and other channels (including AI-generated alerts) to reduce overdue receivables and improve cash flow.
      • Resolve and mitigate risk: resolve payment disputes and negotiate payment plans with Sales, CS, Finance, and Operations; anticipate risks and address root causes of delays; manage insolvency proceedings and submit claims when required.

        • 4. Continuous Process Improvement

        • Continuously improve billing and collection processes and tools, proposing enhancements, staying current on best-in-class solutions, joining efficiency working groups, and building AI agents and KPI dashboards to automate work and track performance.

          • 5. Sales Support

          • Onboard new clients on the billing process; assist with PO entry, collection, and budget tracking.

  • Expertise in billing and invoicing processes
  • Experience with billing systems and tools
  • Strong financial and accounting knowledge
  • Proficiency in English is mandatory
  • Rigorous and detail-oriented
  • Strong communicator and a team player
  • Adaptable and responsive to shifting priorities

  • Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.

title: Senior Business Development Lead
descriptionHtml:
About the role

As a Senior Business Development Lead at SkyNRG, you’ll build and grow partnerships with large corporate customers looking to address the emissions associated with their business travel and air freight.

You’ll be responsible for developing new customer relationships and growing existing ones, from understanding a company’s sustainability goals and business needs to shaping proposals, negotiating agreements and closing deals. Working with senior decision makers and colleagues across SkyNRG, you’ll help customers understand how SAF certificates (SAFc) can form part of their approach to reducing aviation-related emissions.

This is a senior commercial role for someone who enjoys building relationships, navigating complex sales processes and turning customer interest into long-term partnerships. You’ll combine strategic account development with a hands-on approach to progressing opportunities and delivering commercial results.

 

Your responsibilites

  • Win new strategic customers and grow existing partnerships.

  • Build relationships with senior stakeholders and guide them through their SAF journey.

  • Lead commercial opportunities from first conversation through to signed agreement, nurturing the relationship at every stage and ensuring a high-quality customer experience.

  • Develop account and engagement plans for high-priority customers and partners.

  • Create new opportunities through networking, outreach, events, and referrals.

  • Share customer and market insights to help continuously improve our commercial approach and propositions.

  • Management of industry initiatives and client-facing campaigns.

  • Work closely with colleagues across SkyNRG to ensure customers receive a seamless experience.

 

Your profile

We're looking for someone who is commercially sharp, curious by nature, and motivated by helping organisations make meaningful progress towards their sustainability goals.

Must-Haves

  • 8+ years of experience in a consultative B2B business development, sales, or commercial role, preferably within SAF, energy, carbon, or similarly complex or emerging markets.

descriptionHtml:

As a Senior Business Transformation Analyst - Quality Management, you will play a key role in shaping and harmonizing quality processes across Intersnack's international manufacturing entities.   • Represent Business Transformation in discussions with Management Units, Group Functions, and external implementation partners.

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration and influence stakeholders across all organizational levels.

title: Senior Consultant - Strategy & Transformation
descriptionHtml:
Location: Amsterdam

Language: English required, Dutch knowledge is a bonus

A little bit about us

Riverflex was founded in Amsterdam and London in 2018 and has grown into a global team of consultants united by one mission: help courageous leaders drive intelligent transformation. We integrate three service pillars – strategy & transformation consulting that Creates Change, talent services that Build Teams, and business-accelerating AI products that Augment Intelligence. We work with top-tier clients including Nestlé, Ahold Delhaize, IKEA, Samsung, Fenix Outdoor and PVH, and we're growing fast.

Your role as Senior Consultant, Strategy & Transformation

We're looking for a highly motivated, experienced strategy and digital transformation consultant to take the next step in a rapid-growth scale-up environment. You'll play a pivotal role in shaping our clients' future success, providing strategic guidance and overseeing execution across consulting projects.

What you’ll be working on

  • Leading and managing workstreams from initiation to completion, keeping objectives on time and on budget

  • Building and maintaining strong client relationships, understanding business challenges and delivering value-driven solutions

  • Conducting in-depth industry and market research, competitive analysis, and benchmarking to identify growth opportunities and shape data-driven digital strategies

  • Developing and implementing digital transformation strategies that help clients put technology to work for the business

  • Guiding and mentoring a team of consultants, fostering a collaborative, high-performance environment

  • Developing actionable recommendations and strategic plans tailored to each client's needs

  • Ensuring the quality and accuracy of deliverables, reports, and client presentations

  • Supporting business development by identifying potential clients and contributing to proposals

  • Staying ahead of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in strategy consulting and digital transformation

Who you are

  • 4–6 years of experience at a top-tier consulting firm, with a focus on digital and/or tech transformation

  • Strong understanding of digital technologies, trends, and their applications in business

  • Proven ability to turn quantitative and qualitative analysis into actionable strategy

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to inspire and guide teams

  • Strong project management skills, comfortable running multiple projects at once

  • A client-focused mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional value and impact

  • Adaptable and always looking to innovate in evolving business contexts

  • Master's degree in business, management, or a related field

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and project management tools

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English (C1 minimum); Dutch is a plus

  • Willing to travel as needed

What we offer

  • A competitive compensation package

  • 25 days off per year, plus a full week off between Christmas and New Year

  • Flexible work from abroad for up to 6 weeks per year

  • Pension scheme to help you plan for your future

  • Learning & Development budget

  • ClassPass membership

  • Access to the latest tools: ChatGPT Pro, Claude, Notion, Sembly, SlideHub and Riverflex's in-house developed software

  • Equity share scheme for long-term team members

  • EU-eligible or open to a Dutch highly skilled migrant visa - we sponsor. 30% ruling support available.

Why join now?

Riverflex is at an inflection point. We've built trusted relationships with some of Europe's most complex organisations, and demand for strategy and transformation expertise keeps growing. This isn't a role where you slot into an existing structure - you'll get real ownership from day one, exposure to blue-chip clients, and the chance to help shape how we scale. If you're looking for a place to do your best work and leave a mark, this is it.

title: Senior Consultant (w/m/d) - Transportation Management
descriptionHtml:
Bei Miebach Consulting erwarten Dich anspruchsvolle Aufgaben entlang der gesamten Supply Chain. Von Anfang an übernimmst Du Verantwortung in spannenden Beratungsprojekten, unterstützt durch ein fundiertes, individuelles Trainingsprogramm. 

Du arbeitest analytisch und lösungsorientiert an komplexen Fragestellungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Deinem Team innovative Lösungen für unsere Kunden. 

In einem dynamisch wachsenden Umfeld entwickelst Du Dich fachlich und persönlich weiter und findest bei uns den richtigen Platz, wenn Du Leidenschaft für komplexe Fragestellungen und smarte Lösungen mitbringst. 

Diese Aufgaben erwarten Dich:

  • Transportstrategien: Du analysierst Transportstrukturen, Prozesse und Kosten und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden Strategien für ein effizientes und zukunftsfähiges Transportation Management

  • Operating Models: Du konzipierst Target Operating Models für das Transportmanagement und gestaltest Organisationsstrukturen, Rollen, Prozesse und Governance sowie die Zusammenarbeit mit Logistikpartnern, 4PL-Dienstleistern und Control Towers

  • IT-Strategien: Du entwickelst Zielarchitekturen und Roadmaps für die digitale Transportsteuerung und berücksichtigst dabei bestehende IT-Systeme, Integrationsanforderungen und zukünftige Entwicklungen

  • TMS-Auswahl: Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in konkrete Auswahlkriterien, bewertest geeignete Transport-Management-Systeme (TMS) und Anbieter und begleitest Ausschreibungen, Systemdemonstrationen und Entscheidungsprozesse

  • Implementierung: Du begleitest die Einführung neuer Transportprozesse und TMS-Lösungen und stellst dabei das Zusammenspiel von fachlichen Anforderungen, organisatorischen Veränderungen und technischer Umsetzung sicher

  • Projektleitung: Du leitest Beratungsprojekte, führst Dein Projektteam und übernimmst Verantwortung für den Projekterfolg, die Qualität der Ergebnisse und die Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden

  • Methodenentwicklung: Du entwickelts unsere Methoden und Beratungsansätze im Transportation Management gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter und teilst Deine Expertise mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen und unseren Kunden

  • Marktbearbeitung und Akquise: Du identifizierst Beratungsbedarf im Transportation Management, baust Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst passgenaue Angebote – vom ersten Austausch bis zur Präsentation unseres Beratungsansatzes


Das bringst Du mit:

  • Abschluss: Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Logistik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang erfolgreich abgeschlossen – idealerweise mit einem Masterabschluss oder einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 5–6 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Transportation Management mit und hast bereits Erfahrung in der Beratung sowie in der Leitung von Projekten gesammelt

  • Fachliche Expertise: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in mehreren der folgenden Bereiche mit: Transportstrategien, Target Operating Models, IT-Strategien sowie in der Auswahl und Implementierungsbegleitung von TMS-Lösungen. Zudem kennst Du die Anforderungen an moderne Transportmanagement- und Control-Tower-Lösungen und kannst die Eignung von TMS-Lösungen für unterschiedliche Kundenanforderungen einschätzen

  • Projekt- & Teamführung: Du strukturierst komplexe Aufgaben, führst Projekt- und Kundenteams und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden praxisorientierte und nachhaltige Lösungen

  • Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du überzeugst durch eine klare und verständliche Kommunikation, moderierst Workshops souverän und förderst eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit zwischen Fachbereichen, IT, Softwareanbietern und Implementierungspartnern

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist flexibel und offen für projektbezogene Reisen im In- und Ausland. Wie häufig Du vor Ort bist, hängt vom jeweiligen Projekt ab

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst für die Arbeit in regionalen und internationalen Projekten sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift


Das bieten wir Dir:

title: Senior contractmanager (domein IT)
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij ervoor zorgen dat belangrijke contracten niet alleen goed zijn afgesloten, maar gedurende de hele looptijd ook daadwerkelijk waarde leveren? En krijg jij energie van leveranciers uitdagen, risico’s beheersen en samen met de business sturen op prestaties en verbetering? Kies dan voor Univé!

Wie zijn wij?

Het mooie van Univé? Dat zijn de mensen, de resultaten, de geschiedenis, de cultuur, het ontstaan en de betrokkenheid. Dat is samenwerken. Een coöperatie zijn zonder winstoogmerk. Dicht bij onze leden staan. En samen bouwen aan een organisatie die betrouwbaar, toekomstbestendig en wendbaar is.

Wij richten ons op het voorkomen van risico’s, het beperken van gevolgen en we verzekeren alleen als het echt nodig is. Coöperatie Univé bestaat uit zeven verschillende Regionale Univé’s, zodat we op landelijk én lokaal niveau altijd dichtbij onze leden zijn. Dat is het mooie van Univé.

Waar kom je te werken?

Je komt te werken binnen de afdeling Inkoop & Facilitaire Zaken, in het team Inkoop & Contractmanagement. Dit team voert binnen Univé de regie op inkoop-, contract- en leveranciersmanagement. Ons doel? Grip op uitgaven en risico’s, professionele en efficiënte processen én optimale ondersteuning van de business.

We zijn volop in ontwikkeling. Inkoop & Contractmanagement groeit verder naar een professionele, businessgerichte en datagedreven regiepartner. Dat betekent dat we niet alleen kijken naar wat er contractueel is afgesproken, maar vooral ook naar de waarde die contracten en leveranciers gedurende de looptijd daadwerkelijk voor Univé realiseren.

Als contractmanager speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol. Je werkt intensief samen met contracteigenaren, management, inkopers, Risk, Compliance en Juridische Zaken. En natuurlijk met onze leveranciers.

Jouw uitdaging

Als contractmanager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren en bewaken van contractwaarde gedurende de volledige looptijd van onze contracten.
Je voert regie op het contract- en leveranciersmanagement van de aan jou toegewezen contracten en leveranciers. Daarbij stuur je op naleving van afspraken, kosten, kwaliteit, risico’s, performance, compliance en duurzaamheid.

Je zorgt ervoor dat Univé grip houdt op de ingekochte dienstverlening en dat afspraken niet alleen op papier goed geregeld zijn, maar in de praktijk ook worden nagekomen.

Daarbij ben je een stevige gesprekspartner voor zowel de business als leveranciers. Je organiseert en leidt leveranciersoverleggen, maakt prestaties en risico’s inzichtelijk en zorgt dat acties daadwerkelijk worden opgevolgd. Zie je afwijkingen, kansen of risico’s? Dan wacht je niet af, maar kom je in actie.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • regie voeren op complexe, risicovolle en/of strategische contracten;

  • sturen op contractnaleving, kosten, kwaliteit, performance, risico’s, compliance en duurzaamheid;

  • organiseren en leiden van leveranciersoverleggen;

  • bewaken van SLA’s, KPI’s, afspraken en verbetermaatregelen;

  • begeleiden van wijzigingen, indexaties, evaluaties, verlengingen en beëindigingen;

  • signaleren en beheersen van contractuele, leveranciers- en continuïteitsrisico’s;

  • initiëren en begeleiden van verbeterplannen, disputen en escalaties;

  • ondersteunen van contracteigenaren en management bij besluitvorming over contracten en leveranciers;

  • opstellen van analyses en managementrapportages over contractstatus, prestaties, risico’s, acties en besluitpunten;

  • tijdig signaleren wanneer hercontractering of een nieuwe marktbenadering nodig is;

  • bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van contract- en leveranciersmanagement binnen Univé.

De inhoudelijke beoordeling van de dienstverlening ligt primair bij de business en contracteigenaar. Jij zorgt ervoor dat deze prestaties periodiek worden beoordeeld en voert regie op de contractuele borging, opvolging en eventuele escalatie. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan één overleg of één contractmoment.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een contractmanager die regie pakt. Je brengt structuur, houdt overzicht en weet wanneer je moet verbinden, adviseren, onderhandelen of juist escaleren.

Je voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waarin verschillende belangen samenkomen. Je kunt schakelen tussen de dagelijkse praktijk en tactisch-strategische vraagstukken en bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor contracteigenaren, management en leveranciers.

Je bent analytisch en risicobewust, maar vooral ook gericht op resultaat. Een contract is voor jou geen statisch document: je gebruikt het als instrument om prestaties te verbeteren, risico’s te beheersen en waarde voor Univé te realiseren.

Je bouwt aan professionele leveranciersrelaties waarin transparantie, voorspelbaarheid, continue verbetering en wederzijdse aanspreekbaarheid centraal staan. Je durft leveranciers uit te dagen en weet tegelijkertijd hoe je een constructieve langetermijnrelatie onderhoudt.

Verder breng je mee:

  • HBO/HBO+ werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in bedrijfskunde, rechten, economie of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen contractmanagement, bij voorkeur domein IT;

  • aantoonbare ervaring met complexe, risicovolle en/of strategische contracten en leveranciers, binnen het domein IT;

  • kennis van contract lifecycle management, leveranciersrelatiemanagement, prestatiesturing en contractgovernance;

  • ervaring met leveranciersoverleggen, prestatiebeoordelingen, contractevaluaties en escalatiemanagement;

  • kennis van risicomanagement, compliance-eisen en interne beheersing;

  • kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving en uitbestedingskaders;

  • bij voorkeur een aanvullende opleiding op het gebied van contractmanagement, zoals CATS, NEVI 2 of vergelijkbaar.

Daarnaast herkennen we in jou initiatief, regievoering, risicobewustzijn en resultaatgerichtheid. Je bent communicatief sterk, kwaliteitsgericht en analytisch, kunt goed samenwerken en beschikt over overtuigingskracht en onderhandelingsvaardigheden op tactisch-strategisch niveau.

Wat bieden wij?

We vragen veel van je, maar daar geven we je ook graag veel voor terug:

  • een salaris passend bij jouw kennis, opleiding en ervaring op basis van een 38-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand;

  • een collectieve prestatiebeloning;

  • een arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd;

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;

  • een studiekostenregeling en volop ruimte om jezelf professioneel verder te ontwikkelen;

  • een goede pensioenvoorziening;

  • hybride werken: thuiswerken is bij ons heel normaal en je hebt de vrijheid om samen met je team je ideale werkplek te bepalen;

  • een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding op de dagen dat je vanuit huis werkt;

  • een laptop en telefoon;

  • korting op schade- en zorgverzekeringen.

Maar minstens zo belangrijk: je krijgt bij ons ruimte om impact te maken. Contract- en leveranciersmanagement is binnen Univé volop in ontwikkeling. Je krijgt daarmee de mogelijkheid om niet alleen contracten professioneel te managen, maar ook actief bij te dragen aan hoe we ons vakgebied verder vormgeven.

Enthousiast?

Wil jij samen met ons bouwen aan professioneel contract- en leveranciersmanagement binnen Univé? Solliciteer dan via de sollicitatiebutton. Je kunt tot en met 30 november 2026 reageren.

Gedurende de looptijd van de vacature kunnen we kandidaten die goed aansluiten bij het profiel alvast uitnodigen voor een eerste gesprek.

title: Senior Control Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

Please note we would require you to be onsite, full-time in Switzerland. For details on the visa requirements for relocating to this exceptional Swiss canton, please get in touch and a member of our team will be happy to advise.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems

  • Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs

  • Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7

  • Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems

  • Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic

  • Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products

  • Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures

  • Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management

  • Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements

  • Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization

  • Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

 

Skills and Experience Required:

  • BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role

  • Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus

  • Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements

  • Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions

  • Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management

  • Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements

  • Proven team player, with the ability to:
    (i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team
    (ii)Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams

  • Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

  • Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus

  • Professional working language is in English.

     

Start date: Immediately
