title: Senior/Lead Lifecycle Marketing Manager (Full Remote - France)
descriptionHtml:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

More than 50 million people already use EverAI’s products, and we’re growing toward 100 million.

The audience is already here. The opportunity is what happens next.

We’re hiring a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to take CRM to an entirely new level. Your mission is clear: turn it into a major revenue channel by converting more users, increasing repeat purchases, and giving people compelling reasons to keep coming back.

You’ll own everything within CRM, from onboarding and first purchase to retention and reactivation, across email, push notifications, in-product messaging, and promotions.

You’ll report directly to Thomas Lacroix, our Co-founder and CMO, with the freedom to rethink journeys, test ambitious ideas, and build the CRM playbook that gets us there.

At our scale, even small improvements can influence millions of user journeys and create significant growth.

If you’re looking for more than a campaign-management role, this is your opportunity to drive measurable growth at exceptional scale.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own one of EverAI’s biggest growth opportunities: lead the strategy and execution across the full CRM lifecycle, from onboarding and conversion through repeat purchasing, retention, and reactivation

  • Find the growth hiding in our user base: use behavioral data to uncover where users lose interest, stop engaging, or miss an opportunity to purchase

  • Crack the first-purchase challenge: create onboarding, abandoned-payment, offer, and follow-up journeys that turn more registered users into paying customers

  • Keep users coming back: increase token purchases, repeat purchasing, retention, reactivation, and LTV through smarter segmentation, personalization, and timing

  • Test big ideas quickly: build experiments, measure what genuinely moved the numbers, scale the winners, and turn each result into the next opportunity

  • Make ambitious CRM ideas possible: work directly with Product, Data, Engineering, and Creative to improve the tooling, tracking, messages, offers, and reporting behind the channel

Your Qualifications

  • You’ve scaled CRM before: you can show significant improvements you personally drove in revenue, conversion, repeat purchases, retention, reactivation, or LTV, with real numbers

  • You understand consumer growth: you’ve worked in a high-volume B2C subscription business, where CRM had a direct effect on revenue

  • You think like a builder: you do not stop at recommendations; you can personally create segments, journeys, experiments, campaign logic, and performance analysis

  • You know how to find and prove what works: you can turn user behavior into ideas and use testing, control groups, attribution, and incrementality to validate the results

  • You move quickly and take ownership: you are comfortable building without a finished playbook, deciding what matters most, and creating momentum without waiting for perfect information

  • You communicate clearly and work across teams: you collaborate directly with technical, creative, and commercial stakeholders in English

  • You are comfortable with our product category: you can confidently work on products powered by uncensored AI models and content

Bonus points

  • You have worked in iGaming, free-to-play gaming, fintech, consumer subscriptions, or high-frequency e-commerce

  • You have experience with token, credit, virtual-currency, bonus, or repeat-deposit models

  • You have built or redesigned CRM in a fast-scaling company

  • You use AI to improve analysis, personalization, experimentation, or content development

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

title: Senior Lead Product Designer, Operations
descriptionHtml:
📍London or UK Remote | 💰£110,000 - £125,000 + Stock Options + Benefits | Hear from the team ✨

⭐Our Design team

We’re a team of 100+ designers, researchers, and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design makes up almost half of our design disciplines, working in tight-knit squads alongside research, product, and engineering to solve real customer problems at scale.

We design for the "magic moments"

We’ve built a bank that feels human, not just functional. Our product is our personality. We blend research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.

Right now, we’re growing fast and looking for passionate designers to shape Monzo’s future and there’s a huge opportunity to make your mark.

The Operations Collective is where we design how help and customer support works at Monzo. We think holistically about the experience of getting support as a customer, and how that connects to the systems, tools, and people behind the scenes.

We’re focused on delivering effortless, tech-led support experiences that can scale as Monzo grows. That means understanding customer problems deeply, preventing support needs where possible, solving issues at their source within the product, and designing seamless journeys whether customers self-serve or speak to a customer support agent. 

AI and automation play a central role, empowering customers to resolve simpler issues independently, and equipping our operations teams with intelligent tools to handle more complex cases with confidence and speed. We design across the full ecosystem: customer journeys, internal platforms, routing, and the foundations that enable us to scale safely.

There’s a real opportunity to shape how help works across Monzo, end to end. 

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

  • Embedding the long-term design vision for support experiences at Monzo, shaping how customer-facing journeys, internal systems, and human service connect into one coherent ecosystem.
  • Leading large, end-to-end design initiatives across ambiguous problem spaces, spanning AI-enabled help experiences, internal tooling, and operational workflows.
  • Designing with a service mindset, understanding what happens beyond the interface and shaping the real-world impact of your design decisions.
  • Designing across touchpoints; from the app, to the phone, to human support.
  • Navigating tradeoffs and guiding strategic decisions in an opinionated way.
  • Coaching the other Ops Collective designers by helping them to embed the vision in their work, running design crits and supporting them to shape their work. 
  • Continuing to raise the bar for design craft and product excellence at Monzo, ensuring your work is a benchmark for quality and innovation across the organisation and our industry.
  • Partnering with cross-functional leaders to define and execute product strategies that translate into actionable plans you help build and ship.
  • Proactively addressing systemic challenges, reducing complexity, and creating better conditions for teams to deliver impactful work.
  • Acting as a visible ambassador for Design, sharing your work and its impact across the company to maintain Design’s place at the heart of Monzo.
  • Mentoring and levelling up designers across the discipline, fostering a culture of growth, collaboration, and belonging.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You’re an expert in your craft, with deep expertise in a specific design discipline and strong foundational skills across all areas of product design.
  • You’re comfortable designing for AI and automation-enabled environments, and excited by the opportunities AI creates to rethink how services operate.
  • You have experience working on complex service ecosystems, where digital products connect to real-world operations, people, or logistics.
  • You’re passionate about improving how humans and technology work together, creating experiences that feel seamless to customers and empowering to the teams delivering support.
  • You have a proven track record of delivering high-impact design work that drives customer outcomes, influences company metrics, and achieves commercial goals.
  • You’ll have excellent visual, UI and interaction skills, and the ability to think through complex interaction design. 
  • You thrive in ambiguity, leading teams to deliver in complex, fast-changing environments while maintaining a high bar for quality.
  • You’re a strategic thinker who can shape product direction across multiple areas and translate organisational goals into clear, actionable plans.
  • You’re a natural collaborator, skilled at working cross-functionally to improve ways of working and deliver greater value for customers and the business.
  • You’re passionate about growing and shaping the Design team, whether through hiring, onboarding, or creating resources that scale your impact across the organisation.
  • You’re pragmatic and proactive, always looking for ways to improve Design’s impact at Monzo while balancing the need to “get the job done”.

🙌What’s in it for you

💰£110,000 - £125,000 + Stock Options

✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.

✅ We can sponsor your visa.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

title: Senior Linux Kernel Driver Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The Role

This role sits at the boundary between host and silicon. The kernel driver is key to keeping pace with our ultra-fast devices on cutting-edge server platforms. It’s a high-leverage layer where each win shows up as real throughput and latency gains.

You’ll be there for the pre-silicon simulations, first bring-up, first end-to-end runs, and the moments where performance jumps because of something you shipped.

What you’ll do

  • Design, develop, and maintain the Linux kernel driver for Fractile’s AI accelerator

  • Build the performance-critical kernel-space paths that keep the host stack moving: PCIe device management, DMA, memory handling, interrupt handling, and robust recovery paths

  • Define and evolve the userspace interface the runtime depends on, with a focus on stability, debuggability, and performance

  • Work in a tight co-design loop with hardware, firmware, runtime and ML engineers: validate assumptions, iterate on behaviour, and close gaps early

  • Improve tooling/workflows so we move fast without breaking things

What we’re looking for

  • You’ve shipped and maintained Linux kernel device drivers in production. Experience with PCIe-attached devices and custom hardware interfaces is ideal.

  • Strong systems and performance instincts. You can reason about computer architecture, concurrency, and where the time goes

  • Excellent C and/or Rust, and a pragmatic approach to building high-quality, maintainable & secure kernel code

  • You enjoy hard kernel and system-level problems, and you take them end-to-end until the measurements move

  • Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Maths, Physics, or related degree and 3+ years of industry experience

Nice to have

  • GPUs / ML accelerators / high‑throughput I/O (NICs, RDMA, storage)

  • Hardware bring‑up or pre‑silicon simulation experience

  • Performance work: profiling, tracing, benchmarking, regression tracking

If you want to build the software where every driver win unlocks huge system performance, come build it together.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Senior Manager, Financial Crime Investigations & Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.

What you'll do

As the Senior Manager, Financial Crime Investigations & Intelligence, you’ll lead proactive, complex, and high-risk anti-money laundering and financial crime investigations across Airwallex’s global financial infrastructure. You’ll act as an investigative subject-matter expert and operational lead, helping identify and mitigate risks across cross-border payments, corporate accounts, cards, FX and embedded finance.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end investigations into complex financial crime typologies involving cross-border payment flows, multi-currency corporate accounts, complex ownership structures, cross-product financial-crime risks, KYB/UBO considerations and high-risk corridors.

  • Oversee case intake, triage, prioritisation and assignment for special investigations, ensuring matters requiring enhanced investigative expertise are resolved thoroughly and within established SLAs.

  • Lead financial-crime-related internal fraud and insider-threat investigations where employees or insiders may be involved in fraud, collusion with external parties, misuse of access or other conduct with a financial-crime nexus. Partner with Fraud, Infosec, People/HR, Employment Legal and senior management. Provide evidence-based findings and risk-based recommendations.

  • Analyse layered international transactions across payment rails including SWIFT, local clearing rails, card schemes and alternative payment methods to trace illicit fund movements, identify beneficial owners and uncover hidden counterparty networks.

  • Provide investigative analysis, suspect and typology recommendations, quality assurance and escalation support for SAR/STR cases, enabling MLROs to make final filing decisions in accordance with local requirements.

  • Translate investigative findings into actionable feedback for Risk, Data and Engineering teams to calibrate transaction monitoring rules, improve automated detection models and address control vulnerabilities.

  • Develop and maintain financial-crime typologies, investigative intelligence and threat assessment based on internal investigations, external intelligence, and regulatory guidance; translate these insights into control improvements, targeted training and intelligence briefings.

  • Partner with Transaction Monitoring, Onboarding and EDD, Sanctions, Fraud, Legal and regional MLROs to address systemic threats and implement coordinated risk-mitigation measures.

  • Build and maintain investigative playbooks, investigative analysis, typology context and case documentation standards and quality-assurance frameworks tailored to B2B fintech, complex law-enforcement referrals, regulatory information request, partner-bank inquiries and partner due-diligence reviews..

  • Support internal audits, independent reviews and regulatory inquiries with clear documentation, case files and briefings on investigative methodologies and outcomes.

  • Provide day-to-day guidance, peer reviews and typology training to investigators and analysts across the broader Financial Crime Compliance team.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 8+ years of dedicated experience in AML/CFT investigations, financial intelligence or special investigations within cross-border payments, global fintech, merchant acquiring or international corporate and commercial banking.

  • Deep understanding of cross-border payment mechanisms, including SWIFT, local ACH and clearing schemes, and FX; business payment flows; merchant acquiring; and corporate entity structures, including complex shareholding, shell companies and beneficial ownership.

  • A proven track record of independently conducting and documenting complex, multi-layered financial crime investigations from initiation through documented findings, risk recommendations and support to the MLRO-led regulatory reporting process.

  • Solid working knowledge of global AML/CTF and sanctions regulatory frameworks, including, where applicable,FATF recommendations, FinCEN/BSA, FCA, AUSTRAC,MAS and other relevant local regulatory requirements.

  • A strong analytical mindset, with experience querying, synthesising and interpreting large datasets of transactional and customer data.

  • Exceptional written communication skills, demonstrated through investigative narratives and SAR/STR drafting, with the ability to articulate complex financial crime risks to non-compliance stakeholders, including Product and Engineering.

  • Comfort working in a high-growth and rapidly evolving fintech environment, managing competing priorities under tight deadlines.

Preferred qualifications:

  • A professional certification such as CAMS, CFE or an equivalent ICA diploma.

  • Practical experience with data querying and visualisation tools such as SQL, Python, Tableau or network/link analysis software.

  • Experience investigating financial crime risks in digital assets or crypto rails, or embedded finance/BaaS integrations.

title: Senior Marketing Manager- Burson
descriptionHtml:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Senior Marketing Manager to help Burson drive visibility, relevance and connection to the clients and prospects we most want to work with.

Sitting at the heart of the UK Growth Team, this is a high-profile role working closely with the Chief Growth Officer and senior leaders across the business. You will help further Burson’s momentum in the UK having been named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026, turning our best thinking, expertise, people and client work into marketing that builds our reputation, creates demand and opens doors.

You will be responsible for growing Burson's reputation and visibility in the market, strengthening engagement with priority audiences and building marketing programmes that support our growth ambitions across all areas of our business.

We are looking for someone with ideas, energy and excellent judgement. Someone who understands what makes senior decision-makers pay attention, knows how to turn complex expertise into compelling stories and can mobilise a busy organisation behind a great idea.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and deliver a focused UK marketing strategy that builds brand awareness, distinctiveness and demand, aligned with business and growth priorities.
  • Strengthen Burson’s profile among priority clients, prospects, industry influencers, business leaders and future talent, positioning us as a modern strategic advisory partner.
  • Build a distinctive thought leadership and editorial programme, turning our expertise, insights, data and senior counsel into timely and compelling content across multiple channels.
  • Identify key moments across the business, media and cultural agenda where Burson can lead the conversation, mobilising experts and building the external profiles of senior leaders.
  • Create an engaging events and experiences programme, including briefings, roundtables, webinars and partnerships that deepen relationships with clients and prospects.
  • Showcase Burson’s best work through case studies, credentials, awards and external storytelling, increasing visibility and recognition for our people, expertise and client impact.
  • Build a modern, high-performing marketing engine, using AI, automation, media intelligence, data and measurement to make marketing faster, smarter and more effective.
  • Partner closely with UK leadership, Growth, practices, capabilities and the EMEA Marketing Team to maximise commercial impact, amplify regional and global programmes, and share the best of Burson UK across the wider network.

Experience that contributes to success:

We're looking for an ambitious marketer who combines the instincts of amarketer, editor and connector, and who likes making things happen.

You'll bring:

  • A strong track record in B2B or professional-services marketing, ideally within strategic communications, consulting, creative, technology or another expertise-led business.
  • Evidence that you have helped build a brand, audience or market position, rather than simply managed marketing activity.
  • Experience developing and delivering high-impact thought leadership, content and integrated marketing programmes.
  • Excellent editorial judgement. You know what makes an interesting point of view, what will engage an external audience and what won't.
  • Outstanding writing and storytelling skills, with an ability to turn complex ideas into clear, engaging narratives.
  • Commercial instinct and an understanding of the relationship between reputation, relationships, marketing and new business.
  • Confidence working with senior leaders, including the ability to advise, influence and challenge constructively.
  • A strong understanding of AI-enabled marketing, together with curiosity about how emerging technology can improve insight, creativity, personalisation, productivity and measurement.
  • Strong knowledge of the communications, marketing and wider business landscape, with a natural curiosity about what's happening in the world.
  • A proactive approach to building external relationships with industry influencers, partners, media stakeholders and senior decision-makers.
  • A bias for action. You spot opportunities, bring ideas and make them happen.
  • High standards and exceptional attention to detail, without allowing perfection to get in the way of momentum.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to bring people together across Growth, practices, capabilities, creative teams and regional marketing colleagues.

What success looks like

You will help create a Burson UK that feelsimpossible to ignore: sharper in the market, faster into important conversations and better at turning our expertise into reputation, relationships and growth.

Success will mean:

  • greater visibility and distinctiveness for Burson amongst priority audiences;
  • stronger engagement with the clients and prospects we most want to reach;
  • a recognisable and consistent flow of distinctive Burson attitude, thinking and expertise into the market;
  • greater visibility for our senior experts and our best client work;
  • marketing programmes, content and experiences that create meaningful conversations and support growth; and
  • a faster, smarter and more measurable marketing operation.

This is an opportunity to help shape not simply how Burson markets itself in the UK, but how the market sees Burson and what we are capable of.

#LI-CY1

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

title: Senior Marketing Manager, Integrated Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution.

  • Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals.

  • Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics.

  • Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation.

  • Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority.

  • Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments.

  • Background working across international or multi-market structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior Match-3 Designer, New Game
descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match-3 Designer (internally Game Designer) to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game.

You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience.

  • Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

What We're Looking for

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

  • A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

  • A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

title: Senior Mechatronics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Lightcast we are enabling scientists to gain a deeper understanding of human health and disease at the cellular level.

Our technology enables the direct, precise interrogation of single cell heterogeneity, interactions and functional behaviours with a level of flexibility and scale that was previously inaccessible. Across a broad range of disciplines from basic and translational research to drug discovery, we provide the freedom to accelerate discovery and apply novel biological insights. 

At Lightcast we are enabling scientists to gain a deeper understanding of human health and disease at the cellular level. Our technology enables the direct, precise interrogation of single cell heterogeneity, interactions and functional behaviours with a level of flexibility and scale that was previously inaccessible. Across a broad range of disciplines from basic and translational research to drug discovery, we provide the freedom to accelerate discovery and apply novel biological insights.  

The Lightcast platform is a benchtop laboratory instrument that uses microfluidics to allow precise and highly flexible control of thousands of aqueous microdroplets using software-generated light patterns. Control systems enable the integrated optical, mechanical, and fluidic sub-systems to perform complex workflows and assays used in the search for drug candidates. 

We are seeking a Senior Mechatronics Engineer to join our team and take a leading role in system design and engineering activities. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience delivering complex systems within a product business through a background in Electronics, Mechatronics or Mechanical Engineering, with an emphasis on designing and debugging systems at the intersection of hardware, firmware and control. You will have: 

  • A strong technical track record in designing complex mechatronic products for function, reliability, manufacture, serviceability and cost  
  • Hands-on and analytical approach to debugging complex systems, problem solving and resolution ownership 
  • Full end-to-end development experience in mechatronic and electronic systems, having worked with development and manufacturing teams to engineer and improve product designs 
  • Deep subject matter expertise and extensive experience in developing and delivering complex measurement systems and instrumentation  

Your responsibilities: 

  • Working with our development, manufacturing and support teams to design, develop, deliver and maintain our platform and microfluidic products 
  • A strong focus on delivering electro-mechanical system architecture designs  
  • Taking a key position in system engineering activities, devising and delivering system tests, functional characterisation and verification tests 
  • Technical review of projects, as a subject matter expert 
  • Technical documentation of design outputs and rationale 
  • Leadership in and advocacy for good product engineering practice, process development, definition and documentation 
  • Leading and participating in risk mitigation, design reviews, verification, change control 

It would be advantageous for you to have any of the following: 

  • Embedded programming experience 
  • Experience using Python or similar programming languages 
  • Experience developing Life science products 
  • Experience developing opto-mechanics, precision motion control and fluidics systems
  • A track record of working in a multidisciplinary environment 
  • Deep knowledge of operating with MCAD and ECAD 

Lightcast Discovery is committed to equal employment opportunity. Learn more about Lightcast Discovery

We have agreements with our preferred suppliers and will not be adding to this list. Any resume submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will become the property of Lightcast Discovery, and will not incur a placement fee.

title: Senior Medical Content Manager (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Wir suchen Dich als Senior Medical Content Manager (x/f/m) als Unterstützung für das Patient Content Factory Team in Berlin.

Doctolib ist Europas führender Health Companion und begleitet Millionen von Patient:innen und Gesundheitsfachkräften auf dem gesamten Kontinent. Wir transformieren die Gesundheitsversorgung, indem wir unsere Plattform mit innovativen Lösungen rund um Prävention und Patient:innen-Empowerment bereichern.

Unser nächster Schritt: Doctolib zur vertrauenswürdigsten Gesundheitskontent-Destination in Europa zu machen. Dafür haben wir das Patient Content Factory Team ins Leben gerufen — ein dediziertes Team, das für alle Inhalte innerhalb der Doctolib-App verantwortlich ist. Dies umfasst Präventionskampagnen sowie personalisierte Gesundheitsinformationen (Artikel, Videos, interaktive Inhalte), die auf verifizierten medizinischen Kenntnissen basieren.

Du verantwortlich für das Verfassen und die Verwaltung von Inhalten für den Health Companion der App — und stellst dabei höchste Qualitätsstandards sicher. Du koordinierst funktionsübergreifende Stakeholder, sorgst für End-to-End-Qualität an allen Touchpoints und steuerst die gesamte Content-Produktion.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du hilfst beim Aufbau und der Pflege des Redaktionskalenders für alle deutschen Gesundheitsinhalte und identifizierst Content-Möglichkeiten basierend auf Patient:innen-Bedürfnissen und öffentlichen Gesundheitsprioritäten
  • Du schreibst und erstellst verständliche medizinische Inhalte für Patient:innen und übersetzt komplexe medizinische Informationen in klare, handlungsorientierte Artikel für das deutsche Publikum
  • Du managst den gesamten Content-Workflow von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung und koordinierst interne sowie externe Content-Writer:innen für eine termingerechte Umsetzung

  • Du trägst zum Aufbau eines Netzwerks aus glaubwürdigen Partner:innen (Institutionen, Expert:innen, medizinische Fachgesellschaften) bei, um die Autorität von Doctolibs Gesundheitsinhalten zu stärken

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

  • Mindestens 4 Jahre nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Bereich Medical Content Writing, Gesundheitskommunikation oder verwandten Feldern
  • Erfahrung im Management digitaler Kampagnen und in der Arbeit mit CMS-Systemen
  • Starker Projektmanagement-Hintergrund mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Stakeholder zu koordinieren
  • Herausragende schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Deutsch sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:

  • Neugier und Interesse an multiformat-Storytelling (Video, interaktive Inhalte) — praktische Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung mit Performance-Measurement-Tools
  • Starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen, funktionsübergreifenden Umfeld zu navigieren

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth
  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das extra Elternzeit (1 Monat) u.v.m. enthält
  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner

title: Senior ML Engineer (AI Research)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

This role is for Nebius AI R&D, a team focused on applied research in AI. Examples of applied research that we have recently published include:

  • applying reinforcement learning for agent training in long-context multi-turn scenarios
  • dramatically scaling task data collection to power reinforcement learning for SWE agents
  • building a decontaminated evaluation for SWE agents that is regularly updated
  • investigating how test-time guided search can be used to build more powerful agents

The results often lead to collaboration with adjacent teams where our research findings are applied in practice.

We are currently looking for senior- and staff-level ML engineers to work on research in areas such as:

  • Guided search and reinforcement learning for agentic systems
  • Reinforcement learning for reasoning models
  • Web-scale problem collection for training agents
  • Efficient model distillation

Some examples of what your responsibilities might include are:

  • Conducting experiments to figure out efficient ways to train a large language model on traces of interactions with various environments
  • Exploring methods of guided generation and search in the trajectory space
  • Coming up with ways to mine relevant data at web scale and figuring out efficient ways to use this data in model post-training
  • Conducting experiments with different reinforcement learning configurations in verifiable domains
  • Exploring methods to train AI agents on tasks with non-verifiable reward signals

We expect you to have:

  • A profound understanding of theoretical foundations of machine learning and reinforcement learning
  • Deep expertise in modern deep learning for language processing and generation
  • Substantial experience with training large models on multiple computational nodes
  • Strong software engineering skills (we mostly use python)
  • Deep experience with modern deep learning frameworks (we use jax)
  • Strong communication and leadership abilities
  • Experience designing, executing, and analyzing machine learning experiments with proper statistical rigor
  • Ability to formulate research questions, design experiments to test hypotheses, and draw meaningful conclusions from results
  • Ability to document research findings clearly and contribute to technical publications or report

Nice to have:

  • Experience with deep reinforcement learning for LLMs, including techniques such as reward modeling, DPO, PPO etc
  • Familiarity with important ideas in LLM space, such as RoPE, ZeRO/FSDP, Flash Attention, quantization
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field Master’s or PhD preferred
  • Track record of building and delivering products (not necessarily ML-related) in a dynamic startup-like environment
  • Experience in engineering complex systems, such as large distributed data processing systems or high-load web services
  • Open-source projects that showcase your engineering prowess
  • Excellent command of the English language, alongside superior writing, articulation, and communication skills
  • Proficiency in contemporary software engineering approaches, including CI/CD, version control and unit testing

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter
descriptionHtml:

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger.

At Flock, we’re transforming the motor fleet insurance landscape with cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights. As a Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter, you’ll play a pivotal role in our mission to deliver smarter, safer, and more cost-effective insurance solutions. You’ll leverage advanced analytics and AI to assess risk, optimise underwriting processes, and create tailored policies that meet the unique needs of our clients. Your expertise will drive our growth, helping us build a future where innovation and excellence in insurance are the norm. If you’re passionate about making an impact, thrive in a dynamic startup environment, and are ready to lead the charge in redefining fleet insurance, we want you on our team!

Your expertise will drive growth and innovation, positioning us at the forefront of the fleet insurance industry. You’ll also work with AI in the underwriting process itself, using it to pull risk data out of submissions and triage cases faster, which leaves your time for the judgement calls that need an experienced underwriter.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK

ESSENTIAL

  • Extensive experience underwriting motor fleet insurance 

  • Track record of building strong and supportive relationships with insurance brokers

PREFERABLE

  • Experience in dealing with large corporate customers

WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary)

title: Senior Product Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Rohlik Group, we are building the future of e-grocery for over a million active customers across the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Romania. We own our entire technology stack — from storefronts and apps to automated fulfillment centers and last-mile logistics.

Within the Customer Experience (CUEX) domain, we own every touchpoint a customer interacts with, from the homepage to checkout and real-time order tracking across web, iOS, and Android. Our five storefronts run on a single product spine with localized content, pricing, and brand layers. We operate as a deliberately tight-knit, high-performing team where a Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, two Product Designers, and a dedicated full-stack engineering team ship fast, iterate constantly, and take full ownership of the end-to-end user journey.

Most interface failures in e-commerce aren’t layout issues — they are communication problems: what is said, in what order, and on which screen. As Senior Product Design Engineer, you will own the end-to-end design of all customer-facing surfaces across five markets. You will also manage our design system, Maia (our AI shopping assistant), and provide the design guidance that powers our automated coding workflows.

Why this role is exciting

  • High-impact Group scope: Design every customer-facing touchpoint across web, iOS, and Android for five international markets, impacting millions of orders.

  • True end-to-end ownership: Lead the complete lifecycle of product design — from initial problem definition and customer research to shipped A/B tests and real-world performance analysis.

  • AI-first execution: Rohlik is an AI-first company. You’ll own the interface design for Maia, our AI shopping assistant, and build the structured design system guidance used by AI coding agents to generate on-brand code without hand-coding interfaces.

  • Direct customer engagement: Lead user research and usability testing sessions directly with real shoppers, rather than commissioning external agencies or receiving filtered insights.

  • High accountability, low overhead: Work in a small, autonomous team where design decisions move straight to production and work that doesn't deliver measured impact is honestly reverted.

What you will own and deliver

  • Customer Surfaces: Own the end-to-end design and UX strategy across web, iOS, and Android for all core journey stages: homepage, search & browse, product pages, basket, slot selection, checkout, and order tracking.

  • Design System as a Product: Own component architecture, design tokens, patterns, and documentation, ensuring our coding agents have precise design guidance to generate accurate interfaces.

  • AI Experience Design: Define the interaction patterns for Maia (our AI shopping assistant), governing when it intervenes, how it presents information, and how it hands over to human support.

  • Experimentation & Analysis: Drive hypotheses, prototype rapidly, and evaluate A/B test results objectively — scaling successful experiments and sunsetting features that miss target performance.

  • Direct User Research: Conduct qualitative interviews, usability tests, and field research directly with customers to continuously uncover friction points.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with the Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, and your peer product designer, while providing design input to Commercial, Marketing, and Operations.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years of experience designing consumer-facing digital products with a strong portfolio of shipped work across both web and native mobile (iOS and Android).

  • Advanced Figma & Design System expertise: Deep, hands-on experience building, scaling, and architecting multi-platform design systems at the token and component level.

  • Data-fluent mindset: Ability to read and rigorously interpret A/B testing data, distinguishing genuine impact from vanity metrics.

  • Fluency with AI tooling: Practical experience integrating AI tools into modern design, prototyping, and design system workflows, along with a clear view of where conversational AI adds real interface value.

  • User research expertise: Demonstrated experience designing, running, and analyzing qualitative usability sessions directly with end users.

  • Strong product reasoning: Excellent communication skills in English (C1 level or above), with the ability to articulate the strategic and behavioral rationale behind design decisions.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience designing production-grade AI or assistant-driven interfaces.

  • Experience contributing directly to code at the component or token level.

  • Background in e-commerce, quick-commerce, online grocery, or last-mile delivery.

  • First-hand familiarity with how German customers shop.

  • Fluency in German or Czech.

What’s in it for you

  • Fair pay, transparent, stable compensation A strong fixed salary with clear rules. No bonus politics. Great work is rewarded openly and fairly.

  • Good food options, fresh, every day Enjoy subsidised meals/fresh food options in the office and regular refreshments like drinks, fruit, and snacks that keep you energized.

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Changing your car should feel like one seamless journey, not a series of disconnected tasks. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be.

We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it.

This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise.

If you want to shape a new consumer product from the ground up, work at the cutting edge of applied AI, and build things that millions of UK drivers could use, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Set the product direction for the Carwow consumer app, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery work with consumers: interviews, usage data, behavioural analysis, to build a precise understanding of where the app can add the most value

    • Identify, prototype and ship opportunities to bring AI into the app: smarter discovery, personalisation and recommendations that actually change behaviour

    • Collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Designer and Engineers as a product trio to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives engagement, retention and revenue, not just activity

  • Design & Engineering Partnership:

    • Work shoulder to shoulder with design to shape journeys and screens from the ground up, and test them with users before engineering starts

    • Work with engineers on the right trade-offs for a native app: release cadence, quality and what to build versus reuse

    • Use AI tools every day in your own work, prototyping, synthesising research and analysing data, so the squad learns faster and ships more

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, data, CRM and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Own the app's success measures and bring clean evidence, including holdouts and controlled tests, to decisions on what to scale, change or stop

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including time owning a consumer mobile app, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics

  • Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox

  • AI-native: you use AI tools daily, you have shipped or prototyped AI-powered features, and you have a clear point of view on where it adds real value for consumers

  • Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve as evidence comes in

  • A proven partnership with design and engineering: you have worked as a product trio and can hold a credible conversation about journeys, architecture and app quality

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in automotive, marketplace or two-sided consumer products

  • Familiarity with habit loops and engagement design in a consumer app: push, onboarding, personalisation

  • Background in scale-up or high-growth environments

  • Experience taking new products to market, including GTM planning and launch

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Step 2: Hiring Manager Call: Experience (30 min)

  • Step 4: Values Interview (45 min)

 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

We are Ocado Group and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About the Role

Storage, Peripherals & Retrieval is the product area behind the automated systems at the heart of Ocado's automated warehouses: the grid, the peripherals and the bots that run on it. Our mission is to develop the world's leading ASRS: highly cost-competitive, reliable, easy to launch and support and suitable for diverse global use cases.

As the Senior Product Manager for Retrieval, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for our bot, battery and charger fleet. Retrieval is the core driver of grid movement - bots transport stock and customer orders between grid locations, stations and ports, meaning every customer order depends on their availability, reliability and cost-effectiveness.

Operating at the intersection of hardware, firmware, wireless and cloud software, you will lead a critical product domain where even a small change to a bot scales across every operational site globally. You will collaborate closely with mechanical, mechatronics, firmware, wireless and cloud engineering teams, as well as manufacturing and field support teams, driving complex problem-solving and cross-domain alignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Vision & Strategy: Shape and execute the product vision for complex initiatives across the bot, battery and charger domain, balancing short- and long-term goals to lower Capex, Opex and lead time.
  • Commercial & Data Leadership: Define key domain metrics connected directly to business outcomes. Manage financial rationale, balance KPI impacts and make informed Build vs. Buy decisions.
  • Execution & Problem Solving: Lead discovery and problem-solving across cross-functional teams, setting high standards for scoping, requirements and data-driven hypothesis testing.
  • Product Adoption & Scale: Build adoption metrics into domain capabilities, monitor usage across customer segments and collaborate with Solutions, Partner Growth and Partner Success teams to drive global rollout.
  • Stakeholder Management & Evangelism: Manage relationships across engineering crafts, leadership levels and external partners. Articulate complex technical decisions clearly and build strong buy-in.
  • Domain Expertise & Leadership: Serve as the recognized go-to expert for Retrieval, providing strategic guidance, mentoring surrounding PMs and stepping into leadership moments for the Product Director when needed.

What We’re Looking For

  • Substantial, battle-tested product management experience owning end-to-end product lifecycles for complex engineering products shipped at scale.
  • Proven track record of leading product discovery, setting product strategy in uncertain environments and making high-impact strategic trade-offs.
  • Strong experience building product roadmaps alongside Design and Engineering peers, owning the business case and ROI.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, UX, Data, delivery teams and external partners or clients.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment and deliver on commitments.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with products that combine hardware and software (e.g., robotics, connected devices or industrial automation).
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other Product Managers.

Benefits

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:

  • Time to recharge: 25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more - and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.
  • Health & wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.
  • Family-first policies: 22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave.
  • Financial support: Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE) and interest-free loans for train tickets.
  • Commuter perks: Cycle to Work Scheme, Car salary sacrifice and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.
