title: Senior Product Manager – Tax and Recs (Europe)
descriptionHtml:
Hybrid role based in our London office (3 days a week)

 

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

 

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe, starting in Ireland.

 

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

 

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

 

If you want to help build the next chapter of Seccl in Ireland and shape the future of investing across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

 

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

 

The role

We’re looking for a Senior product manager to join the Tax and Recs squad in our European tribe. You’ll own how we reconcile client cash and assets, and how we help our clients report their customers’ tax correctly, as we grow across Europe.

Our European strategy has two parts. First, we’re going deep in Ireland, building a full proposition with the products, tax wrappers and pensions that Irish firms and their clients need. Second, we’re building the foundations to spread at speed into more European countries, with a focused offering for each market rather than a rebuild every time we enter a new one. The Tax and Recs squad makes both possible: we can only grow if our reconciliations hold up under regulatory scrutiny and our tax engine is something clients can trust.

You won’t be joining a finished roadmap. You’ll help define it, with real ownership over the problems that will decide how far and how fast we can grow in Europe. You’ll work closely with our Operations, Compliance and Customer teams, and with key European clients. A reliable tax engine is not just a regulatory necessity, it is a genuine advantage when we sell to new firms, so your work will be felt well beyond the squad.

What you’ll own

  • Scaling our cash and stock reconciliations to meet Client Asset Requirements (CAR) in Ireland, so we can grow volumes with confidence

  • Making sure our Operations team’s processes work in Europe and scale as we do

  • Building the tax reporting and tax engine for Ireland, so our clients can report tax correctly on behalf of their customers across the wrappers that matter to Irish firms

  • Localising that foundation to each wrapper and each country across Europe, rather than starting again every time

  • Connecting directly to tax authorities where a country requires us to pay tax on behalf of our clients’ customers

  • Making our tax engine reliable, transparent and easy to build on, so tax becomes a reason firms choose Seccl

  • Defining and prioritising the Tax and Recs squad’s roadmap, balancing what Ireland needs today with what the next European markets will need

  • Translating regulatory requirements, including CAR and Irish tax rules, into clear product requirements with Compliance

  • Breaking down complex problems like localising a tax engine into clear, actionable plans with engineers and other stakeholders

  • Using quantitative and qualitative data, such as break rates, exceptions and resolution times, to make evidence-based decisions

This role’s for you if...

  • You have a track record of owning a product area end to end, ideally in reconciliations, custody, investment operations or tax in a regulated environment (e.g. fintech, banking, investments, pensions, insurance)

  • You understand client money and money flow

  • You’re comfortable operating in 0→1 or highly ambiguous environments where structure doesn’t yet exist

  • You can bring clarity to complex, undefined problems and turn them into actionable plans

  • You’re highly proactive: you create momentum rather than wait for direction

  • You’re customer-obsessed, with a focus on improving workflows and outcomes

  • You thrive in cross-functional environments, working comfortably with Operations, Compliance, Customer and Engineering, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 As salary between £75,000 and £90,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with some flexibility around bank holidays, plus your birthday off

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 Annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

 

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

 

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

 

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

 

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

 

  • First stage – 45 mins competencies-based interview with the hiring manager + team member

  • Second stage – one-hour technical focused interview, we will share a case study task in advance for you to present back to us on

  • Final stage – 45 mins bar-raiser culture-based interview

     

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

 

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

 

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

Compensation: £75K – £90K

title: Senior Quality Engineer, Chassis and Powertrain
descriptionHtml:
Czinger Vehicles is redefining the future of automotive design and manufacturing. Founded in 2019, we're pioneering a new era of performance vehicles through revolutionary, proprietary technology that blends human-AI design with sustainable manufacturing. Our flagship 21C hypercar, celebrated as the world’s fastest production vehicle and for its record-setting runs at Goodwood Hill Climb, Circuit of the Americas, and Laguna Seca, showcases the innovation behind over 550 patents in AI-driven generative design, materials, and additive manufacturing. With our three core pillars of dominating performance, iconic design, and revolutionary technology, Czinger is at the intersection of deep technology, consumer products, and high-performance branding. We invite you to join our world-class talent in shaping the future of the automotive industry. Here, you'll be part of a groundbreaking journey that pushes the limits of performance, design, technology, and sustainability. 

Purpose

The Senior Quality Engineer is responsible for driving quality performance across the assigned products and supplier base throughout the full product lifecycle, from supplier development and production readiness through launch, current production and issue resolution.

The primary responsibility for this role is the Chassis vehicle system, with additional execution support for selected Powertrain suppliers and activities within the UK, including the Powertrain Controls interface. The role requires a high level of ownership, practical judgement and technical understanding.

Effective cross functional collaboration to identify quality risks early, develop effective solutions and ensure robust implementation. Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and suppliers, the Senior Quality Engineer will take ownership of quality concerns, drive supplier performance and support the continuous improvement of Quality Engineering processes, standards and practices.

The Role

Supplier Development & Production Readiness

  • Support supplier selection by assessing manufacturing capability, process maturity and identify key quality risks and required actions before supplier nomination.
  • Apply the Supplier Qualification Framework and lead or coordinate the appropriate APQP, PPAP, audit and production-readiness activities.
  • Review key manufacturing controls, including FMEAs, Control Plans, inspection strategy, process capability and validation evidence, challenging gaps and driving actions where controls are not adequate.
  • Drive supplier-development actions and ensure significant supplier or manufacturing changes receive appropriate validation and requalification before implementation.

Supplier Execution & Current Quality

  • Own Quality Engineering follow-up for assigned suppliers and components  after launch, monitoring performance and emerging risks, proactively driving improvement.
  • Lead containment, root-cause analysis and corrective action for significant supplier-related concerns, verifying sustainable prevention of recurrence, including clear ownership, timing and evidence of effectiveness.
  • Determine when supplier visits, additional controls, escalation or supplier-development activities are required, using risk and data to determine the appropriate level of response.
  • Own and coordinate incoming inspection requirements for assigned parts when defined by the Supplier Qualification Framework or required as part of issue containment, including stock checks, increased inspection and verification of subsequent purchase orders until confidence in product quality is restored.
  • Provide local UK execution support for selected Powertrain suppliers while maintaining alignment with the Powertrain system owner and relevant Engineering teams.

Product Quality & Ticket Management

  • Own and coordinate the Product-quality ticket landscape for the assigned vehicle system, including Issues, Enhancements, FAR’s (Field Action Requests) and other applicable concerns.
  • Ensure concerns are clearly defined, prioritised and progressed with appropriate containment, technical ownership and corrective action.
  • Coordinate resolution across Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and suppliers, clearly escalating significant or ageing risks when progress is insufficient.
  • Maintain alignment between supplier-level actions and Product-level resolution, including support to Powertrain activities when assigned.

Quality Documentation & Standards

  • Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of Quality Engineering standards and documentation, using lessons learned from practical supplier and product quality experience.
  • Ensure applicable requirements are understood and consistently deployed internally and within the supplier base.
  • Capture lessons learned from supplier and Product-quality concerns into standards covering areas such as qualification, APQP/PPAP, inspection, critical characteristics, supplier changes and structured problem solving.
  • Promote effective and proportionate quality controls without unnecessary complexity or bureaucracy.

Basic Qualifications

  • Strong ownership and a track record of taking complex issues through to effective closure, with the ability to work independently and make sound decisions in a fast-moving environment.
  • Practical experience in Quality Engineering, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Engineering or a related technical environment, ideally within a high-complexity manufacturing environment.
  • Hands-on experience working with suppliers and manufacturing processes, with sound structured problem-solving capability.
  • Working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans and production-process qualification, with the ability to apply these tools practically and proportionally.
  • Ability to understand engineering drawings, specifications and technical requirements, and translate them into practical quality controls. Previous GD&T experience is a plus.
  • Confidence working cross-functionally and constructively challenging suppliers or internal stakeholders when required, whilst maintaining effective working relationships.
  • Ability to prioritise in a fast-moving environment, combining a practical, data-driven approach with sound judgement, and focus effort on the highest quality risks.
  • Strong communication, curiosity and willingness to develop a detailed understanding of the product and manufacturing process, with the ability to communicate technical quality risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within automotive, motorsport, aerospace or other high-complexity manufacturing environments is essential.
  • Chassis or Powertrain experience is advantageous but not essential where strong transferable technical capability can be demonstrated.
  • Experience with low-volume, high value, high performance and technically complex products is particularly relevant to the role.

title: Senior Quality Engineer - MONOPOLY GO!
descriptionHtml:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Quality Engineer to join the MONOPOLY GO! team. The role can be based remotely in the UK, or in Barcelona or Seville on a hybrid basis, with three days a week in the office.

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day—whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating across the games industry, connecting millions of players around the world every day.

The MONOPOLY GO! Tech Vertical develops the platforms, services, and engineering capabilities that support a reliable, responsive mobile gaming experience.We are building a Quality Engineering organization that embeds quality throughout development through automation, continuous validation, and shared engineering ownership.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Quality Engineer who enjoys writing code, solving complex problems, and building tools that help teams deliver with confidence. Reporting to the Quality Director of Tech, you will help establish our QE capabilities through hands-on development of automation frameworks, test infrastructure, and quality insights across mobile, Unity, APIs, integrations, performance, and CI/CD.

You will help build our Quality Engineering capabilities incrementally, prioritizing the areas of greatest risk and value with the team. We are building these capabilities while supporting an active live-service game. You will take ownership of immediate testing needs, including manual, exploratory, and release validation, while developing sustainable automation and tooling. A willingness to test directly is essential. You will use what you learn to guide automation priorities, while recognizing the continuing value of exploratory testing, and develop practical AI capabilities that improve engineering effectiveness.

What You Will Do

  • Build reusable engineering solutions. Write, review, debug, and maintain automation frameworks, tools, and test infrastructure that other engineers can adopt and extend.
  • Improve testability from the start. Participate in technical design and code reviews to identify risks early and improve test hooks, service interfaces, and diagnostic capabilities.
  • Balance building with hands-on testing. Perform manual, exploratory, and release testing where automation is not yet available or direct investigation provides greater value. Meet current delivery needs while building sustainable solutions.
  • Develop mobile and Unity automation. Automate Android, iOS, and Unity workflows, accounting for device differences, application lifecycle events, network conditions, and client performance.
  • Strengthen API and integration testing. Validate backend services, service contracts, client-server interactions, data integrity, and failure recovery through reliable automated tests.
  • Validate player-state consistency and recovery. Test interrupted sessions, reconnects, retries, and client-server synchronization to help protect player progress and data integrity.
  • Investigate failures across systems. Use logs, metrics, traces, crash reports, and telemetry to investigate client, backend, and integration failures, support root-cause analysis, and turn findings into regression coverage.
  • Validate mobile and backend performance. Profile frame rate, memory usage, application startup, crashes, and responsiveness. Develop backend load, stress, and endurance tests, establish meaningful baselines, and investigate bottlenecks and regressions with engineers.
  • Apply risk-based testing. Prioritize validation by player impact, technical complexity, change scope, and failure history. Combine service-level tests, targeted end-to-end automation, and exploratory testing.
  • Integrate validation into CI/CD. Deliver reliable automated feedback, useful diagnostics, and maintainable quality checks. Improve test stability and execution time, with clear ownership of failures.
  • Improve test data and environments. Build utilities, fixtures, and repeatable setup processes that make testing dependable and defects easier to reproduce.
  • Develop AI-assisted quality workflows. Build and evaluate solutions for test generation, failure triage, regression selection, and coverage analysis, with human review and measurable outcomes.
  • Strengthen telemetry validation and quality visibility. Partner with engineering and analytics to validate telemetry accuracy, completeness, duplicates, schema changes, and data freshness. Query large datasets to investigate issues and build quality dashboards that inform risk assessment and release decisions.
  • Help establish the QE organization. Contribute standards, documentation, reusable patterns, and mentoring. Partner with developers, Quality Analysts, and technical leaders to strengthen shared ownership of quality.

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrated quality engineering, software development in test, or software engineering experience, including hands-on ownership of automation used by other engineers.
  • Strong programming skills in C# or Python, with the ability to work effectively in Unity and automation codebases. Experience in source control, code reviews, debugging, and maintainable software design.
  • Practical experience testing and automating Android and iOS applications, including device coverage, operating system differences, and unreliable network conditions.
  • Experience developing API and integration tests, diagnosing failures across services and data flows, and integrating reliable automated tests into CI/CD.
  • Working knowledge of performance, risk-based, and exploratory testing, with sound judgment about what to automate and when to investigate directly.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and practical experience with telemetry and big data, including querying large datasets, validating events and data pipelines, and using findings to guide testing and release decisions.
  • Experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and the ability to evaluate the accuracy and usefulness of their outputs.
  • Strong ownership and collaborative problem-solving, with the ability to turn ambiguous needs into practical solutions. A passion for quality, mobile games, AI, and technology.
  • Advanced professional proficiency in spoken and written English, sufficient to participate independently in technical discussions, explain engineering decisions, and write clear documentation with global teams.

Additional experience we value

  • Hands-on experience with Unity, C#, Unity Test Framework, or automated testing of Unity-based mobile games.
  • Experience with live-service games, player-state consistency, reconnect behavior, live configuration, or client-server synchronization.
  • Experience with mobile device farms, observability, quality dashboards, or establishing QE capabilities within a growing team.

What success looks like

Teams receive faster, more trustworthy feedback and clearer visibility into release risk. Immediate testing needs are met while dependable automation grows around critical player journeys and integrations. Performance regressions surface earlier, failures are easier to diagnose, and repetitive effort decreases. Your tools are maintained, documented, and adopted by other engineers, and AI capabilities demonstrate measurable value.

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

title: Senior Quantum Applications Architect
descriptionHtml:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. 

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. 

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. 

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström. 

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. 

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real. 

Job Summary:

Within the Quantum Algorithms team, we develop and adapt quantum algorithms, identify and scope promising use cases, and analyze their resource requirements. In this role, you will translate computational tasks into abstract quantum-algorithm specifications, analyze their asymptotic performance, and define meaningful problem instances that lie beyond the practical reach of classical computation. You will also work closely with PsiQuantum’s Compilation team to develop explicit implementations of these algorithms and evaluate their resource requirements on our architecture. 

In this position, you will be expected not only to conduct outstanding individual research, but also to formulate and lead broader research programs that draw on the work of other researchers and collaborators. You will contribute to cross-team initiatives spanning PsiQuantum’s applications, architecture, and compilation efforts, helping to connect algorithm design with the practical requirements of fault-tolerant quantum computation. 

The role will also involve external collaboration. You will have the opportunity to lead projects with industrial and research partners, working with domain experts to identify important computational challenges, formulate them as well-defined problems, and map them to appropriate quantum algorithms. Success in this work requires the ability to communicate across disciplinary boundaries and to move fluently between real-world applications, mathematical abstractions, algorithmic complexity, and implementation-level resource analysis. 

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with scientific leadership, intellectual independence, and a collaborative mindset. They will be comfortable shaping open-ended research directions, assessing the practical significance of algorithmic advances, and guiding projects from the initial identification of an application through to a concrete fault-tolerant quantum algorithm and a detailed resource estimate. 

Responsibilities:

  • Propose initiatives into research and development of quantum algorithms tailored for fault-tolerant quantum computers; act as primary contributor to research programs beyond the current state of the art in quantum algorithms design.
  • Work closely with external partners to instantiate, validate and optimize quantum algorithms for use cases across a variety of domains, such as life sciences, industry and sustainability.
  • Establish families of benchmarks and problem instances to validate post-classicality of quantum algorithms.
  • Guide both the simulation and analysis of resource requirements for fault tolerant implementation of quantum algorithms in photonic quantum computing.

Experience/Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of research experience (academia or industry) in the field of quantum computing, with focus on algorithms and applications.  
  • A degree in Physics, Math or Computer Science or equivalent is required. PhD in Physics, Math or Computer Science, with a focus on quantum information theory or quantum computation will be preferred. 
  • Experience with quantum algorithms and compiling in the regime of fault tolerant gates preferred.
  • Experience working with partners in academia or industry to analyze real-world quantum applications of interest preferred.
  • Proven team player with an ability to work effectively across departments, sites and time zones.
  • Ability to work independently and contribute to fast-moving start-up environment.
  • Experience programming in Python, C++ or similar languages.

title: Senior Robotics Autonomy Engineer - Planning, Decision & Intercept
descriptionHtml:
Building autonomous supremacy systems in Berlin

Promethion Industries is a European defence technology company building autonomous supremacy systems for aerial and multi-domain operations. We design tightly integrated autonomy stacks in Europe to enable decisive autonomy for NATO-aligned forces, focusing on defensive and counter-system capabilities including anti-UAS and resilient autonomy under contested conditions.

We are looking for a Senior Robotics Autonomy Engineer to build the intelligence that turns mission objectives, target information and vehicle state into executable autonomous behaviour.

Your mission with us

  • Build the autonomy layer of our high-speed aerial robotic systems.

  • Convert mission objectives, target state and vehicle state into real-time actions and trajectories.

  • Develop algorithms for dynamic rendezvous, pursuit, interception and terminal approach.

  • Build target-motion prediction and intercept-point estimation for moving airborne targets.

  • Develop real-time path planning, trajectory generation and replanning under uncertainty.

  • Account for aircraft capabilities, energy, maneuverability, sensing uncertainty and changing target behaviour.

  • Build decision and behaviour logic that allows the system to adapt continuously during a mission.

  • Combine classical robotics, optimization, MPC and learned approaches where appropriate.

  • Explore reinforcement learning, imitation learning and policy-based autonomy where they provide meaningful advantages.

  • Work closely with perception, estimation and control engineers to close the autonomy loop.

  • Take algorithms from simulation into real aircraft and validate them through repeated flight testing.

Your contribution to the team (required)

  • Strong robotics or autonomous-systems background with significant real-world deployment experience.

  • Strong experience with motion planning, trajectory generation or autonomous decision-making.

  • Deep understanding of kinematics, dynamics and optimization.

  • Experience with dynamic environments and moving-target problems.

  • Experience with trajectory optimization, optimal control, MPC or comparable approaches.

  • Strong C++ skills and good Python skills.

  • Experience deploying autonomy algorithms onto real robotic systems.

  • Strong understanding of uncertainty and its implications for decision-making and planning.

  • Ability to design algorithms that operate under real-time compute constraints.

  • Hands-on attitude and willingness to participate directly in flight testing and system debugging.

Big plus

  • UAV / fixed-wing autonomy.

  • High-speed aerial robotics.

  • Rendezvous, pursuit or intercept problems.

  • Target-motion prediction.

  • Aggressive flight.

  • Reinforcement learning on real robots.

  • Imitation learning / learned policies.

  • PX4.

  • ROS2.

  • Optimal control and trajectory optimization.

  • Aviation, defence or space systems.

Even if you don’t tick every box, we encourage you to apply - we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
As a Security Operations Engineer, you will help protect DiliTrust's SaaS platform, cloud infrastructure, networks and production environments. You will join the Infrastructure & Security team, a 12-person team spread across France, Canada and Spain, and work in an international context (Europe, North America and EMA). The infrastructure you will secure is managed in an automated way and counts more than 350 assets hosted across our cloud providers.

You will contribute to the continuous improvement of our security posture through monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, hardening and automation, and you will work closely with infrastructure, DevOps, development and product teams so that security is embedded into our architectures, operations and delivery processes.

Missions:

In this role, your main responsibilities will include:

Security monitoring & incident response

· Monitor the security of networks, cloud infrastructure, systems, applications and endpoints.

· Administer, configure and continuously improve our security tools, including CNAPP, SIEM, EDR, bastion, ZTNA, PKI, antivirus and WAF solutions.

· Continuously evolve our detection mechanisms and threat-detection scenarios.

· Investigate security alerts and incidents, support incident handling, and contribute to root-cause analysis, remediation and post-incident reviews.

Hardening, vulnerabilities & secure architecture

· Implement hardening measures and support vulnerability identification, prioritization, remediation and follow-up through action plans.

· Validate the security aspects of IT architectures and application projects.

· Actively participate in security audits and penetration tests: scoping, support during the exercise, remediation of findings and follow-up.

· Test products and run technical validations on prototype environments before they reach production.

Automation & Infrastructure as Code

· Automate deployments and security / infrastructure operations using Infrastructure as Code, configuration management and scripting.

· Create and maintain security procedures, incident-response playbooks, operational documentation and technical standards.

Roadmap, watch & knowledge sharing

· Define and deliver the team's security roadmap together with the Hiring Manager and your peers.

· Keep an active watch on threats and security news, and share what you learn with the team.

Candidate Profile:

Experience & seniority

· You have at least 5 years of professional experience in Security Operations, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure Security, Cloud Security or a related field (network, systems or cloud engineering with a strong security component).

· You have practical experience with security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, system hardening and operational security.

Mindset & collaboration

· You are passionate about cybersecurity and interested in automation and the DevOps culture; you would rather automate a process than repeat it.

· You are analytical, autonomous, versatile and rigorous, with a strong sense of service and good synthesis skills.

· You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and you are confident in your expertise without losing the team spirit.

· You enjoy working collaboratively in an international, distributed team and have a good command of English.

Technical Skills:

Required

· Good knowledge of Linux (Debian-based environments in particular), Docker and Kubernetes;.

· Good knowledge of networking, enough to design, routing and firewall rules: TCP/IP, DNS and TLS; static routing, VLANs, segmentation and NAT; stateful and application-level firewall rule design; reverse proxies and load balancers; VPN and overlay technologies (WireGuard, IPsec); ZTNA principles (identity-aware access, device posture, micro-segmentation); cloud networking (VPC, peering, private endpoints).

· Ability to manage network and security configurations as code, using Infrastructure as Code and automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible and AWX.

· Good knowledge of PKI and certificate management: CA hierarchies, certificate lifecycle (issuance, renewal, revocation, automation), TLS / mTLS, key and secret management.

· Administration of security tools: CNAPP, SIEM, EDR, bastion, ZTNA and PKI, including interpreting security events and alerts.

· Hands-on experience with WAF (policy and rule tuning).

· Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana and Datadog.

· Ability to script and automate repetitive operational or security tasks.

Nice to have

· Knowledge of Google Cloud Platform or an equivalent cloud environment.

· An active interest in security news, emerging threats, conferences and meetups.

Our Security & Infrastructure Environment:

· Cloud: Google Cloud Platform and other cloud providers, with automated infrastructure management (700+ assets)

· Systems & containers: Linux (Debian), Docker, Kubernetes

· Automation: Ansible, AWX, Terraform

· Network & access: ZTNA, bastion

· Security tooling: SIEM, EDR, WAF, antivirus, PKI

· Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog

Process:

· Interview with a member of the Talent Acquisition team (30–45 minutes)

· Technical interview with the SecOps Team Lead and the Team manager, including a practical case study (about 90 minutes)

· Final interview with the CTO (30 minutes)

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Engineer

Location: Bristol, London or Edinburgh (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Senior Engineer I - Senior Engineer II

Team: Engineering

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Software Engineering Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

The role

You’ll join the Kaluza Technology community: a large team of product-focused and data-led Product and Platform Engineers working at serious scale. Our ecosystem is diverse depending on the team, spanning TypeScript on AWS, Go on GCP, and Scala, so we index on product-minded problem solving over language purity. As a Senior Engineer you’ll own a slice of the product end-to-end, from the first design conversation to running it in production, and you’ll build it with AI coding agents as your default. We’re looking for someone whose judgement is worth more than their typing speed.

Engineers at Kaluza build with AI, and we mean that practically. From your first day you’ll have paid access to Claude Code, with a budget we don’t ration, and MCP access to the systems you need. Our tooling and conventions are evolving quickly, and you’ll have a heavy hand in defining how we build moving forward.

What you’ll do

  • Own a slice of the product end to end: shape the problem with product and design, build the interface and the services behind it, ship it, and run it in production.

  • Work across the stack over time: depending on the team you’ll work across the interface people use, the services behind it, and the APIs between them, in whatever stack your team runs.

  • Build with AI coding agents as your default: break work down so agents can execute it, direct them, review what they produce as carefully as a colleague’s PR, and maintain the tests and guardrails that let agent-written code merge safely.

  • Stay close to the people who use what you build, directly or through our forward-deployed engineers: a supplier’s operations team, a customer plugging in a car at night. Instrument what you ship so you can see how it’s used, and turn what you learn into shipped changes.

  • Make good work the default: shape the codebase, conventions and automated checks so that agents and new teammates produce the right thing without anyone catching it in review.

  • Mentor, review, and share what you know.

What you’ll bring

These are the practices and behaviours we see most in our top engineers and value deeply, but we don't expect everyone to tick every single box. If you're excited by the role and can see yourself thriving here, we’d love to hear from you.

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Experience shipping production software: You bring real depth to either the front or back end of a modern stack, and potentially an openness to stretch across both as you navigate our diverse ecosystem.

  • A daily agentic development practice: You build with tools like Cursor or Claude Code, can walk us through work you’ve shipped this way, and review AI output as rigorously as a colleague’s PR.

  • Able to navigate a complex, high-stakes domain: You keep complex energy logic legible across microservices, knowing exactly when to use sync vs async to prevent cascading failures.

  • Cloud and operational ownership: You're comfortable deploying on major cloud platforms using shared tooling. You fully own your software in production, which includes participating in an out-of-hours on-call rota.

  • Strong product sense: You relentlessly ask "why" before building, and can point to times when direct user feedback or metrics materially changed what you ultimately shipped.

  • Clear written communication: You write specs, PR descriptions, and post-mortems with enough clarity and context that either a human teammate or an AI agent can immediately act on them.

  • A multiplier for your team: You mentor peers and proactively shape how the team works; introducing conventions, checks, or shared context that makes everyone else’s output consistently better.

Nice to have: you’ve built tooling around coding agents (MCP servers, skills, CI checks); experience in energy or another real-time, regulated domain.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Senior Spacecraft Thermal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are seeking an experienced Senior Spacecraft Thermal Verification Engineer to join our Thermal Control System team. You will be the technical lead for the preparation, execution and exploitation of thermal verification activities by test across the Nyx program. You will own spacecraft-level thermal test campaigns, including Thermal Vacuum (TVAC) and Thermal Balance testing, support AIT with the Thermal Control System Flight Model integration and verification, coordinate thermal qualification activities with other sub-systems, and ensure compliance with spacecraft verification requirements.

You will work closely with System Engineering, AIT, Test facilities, Program, Avionics and Propulsion. You will be part of the TCS & ECLSS Team and will report to the Principal Thermal Control System Engineer.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Thermal Vacuum and Thermal Balance Campaigns

  • Define test objectives, verification logic and success criteria of the Nyx system TVAC campaign

  • Develop test plans, test procedures and operational concepts with other functional chains and AIT

  • Prepare and lead Test Readiness Reviews, Test Review Board and NCR Board

  • Lead test logic and execution of spacecraft, subsystem and components thermal test campaigns.

  • Drive anomaly and NCR investigations and technical decision-making during testing.

  • Present campaign status and recommendations to project leadership.

  • Deliver test reports and verification evidence packages

Own Thermal Test Verification Strategy

  • Ensure thermal requirements are properly verified through test, inspection or demonstration.

  • Build and maintain verification events.

  • Drive verification closure toward Qualification Review and Flight Readiness Review.

  • Support Technical Reviews, Design Reviews and Qualification Reviews.

  • Ensure TCS verification activities by tests remain aligned with program priorities, schedules and risks.

Support Flight Model Integration and AIT

  • Work alongside AIT teams during spacecraft assembly and integration.

  • Define thermal instrumentation strategies and test configurations.

  • Support installation, verification and troubleshooting of thermal hardware.

  • Participate in integrated spacecraft functional testing.

  • Support leak testing, functional testing, fluid loop commissioning and system check-outs.

Drive Thermal Test Data Exploitation

  • Support pre-test thermal predictions.

  • Analyze thermal test results.

  • Assess subsystem and spacecraft performance.

  • Identify design improvements and operational recommendations.

  • Ensure lessons learned are captured and disseminated across the organization.

What We Are Looking For

Required Experience

  • MSc or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Thermodynamics or equivalent.

  • 10+ years' experience in spacecraft thermal engineering

  • Proven experience leading Thermal Vacuum and Thermal Balance campaigns.

  • Experience with Spacecraft qualification and acceptance programs

  • Experience supporting spacecraft assembly, integration and test activities.

  • Strong understanding of thermal control systems and their implementation (MLI, Temperature sensors, Heaters, Pumped Fluid Loops...)

  • Experience working with suppliers and external test facilities.

  • Experience with thermal instrumentation, DAQ systems and test facility interfaces

  • Experience with test-data processing tools, preferably Python, MATLAB or equivalent

  • Fluent in English. German, French and Italian are an asset

Skills & Behavior

  • Strong oral and written communication skills

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done

  • Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Vision, Competence, Integrity and Passion

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

title: Senior/Staff Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


We're looking for seasoned Product Designers who thrive in ambiguity and challenging problem spaces.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems you tackle as a designer are complex. Your design decisions must account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes impact the entire platform. To thrive here, you will need to love talking to users, understanding technology, and reducing complexity and scope.

You'll be embedded in a product squad alongside a product manager and around three to five engineers, owning the user experience for your area end to end. Our design team is small but growing, so you'll shape the craft bar and the culture, not inherit them.

We're hiring designers across the following teams:

  • Enterprise (two roles - Governance & Observability, and Licence & Billing): You've worked on technical B2B platforms. You've designed for scale, governance, and collaboration across teams, including permissions, environments, observability, and failure modes included and you're comfortable making deeply complex systems feel coherent and simple.

  • Adore - Adoption & Retention: You have exceptional product sense and can connect disparate elements into a coherent whole. You'll take something complex, with many moving parts, and make it make sense - shaping what the visual layer of n8n becomes next. Experience with data visualisation is welcome; deep technical expertise isn't required.

  • n8n Labs: As a Product Designer, you'll own discovery end-to-end, spotting the riskiest assumptions, running the research, and turning findings into decisions without waiting on a brief. You move fast, cut scope without losing what matters, and you're hands-on enough to build and ship your own prototypes, including using AI tools to get there quicker. You've got product and business judgment, not just craft; you can spot an opportunity and make the case for it. Founder or co-founder experience is a helpful signal but not a requirement.

Team assignment is confirmed at the offer stage and may be subject to change as the team structure evolves.

🎯 Regardless of the team, your main goal will be to lead end-to-end product design on complex workflows that elevate n8n's user experience, ship measurable outcomes, and raise the quality bar across our platform. To do so, here are your responsibilities:

End-to-end product design

  • Lead the full design process for your team, from discovery to polished delivery, collaborating closely with PMs and engineers.

  • Consistently ship high-quality, visually cohesive designs that improve the overall UX at every release.

  • Work effectively on complex features and understand the underlying technology.

  • Take ownership of complex, multi-faceted problems and drive them to completion with initiative and autonomy.

Research, feedback, and UX quality

  • Own the direction of research for your team, decide when it's needed, choose the right methodology, and take the initiative without waiting to be told.

  • Champion the user by running interviews, usability tests, and research to inform critical product and business decisions.

  • Master the feedback loop by gathering, synthesizing, and acting on input while giving actionable critique to elevate teammates' work.

  • Balance speed and quality in an MVP-driven environment, navigating ambiguity while maintaining a high bar.

Systems thinking and platform coherence

  • Design in systems, integrating solutions into the broader n8n platform and safeguarding the product's big picture.

  • Account for edge cases, constraints, and interaction details so users never end up in impossible states.

  • Collaborate across teams and designers to ensure consistency and quality across shared patterns and components.

Strategy, impact, and innovation

  • Shape team strategy by influencing planning, prioritization, and scope with a strong design perspective tied to KPIs.

  • Explore and adopt AI and automation tools to push the boundaries of design practice and AI-powered workflows.

Senior or Staff?

We're open at both levels, and we'll calibrate with you during the process. At Senior, you own your squad's design end-to-end and ship work that raises the bar for your area. At Staff, you do that, and your influence reaches beyond your own squad - you shape patterns other designers build on, and you take on the problems that span teams. Both are hands-on: this is not a step away from the craft.


REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🎨 Product design excellence: You're proficient across product design, UX, UI, and qualitative research, delivering polished, detail-oriented work.

  • 🧠 Technical mindset: You collaborate effectively with engineers and understand how software is built, including common web technologies. You don't need to write code, but you do need genuine curiosity about what's happening underneath - APIs, webhooks, data structures and how workflows actually execute.

  • 🧭 Ownership & delivery: You've shipped end-to-end features in smaller teams or startups and can drive complex problems to measurable outcomes.

  • ⚡ Fast, focused execution: You operate at high speed in an MVP-driven environment, balancing quality and velocity amid ambiguity.

  • 📈 Outcome orientation: You use research and metrics to inform decisions and consistently deliver solutions that enable team KPIs.

  • 🤝 Feedback & collaboration: You're open and non-defensive in critique and provide actionable feedback that raises the team's bar.

  • 🧪 Curiosity for AI: You're enthusiastic about AI and innovation, actively exploring new tools and approaches to advance the craft.

  • 📅 Experience level: You have 5+ years in product design with demonstrable impact on shipped products.


Nice-to-haves

  • 💻 Front-end fluency: You can prototype using HTML/CSS/JavaScript, with or without AI coding tools, and can collaborate effectively with engineers on the result.

  • 🧩 AI & automation domain: You've designed AI or automation products; familiarity with n8n is a plus.

  • 🔁 Process improvement: You proactively refine team rituals and workflows to increase effectiveness.

  • 📚 Continuous growth: You invest in your craft and are motivated by creating tangible product and company impact.

  • 🔎 Discovery frameworks: You know methodologies like Continuous Discovery or Shape Up.

  • 📊 Data-informed design: You're comfortable with metrics, A/B testing, or SQL to guide decisions.

  • 🚀 Entrepreneurial drive: You've built startups or side projects that show initiative and creative problem-solving.


Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a slide deck. You'll lead high-impact design across core product surfaces, shaping AI-powered workflows, enterprise governance and billing, and how people discover and adopt n8n, from discovery to delivery. You'll join a fast-growing, Europe remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, partnering closely with PMs and engineers to ship real outcomes to a passionate global community.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now and help us build the future of automation.

title: Senior Strategist
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

About VML Live

At VML Live, we believe brands don’t just belong in ad breaks—they belong in culture.

We exist to create moments that matter in the real world. By uniting brand ambition with genuine fan passion, we turn sponsorships and commercial rights into living, breathing cultural phenomena. Whether it’s global sports tournaments, music festivals, gaming universes, or grassroots movements, we ensure our clients show up where audiences are genuinely invested.

The Opportunity

A brand’s partnership rights are only as powerful as the way they are activated. Too many sponsorships end at logo placement; at VML Live, that’s where our work begins.

As a Senior Strategist (Sport & Entertainment), you will sit at the vital intersection of brand strategy, commercial rights, and multi-channel comms planning. Your mission is to take partnership assets—new or legacy—and translate them into culturally resonant, high-impact activation strategies that excite fans and move the commercial needle.

You will own strategic relationships across flagship accounts, guide creative teams with inspiring, actionable briefs, and spearhead pitches that showcase VML Live’s specialist edge to prospective clients across the globe.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect End-to-End Activation Plans: Translate brand ambitions, fan insights, and complex rights packages into integrated, channel-ready activation frameworks spanning experiential, digital, social, PR, content, and paid media.
  • Unlock Value Beyond Visibility: Ensure every asset, contractual right, and IP opportunity is leveraged creatively and commercially—moving clients from passive sponsor to active cultural participant.
  • Be the Strategic Catalyst for Creative: Partner closely with creative teams, providing sharp, fertile briefs and frameworks that empower them to develop bold work with speed, focus, and clarity.
  • Lead Pitches & Drive Growth: Play a pivotal role in new business and competitive pitches, crafting compelling narratives that demonstrate how partnership activation drives measurable business outcomes.
  • Collaborate Across the Network: Champion integrated thinking by seamlessly connecting with teams across VML Live, broader VML, and WPP sister agencies.
  • Prove What Works: Partner with data and effectiveness teams to build robust measurement frameworks, proving ROI and turning campaign learnings into future strategic advantage.

Who You Are

  • A Cultural & Fan native: You understand fandom, subcultures, and audience behaviors in sport, music, gaming, or entertainment, and know how brands can show up authentically without gatecrashing.
  • An Integrated Strategist: You have proven experience bridging brand strategy, partnership activation, and comms/channel planning within an agency, rights holder, or brand environment.
  • A Master Storyteller: You know how to structure an argument, articulate a vision, and deliver presentations that captivate senior clients and win high-stakes pitches.
  • Commercially & Operationally Astute: You understand rights contracts, sponsorship mechanics, and production realities—ensuring your strategic visions are both ambitious and executable.
  • A Collaborative Leader: You thrive in fast-paced, multi-disciplinary environments and enjoy mentoring junior team members while holding your own with senior stakeholders.

Why VML Live?

  • Unrivalled Scale & Access: Work with some of the world’s most recognizable brands, governing bodies, and entertainment properties.
  • Connected Culture: Join a collaborative, forward-thinking team backed by the global reach, tools, and intelligence of the VML and WPP network.
  • Real Cultural Impact: See your ideas come to life in stadiums, arenas, digital spaces, and on the streets—shaping how fans experience the things they love most.
  • Growth & Flexibility: We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, flexible hybrid working policies, and dedicated career development pathways.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

title: Senior Strategy & Operations - Success Department
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1300 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 

Strategy & Operations chez Pennylane :

Chez Pennylane, faire partie de la fonction Strat & Ops, c’est parfaitement comprendre les problématiques opérationnelles. Ensuite, nous concevons et implémentons des solutions efficientes et scalables qui permettent à Pennylane d’atteindre et dépasser ses plans de croissance (de 110 000 à 1 200 000 clients entre 2024 et aujourd'hui). Pour déplacer ces montagnes, nos équipes Strategy & Operations travaillent au quotidien avec les équipes Tech (développeurs, Product Manager) et Data (Scientists, Analysts…).

 

L’objectif :

Améliorer de façon très significative la productivité des équipes par une meilleure utilisation des outils et une forte simplification.

 

Le quotidien :

Tu seras la/le responsable, l’interlocuteur.trice privilégié.e et la personne qui drive le changement au sein du département Customer Success (CS), aux côtés des managers opérationnels en charge des services professionnels, du support client et des chargés de comptes.

 

Ton rôle sera :

- D'être force de proposition et moteur de la transformation : tu observes, écoutes, questionnes, challenges le status quo et suggères constamment des points d’amélioration et des moyens de réduire le temps actuellement passé à des tâches administratives de saisie ou recherche d’information. Tu permettras l'anticipation de la croissance future et tu documenteras les changements.

- De mettre en oeuvre des points relevés via des nouveaux systèmes d’information, des modifications d’applicatifs existants et/ou des changements d’organisation. Tu devras conduire des projets au sein du CS tout en t’appuyant sur des compétences extérieures au service tels que la data, sales ou finance par exemple. Ta mission sera aussi de s'assurer de la satisfaction client, de veiller au respect des délais et de suivre les indicateurs de performance de mise en place.

- D'écouter et observer les autres services, de prendre du recul, de comparer, d'élaborer des benchmarks afin de nourrir ta propre réflexion.

- De donner de la visibilité au niveau ops et data : aller comprendre au niveau corporate les challenges auxquels les équipes font face afin d’en anticiper et de comprendre les impacts sur le CS.

 

Profil recherché :

Nous recherchons un profil ambitieux, avec de précédentes expériences réussies sur des enjeux de transformation, d’amélioration de productivité et de gestion de projets.

 

Le candidat a les compétences et expériences suivantes :

- Expérience en transformation et amélioration de productivité par la mise en place de SI

- Une curiosité naturelle et l’envie de vraiment avoir de l’impact : capacité forte d’écoute et d’observation

- Expérience complète de la gestion de projet : tu sais cadrer un problème rapidement, livrer vite et itérer, sans attendre que tout soit parfait

- Capacité à, d’une part, descendre dans le détail et d’autre part, prendre du recul et analyser

- Mindset business

- Excellent(e) communicant(e) (à l’oral et à l’écrit), capacité à vulgariser un problème

- Appétences/connaissances sur l’IA, nocode, ou toute forme d’automatisation est souhaité

- Fortes capacités analytiques (une bonne maîtrise SQL est un plus)

- La connaissance d'un département Customer Support ainsi que des outils Intercom, Zendesk et Salesforce est un plus

 

Process de recrutement :

- Second entretien avec Laetitia Bruneton (Manager) - 1h visio

- Étude de cas (sur site) : avec François Aubry (VP Success) et Laetitia

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

title: (Senior) Supply Chain Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Every RELEX implementation is a solution built from scratch for one customer: their processes, their data, their targets. (Senior) Supply Chain Consultants shape both sides of that build — the business processes and KPIs the customer will run on, and the configuration that makes them work in the system. Depending on your background you will lean more towards one side than the other. This is a heavily customer-facing role.

What you'll be doing

  • Understand how the customer really plans. Prepare, facilitate and document workshops to gather and specify business requirements, and run the data analysis that shows where the strengths and the gaps actually are.
  • Design the target picture — planning processes, roles and the KPIs the project is measured on — and guide customers towards RELEX best practice, including where their current way of working needs to change.
  • Build it. Configuration, business rules, workflows and reporting that deliver the design you just agreed, and that hold up in operation: nightly run performance, scalability and maintainability, not just functional correctness.
  • Make the value case tangible for customer leadership: define how forecast accuracy, availability, inventory and cost will be measured, and report honestly on where we stand.
  • Take it live. Coordinate User Acceptance Testing, resolve what testing surfaces, and upskill super users so the customer is proficient and self-sustaining after go-live.
  • Own adoption, not just delivery. A technically correct solution that nobody uses is not a successful project.
  • Document what you built — requirements, scope and configuration — so the project team, the customer and our Continuous Services colleagues can work with it after handover.
  • Work across disciplines: with Technical Consultants on the data model, interfaces and the customer's ERP landscape, and with Project Managers on scope, effort and timelines.

Within RELEX

  • Challenge and develop implementation best practice across industries (grocery, DIY, home goods, pharma, wholesale and more)
  • Share knowledge with the team as both a trainer and a participant, and support colleagues who are earlier in their journey
  • Work with our global teams on international projects and bring practices between regions
  • Use AI tooling actively in your daily work — we expect curiosity here and give you room to experiment

What we're looking for

  • Around 2+ years of relevant experience in supply chain or retail planning, demand and inventory planning, or in implementing / consulting on planning software. A degree in supply chain management, business, engineering, mathematics or computer science is a good foundation — but we care more about what you have actually done.
  • Structured thinking and comfort with ambiguity. Many customer requirements arrive without a ready-made answer. You break them down, work with data, and arrive at a defensible recommendation.
  • Communication that works across levels — from super users in a training room to senior stakeholders in a steering committee, including the conversations where the message is not what the customer hoped to hear.
  • Business-fluent German and English. Both are used daily.
  • Willingness to travel depending on the project phase.
  • Technical affinity: SQL, scripting, or an interest to pick these up

Additionally, for the Senior level:

  • Several years of consulting or implementation experience, including demonstrable ownership of a workstream or a smaller project end-to-end — scope, risk, timeline and completion, not just your own tasks
  • Reliable effort estimation for standard and custom requirements, supporting scoping and SOW discussions
  • Experience coaching and mentoring less experienced colleagues
  • Confidence in front of senior customer stakeholders, including steering committees
  • Hands-on experience with a supply chain planning system, either as a user or as an implementer
  • Experience defining and tracking KPIs or building a value case

Who we are

We’re bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. Our Nordic roots and global outlook shape a culture of friendliness, creativity, and collaboration, all powered by openness and shared wins. We care deeply about doing the right thing - and doing it together. 

  • Flexibility in how and where you work
  • Room to thrivein a fast-growing global company with a good market position
  • Practical benefits that support work, family, wellness, and everyday life
  • Annual leave
  • Diverse, inclusive, and supportive work culture
  • Work that meaningfully reduces waste and improves sustainability
  • Ownership, autonomy and flat hierarchies
  • Two paid volunteering days each year

We are a global community of different cultures, voices, and experiences. We celebrate what makes us unique and connect through what we share, in an authentic and safe environment. Together we shape the future, and each other. 

If you feel this is the opportunity you don’t want to miss, you can apply by sending your resume through the application form as soon as possible. Please note that we cannot process any applications through email.     

Apply today and be part of the future. Be RELEX!

title: Senior Systems Software Engineer, GPU Compute
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Systems Engineer to join our team and play a key role in the development of our cutting-edge hyperscaler platform. The GPU & InfiniBand team is responsible for enhancing and optimizing the core components of our Cloud platform, with a specific focus on GPU computing, InfiniBand networks, and the KVM/QEMU stack. You’ll work closely with hardware virtualization and device emulation technologies, ensuring high performance and security in multi-GPU, HPC environments. The role involves analyzing, troubleshooting, and improving infrastructure to support new hardware, fine-tuning system performance, and automating fault detection and resolution in a complex system.

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Tuning the performance of GPU clusters and InfiniBand networks to ensure optimal operation in HPC and GPU-based environments. 
  • Analyzing and troubleshooting the root cause of issues related to GPUs and InfiniBand networks, and proposing corrective actions. 
  • Integrating new hardware into the existing infrastructure, including support for new GPU hardware through software stacks like Kubernetes, QEMU, and KVM. 
  • Enhancing automation systems for proactive monitoring, detecting, and resolving issues in GPU and InfiniBand environments. 
  • Configuring and managing GPU devices and InfiniBand fabrics, ensuring efficient and reliable operation.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in system-level software development (focused on performance optimization, low-level programming). 
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Linux systems (administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning). 
  • In-depth understanding of server architecture, including PCIe devices, NICs, Linux OS/Kernel, and high-performance computing (HPC) systems. 
  • Strong proficiency in one or more performance-oriented programming languages (C/C++, Go, Python).

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with GPU end-to-end testing in a cluster environment using InfiniBand networking. 
  • Proven track record of analyzing and optimizing the performance of HPC workloads (e.g., simulations, data analysis, AI/ML workloads). 
  • Familiarity with RDMA, RoCE, and InfiniBand protocols for high-performance communication. 
  • Background in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and experience with HPC cluster networking. 
  • Understanding of QEMU/KVM virtualization and managing virtualized environments. 
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, and their integration with HPC systems. 
  • Familiarity with collective communication libraries like MPI and NCCL for distributed computing. 

We offer competitive salaries ranging from $170k-$300k + equity based on your experience.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership

  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI
