title: Transformation Advisory Lead, Strategy & Economics, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is building a legal transformation practice for the AI era. Our Transformation Office brings together highly experienced consultants and practitioners to help law firms and legal departments turn AI from a tool their teams use into value their business can see.

Harvey’s experts help leaders decide what to change, and how to change it, as they adopt and embed new ways of working: how legal work is organized and governed, how it’s priced by firms and valued by in-house teams and how their people build new capability. The Transformation Office then works alongside their teams to make it happen. Our advice draws on what we see across Harvey's customers in more than 50 countries and on where the technology is heading. Our client work shapes Harvey's product, and the product shapes our advice. Both improve together.

Law firms and legal departments are making decisions now that will shape how they compete for the next decade: which work to prioritize, how to price and value it, how to staff it and how to organize around AI. As Transformation Advisory Lead for Strategy & Economics, you help their leaders make those decisions well. You have made them yourself, inside a firm or a legal department, and advised others through them, so managing partners, general counsel and CFOs treat you as a peer.

You will be one of the first senior specialists in Harvey's Transformation Office. You will help build our strategy and economics offering, bring that expertise to client engagements run by our Engagement Managers and join our Practice Directors when a customer has a specific need in strategy and economics. What you learn will shape how Harvey advises the market and what we build next.

What You'll Do

  • Advise on strategy. Help leaders decide where AI changes their competitive position: which practices/domains, clients and types of work to prioritize, and where to invest.

  • Advise on pricing and value. Help firms and legal departments measure the impact of AI on the cost, speed and value of their work. For firms, that means working through how fee structures and value models need to change; for legal departments, it means showing the value their work creates for the business.

  • Advise on operating models. Help customers redesign how legal work is organized, supported and staffed, including team structures and the roles AI creates or changes.

  • Help leaders make the case for change. Work with managing partners, general counsel and finance leaders to build the case they take to their partnership, board, internal stakeholders or executive team.

  • Build the offering. Create the diagnostics, frameworks and leadership readouts the Transformation Office uses to deliver strategy and economics engagements, and turn each engagement into material the wider team can use.

  • Bring your expertise to early conversations. Join Practice Directors and account teams when a customer has a specific need in strategy and economics.


What You Have

  • 10+ years of experience, including significant time shaping strategy, pricing or operating decisions: for example in a law firm's strategy, pricing or practice management team, in legal operations, external counsel or law firm management, or as chief of staff to a general counsel. Experience in a legal-sector consulting practice is a strong plus.

  • Deep fluency in legal economics. For law firms: leverage, practice-group and matter profitability, pricing and fee structures. For legal departments: cost-center dynamics, outside-counsel spend and how the value of legal work is measured.

  • A track record of advising senior legal leaders through high-stakes decisions, with the presence to hold a room that includes finance.

  • A clear point of view on how AI will change the business of law, grounded in how the economics actually move.

  • Evidence that you have built frameworks or methods that others adopted and kept using.

  • The judgment to discuss efficiency in a way that builds support for change rather than fear about displacement.

  • Energy for building something new while the playbook is still being written.

title: UAS Instructor (m/f/d)- Salisbury
descriptionHtml:
As a UAS Training Instructor, you will play a critical role within our Training, Demonstration, and Documentation team. Through close collaboration with defence, government, and public safety customers across the UK and internationally, you will become a key representative of Quantum-Systems. Your expertise and ability to deliver high-quality training will ensure customers can safely, effectively, and confidently operate our unmanned aerial systems (UAS).

In this customer-facing role, you will lead training programmes and product demonstrations for operators, military personnel, law enforcement agencies, and senior stakeholders. You will work closely with the Government Sales team to support customer engagement, showcase operational capabilities, and contribute to the continued success of Quantum-Systems in the UK and international defence markets.

Your Day-to-Day Mission

Prepare and Maintain UAS Operational Readiness

  • Ensure all UAS platforms, payloads, and supporting equipment are fully operational and ready for customer demonstrations and training activities worldwide.

  • Conduct pre-deployment inspections, system checks, and troubleshooting to maintain the highest levels of operational readiness.

Develop and Maintain Training Programmes

  • Support in creating, updating, and continuously improving training materials, including manuals, presentations, lesson plans, and practical exercises.

  • Support in ensuring training content remains aligned with product developments, operational requirements, and customer needs.

Deliver Practical Flight Training

  • Lead classroom and field-based training primarily on fixed-wing UAS platforms

  • Instruct customers on mission planning, pre-flight preparation, flight operations, emergency procedures, post-flight activities, and data exploitation.

  • Promote best practices for operational safety and mission effectiveness.

Evaluate Learner Performance

  • Assess participants during both theoretical and practical training exercises.

  • Provide constructive feedback and coaching to support competence development and operational proficiency.

  • Maintain accurate training records and certification documentation where required.

Conduct Professional Product Demonstrations

  • Deliver engaging and impactful demonstrations to prospective customers and stakeholders.

  • Use your operational experience to effectively communicate real-world use cases and mission benefits.

  • Present confidently to audiences ranging from end users and operators to senior military officers, procurement officials, and government decision-makers.


What you bring to the team:

  • Military, law enforcement, intelligence, or other government service background, ideally with operational deployment experience.

  • Proven experience delivering training to defence, security, public safety, or government organisations.

  • You already have, or have the ability to acquire, Multi rotor and Fixed wing UAS licenses within the UK and Europe.

  • Ideally, experience operating and instructing on fixed-wing UAS platforms

  • Strong presentation, communication, and instructional skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • The ability to independently plan, deliver, and evaluate training programmes in English. Additional language skills would be advantageous.

  • A professional and confident manner when interacting with senior military, government, and security stakeholders.

  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.

  • Willingness to travel extensively within the UK and internationally, including to remote and challenging operational environments.

  • Experience working in multinational and multicultural environments is desirable.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

Our benefits:

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

    About us:

    Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.

    Our commitment:

    We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

    At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

title: UI/UX Designer (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Wir sind auf der Suche nach neuen Kollegen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Prozess der Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht, unserer juristischen Kompetenz und einem starken Team von zahlreichen Mitarbeitern begleiten wir tausende Mandanten erfolgreich auf dem Weg zur deutschen Staatsbürgerschaft. Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich einen Einblick unter migrando(.)de/karriere, unserer Karriere-Page. Denn wir können hier schreiben was wir wollen, im Endeffekt bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast. Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich? Wer jahrelang in der Praxis gearbeitet und Hands-on-Erfahrungen gesammelt hat, bringt mehr mit als jeder Kursabschluss. Wir suchen nach Kollegen, die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Wir bieten Dir

Unser Produkt ist rein digital – das bedeutet, jede Designentscheidung ist messbar, jede Verbesserung sofort sichtbar. Du arbeitest nicht im Dunkeln, sondern mit echten Nutzerdaten, echtem Traffic und echtem Feedback. Und du gestaltest nicht nur nach außen: Auch unsere internen Tools und Workflows brauchen jemanden, der das Nutzererlebnis im Blick behält.

  • High-End Hardware nach Wahl
    Egal ob MacBook oder Windows Tower. Du bekommst die Maschine, auf der du am besten performst, inkl. 4K-Monitoren.
  • Große Reichweite
    Über die Jahre haben wir mit unserer Plattform bereits sehr viele Menschen erreicht. Diese Menge an realem Traffic bedeutet für dich: Du siehst die Auswirkung deiner Arbeit schnell – und kannst daraus genauso schnell lernen.
  • Echte Eigenverantwortung
    Du bist nicht Umsetzer fremder Ideen. Du kannst deine eigenen Perspektiven bringen, Designentscheidungen auf Basis von Daten treffen und hast einen direkten Draht zu den anderen Teams und der Geschäftsführung.
  • Kleine Teams statt Großraumbüro
    Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt und schnell ins Gespräch kommt.
  • Musik bei der Arbeit
    Bei uns wird nicht mit der Stirn gerunzelt, wenn du dir Kopfhörer aufsetzt. Wenn es dir hilft (und keinen anderen stört), kannst du auch gerne Heavy Metal über eine Soundanlage an deinem Schreibtisch pumpen.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro im Herzen von Cottbus
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen in den Räumen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch. Einen Einblick in unsere Räumlichkeiten kannst du dir auf unserer Website anschauen.
  • Ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz mit moderner Ausstattung
    Rückenfreundlicher Stuhl, höhenverstellbarer Tisch, zwei große Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset, ein leistungsstarker Laptop und eine ruhige Umgebung.
  • Homeoffice-Möglichkeit
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Gleichzeitig ist Home Office jederzeit möglich. Auch spontan und ohne lange Abstimmung.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit ohne Kernzeiten
    Bei uns gibt es keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster, in denen du anwesend sein musst.
  • Flexible Teilzeitmodelle
    Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell. Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Spontan Urlaub nehmen
    Manchmal braucht man einfach eine Auszeit. Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen.
  • Familienfreundliche Kultur
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend oder kurzfristiger Arzttermin – wir wissen, dass solche Situationen zum Alltag gehören. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Kurze Wege
    Bei uns musst du dich nicht durch die Hierarchien hangeln oder lange Mails schreiben, um gehört zu werden. Du kannst jederzeit direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung sprechen. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, Austausch ist direkt und niemand sitzt „im Elfenbeinturm“.
  • Mitgestalten statt nur abarbeiten
    Wir suchen Kolleg:innen, die mitdenken. Wenn du eine Idee hast, wie ein Prozess besser laufen kann, ein Tool sinnvoll wäre oder ein Workflow smarter funktionieren könnte, dann wirst du gehört.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Deine Tätigkeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit – es ist Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung und spürbarer Wirkung.
  • Feel-Good-Angebote im Haus
    Unsere Feel-Good-Managerin sorgt regelmäßig für kleine Auszeiten – von Nacken- und Schultermassagen über kurze Entspannungs- und Beauty-Sessions bis hin zu Momenten zum Durchatmen.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events
    Wir feiern gern. Sommerfest am See, gemütliche Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner mit der Abteilung. Unsere Events sorgen dafür, dass wir als Team zusammenwachsen und den Arbeitsalltag auch mal beiseiteschieben können. Aber keine Sorge: Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht und eher Gehen auch kein Problem.
  • Fitnessraum im Haus
    Unser eigener Fitnessraum steht dir direkt im Haus zur Verfügung – kostenlos, gut ausgestattet und jederzeit zugänglich.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Wie verhalten sich User auf unserer Website? Wo springen sie ab, wo zögern sie, wo verstehen sie nicht, was als nächstes zu tun ist? Diese Fragen treibt dich an – und du beantwortest sie nicht mit Bauchgefühl, sondern mit Methode.

  • Konzeption & Design von User Interfaces
    Du erstellst (oder bist beteiligt an der Erstellung von) Wireframes und Prototypen in Figma – für unsere Haupt-Websites, Landingpages und Apps.
  • User Journey Mapping & Optimierung
    Du analysierst die komplette Customer Journey – vom ersten Klick bis zur erfolgreichen Einbürgerung und Kundenbewertung – und sorgst dafür, dass unnötige Reibungspunkte, Kontaktanfragen und Bedenken verschwinden.
  • Conversion Rate Optimization
    Du planst, implementierst und analysierst A/B-Tests (z. B. zur Optimierung von Formularen oder Call-to-Actions), um die Abschlussrate zu steigern.
  • Design System Management
    Du baust unser zentrales Design System in Figma weiter auf, pflegst es und entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Frontend-Team weiter, damit alles konsistent und skalierbar bleibt.
  • Entwicklung mobiler Erlebnisse
    Du stellst sicher, dass alle Interfaces auf mobilen Geräten perfekt funktionieren – mit Mobile-First-Ansatz, Fokus auf Touch-Interaktionen und optimaler Performance (Kann die Website auch von einem User, der gerade zur Arbeit pendelt, zufriedenstellend genutzt werden?)
  • Usability-Testing & Research
    Du bist der Ansprechpartner für Usability-Testing (Eye-Tracking-Analysen, User-Interviews, regelmäßige Gespräche mit anderen kundennahen Teams), damit unsere Design-Entscheidungen auf echten Daten und Nutzerfeedback basieren.
  • Kollaboration mit Marketing & Content
    Du arbeitest mit dem Marketing-Team zusammen, um visuell starke Landingpages, Kampagnen und Social-Media-Grafiken umzusetzen. Du weißt, was Nutzer anspricht und bewegt und wo ihre Bedenken liegen.
  • Tracking & Datenanalyse
    Du richtest Tracking-Events (z. B. via Google Analytics, Hubspot) ein oder wertest sie mit aus, um aus echten Nutzungsdaten Designentscheidungen abzuleiten.
  • Prozessoptimierung & UX-Standards
    Du entwickelst Standards, Templates und Workflows, die die Design-Arbeit für das gesamte Team effizienter machen.

Dein Profil

Kein Zertifikat der Welt ersetzt echte Erfahrung und Know-How aus der Praxis. Genau die suchen wir. Ob du dein Können im Job, in eigenen Projekten oder auf eigene Faust unter Beweis gestellt hast – uns interessiert, was du wirklich kannst und wie du denkst. Direkte Kommunikation und Hand-on-Erfahrung sind uns wichtiger als jeder Abschluss. Wir suchen nach Kollegen, die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit UX-Methoden
    Du beherrschst User-Centered Design - und denkst nicht, dass UX ein Synonym für “schönes Design” ist.
  • Erfahrung im UX-Research
    Du hast bereits Interviews, Usability-Tests oder Auswertungen begleitet.
  • Bestenfalls erste Erfahrungen mit Figma
    Auto-Layout, Komponenten, Prototyping und Design-System-Elemente sind für dich tägliches Handwerkszeug (oder du hast keine Schwierigkeiten, sie zu lernen).
  • Praxis im UI/UX-Design
    Du hast Websites oder Web-Apps gestaltet und kennst die typischen Herausforderungen digitaler Produkte (oder kannst dir dieses Wissen selbstständig aneignen).
  • Design-Sensibilität
    Du erkennst gute Typografie, klare Layouts, starke Kontraste und ein modernes Look-and-Feel auf den ersten Blick.
  • Verständnis für Microinteractions
    Du weißt, wie kleine Animationen und Interaktionen das Nutzererlebnis verbessern können.
  • Grundkenntnisse im Frontend
    Kein Muss, aber hilfreich – du verstehst HTML/CSS/JS so weit, dass du Designs technisch durchdacht planen kannst.
  • Teamspirit & Humor
    Du arbeitest am liebsten gemeinsam, denkst nutzerzentriert – und bringst eine ordentliche Portion gute Laune mit.
  • Keine formellen Voraussetzungen
    Du musst kein Studium oder 30 Weiterbildungen haben. Wir wollen Talente und fähige neue Kollegen finden. Selbst wenn du nicht alle Punkte hier erfüllst - wir sind auf der Suche nach erfahrenen und verantwortungsbewussten Kollegen, idealerweise bist du schon viele Jahre in dem Bereich aktiv und konntest viele Learnings mitnehmen. Denn genau daran sind wir interessiert: saubere, langfristig robuste Problemlösungen. Und die hat man meist erst, nachdem man es einige Zeit auf die harte Tour lernen musste.
  • Einfache Kommunikation
    Du bist kommunikativ und offen. Eigentlich wollen wir hier keine generischen Sachen schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist wichtig. Gute Zusammenarbeit schlägt oft reines Know-how. Ein Kollege, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos ist, kann im Alltag wertvoller sein als jemand mit mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber eher schleppend ist.
  • Deutsch oder Englisch
    Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch oder am besten beides (ca. B2-Level). Keine Sorge, wir erwarten keinen Nachweis des Sprachniveaus.

title: UK I Fractional Legal Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About Infinite Lambda

Infinite Lambda is a global data and AI consultancy on a mission to make innovation accessible. We help organisations build the data foundations and business context they need for enterprise AI to actually work: from modern data platforms to agentic enablement and our software solution, Flowline.

We are a Certified B Corporation, with 7 legal entities around the world, and are proud to nurture a workplace where decent human beings can do their best work. Curiosity is our default setting, autonomy is non-negotiable, and impact is the whole point.

The role

As our Fractional Legal Counsel, you will be the senior legal partner to our COO, Exec team, and Board. In a fractional capacity, you will be part of the team, close to the people who win and deliver the work, and trusted to make the calls that keep us keep moving.

We need someone who can start adding value from their first week. You will handle our most important contracts and legal questions across EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, and set up the templates, playbooks, and processes that let the business handle routine matters with confidence when you are not there.

Being qualified in both England & Wales and the US means you can cover our two largest legal systems directly and coordinate local counsel everywhere else.

You will report to the COO and work closely with our CFO and General Managers, as many of our legal questions (commercial terms, liability, entity structure and governance) sit at the intersection of legal, finance, and operations. As the business grows, you will also help us decide what our long-term legal function should look like.

What you will own

This role spans four pillars. As the role is fractional, focus matters a lot: you will prioritise what only a senior lawyer can do, bring in external support where it makes sense, and build the tools that let the business help itself.

1. Commercial contracting & client advice

  • Reviewing and negotiating our priority client agreements: MSAs, SOWs and framework agreements under English and US law

  • Drafting key partner, vendor, and supplier agreements

  • Advising clients and internal teams on cross-border matters across EMEA, the Americas, and APAC

  • Setting clear positions on liability, IP ownership, and data terms, so deals keep moving

2. Governance, risk & compliance

  • Flagging the legal risks that matter most and recommending priorities to the COO and Exec team;

  • Oversight of corporate governance and entity matters across our 7 legal entities, working with local advisers;

  • Supporting the Exec team and board matters when legal input is needed;

  • Keeping our compliance posture current, including anti-bribery, sanctions, and export controls.

3. Data, AI & intellectual property

  • Data protection and privacy across the UK, EU and US, including DPAs and international transfers;

  • Guidance on AI regulation, including the EU AI Act, as it applies to our services;

  • Protecting our intellectual property, including our flagship product, Flowline.

4. Building the legal foundations

  • Contract templates, negotiation playbooks and approval rules for routine matters;

  • A simple intake and tracking process so everyone knows what is in progress;

  • Selecting and managing external counsel for specialist or local-law work, within budget;

  • Helping shape the scope of a future full-time legal hire if and when we need one.

Who you are

We are not looking for a particular CV but for a particular kind of lawyer, namely senior, commercial, honest, and genuinely interested in the work our teams do.

Experience that matters

  • Qualified as a solicitor in England & Wales and the US (preferrably), with both qualifications current and in good standing;

title: UK Service Line Director - Data
descriptionHtml:
About HSO 

HSO is a Microsoft focused, business transformation partner, with deep industry expertise and global reach. We leverage the full power of the Microsoft Cloud to transform the way in which people work and engage customers, accelerating the impact of cloud transformation and improving overall business performance. By leveraging the power of Dynamics 365, Generative AI, Data, AI, Copilot capabilities and the Microsoft Cloud, HSO helps companies innovate faster, by modernizing business operations, adopting data-driven intelligent automation, delivering real-time insights and connecting the enterprise.  

Founded in 1987, HSO has more than 2,500 professionals throughout EMEA, the Americas and Asia and is one of the world’s top business solution and implementation partners. We are a member of Microsoft’s elite Inner Circle, representing the Top 1% of partners worldwide. HSO UK has grown to more than 300 people and we expect over 100% organic growth in the next 5 years. 

HSO specializes in industry sectors such as Retail, Manufacturing, Professional Services, Financial Services and Public Sector. HSO has been recognized as the global winner of the 2023 Partner of the Year Award for D365 Finance and as a Finalist for D365 Sales and Marketing. In addition, we have been awarded ‘Best Tech Company 2021 to Work For’ and the ‘6th Best Large Company to Work For’ in 2022.   

At HSO we take pride in being large enough to serve, but small enough to care. Both for our customers and colleagues. We are uniquely positioned to empower you to transform your career, without compromising your life goals and we take pride in investing as much in our people as we do in our clients. Our culture and values support entrepreneurial mindsets and attitudes, where your voice will always be heard. 

Why Work for HSO? 

Joining the HSO team means being an integral part of a dynamic organization that values innovation, collaboration and professional growth. Here are some of the reasons why HSO is a great place to work and build your career: 

  • Customer Value: Work for market-leading clients across multiple industries, delivering value-adding solutions and a meaningful difference. 
  • Supportive Culture: Enjoy an environment where everyone is encouraged to be heard in a positive and inclusive environment. 
  • Flexibility and Wellbeing: We understand that life is complex and if you share what you need, you’ll find we care in return.  
  • Commitment to Quality: Be part of a team that truly places quality at the heart of all we do. 

If you're looking for a rewarding career with opportunities to stretch yourself, make an impact and work with a supportive team, HSO is the place for you! 

Purpose of the Role & Key Responsibilities

This is a genuinely transformative leadership opportunity. Our Data Platform (DP) team is rapidly growing and we’re looking for a someone with the skills, knowledge and experience to achieve this.  Our goal is for Data to be a growth engine of our UK business, at the forefront of our ambition as the UK’s services partner of choice, for Enterprise clients wishing to drive, innovate and run their businesses with Microsoft. The market opportunity is huge and this role is key in ensuring HSO takes full advantage of this, alongside our dedicated Data Sales team.  

There are four major accountabilities: 

  1. Business Growth – to build on our success to date, by defining and building the market opportunity for Data, then leading key opportunities and winning net new clients, as well as to grow on existing. This role’s primary objective is to grow the HSO UK Data business by at least 40% year on year.
  2. P&L Management – to run and operate the profit and loss as best in class, using known best practices and to build on these, as the Service Line grows, to meet / exceed our financial and other targets.
  3. Customer Leadership – to work successfully as an Executive Sponsor on key accounts and to coach others to do the same, so that we deliver on our client commitments and win multi-year relationships.
  4. Talent Development – to build a high performing Data team and to develop new talent for the future success of HSO.

While this is a UK role, there is also an HSO-wide global contribution to the DP Service Line: sharing knowledge, experience and helping others achieve.  

Overview of Essential Behaviours & Experience 

Essential Behaviours 

  • Team Leadership - wants to lead and be accountable. Takes personal responsibility. Ability to influence others and build followship. Listens to others to find the best outcome. 
  • Ambitious - for client success, as well as personal success and for the success Data and the wider HSO team.  
  • Strategic - sees the wider picture and makes informed decisions from complex and varied sources.  
  • Care - demonstrates care with every interaction. Looks for team success. Embodies Servant Leadership. 
  • Tenacious - happy to roll sleeves-up to deliver and drive challenging outcomes over a sustained period. Strives for excellence in oneself and others. 
  • Entrepreneurial - ability to work successfully in a fast-paced environment. Comfortable with ambiguity. 

Essential Experience 

  • Led, built and grown a multi-disciplined Data function, preferably with Microsoft technology. 
  • Leadership experience in a consulting services environment, with a strong track record of selling, managing and delivering multi-million pound engagements, using resources both onshore and offshore. Building multi-year relationships for Enterprise clients. 
  • Managed an annual budget in excess of £10m per annum, including investment, forecasting, revenues, profit and loss.  
  • Proven ability to understand and successfully manage risk.   
  • Able to identify and resolve issues to deliver challenging growth targets. 
  • Deployed and leveraged technology (eg. AI) and new ways of working to improve business performance and take advantage of new market potential. 
  • Worked collaboratively in a business with multiple lines of business. 
  • Led a geographically dispersed team of at least 8 direct reports and a total team of 20 or more people. Successfully led such a team through periods of significant change and business improvement.  
  • Previous experience utilising AI to deliver data solutions to customers, or delivering AI solutions to customers. 
     

Location 

This is a hybrid role and can be based either from our London, Glasgow or Manchester offices, as well as from home.  There will be regular, planned travel, involving overnight stays near our offices and other UK locations for customer / internal meetings, events and training. Occasional planned international travel is expected. 


Total Reward 

We offer competitive and equal pay which reflects the skills, experience and performance of the individual. Any reward package will be discussed honestly during the interview process.  

Our people have the opportunity to earn performance-based bonuses or commission, and everyone can benefit from paid holiday, private healthcare, private dental care, life assurance, pension, retail discounts and monthly wellbeing activities. 

We set the bar high and won't extend an offer until we're convinced we've found the right candidate. This is why a job may stay open for months or be reposted several times.  

Studies suggest that women tend not to apply for a job if their CV isn’t a perfect fit. Here, talent takes precedence over experience. So if you like the role and think you could be awesome at it in time, go ahead and apply. HSO is an equal opportunity employer. We will consider for employment any applicant and provide reasonable accommodations for an individual with disabilities - just let us know how we can support you.

title: UX Researcher
descriptionHtml:
UX Researcher 

  • Location: Bristol/London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

  • Contract: Permanent
  • Reporting To: UX Lead

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

Hands-on research

  • Run mixed-methods research in a B2B2C setting, combining qualitative studies with behavioural data in Mixpanel, that sets the standard for good research and shapes team roadmaps and client conversations
  • Research the whole chain, from client teams and subject matter experts to their end customers and the developers using our SDKs and APIs, and look for patterns that hold across clients so we build once and reuse
  • Make sure research has impact: track whether it changed a decision and what result followed, and use that to make the case for research investment

Research enablement and operations

  • Democratise research: coach and mentor colleagues in Product, Design and Engineering to run their own studies with rigour, through workshops, guidance and lightweight methods
  • Make insight easy to find and trust, through our insights agents, knowledge bases and journey management artefacts, backed by data you can rely on (quality, privacy, bias), so people can find and question evidence themselves
  • Help run research operations: improve how we recruit participants (frameworks, lead times, consent and data protection), and set clear guardrails so teams run ethical, compliant research
  • Assess and recommend research tools, deciding when to build and when to buy, trial them, and support procurement; use AI-assisted development such as Claude Code to build working tools where that is the right call

What you’ll bring

Ideally you’ll have/be

  • A track record of running research end to end that other teams used in product or roadmap decisions, with strong data literacy: you combine qualitative methods with behavioural data and know what the numbers can and can’t tell us
  • Experience researching in B2B or B2B2C or enterprise contexts, including technical users such as developers (eg SDKs, APIs or documentation), or a strong appetite to learn how
  • Experience coaching non-researchers in research fundamentals (interviewing, bias mitigation, ethical handling of user data) so they can self-serve
  • Experience on a platform or multi-client product, spotting patterns across customers, and familiarity with journey mapping or service design methods
  • Experience in research operations or enablement, such as participant recruitment, consent and data governance, repositories or tool selection, with judgement on when to build and when to buy
  • Confidence working with some autonomy across a distributed, international team

What will set you apart 

  • You’ve built a tool, repository or pipeline that measurably cut the time from research signal to team-wide insight
  • You’ve found a way to measure developer experience where there was no playbook (eg time to first successful call, or where developers drop off)
  • You’ve made the case for research with real numbers, and followed your research after the readout to see what happened

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.
  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.
  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.
  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.
  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period
  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests
  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work
  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget
  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About the role

We're hiring a Vice President to own and lead our EMEA business. You'll inherit a team of 20+ quota-carrying Commercial and Enterprise AE's across four hubs: London, Amsterdam, Munich, Stockholm and be responsible for building the management layer, operating model and partner ecosystem that takes the EMEA region from early traction to consistent, scaled revenue.

This is a second-line leader role that will see you report directly to the Global Vice President of Sales and operate with meaningful autonomy across pipeline, hiring, partner relationships and executive engagement.

What you'll own

Team leadership and performance

Revenue

Hiring

  • Partner with the internal talent team to move at pace without compromising on quality

Partner ecosystem

  • Represent LangChain at partner QBRs and executive engagements in region

Market presence

  • Represent LangChain as a keynote-ready leader at partner events, customer engagements, and industry conferences across the region: including KubeCon, Money20/20, Nordic AI summits, and customer EBCs

  • Build LangChain's brand with technical buyers, CIOs, and innovation leaders across Northern Europe's most important enterprise accounts

  • Bring intelligence on the EMEA markets back to the Global VP of Sales and product teams to inform roadmap and go-to-market positioning

What we're looking for

Experience

  • 10+ years in enterprise SaaS sales, with at least 5+ years in a regional or sub-regional leadership role managing quota-carrying AE's

  • Demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding regional revenue targets across multiple quarters

  • Experience managing teams across multiple countries and time zones, with the cultural intelligence to operate across EMEA

  • Background selling to technical buyers (engineering leaders, CTOs, platform teams): you understand how developer tools get evaluated and adopted

  • Experience in the AI, data, or developer tooling space strongly preferred; familiarity with the LangChain ecosystem is a meaningful plus

Leadership

  • You've run teams of 20+ AEs before and know the difference between managing and coaching

  • You can hold a forecast conversation with a VP and a deal coaching session with an AE in the same afternoon and add value in both

  • You hire well and fast. You know what good looks like for enterprise AE profiles and you can run structured hiring processes across four open roles simultaneously

  • You've built or contributed to a partner motion before: you understand what "partner pipeline" means in practice, not just in theory

Operating style

  • You bias toward action. You don't wait for a playbook to be handed to you: you build it

title: VP, Strategic Finance
descriptionHtml:
Team: Finance (G&A)

Reports to: Chief Financial Officer

Location: London, Amsterdam or Stockholm. Remote-first, with travel as and when needed

About Nivoda

Nivoda is the B2B marketplace rebuilding how the jewellery industry works. We connect independent jewellery retailers with a global network of diamond and gemstone suppliers, so a jeweller in Denver or Devon can source from anywhere in the world without the cost, risk, and hassle of doing it the old way. We handle the logistics, the payments, and the quality checks, the messy middle that used to put global sourcing out of reach for small businesses.

Today we process over $300M in transactions a year in a $350B industry that still runs largely on personal relationships and paperwork. We are growing quickly, we are backed by leading investors, and we are only getting started.

We built Nivoda so every jeweller, whatever their size and wherever they are, has access to the same global supply, pricing and tools as the biggest players.

Why this role & why now

You will sit on the Extended Leadership Team, report to the CFO, and own how Nivoda plans, reports and is funded. You will present to the board, investors and our receivables lender yourself, work directly with the CFO on equity and debt financing, and build a finance function that runs on routine rather than heroics. This is for someone who wants to lead a team and shape the company’s financial story, not only model it.

What you will own

Planning and forecasting. You own the annual budget, quarterly reforecast and long-range plan, plus scenario and funding cases for the C-suite and board. You are accountable for forecast accuracy against agreed tolerances, and for an honest post-mortem whether we miss or overachieve.

Board, investor and lender reporting. You own the monthly board pack and the numbers behind it, plus materials for existing and prospective investors and our receivables lender, including covenant reporting and onsite diligence. You present to these audiences yourself and you are their first call for analytical questions. The aim is that they trust the numbers without the CFO needing to vouch for them.

Corporate finance. You build the models and documentation for equity and debt financing, analyse term sheets, work with the People team on cap table and option pool, and support the CFO on transactions.

Commercial and unit economics. You own cohort economics, customer lifetime value, geographic and segment profitability, and the return on marketing and sales spend. With the CRO’s organisation, you build quota and commission models so targets, incentives and the forecast point at the same numbers.

Business partnering. You partner with Product and Engineering, Fulfilment, Fintech and the commercial teams on build versus buy, hiring cases, pricing and fee experiments, and capital allocation. The function says yes, no or not yet, with a model behind it.

Leading the function. You lead the team: hiring, onboarding, objectives, development and performance, including written objectives and regular structured feedback for each person. You set the review standard and deliverables calendar, agree data contracts with the Data team, and own the tooling (Snowflake, NetSuite, ThoughtSpot, Claude and the modelling stack). We measure the function on on-time delivery, errors caught internally rather than by the audience, forecast accuracy, and how many people can produce each recurring deliverable.

What good looks like

First 90 days. You have taken over the monthly pack and the reforecast without the investors noticing a handover. You have met your leadership-team peers and told the CFO what you would change and in what order.

90 to 180 days. The monthly pack, FP&A-approved numbers and lender reporting land on the agreed date, each with a named owner and a written process. No board, lender or investor number has needed restating. The first version of the business line P&Ls is delivered at day 180.

Twelve months. The function delivers month-end and board commitments without you or the CFO stepping in, including when you are away. A team member has delivered a new analytical capability end to end. FP&A and the Data team work from one set of metric definitions. Board members, lenders and the leadership team rely on the numbers without asking the CFO to vouch for them.

The standard

A finance team has no quota. The thing it sells is trust, and trust is earned with accuracy a bar above the rest of the company and delivery on the date promised.

Three things must not fail in this role.

  • Timeliness: deadlines are commitments, not targets.

  • Quality: every external-facing number reconciles to a primary source and has been reviewed by someone other than its author before it leaves the team.

  • Capacity: within reason, not a constraint. The function absorbs the demands of a 450-person company by organising, prioritising and delegating. If capacity is a hard limit, you make the case for a hire or an automation with numbers, rather than letting the work slip.

That is a high bar, and it is fair because the role comes with the means to meet it: people to delegate to, authority over how the team's week is spent, a budget line, and the standing to say no to the business with the CFO's backing.

What you bring

  • A background in investment banking, FP&A or venture capital, building models that senior stakeholders made decisions on.

  • You have led a team, directly or through managers, and you want the management part of this role.

  • You have presented to boards, investors or lenders as the person answering the question, not the person who built the slide.

  • A working understanding of marketplace dynamics: two-sided liquidity, take rates, usage-based revenue without a contract, and what FX does to all of it. Complex cohort modelling is native to you.

  • You are comfortable in Snowflake and a modern BI tool, you treat AI tooling as part of the stack, and you would rather fix the pipeline than reformat the output every month.

  • You are calm under pressure, low on ego and allergic to spin. You tell people the uncomfortable thing early.

Useful but not required: receivables financing or lender reporting, a multi-jurisdiction group, NetSuite, or a business that trades physical goods across borders.

What this role is not

It is not a bigger version of a senior analyst role, and it is not where every difficult model gets built personally. If you are at your best as the smartest modeler in the room and would rather stay that way, this will frustrate you.

It is also not a quiet seat. Month-end, board and lender deadlines are fixed, a 450-person company makes a lot of demands on finance, and you will regularly be the one saying no, with the CFO’s backing. If you want a purely advisory or slower-paced role, this isn’t it.

What we offer

Nivoda is a place where smart, driven people do the best work of their careers. We move fast, give ownership early, and don’t have layers of bureaucracy slowing things down. If you see a problem, you can fix it.

Our current benefits include:

  • Flexible working hours and a vibrant, remote-first company culture

  • Unlimited holiday allowance

  • Participation in our equity programme

  • Genuine opportunities for growth: we promote from within and invest in your development

  • The chance to join during an expansion phase and shape how Nivoda operates at scale

Interview Process

  • Screening conversation with Talent Acquisition

  • Structured career-history interview with Hiring Manager

  • Focus interview: you present a case study to a panel from Finance and the leadership team

  • Final conversation with the C-suite

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

If you meet most of this description and not all of it, apply anyway and tell us where the gaps are.

Please submit your CV in English.

Not the right role? Join our Talent Pool

If this isn’t quite the right fit but you’re excited about what Nivoda is building, we’d still love to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we’ll reach out when the right opportunity comes along.

descriptionHtml:

title: Wirtschaftsinformatiker/in – Digitalisierung & Automatisierung - Vollzeit (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du denkst gerne in Systemen, erkennst ineffiziente Abläufe schnell und hast Freude daran, aus manuellen Prozessen saubere digitale Lösungen zu machen?

Als Wirtschaftsinformatiker/in bei ESH arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsprozessen, Software und Automatisierung.

Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe, entwickelst digitale Lösungen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme zuverlässig miteinander funktionieren.

Dabei geht es nicht darum, ständig jedem neuen Tool hinterherzulaufen. Wir suchen jemanden, der Prozesse wirklich versteht, sinnvolle Lösungen entwickelt und diese anschließend sauber, nachvollziehbar und dauerhaft implementiert.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Daten zuverlässig zwischen unseren Systemen übertragen werden.

  • Du analysierst Fehler und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen statt kurzfristiger Workarounds.

  • Du dokumentierst Prozesse, Systeme und Automationen nachvollziehbar.

  • Du überprüfst bestehende Lösungen regelmäßig auf Stabilität, Effizienz und mögliche Verbesserungen.


So sieht dein Arbeitsalltag aus

Ein großer Teil deiner Arbeit besteht darin, bestehende Abläufe zu verstehen und daraus funktionierende digitale Systeme zu entwickeln.

Du bekommst beispielsweise einen Prozess aus Vertrieb, Marketing, Kundenbetreuung oder interner Organisation und analysierst zunächst:

Was passiert aktuell? Wo entstehen Fehler oder unnötige manuelle Schritte? Welche Daten werden benötigt? Welche Systeme sind beteiligt? Und was lässt sich sinnvoll automatisieren?

Anschließend entwickelst du eine Lösung, setzt sie technisch um, testest sie und dokumentierst den neuen Ablauf.

Dabei arbeitest du überwiegend konzentriert und eigenständig an deinen Aufgaben und Projekten. Für fachliche Anforderungen stimmst du dich direkt mit den zuständigen Kollegen ab.

Wir legen Wert darauf, dass Lösungen nicht nur technisch funktionieren, sondern verständlich dokumentiert, stabil und langfristig wartbar sind.


Die Stelle passt besonders gut zu dir, wenn …

  • du gerne logisch und analytisch denkst,

  • du komplexe Abläufe schnell verstehen kannst,

  • du Spaß daran hast, Probleme systematisch zu lösen,

  • du sehr strukturiert und präzise arbeitest,

  • du lieber eine saubere langfristige Lösung entwickelst als mehrere kurzfristige Workarounds,

  • du dich längere Zeit konzentriert mit einem Problem beschäftigen kannst,

  • du bestehende Prozesse zunächst verstehen möchtest, bevor du sie veränderst,

  • du gerne eigenständig arbeitest, Anforderungen aber zuverlässig mit anderen abstimmst,

  • du Fehler nicht nur behebst, sondern ihre Ursache verstehen möchtest,

  • du Wert auf Dokumentation und nachvollziehbare Systeme legst,

  • du Verantwortung für die Funktionsfähigkeit deiner Lösungen übernimmst,

  • du gerne einen Bereich langfristig aufbaust und immer besser verstehst.


Das solltest du mitbringen

  • abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einen vergleichbaren fachlichen Hintergrund

  • sehr gutes analytisches und strukturiertes Denkvermögen

  • schnelle Auffassungsgabe

  • gutes Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse und deren Digitalisierung

  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Systemlandschaften und SaaS-Anwendungen

  • Verständnis von APIs, Webhooks und Schnittstellen

  • Erfahrung mit Automatisierungsplattformen oder die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in diese einzuarbeiten

  • hohe Lösungs- und Ergebnisorientierung

  • sorgfältige und nachvollziehbare Dokumentation

  • eigenständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Erfahrung mit n8n, Make, Zapier oder vergleichbaren Automatisierungsplattformen ist von Vorteil.

Entscheidend ist für uns aber nicht, dass du bereits jedes von uns eingesetzte System kennst. Wichtiger ist, dass du technische Zusammenhänge verstehst und dich strukturiert in neue Lösungen einarbeiten kannst.


Deine Einarbeitung bei ESH

Zu Beginn lernst du unsere bestehenden Systeme, Geschäftsprozesse und Zuständigkeiten kennen.

Wir zeigen dir, wie Informationen zwischen den einzelnen Bereichen fließen, welche Abläufe bereits automatisiert sind und wo aktuell noch manuelle Schritte bestehen.

Danach übernimmst du schrittweise eigene Prozesse und Projekte.

Bestehende Dokumentationen, feste Ansprechpartner und unsere interne Schulungsplattform helfen dir dabei, schnell ein vollständiges Verständnis unserer Abläufe aufzubauen.

Unser Ziel ist, dass du unsere digitale Infrastruktur zunehmend eigenständig betreust, weiterentwickelst und optimierst.


Was gute IT-Arbeit für uns bedeutet

Wir führen keine neue Software ein, nur weil sie gerade neu oder interessant ist.

Technologie soll unsere Arbeit einfacher, zuverlässiger und effizienter machen.

Deshalb erwarten wir, dass du zunächst das Problem verstehst und anschließend die technisch sinnvollste Lösung entwickelst.

Eine gute Lösung ist für uns:

  • skalierbar

  • und für die Menschen nutzbar, die täglich damit arbeiten.

Du bekommst nicht nur einzelne IT-Tickets, sondern übernimmst Verantwortung für digitale Prozesse, Automationen und Systeme.

Viele deiner Aufgaben erfordern Ruhe und analytisches Denken. Deshalb sollst du ausreichend Zeit haben, dich konzentriert in technische Fragestellungen einzuarbeiten.

Bei neuen Projekten klären wir zunächst gemeinsam das gewünschte Ergebnis und die fachlichen Anforderungen.

Innerhalb dieses Rahmens entwickelst du eigenständig die technische Lösung.

Moderne digitale Arbeitsweise

Wir arbeiten bereits stark digital und setzen verschiedene SaaS-Anwendungen, Automationen und Online-Systeme ein, die du weiterentwickeln und miteinander verbinden kannst.

Langfristige Perspektive

Unsere Prozesse und Systeme entwickeln sich mit dem Unternehmen weiter.

Wir suchen daher jemanden, der unsere technische Infrastruktur langfristig kennt, Verantwortung dafür übernimmt und sie kontinuierlich verbessert.

Ben jij die perfectionist met passie voor de Engelse taal?
Volg je het laatste nieuws en wil je een bijdrage leveren aan een overheidsinstantie met grote maatschappelijke relevantie?
Heb je affiniteit met wetenschappelijke artikelen en statistiek?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Bij het CBS vormt statistisch onderzoek de basis voor alle media-uitingen. Bij het vertaalbureau komen diverse verzoeken binnen vanuit de gehele organisatie. De Engelstalige website vervult een belangrijke rol in het verspreiden van informatie onder niet-Nederlandstaligen.

Je gaat aan de slag met het vertalen en reviseren van content voor de CBS-website.

Je maakt gebruik van vertaaltools (onder andere MemoQ).

Omdat je gelijktijdig aan meerdere publicaties werkt, leer je een goede planning te maken en ervaar je hoe het is om te werken met deadlines.

Je schakelt met opdrachtgevers, een extern vertaalbureau en raadpleegt referentiemateriaal.

Onze producties zijn te vinden op https://www.cbs.nl/en-gb

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

Je komt in een klein team en wordt intensief begeleid. Er wordt nauw samengewerkt met o.a. het redactieteam en collega's van logistiek en planning. Daarnaast is er contact met diverse afdelingen. Het vertaalbureau levert per maand zo'n 40 producten af, waaronder nieuwsberichten, webpagina's, corporate artikelen, brieven en presentaties.

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een opleiding tot vertaler met als studierichting Engels, of hebt een bachelor in Engels en bent bezig met een master Vertaalkunde.
Je hebt kennis van en enige ervaring met:

  • vertaaltools (liefst MemoQ);

  • vakontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI;

  • Microsoft Word, Excel en Adobe Acrobat;

  • Sociale media (LinkedIn).

Ook volg je het nieuws en de achtergronden in de media.

In deze stage krijg je de ruimte om je nauwkeurigheid, communicatieve vaardigheden en initiatief te laten zien. title: Workday Financial Systems Architect
descriptionHtml:
Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.


Why Systems at AMBOSS?

AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.

You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.

Where we are

Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

You will:

  • Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

  • Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

  • Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant.

  • Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved.

  • Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions.

  • Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible.

  • Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it.

You bring:

  • Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases).

  • Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags).

  • Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT.

  • Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools.

  • Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements.

  • Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use.

  • Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT

  • Proficiency in German

  • Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations

  • Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara

  • Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate

  • A Workday consulting or CoE background

  • A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context

You enjoy:

  • Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months.

  • Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands.

  • Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait.

  • Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first.

What success looks like after your first year:

  • The tenant runs without the implementation partner.

  • The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does.

  • The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end.

  • Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on.

Benefits:

🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

🥙Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town)

🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…)

title: Workplace Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book,which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

Due to the nature of this role, you will be required to work onsite in our Shoreditch office full time, Monday - Friday.


The challenges you’ll solve as our Workplace Coordinator

As our Workplace Coordinator, you will take broad ownership of our day-to-day office environment and supporting internal events. Working alongside a team of 4 in a highly visible role, you will be one of the first faces people see in the morning, ensuring our facilities run seamlessly while creating consistent, memorable cultural events that bring our team together.

  • Managing daily operations: Taking charge of reception duties, building opening checks, deliveries, post, and maintaining meeting rooms to keep the office highly organised.

  • Championing the visitor experience: Acting as the first point of contact by warmly greeting visitors, managing security passes, and ensuring an exceptional front-of-house experience.

  • Overseeing facilities and maintenance: Managing stock, refreshments, and essential maintenance while handling relationships with landlords, contractors, and suppliers.

  • Improving and automating processes: Spotting opportunities to replace manual workflows with automated solutions for tasks like issue reporting, capacity tracking, and event workflows.

  • Creating memorable events: Planning and delivering company celebrations and cultural events, including sourcing suppliers, managing budgets, and documenting contingency plans.

  • Supporting the wider team: Working seamlessly across the workplace function to cover responsibilities, step in during absences, and collaborate with key stakeholders like IT, People, Finance, and the kitchen team.

You should apply if...

  • You have proven experience in a customer-facing role - either in workplace, front of house, hospitality or general customer service - with a natural ability to provide a welcoming experience.

  • You possess meticulous attention to detail, consistently documenting your work and leaving no stone unturned.

  • You are a self-starter who proactively spots and fixes problems without needing to be prompted.

  • You have the ability to manage facilities work, general maintenance, and hold external contractors and suppliers accountable.

  • You love planning - events, holidays, travel, whatever it is, you're the go to when it comes to ensuring everything runs without a hitch.

  • You are tech-savvy, able to quickly learn new software and computer systems without extensive training.

  • You naturally align with our core principles: you are relentlessly resourceful, enjoy succeeding together, and you prefer to be a driver, not a passenger.

What’s in it for you?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers

  • £32,000 - £36,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

  • Equity: £7,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week

  • Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat

Compensation: £32K – £36K • Offers Equity
